## Part 4: Key Implementation Details

### 4.1 Text Overlay on Video (LVGL)

**Chosen: LVGL Overlay** - Rich typography, word wrap, polished look

```cpp
// text_overlay.cpp
#include <lvgl.h>

static lv_obj_t* text_layer = nullptr;
static lv_obj_t* label = nullptr;

void initTextOverlay() {
    // Create semi-transparent container
    text_layer = lv_obj_create(lv_scr_act());
    lv_obj_set_size(text_layer, 230, 120);
    lv_obj_align(text_layer, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -10);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(text_layer, LV_OPA_80, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x001100), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(text_layer, 2, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(text_layer, 8, 0);

    // Create label with retro monospace font
    label = lv_label_create(text_layer);
    lv_label_set_long_mode(label, LV_LABEL_LONG_WRAP);
    lv_obj_set_width(label, 210);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);  // Matrix green
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
    lv_obj_center(label);

    // Initially hidden
    lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
}

void showText(const char* text) {
    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
        lv_label_set_text(label, text);
        lv_obj_clear_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        lvgl_unlock();
    }
}

void hideText() {
    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
        lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        lvgl_unlock();
    }
}

// For streaming LLM output character-by-character
void appendText(const char* chunk) {
    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
        const char* current = lv_label_get_text(label);
        String updated = String(current) + chunk;
        lv_label_set_text(label, updated.c_str());
        lvgl_unlock();
    }
}
```

### 4.2 Wake Word → Recording Transition

```cpp
void transitionToRecording() {
    // 1. Stop wake word detection
    wakeWord.end();  // Frees ~700KB PSRAM

    // 2. Reconfigure I2S for recording (same pins, different buffer size)
    recorder.begin(RECORD_DURATION_MS);

    // 3. Visual feedback
    video.showText("Listening...");

    // 4. Record
    int16_t* audio = recorder.record();  // Blocking, returns PSRAM buffer
    size_t samples = recorder.getSampleCount();

    // 5. Save to SD
    saveAudioToSD(audio, samples);

    // 6. Transition to embedding
    transitionToEmbedding(audio, samples);
}
```

### 4.3 Cosine Similarity Search

```cpp
// embed_search.cpp
class EmbeddingSearch {
    float* embeddings;      // 300 × 256 floats from SD
    char** intents;         // 300 strings from SD
    int count;

public:
    bool begin(const char* embed_path, const char* intent_path) {
        // Load embeddings.bin (307KB) to PSRAM
        embeddings = (float*)ps_malloc(300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
        File f = SD.open(embed_path);
        f.read((uint8_t*)embeddings, 300 * 256 * sizeof(float));

        // Load intents.txt (one per line)
        // ...
    }

    SearchResult search(float* query_embed) {
        float best_score = -1;
        int best_idx = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            float score = cosineSimilarity(query_embed, &embeddings[i * 256], 256);
            if (score > best_score) {
                best_score = score;
                best_idx = i;
            }
        }

        return {intents[best_idx], best_score};
    }

private:
    float cosineSimilarity(float* a, float* b, int len) {
        float dot = 0, norm_a = 0, norm_b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            dot += a[i] * b[i];
            norm_a += a[i] * a[i];
            norm_b += b[i] * b[i];
        }
        return dot / (sqrtf(norm_a) * sqrtf(norm_b));
    }
};
```

### 4.4 Robotic TTS with SAM (Software Automatic Mouth)

**Chosen: SAM** - Any text input, classic 1980s computer voice

SAM is the legendary Commodore 64 / Apple II speech synthesizer. It converts
arbitrary English text to phonemes and synthesizes robotic speech. Perfect for
that retro "talking computer" vibe!

```cpp
// robot_tts.cpp
// Using ESP32-SAM port: https://github.com/pschatzmann/ESP32-SAM

#include "ESP32SAM.h"
#include "AudioOutputI2S.h"

class RobotTTS {
private:
    AudioOutputI2S* out = nullptr;
    ESP32SAM* sam = nullptr;

public:
    bool begin() {
        // Configure I2S for MAX98357A speaker
        out = new AudioOutputI2S();
        out->SetPinout(6, 7, 8);  // BCLK, LRC, DOUT
        out->SetGain(0.5);        // Volume control
        out->begin();

        sam = new ESP32SAM();
        return true;
    }

    void speak(const char* text) {
        // SAM handles text-to-phoneme conversion internally
        // Output: 22050Hz mono audio
        sam->Say(out, text);
    }

    // For more robotic effect, adjust voice parameters
    void setRoboticVoice() {
        sam->SetSpeed(72);      // Default 72, lower = slower
        sam->SetPitch(64);      // Default 64, higher = squeakier
        sam->SetThroat(128);    // Default 128, affects resonance
        sam->SetMouth(128);     // Default 128, affects articulation
    }

    // Ultra robotic: pitch down, slow, mechanical
    void setUltraRobotic() {
        sam->SetSpeed(50);      // Slow and deliberate
        sam->SetPitch(40);      // Deep, mechanical
        sam->SetThroat(160);    // More robotic resonance
        sam->SetMouth(100);     // Slightly muffled
    }

    void end() {
        if (sam) { delete sam; sam = nullptr; }
        if (out) { delete out; out = nullptr; }
    }
};

// Usage in main sketch:
RobotTTS tts;

void setup() {
    tts.begin();
    tts.setUltraRobotic();  // Maximum robot vibes!
}

void speakResponse(const char* text) {
    video.showText(text);      // Show on screen
    tts.speak(text);           // Speak robotically
    delay(2000);               // Pause after speaking
    video.hideText();          // Resume logo
}
```

**Memory footprint**: ~50KB ROM for SAM phoneme tables
**Latency**: Near-instant start (no model loading)
**Quality**: Authentic 1980s computer voice - perfect for badge aesthetic!

### 4.5 Deep Sleep with Accelerometer Wake

```cpp
// sleep_manager.cpp
#include "esp_sleep.h"
#include "driver/rtc_io.h"

#define ACCEL_INT_PIN GPIO_NUM_XX  // QMI8658 INT pin (check schematic)

void enterDeepSleep() {
    // Save state to RTC memory
    RTC_DATA_ATTR static uint8_t last_rotation;
    last_rotation = video.getRotation();

    // Configure QMI8658 motion interrupt
    // (Set high-g threshold, enable interrupt output)
    configureAccelInterrupt();

    // Configure wake source
    esp_sleep_enable_ext0_wakeup(ACCEL_INT_PIN, 1);  // Wake on HIGH

    // Enter deep sleep
    esp_deep_sleep_start();
}

void setup() {
    if (esp_sleep_get_wakeup_cause() == ESP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_EXT0) {
        // Woke from shake - restore state
        video.setRotation(last_rotation);
    }
    // Normal boot...
}
```

## Part 6: Risk Mitigation

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| PSRAM fragmentation | Use fixed memory pool, sequential load/unload |
| Wake word false positives | Tune threshold in config.json, add cooldown |
| Embedding mismatch | Start with high threshold (0.8), tune down |
| LLM hallucination | Train on exact Q&A, use low temperature |
| TTS unintelligible | Test Talkie vs SAM, choose clearer one |
| WiFi unreliable | Graceful degradation, work fully offline |
| Deep sleep instability | Test thoroughly, add watchdog timer |
| SD card corruption | Use safe write patterns, checksums |

     9→
    10→#include <FFat.h>
    11→#include <Wire.h>
    12→#include <Arduino_GFX_Library.h>
    13→#include <OneButton.h>
    14→#include <FastIMU.h>
    15→#include "MjpegClass.h"
    16→
    17→// Hardware configuration
    18→#define LCD_CS 45
    19→#define LCD_DC 42
    20→#define LCD_BL 1
    21→#define BTN_BOOT 0
    22→
    23→// IMU configuration
    24→#define IMU_ADDRESS 0x6B
    25→#define I2C_SDA 48
    26→#define I2C_SCL 47
    27→
    28→// IMU objects
    29→QMI8658 IMU;
    30→calData calib = {0};
    31→AccelData accelData;
    32→
    33→// Memory stream for PSRAM playback
    34→class MemoryStream : public Stream {
    35→  uint8_t *buf;
    36→  size_t sz, pos;
    37→public:
    38→  MemoryStream(uint8_t *b, size_t s) : buf(b), sz(s), pos(0) {}
    39→  int available() override { return sz - pos; }
    40→  int read() override { return (pos < sz) ? buf[pos++] : -1; }
    41→  int peek() override { return (pos < sz) ? buf[pos] : -1; }
    42→  size_t readBytes(char *b, size_t len) override {
    43→    size_t n = min(len, sz - pos);
    44→    memcpy(b, buf + pos, n);
    45→    pos += n;
    46→    return n;
    47→  }
    48→  void reset() { pos = 0; }
    49→  size_t write(uint8_t) override { return 0; }
    50→  void flush() override {}
    51→};
    52→
    53→// Orientation manager with debounced rotation detection
    54→class OrientationManager {
    55→  const float THRESHOLD = 0.5;           // Hysteresis threshold (±0.5g)
    56→  const unsigned long DEBOUNCE_MS = 1000; // 1 second stability required
    57→  const unsigned long POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 50; // Poll at 20Hz
    58→
    59→  uint8_t currentRotation;    // Stable rotation: 1 (USB right) or 3 (USB left)
    60→  uint8_t pendingRotation;    // Candidate rotation during debounce (0 = none)
    61→  unsigned long debounceStartTime;
    62→  unsigned long lastPollTime;
    63→  bool rotationJustChanged;   // One-shot flag for change detection
    64→  bool imuAvailable;
    65→
    66→public:
    67→  OrientationManager() : currentRotation(1), pendingRotation(0),
    68→                         debounceStartTime(0), lastPollTime(0),
    69→                         rotationJustChanged(false), imuAvailable(true) {}
    70→
    71→  void setImuAvailable(bool available) {
    72→    imuAvailable = available;
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  void update() {
    76→    if (!imuAvailable) return;
    77→
    78→    unsigned long now = millis();
    79→    if (now - lastPollTime < POLL_INTERVAL_MS) return;
    80→    lastPollTime = now;
    81→
    82→    // Read accelerometer
    83→    IMU.update();
    84→    IMU.getAccel(&accelData);
    85→    float accelY = accelData.accelY;
    86→
    87→    // Determine desired rotation based on accelY
    88→    uint8_t desiredRotation = 0;
    89→    if (accelY > THRESHOLD) {
    90→      desiredRotation = 1;  // USB on right (normal)
    91→    } else if (accelY < -THRESHOLD) {
    92→      desiredRotation = 3;  // USB on left (180° flip)
    93→    } else {
    94→      desiredRotation = currentRotation; // Hysteresis zone - keep current
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    // State machine logic
    98→    if (desiredRotation == currentRotation) {
    99→      // Orientation matches current stable state
   100→      pendingRotation = 0; // Cancel any pending transition
   101→    } else if (pendingRotation == 0) {
   102→      // Start new transition
   103→      pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
   104→      debounceStartTime = now;
   105→    } else if (pendingRotation == desiredRotation) {
   106→      // Transition in progress, check if debounce time elapsed
   107→      if (now - debounceStartTime >= DEBOUNCE_MS) {
   108→        // Commit rotation change
   109→        currentRotation = pendingRotation;
   110→        pendingRotation = 0;
   111→        rotationJustChanged = true;
   112→      }
   113→    } else {
   114→      // Desired rotation changed during debounce - restart
   115→      pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
   116→      debounceStartTime = now;
   117→    }
   118→  }
   119→
   120→  uint8_t getRotation() {
   121→    return currentRotation;
   122→  }
   123→
   124→  bool hasChanged() {
   125→    if (rotationJustChanged) {
   126→      rotationJustChanged = false; // Clear one-shot flag
   127→      return true;
   128→    }
   129→    return false;
   130→  }
   131→};
   132→
   133→// Video player class
   134→class VideoPlayer {
   135→  Arduino_GFX *display;
   136→  MjpegClass decoder;
   137→  MemoryStream *stream;
   138→  uint8_t *videoBuf, *decodeBuf;
   139→  bool paused;
   140→  bool powered;
   141→
   142→  static VideoPlayer *instance;
   143→  static int drawCallback(JPEGDRAW *d) {
   144→    instance->display->draw16bitBeRGBBitmap(d->x, d->y, d->pPixels, d->iWidth, d->iHeight);
   145→    return 1;
   146→  }
   147→
   148→public:
   149→  VideoPlayer() : display(nullptr), stream(nullptr), videoBuf(nullptr), decodeBuf(nullptr), paused(false), powered(true) {
   150→    instance = this;
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  void togglePause() {
   154→    paused = !paused;
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  void powerOff() {
   158→    if (!powered) return;
   159→    powered = false;
   160→    paused = true;
   161→    display->fillScreen(BLACK);
   162→    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, LOW);
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  void powerOn() {
   166→    if (powered) return;
   167→    powered = true;
   168→    paused = false;
   169→    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, HIGH);
   170→  }
   171→
   172→  void togglePower() {
   173→    if (powered) {
   174→      powerOff();
   175→    } else {
   176→      powerOn();
   177→    }
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  void setRotation(uint8_t rotation) {
   181→    if (!display) return;
   182→    display->setRotation(rotation);
   183→  }
   184→
   185→  bool begin() {
   186→    // Init display
   187→    Arduino_DataBus *bus = new Arduino_ESP32SPI(LCD_DC, LCD_CS, 39, 38, 40);
   188→    display = new Arduino_ST7789(bus, -1, 1, true, 240, 320);
   189→    if (!display->begin()) return false;
   190→    pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
   191→    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, HIGH);
   192→    display->fillScreen(BLACK);
   193→
   194→    // Mount flash and load video
   195→    if (!FFat.begin(false, "", 1)) return false;
   196→    File f = FFat.open("/output.mjpeg", "r");
   197→    if (!f) return false;
   198→
   199→    size_t sz = f.size();
   200→    videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(sz);
   201→    if (!videoBuf || f.read(videoBuf, sz) != sz) {
   202→      f.close();
   203→      return false;
   204→    }
   205→    f.close();
   206→
   207→    // Setup decoder
   208→    stream = new MemoryStream(videoBuf, sz);
   209→    decodeBuf = (uint8_t*)malloc(320 * 240 / 2);
   210→    return decodeBuf && decoder.setup(stream, decodeBuf, drawCallback, true, 0, 0, 320, 240);
   211→  }
   212→
   213→  void play() {
   214→    if (!powered || paused) return;
   215→
   216→    if (decoder.readMjpegBuf()) {
   217→      decoder.drawJpg();
   218→    } else {
   219→      stream->reset();
   220→      decoder.reset();
   221→    }
   222→  }
   223→};
   224→
   225→VideoPlayer *VideoPlayer::instance = nullptr;
   226→VideoPlayer player;
   227→OrientationManager orientationMgr;
   228→
   229→// Button setup
   230→OneButton button(BTN_BOOT, true);
   231→
   232→void onButtonClick() {
   233→  player.togglePause();
   234→}
   235→
   236→void onButtonLongPressStart() {
   237→  player.togglePower();
   238→}
   239→
   240→void setup() {
   241→  // Initialize IMU
   242→  Wire.begin(I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL);
   243→  int imuErr = IMU.init(calib, IMU_ADDRESS);
   244→  if (imuErr != 0) {
   245→    orientationMgr.setImuAvailable(false);
   246→  }
   247→  // Note: If IMU fails, we continue anyway - rotation feature will be disabled
   248→  // but video playback still works
   249→
   250→  if (!player.begin()) {
   251→    pinMode(LED_BUILTIN, OUTPUT);
   252→    while(1) { digitalWrite(LED_BUILTIN, !digitalRead(LED_BUILTIN)); delay(500); }
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  button.attachClick(onButtonClick);
   256→  button.attachLongPressStart(onButtonLongPressStart);
   257→}
   258→
   259→void loop() {
   260→  orientationMgr.update();
   261→
   262→  // Handle rotation changes
   263→  if (orientationMgr.hasChanged()) {
   264→    player.setRotation(orientationMgr.getRotation());
   265→  }
   266→
   267→  button.tick();
   268→  player.play();
   269→}

     1→/*******************************************************************************
     2→ * MJPEG Parser and Decoder
     3→ * Parses MJPEG format and decodes JPEG frames using JPEGDEC library
     4→ ******************************************************************************/
     5→
     6→#pragma once
     7→#include <FS.h>
     8→#include <JPEGDEC.h>
     9→
    10→#define READ_BUFFER_SIZE 1024
    11→
    12→class MjpegClass {
    13→public:
    14→  bool setup(Stream *input, uint8_t *mjpeg_buf, JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *pfnDraw,
    15→             bool useBigEndian, int x, int y, int widthLimit, int heightLimit) {
    16→    _input = input;
    17→    _mjpeg_buf = mjpeg_buf;
    18→    _pfnDraw = pfnDraw;
    19→    _useBigEndian = useBigEndian;
    20→    _x = x;
    21→    _y = y;
    22→    _widthLimit = widthLimit;
    23→    _heightLimit = heightLimit;
    24→    _inputindex = 0;
    25→
    26→    if (!_read_buf) {
    27→      _read_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    28→    }
    29→    return _read_buf != nullptr;
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  // Read next JPEG frame from MJPEG stream (searches for FF D8/FF D9 markers)
    33→  bool readMjpegBuf() {
    34→    if (_inputindex == 0) {
    35→      _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    36→      _inputindex += _buf_read;
    37→    }
    38→    _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    39→    int i = 0;
    40→    bool found_FFD8 = false;
    41→
    42→    // Search for JPEG Start of Image (FF D8)
    43→    while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    44→      i = 0;
    45→      while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    46→        if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
    47→          found_FFD8 = true;
    48→        }
    49→        ++i;
    50→      }
    51→      if (found_FFD8) {
    52→        --i;
    53→      } else {
    54→        _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    55→      }
    56→    }
    57→
    58→    uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
    59→    _buf_read -= i;
    60→    bool found_FFD9 = false;
    61→
    62→    // Copy JPEG data and search for End of Image (FF D9)
    63→    if (_buf_read > 0) {
    64→      i = 3;
    65→      while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    66→        if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
    67→          found_FFD9 = true;
    68→        } else {
    69→          while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    70→            if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
    71→              found_FFD9 = true;
    72→              ++i;
    73→            }
    74→            ++i;
    75→          }
    76→        }
    77→
    78→        memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
    79→        _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
    80→        size_t o = _buf_read - i;
    81→
    82→        if (o > 0) {
    83→          memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
    84→          _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
    85→          _p = _read_buf;
    86→          _inputindex += _buf_read;
    87→          _buf_read += o;
    88→        } else {
    89→          _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    90→          _p = _read_buf;
    91→          _inputindex += _buf_read;
    92→        }
    93→        i = 0;
    94→      }
    95→      return found_FFD9;
    96→    }
    97→    return false;
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  // Decode and draw current JPEG frame
   101→  bool drawJpg() {
   102→    _remain = _mjpeg_buf_offset;
   103→
   104→    if (_jpeg.openRAM(_mjpeg_buf, _remain, _pfnDraw) != 1) return false;
   105→
   106→    if (_scale == -1) {
   107→      // Calculate scale to fit screen
   108→      int iMaxMCUs;
   109→      int w = _jpeg.getWidth();
   110→      int h = _jpeg.getHeight();
   111→      float ratio = (float)h / _heightLimit;
   112→
   113→      if (ratio <= 1) {
   114→        _scale = 0;
   115→        iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 16;
   116→      } else if (ratio <= 2) {
   117→        _scale = JPEG_SCALE_HALF;
   118→        iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 8;
   119→        w /= 2;
   120→        h /= 2;
   121→      } else if (ratio <= 4) {
   122→        _scale = JPEG_SCALE_QUARTER;
   123→        iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 4;
   124→        w /= 4;
   125→        h /= 4;
   126→      } else {
   127→        _scale = JPEG_SCALE_EIGHTH;
   128→        iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 2;
   129→        w /= 8;
   130→        h /= 8;
   131→      }
   132→
   133→      _jpeg.setMaxOutputSize(iMaxMCUs);
   134→      _x = (w > _widthLimit) ? 0 : ((_widthLimit - w) / 2);
   135→      _y = (_heightLimit - h) / 2;
   136→    }
   137→
   138→    if (_useBigEndian) {
   139→      _jpeg.setPixelType(RGB565_BIG_ENDIAN);
   140→    }
   141→
   142→    if (_jpeg.decode(_x, _y, _scale) != 1) {
   143→      _jpeg.close();
   144→      return false;
   145→    }
   146→
   147→    _jpeg.close();
   148→    return true;
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  // Reset decoder state for looping
   152→  void reset() {
   153→    _inputindex = 0;
   154→    _buf_read = 0;
   155→    _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   156→  }
   157→
   158→private:
   159→  Stream *_input;
   160→  uint8_t *_mjpeg_buf;
   161→  JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *_pfnDraw;
   162→  bool _useBigEndian;
   163→  int _x, _y, _widthLimit, _heightLimit;
   164→  uint8_t *_read_buf = nullptr;
   165→  int32_t _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   166→  JPEGDEC _jpeg;
   167→  int _scale = -1;
   168→  int32_t _inputindex = 0;
   169→  int32_t _buf_read;
   170→  int32_t _remain = 0;
   171→};

    39→  const TickType_t timeout_ticks = (timeout_ms == -1) ? portMAX_DELAY : pdMS_TO_TICKS(timeout_ms);

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Video Player Module
 * MJPEG playback with gyro rotation and text overlay support
 ******************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Stream.h>

// Forward declare to avoid circular includes
class Arduino_GFX;

//==============================================================================
// Memory Stream - Wraps PSRAM buffer as a Stream for MJPEG decoder
//==============================================================================
class MemoryStream : public Stream {
public:
    MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size);

    int available() override;
    int read() override;
    int peek() override;
    size_t readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) override;
    void reset();

    // Required Stream methods (write not supported)
    size_t write(uint8_t) override { return 0; }
    void flush() override {}

private:
    uint8_t* _buffer;
    size_t _size;
    size_t _position;
};

//==============================================================================
// Video Player - Handles MJPEG playback and display
//==============================================================================
class VideoPlayer {
public:
    VideoPlayer();
    ~VideoPlayer();

    // Lifecycle
    bool begin(const char* videoPath = nullptr);  // nullptr = use FFat /output.mjpeg
    void end();

    // Playback control
    void play();           // Decode and display one frame
    void pause();
    void resume();
    void togglePause();
    bool isPaused() const { return _paused; }

    // Power control
    void powerOff();       // Blank screen + backlight off
    void powerOn();        // Restore display + backlight
    void togglePower();
    bool isPowered() const { return _powered; }

    // Orientation
    void setRotation(uint8_t rotation);
    uint8_t getRotation() const { return _rotation; }

    // Text overlay (pauses video, shows text box)
    void showText(const char* text);
    void appendText(const char* chunk);  // For streaming LLM output
    void clearText();
    void hideText();                      // Resume video playback
    bool isTextVisible() const { return _textVisible; }

    // Get display for direct access if needed
    Arduino_GFX* getDisplay() { return _display; }

private:
    // Display
    Arduino_GFX* _display;
    uint8_t _rotation;

    // Video buffer (PSRAM)
    uint8_t* _videoBuf;
    size_t _videoSize;
    MemoryStream* _stream;

    // Decoder
    uint8_t* _decodeBuf;
    void* _decoder;  // MjpegClass* (forward declared to keep header clean)

    // State
    bool _paused;
    bool _powered;
    bool _initialized;

    // Text overlay
    bool _textVisible;
    String _currentText;

    // JPEG draw callback (needs static for C callback)
    static VideoPlayer* _instance;
    static int _drawCallback(void* drawInfo);

    // Internal helpers
    void _drawTextBox();
    void _initDisplay();
    bool _loadVideo(const char* path);
};

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Video Player Implementation
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "video_player.h"
#include "../config.h"

#include <FFat.h>
#include <SD.h>
#include <Arduino_GFX_Library.h>
#include <JPEGDEC.h>

// Include MjpegClass inline to avoid separate header management
#define READ_BUFFER_SIZE 1024

class MjpegClass {
public:
    bool setup(Stream *input, uint8_t *mjpeg_buf, JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *pfnDraw,
               bool useBigEndian, int x, int y, int widthLimit, int heightLimit) {
        _input = input;
        _mjpeg_buf = mjpeg_buf;
        _pfnDraw = pfnDraw;
        _useBigEndian = useBigEndian;
        _x = x;
        _y = y;
        _widthLimit = widthLimit;
        _heightLimit = heightLimit;
        _inputindex = 0;

        if (!_read_buf) {
            _read_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
        }
        return _read_buf != nullptr;
    }

    bool readMjpegBuf() {
        if (_inputindex == 0) {
            _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
            _inputindex += _buf_read;
        }
        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
        int i = 0;
        bool found_FFD8 = false;

        while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
            i = 0;
            while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
                if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
                    found_FFD8 = true;
                }
                ++i;
            }
            if (found_FFD8) {
                --i;
            } else {
                _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
            }
        }

        uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
        _buf_read -= i;
        bool found_FFD9 = false;

        if (_buf_read > 0) {
            i = 3;
            while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
                if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
                    found_FFD9 = true;
                } else {
                    while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
                        if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
                            found_FFD9 = true;
                            ++i;
                        }
                        ++i;
                    }
                }

                memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
                _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
                size_t o = _buf_read - i;

                if (o > 0) {
                    memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
                    _p = _read_buf;
                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
                    _buf_read += o;
                } else {
                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
                    _p = _read_buf;
                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
                }
                i = 0;
            }
            return found_FFD9;
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool drawJpg() {
        _remain = _mjpeg_buf_offset;

        if (_jpeg.openRAM(_mjpeg_buf, _remain, _pfnDraw) != 1) return false;

        if (_scale == -1) {
            int iMaxMCUs;
            int w = _jpeg.getWidth();
            int h = _jpeg.getHeight();
            float ratio = (float)h / _heightLimit;

            if (ratio <= 1) {
                _scale = 0;
                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 16;
            } else if (ratio <= 2) {
                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_HALF;
                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 8;
                w /= 2;
                h /= 2;
            } else if (ratio <= 4) {
                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_QUARTER;
                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 4;
                w /= 4;
                h /= 4;
            } else {
                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_EIGHTH;
                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 2;
                w /= 8;
                h /= 8;
            }

            _jpeg.setMaxOutputSize(iMaxMCUs);
            _x = (w > _widthLimit) ? 0 : ((_widthLimit - w) / 2);
            _y = (_heightLimit - h) / 2;
        }

        if (_useBigEndian) {
            _jpeg.setPixelType(RGB565_BIG_ENDIAN);
        }

        if (_jpeg.decode(_x, _y, _scale) != 1) {
            _jpeg.close();
            return false;
        }

        _jpeg.close();
        return true;
    }

    void reset() {
        _inputindex = 0;
        _buf_read = 0;
        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    }

private:
    Stream *_input;
    uint8_t *_mjpeg_buf;
    JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *_pfnDraw;
    bool _useBigEndian;
    int _x, _y, _widthLimit, _heightLimit;
    uint8_t *_read_buf = nullptr;
    int32_t _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    JPEGDEC _jpeg;
    int _scale = -1;
    int32_t _inputindex = 0;
    int32_t _buf_read;
    int32_t _remain = 0;
};

//==============================================================================
// MemoryStream Implementation
//==============================================================================

MemoryStream::MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size)
    : _buffer(buffer), _size(size), _position(0) {}

int MemoryStream::available() {
    return _size - _position;
}

int MemoryStream::read() {
    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position++] : -1;
}

int MemoryStream::peek() {
    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position] : -1;
}

size_t MemoryStream::readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) {
    size_t n = min(length, _size - _position);
    memcpy(buffer, _buffer + _position, n);
    _position += n;
    return n;
}

void MemoryStream::reset() {
    _position = 0;
}

//==============================================================================
// VideoPlayer Implementation
//==============================================================================

VideoPlayer* VideoPlayer::_instance = nullptr;

VideoPlayer::VideoPlayer()
    : _display(nullptr)
    , _rotation(1)
    , _videoBuf(nullptr)
    , _videoSize(0)
    , _stream(nullptr)
    , _decodeBuf(nullptr)
    , _decoder(nullptr)
    , _paused(false)
    , _powered(true)
    , _initialized(false)
    , _textVisible(false)
{
    _instance = this;
}

VideoPlayer::~VideoPlayer() {
    end();
}

int VideoPlayer::_drawCallback(void* drawInfo) {
    JPEGDRAW* d = (JPEGDRAW*)drawInfo;
    if (_instance && _instance->_display) {
        _instance->_display->draw16bitBeRGBBitmap(d->x, d->y, d->pPixels, d->iWidth, d->iHeight);
    }
    return 1;
}

void VideoPlayer::_initDisplay() {
    Arduino_DataBus* bus = new Arduino_ESP32SPI(LCD_DC, LCD_CS, LCD_SCK, LCD_MOSI, LCD_MISO);
    _display = new Arduino_ST7789(bus, -1, _rotation, true, LCD_WIDTH, LCD_HEIGHT);

    if (!_display->begin()) {
        return;
    }

    pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, HIGH);
    _display->fillScreen(BLACK);
}

bool VideoPlayer::_loadVideo(const char* path) {
    File f;

    // Try SD card first if path provided, else FFat
    if (path) {
        f = SD.open(path, FILE_READ);
    } else {
        if (!FFat.begin(false, "", 1)) {
            return false;
        }
        f = FFat.open("/output.mjpeg", "r");
    }

    if (!f) {
        return false;
    }

    _videoSize = f.size();
    _videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_videoSize);
    if (!_videoBuf) {
        f.close();
        return false;
    }

    if (f.read(_videoBuf, _videoSize) != _videoSize) {
        free(_videoBuf);
        _videoBuf = nullptr;
        f.close();
        return false;
    }
    f.close();

    // Create stream and decoder
    _stream = new MemoryStream(_videoBuf, _videoSize);
    _decodeBuf = (uint8_t*)malloc(LCD_WIDTH * LCD_HEIGHT / 2);
    if (!_decodeBuf) {
        return false;
    }

    _decoder = new MjpegClass();
    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;

    return mjpeg->setup(_stream, _decodeBuf, _drawCallback, true, 0, 0, LCD_WIDTH, LCD_HEIGHT);
}

bool VideoPlayer::begin(const char* videoPath) {
    if (_initialized) return true;

    _initDisplay();
    if (!_display) return false;

    if (!_loadVideo(videoPath)) {
        return false;
    }

    _initialized = true;
    return true;
}

void VideoPlayer::end() {
    if (_decoder) {
        delete (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
        _decoder = nullptr;
    }
    if (_stream) {
        delete _stream;
        _stream = nullptr;
    }
    if (_decodeBuf) {
        free(_decodeBuf);
        _decodeBuf = nullptr;
    }
    if (_videoBuf) {
        free(_videoBuf);
        _videoBuf = nullptr;
    }
    _initialized = false;
}

void VideoPlayer::play() {
    if (!_powered || _paused || _textVisible || !_initialized) return;

    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
    if (mjpeg->readMjpegBuf()) {
        mjpeg->drawJpg();
    } else {
        // Loop video
        _stream->reset();
        mjpeg->reset();
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::pause() {
    _paused = true;
}

void VideoPlayer::resume() {
    _paused = false;
}

void VideoPlayer::togglePause() {
    _paused = !_paused;
}

void VideoPlayer::powerOff() {
    if (!_powered) return;
    _powered = false;
    _paused = true;
    if (_display) {
        _display->fillScreen(BLACK);
    }
    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, LOW);
}

void VideoPlayer::powerOn() {
    if (_powered) return;
    _powered = true;
    _paused = false;
    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, HIGH);
}

void VideoPlayer::togglePower() {
    if (_powered) {
        powerOff();
    } else {
        powerOn();
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::setRotation(uint8_t rotation) {
    _rotation = rotation;
    if (_display) {
        _display->setRotation(rotation);
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::_drawTextBox() {
    if (!_display || _currentText.length() == 0) return;

    // Text box dimensions
    const int boxHeight = 100;
    const int boxMargin = 5;
    const int textPadding = 8;
    const int boxY = LCD_HEIGHT - boxHeight - boxMargin;

    // Draw semi-transparent background
    _display->fillRect(boxMargin, boxY, LCD_WIDTH - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BG_COLOR);

    // Draw border
    _display->drawRect(boxMargin, boxY, LCD_WIDTH - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
    _display->drawRect(boxMargin + 1, boxY + 1, LCD_WIDTH - 2 * boxMargin - 2, boxHeight - 2, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);

    // Draw text
    _display->setTextColor(TEXT_COLOR);
    _display->setTextSize(2);
    _display->setTextWrap(true);

    // Calculate text position
    int textX = boxMargin + textPadding;
    int textY = boxY + textPadding;

    _display->setCursor(textX, textY);

    // Word wrap manually for better control
    String remaining = _currentText;
    int lineWidth = LCD_WIDTH - 2 * boxMargin - 2 * textPadding;
    int charWidth = 12;  // Approximate width per char at size 2
    int charsPerLine = lineWidth / charWidth;
    int lineHeight = 20;
    int maxLines = (boxHeight - 2 * textPadding) / lineHeight;

    int line = 0;
    while (remaining.length() > 0 && line < maxLines) {
        String lineToPrint;
        if (remaining.length() <= charsPerLine) {
            lineToPrint = remaining;
            remaining = "";
        } else {
            // Find last space before limit
            int breakPoint = charsPerLine;
            while (breakPoint > 0 && remaining[breakPoint] != ' ') {
                breakPoint--;
            }
            if (breakPoint == 0) breakPoint = charsPerLine;

            lineToPrint = remaining.substring(0, breakPoint);
            remaining = remaining.substring(breakPoint);
            remaining.trim();
        }

        _display->setCursor(textX, textY + line * lineHeight);
        _display->print(lineToPrint);
        line++;
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::showText(const char* text) {
    _currentText = text;
    _textVisible = true;
    _paused = true;

    // Clear area and draw text box
    if (_display) {
        _display->fillScreen(BLACK);
        _drawTextBox();
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::appendText(const char* chunk) {
    _currentText += chunk;

    // Redraw text box with updated text
    if (_textVisible && _display) {
        _drawTextBox();
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::clearText() {
    _currentText = "";
    if (_textVisible && _display) {
        _drawTextBox();
    }
}

void VideoPlayer::hideText() {
    _textVisible = false;
    _currentText = "";
    _paused = false;
    // Video will resume on next play() call
}

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Orientation Manager
 * Debounced rotation detection using IMU accelerometer
 ******************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <Arduino.h>

class OrientationManager {
public:
    OrientationManager();

    // Initialize IMU, returns false if IMU not available
    bool begin();

    // Call in loop() - polls IMU at configured interval
    void update();

    // Get current stable rotation (1 = USB right, 3 = USB left)
    uint8_t getRotation() const { return _currentRotation; }

    // Check if rotation just changed (one-shot, auto-clears)
    bool hasChanged();

    // Check if IMU is available
    bool isAvailable() const { return _imuAvailable; }

private:
    static const float THRESHOLD;           // Hysteresis threshold (g)
    static const unsigned long DEBOUNCE_MS; // Stability time required
    static const unsigned long POLL_MS;     // Poll interval

    uint8_t _currentRotation;     // Stable rotation
    uint8_t _pendingRotation;     // Candidate during debounce (0 = none)
    unsigned long _debounceStart;
    unsigned long _lastPoll;
    bool _rotationChanged;        // One-shot flag
    bool _imuAvailable;
};

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Orientation Manager Implementation
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "orientation.h"
#include "../config.h"

#include <Wire.h>
#include <FastIMU.h>

// Static constants
const float OrientationManager::THRESHOLD = 0.5f;
const unsigned long OrientationManager::DEBOUNCE_MS = ORIENTATION_DEBOUNCE_MS;
const unsigned long OrientationManager::POLL_MS = ORIENTATION_POLL_MS;

// IMU instance and data
static QMI8658 imu;
static calData calibration = {0};
static AccelData accelData;

OrientationManager::OrientationManager()
    : _currentRotation(1)
    , _pendingRotation(0)
    , _debounceStart(0)
    , _lastPoll(0)
    , _rotationChanged(false)
    , _imuAvailable(false)
{
}

bool OrientationManager::begin() {
    Wire.begin(I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL);

    int err = imu.init(calibration, IMU_ADDRESS);
    _imuAvailable = (err == 0);

    return _imuAvailable;
}

void OrientationManager::update() {
    if (!_imuAvailable) return;

    unsigned long now = millis();
    if (now - _lastPoll < POLL_MS) return;
    _lastPoll = now;

    // Read accelerometer
    imu.update();
    imu.getAccel(&accelData);
    float accelY = accelData.accelY;

    // Determine desired rotation based on accelY
    uint8_t desiredRotation = 0;
    if (accelY > THRESHOLD) {
        desiredRotation = 1;  // USB on right (normal)
    } else if (accelY < -THRESHOLD) {
        desiredRotation = 3;  // USB on left (180 flip)
    } else {
        desiredRotation = _currentRotation;  // Hysteresis zone - keep current
    }

    // State machine logic
    if (desiredRotation == _currentRotation) {
        // Orientation matches current stable state
        _pendingRotation = 0;  // Cancel any pending transition
    } else if (_pendingRotation == 0) {
        // Start new transition
        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
        _debounceStart = now;
    } else if (_pendingRotation == desiredRotation) {
        // Transition in progress, check if debounce time elapsed
        if (now - _debounceStart >= DEBOUNCE_MS) {
            // Commit rotation change
            _currentRotation = _pendingRotation;
            _pendingRotation = 0;
            _rotationChanged = true;
        }
    } else {
        // Desired rotation changed during debounce - restart
        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
        _debounceStart = now;
    }
}

bool OrientationManager::hasChanged() {
    if (_rotationChanged) {
        _rotationChanged = false;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS25 Badge - Main Application
 *
 * A smart conference badge with:
 * - Animated logo display with gyro rotation
 * - Wake word OR button activation
 * - Voice command processing via embeddings + LLM
 * - Robotic TTS output
 * - Deep sleep with shake-to-wake
 *
 * Phase 1: Video loop + button + text overlay + gyro rotation
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "config.h"
#include "display/video_player.h"
#include "sensors/orientation.h"

#include <OneButton.h>

//==============================================================================
// Global Objects
//==============================================================================

VideoPlayer video;
OrientationManager orientation;
OneButton button(BTN_BOOT, true);  // Active low

// Current application state
BadgeState currentState = STATE_BOOT;
unsigned long lastActivityTime = 0;

//==============================================================================
// State Machine Helpers
//==============================================================================

void setState(BadgeState newState) {
    if (currentState == newState) return;

    // Exit current state
    switch (currentState) {
        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
            // Nothing special to clean up
            break;
        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
            video.hideText();
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }

    currentState = newState;
    lastActivityTime = millis();

    // Enter new state
    switch (newState) {
        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
            video.resume();
            break;
        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
            video.pause();
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
}

void resetActivityTimer() {
    lastActivityTime = millis();
}

//==============================================================================
// Button Callbacks
//==============================================================================

void onButtonClick() {
    resetActivityTimer();

    switch (currentState) {
        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
            // Toggle pause for demo/testing
            video.togglePause();
            break;

        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
            // Hide text and return to logo
            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
            break;

        default:
            break;
    }
}

void onButtonDoubleClick() {
    resetActivityTimer();

    // Double-click: Show demo text overlay
    if (currentState == STATE_LOGO_LOOP) {
        video.showText("Hello! I am OAISYS, your AI conference badge. Ask me anything!");
        setState(STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE);
    }
}

void onButtonLongPressStart() {
    resetActivityTimer();

    // Long press: Toggle power (blank screen)
    video.togglePower();
}

//==============================================================================
// State Handlers
//==============================================================================

void handleLogoLoop() {
    // Update orientation
    orientation.update();
    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
    }

    // Play video frame
    video.play();

    // Check for idle timeout (Phase 6 will add deep sleep)
    // For now, just track activity
}

void handleDisplayResponse() {
    // Just wait for button press to dismiss
    // In full implementation, this would have timeout
}

//==============================================================================
// Main Loop State Machine
//==============================================================================

void loop() {
    // Process button events
    button.tick();

    // State-specific handling
    switch (currentState) {
        case STATE_BOOT:
            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop
            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
            break;

        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
            handleLogoLoop();
            break;

        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
            handleDisplayResponse();
            break;

        // Future states (Phase 2+)
        case STATE_RECORDING:
        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
        case STATE_STASH_DATA:
        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
        case STATE_DEEP_SLEEP:
            // Not implemented yet - return to logo
            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
            break;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// Setup
//==============================================================================

void setup() {
    Serial.begin(115200);
    Serial.println("\n=== OAISYS25 Badge Starting ===");

    // Initialize orientation sensor (non-fatal if fails)
    if (!orientation.begin()) {
        Serial.println("IMU init failed - rotation disabled");
    } else {
        Serial.println("IMU initialized");
    }

    // Initialize video player
    Serial.println("Loading video...");
    if (!video.begin()) {
        Serial.println("ERROR: Video init failed!");
        // Blink LED to indicate error
        pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
        while (1) {
            digitalWrite(LCD_BL, !digitalRead(LCD_BL));
            delay(500);
        }
    }
    Serial.println("Video loaded");

    // Setup button callbacks
    button.attachClick(onButtonClick);
    button.attachDoubleClick(onButtonDoubleClick);
    button.attachLongPressStart(onButtonLongPressStart);

    // Ready to go
    lastActivityTime = millis();
    currentState = STATE_BOOT;

    Serial.println("=== Badge Ready ===");
    Serial.println("Controls:");
    Serial.println("  Click: Pause/resume video");
    Serial.println("  Double-click: Show demo text");
    Serial.println("  Long press: Power off/on");
}

# OAISYS25 Badge Firmware

Unified firmware integrating all badge functionality.

## Phase 1: Core (Current)
- Video loop playback (MJPEG from FFat)
- Gyro-based screen rotation
- Button controls (click/double-click/long-press)
- Text overlay system

## Hardware
- ESP32-S3-LCD-2 (Waveshare)
- ST7789 240x320 LCD
- QMI8658 IMU
- INMP441 Mics (x2)
- MAX98357A Speaker

## Building
1. Open `oaisys_badge.ino` in Arduino IDE 2.x
2. Select Board: ESP32S3 Dev Module
3. Settings:
   - Flash: 16MB
   - Partition: 16MB Flash (3MB APP/9MB FATFS)
   - PSRAM: OPI PSRAM
4. Upload sketch
5. Upload video to FFat partition (see upload_to_flash.sh in 00_video_loop_*)

## Controls (Phase 1)
- **Click**: Pause/resume video
- **Double-click**: Show demo text overlay
- **Long press**: Power off/on (blank screen)

## Directory Structure
\```
oaisys_badge/
├── oaisys_badge.ino    # Main sketch
├── config.h            # Pin definitions
├── display/
│   └── video_player.*  # Video + text overlay
├── sensors/
│   └── orientation.*   # IMU rotation
├── audio/              # (Phase 2)
├── ml/                 # (Phase 3-4)
├── tts/                # (Phase 5)
├── network/            # (Phase 7)
├── storage/            # (Phase 7-8)
└── sd_data/            # Files for SD card
\```

## SD Card Layout (for later phases)
\```
SD:/
├── config.json
├── models/
│   ├── wake_word.tflite
│   ├── yamnet.tflite
│   ├── projection.tflite
│   ├── llm_model.bin
│   └── tokenizer.bin
├── data/
│   ├── embeddings.bin
│   └── intents.txt
└── stash/
\```

## Phase 1 Complete!

I've created the foundational `oaisys_badge` firmware with the following structure:

```
workbench/working_protos/oaisys_badge/
├── oaisys_badge.ino           # Main sketch with state machine
├── config.h                   # All pin definitions & constants
├── README.md                  # Build instructions
│
├── display/
│   ├── video_player.h         # Video player interface
│   └── video_player.cpp       # MJPEG playback + text overlay
│
├── sensors/
│   ├── orientation.h          # IMU rotation manager interface
│   └── orientation.cpp        # Debounced rotation detection
│
└── sd_data/
    └── config.json            # WiFi + threshold config template
```

### What's Implemented (Phase 1)

1. **State Machine** - Framework for all future states:
   - `STATE_BOOT` → `STATE_LOGO_LOOP` → `STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE` → back

2. **Video Player** with:
   - MJPEG decoding from FFat flash
   - Gyro-based auto-rotation (QMI8658 IMU)
   - Pause/resume/power control
   - **Text overlay** with Matrix-green styling

3. **Button Controls** (OneButton):
   - Click: Pause/resume
   - Double-click: Show demo text
   - Long press: Power off/on

### To Test

1. Open `oaisys_badge.ino` in Arduino IDE
2. Configure board settings (ESP32S3, 16MB Flash, OPI PSRAM)
3. Upload the sketch

    92→## Code Architecture
    93→
    94→### Video Player Architecture (`working_protos/00_video_loop*`)
    95→
    96→Optimized MJPEG player variants with minimal code footprint.
    97→
    98→**Design Pattern:**
    99→- **MemoryStream class**: Minimal Stream implementation for PSRAM buffer access
   100→- **VideoPlayer class**: Encapsulates display, flash I/O, and MJPEG decoding
   101→- **Singleton pattern**: Static instance for JPEG callback access
   102→- **RAII initialization**: All setup in `begin()`, simple `play()` for loop
   103→
   104→**Variants:**
   105→- `00_video_loop/` - Base video loop
   106→- `00_video_loop_btn_pause/` - Button pause/resume
   107→- `00_video_loop_btn_pause_gyro_rotate/` - IMU-based orientation
   108→
   109→### LLM Inference Architecture (`working_protos/01_llm_inference*`)
   110→
   111→Port of llama2.c for on-device text generation.
   112→
   113→**Files:**
   114→- `llm_core.cpp/h` - Transformer forward pass, attention, RoPE
   115→- `tokenizer.cpp/h` - BPE tokenizer (SentencePiece format)
   116→- `sampler.cpp/h` - Temperature/top-p sampling
   117→- `sd_data/` - Model and tokenizer binaries for SD card
   118→
   119→**Model Specs:**
   120→- `stories15m` - 15M param TinyStories (~15MB)
   121→- `stories260k` - 260K param TinyStories (~300KB, faster)
   122→
   123→**Usage:** Load model from SD card to PSRAM, generate token-by-token.
   124→
   125→### Wake Word Detection (`tests/wakeword_pretrained_test/`)
   126→
   127→microWakeWord-based detection using EdgeNeuron TFLite runtime.
   128→
   129→**Pipeline:**
   130→1. INMP441 mic → 16kHz audio capture
   131→2. Microfrontend → 40-bin log-mel spectrogram (30ms window, 10ms stride)
   132→3. EdgeNeuron → TFLite inference every 10ms
   133→4. Sliding window → Probability averaging → Detection trigger
   134→
   135→**Configuration:** JSON config on SD card controls thresholds:
   136→```json
   137→{"probability_cutoff": 0.5, "sliding_window_average_size": 10, ...}
   138→```
   139→
   140→**Training:** See `tests/wakeword_training_ipynb_poc/` for custom wake word training via Colab.
   141→
   142→### Audio Embedding Architecture (`tests/yamnet_audio_embedding_ipynb_poc/`)
   143→
   144→YAMNet-based 1024-D audio embeddings on ESP32-S3.
   145→
   146→**Pipeline:**
   147→1. Dual INMP441 mics → stereo capture → mono downmix
   148→2. ESP-DSP accelerated FFT → 64-mel × 96-frame spectrogram
   149→3. TensorFlowLite_ESP32 → YAMNet inference (dual-core optimized)
   150→4. Extract 1024-D embedding → JSON output
   151→
   152→**Performance:** ~10-14 seconds total (inference is the bottleneck at 6-10s).
   153→
   154→### Factory Demo Architecture (`ESP32-S3-LCD-2-Demo/Arduino/examples/01_factory`)
   155→
   156→Multi-module reference implementation showing full hardware capabilities.
   157→
   158→**BSP Layer (Board Support Package):**
   159→- `bsp_spi.h/.cpp`: Shared SPI bus with semaphore protection
   160→- `bsp_i2c.h/.cpp`: I2C bus for IMU
   161→- `bsp_lv_port.h/.cpp`: LVGL display driver integration
   162→- `bsp_button.h/.cpp`: Hardware button handling
   163→
   164→**App Layer:**
   165→- `app_qmi8658`: IMU data reading and visualization
   166→- `app_system`: System monitoring (battery, brightness)
   167→- `app_camera`: Camera integration
   168→- `app_wifi`: WiFi scanning and connection
   169→
   170→**UI Layer:**
   171→- `lvgl_ui/`: LVGL tabview UI
   172→- Each tab corresponds to an app module
   173→
   174→**Initialization Sequence:**
   175→```cpp
   176→setup() {
   177→  bsp_i2c_init();      // I2C bus
   178→  bsp_lv_port_init();  // Display + LVGL
   179→  bsp_spi_init();      // Shared SPI
   180→  bsp_button_init();   // Buttons
   181→
   182→  lvgl_ui_init();      // UI components
   183→
   184→  app_*_init();        // Module initialization
   185→  app_*_run();         // Start module tasks
   186→}
   187→```
   188→
   189→### Key Libraries
   190→
   191→**Arduino_GFX_Library:**
   192→- Hardware abstraction for ST7789 display
   193→- SPI bus configuration: `Arduino_ESP32SPI`
   194→- Display driver: `Arduino_ST7789` (240x320, IPS mode)
   195→
   196→**LVGL (Light and Versatile Graphics Library):**
   197→- Must configure `lv_conf.h` before use
   198→- Factory example uses LVGL 8.x API
   199→- Thread safety via `lvgl_lock()`/`lvgl_unlock()`
   200→
   201→**JPEGDEC:**
   202→- Software JPEG decoder
   203→- Used by MjpegClass for frame-by-frame decoding
   204→- Callback-based rendering: `JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK`
   205→
   206→**MjpegClass:**
   207→- Custom MJPEG container parser (not a library)
   208→- Searches for JPEG markers (0xFFD8/0xFFD9) in stream
   209→- Extracts individual frames for JPEGDEC
   210→
   211→## FFat Partition Layout
   212→
   213→From `app3M_fat9M_16MB.csv`:
   214→```
   215→# Name,   Type, SubType, Offset,  Size
   216→nvs,      data, nvs,     0x9000,  0x5000
   217→otadata,  data, ota,     0xe000,  0x2000
   218→app0,     app,  ota_0,   0x10000, 0x300000
   219→app1,     app,  ota_1,   0x310000,0x300000
   220→ffat,     data, fat,     0x610000,0x9E0000
   221→```
   222→
   223→**Important:** Flash FFat images at offset **0x611000** (+0x1000 from partition start)
   224→
   225→## PSRAM Usage
   226→
   227→**Enabled via Arduino IDE settings:** OPI PSRAM
   228→
   229→**Allocation:**
   230→```cpp
   231→uint8_t* buffer = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(size);  // PSRAM
   232→uint8_t* buffer = (uint8_t*)malloc(size);     // Heap
   233→```
   234→
   235→**Best Practice:**
   236→- Large buffers (>100KB): Use PSRAM
   237→- Frame buffers, video data: PSRAM
   238→- Small work buffers: Heap
   239→
   240→## Common Patterns
   241→
   242→### Dual I2S Audio Architecture
   243→
   244→ESP32-S3 supports separate I2S buses for simultaneous input/output:
   245→
   246→```cpp
   247→// I2S0 for microphones (RX)
   248→i2s_config_t mic_config = {
   249→  .mode = I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_RX,
   250→  .sample_rate = 16000,
   251→  .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_32BIT,  // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame
   252→  .channel_format = I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_RIGHT_LEFT,
   253→  // ...
   254→};
   255→i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_0, &mic_config, 0, NULL);
   256→
   257→// I2S1 for speaker (TX)
   258→i2s_config_t spk_config = {
   259→  .mode = I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_TX,
   260→  .sample_rate = 16000,
   261→  .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_16BIT,
   262→  // ...
   263→};
   264→i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_1, &spk_config, 0, NULL);
   265→```
   266→
   267→See `workbench/working_protos/02_speaker_mic_combo/` for full duplex example.
   268→
   269→### SPI Bus Sharing
   270→
   271→Multiple devices (LCD, SD card) share SPI bus - must use semaphore:
   272→
   273→```cpp
   274→if (bsp_spi_lock(-1)) {
   275→  // SPI operations
   276→  bsp_spi_unlock();
   277→}
   278→```
   279→
   280→### LVGL Thread Safety
   281→
   282→All LVGL calls must be protected:
   283→
   284→```cpp
   285→if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   286→  // LVGL UI updates
   287→  lvgl_unlock();
   288→}
   289→```
   290→
   291→### Stream-based File I/O
   292→
   293→Prefer Stream abstraction for memory/file interchangeability:
   294→
   295→```cpp
   296→class MemoryStream : public Stream {
   297→  // Implement available(), read(), peek(), readBytes()
   298→};
   299→```
   300→
   301→## Optimization Philosophy
   302→
   303→The `video_loop` prototype demonstrates aggressive optimization:
   304→
   305→**Removed:**
   306→- All Serial.print() debug output
   307→- Verbose error screens
   308→- Statistics tracking
   309→- Redundant comments and temporary variables
   310→
   311→**Retained:**
   312→- All functionality
   313→- Error detection (via return values)
   314→- Minimal LED feedback for critical failures
   315→
   316→**Result:** 59% code reduction (250→103 lines) with zero performance impact
   317→
   318→When modifying code, prioritize:
   319→1. Encapsulation over globals
   320→2. Classes over procedural code
   321→3. Minimal interfaces (begin/run pattern)
   322→4. Fail-fast error handling
   323→5. Production code = no debug spam
   324→
   325→## GPIO Pin Availability
   326→
   327→Based on ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2 schematic **PinOut** section:
   328→
   329→**Pins broken out to headers:**
   330→- IO2, IO4, IO6-18, IO21, IO43, IO44, IO47, IO48
   331→
   332→**Truly free pins** (no peripherals attached):
   333→- **GPIO 18** - Completely free
   334→- **GPIO 2, 4, 6-17, 21** - Camera pins (safe if camera not attached)
   335→
   336→**Occupied pins:**
   337→- GPIO 0 (BOOT), 1 (BL), 5 (BAT) - System
   338→- GPIO 19, 20 - USB D-, D+ (**not available**)
   339→- GPIO 33-37 - **NOT broken out** to headers
   340→- GPIO 38-42, 45 - SPI (LCD/SD card)
   341→- GPIO 43, 44 - Serial console (U0_TXD/RXD)
   342→- GPIO 46 - Touch panel interrupt
   343→- GPIO 47, 48 - I2C (IMU and touch panel)
   344→
   345→## Audio Hardware
   346→
   347→### Microphone (INMP441)
   348→- **Pins:** GPIO 2 (BCK), 4 (WS), 18 (DIN)
   349→- **I2S Port:** I2S_NUM_0 (RX mode)
   350→- **Config:** Stereo capable, 24-bit samples, 16kHz sample rate
   351→- **Test sketch:** `workbench/mic_pin_test/` or `workbench/single_mic_test/`
   352→
   353→### Speaker (MAX98357A)
   354→- **Pins:** GPIO 6 (BCLK), 7 (LRC), 8 (DIN)
   355→- **I2S Port:** I2S_NUM_1 (TX mode)
   356→- **Power:** 5V recommended for full power (3-5W capable)
   357→- **Config:** 16-bit samples, 44.1kHz sample rate, mono/stereo
   358→- **Test sketch:** `workbench/tests/speaker_beep_test/`
   359→- **Note:** GAIN pin controls volume (Float=9dB, GND=12dB, VDD=15dB)
   360→
   361→## ML Model Deployment
   362→
   363→### SD Card Layout for Models
   364→```
   365→SD:/
   366→├── models/
   367→│   ├── hey_daisy.tflite     # Wake word model (~130KB)
   368→│   └── hey_daisy.json       # Detection config

   370→├── stories260k.bin          # LLM model weights
   371→└── tokenizer.bin            # LLM tokenizer
   372→```
   373→
   374→### TensorFlow Lite Libraries
   375→- **EdgeNeuron**: Lightweight, good for small streaming models (wake word)
   376→- **TensorFlowLite_ESP32**: Full-featured, needed for larger models (YAMNet)
   377→

\```
SD:/

├── models/
│   ├── wake_word.tflite

│   └── intents.txt       # 300 intent strings
└── stash/                # Unrecognized audio
\```

### Memory Budget (PSRAM ~8MB)
- Video buffer: ~2MB (logo.mjpeg)
- ML Pool: 6MB (shared, one model at a time)
  - Wake word: ~700KB
  - YAMNet: ~1MB
  - LLM: ~6MB

### Key Design Decisions
- **TTS**: SAM (1980s robotic voice)
- **Text Overlay**: Arduino_GFX direct draw (not LVGL)
- **Model Storage**: SD card + Lightsail FastAPI
- **WiFi Config**: JSON on SD card

   425→### TensorFlow Lite Libraries
   426→- **EdgeNeuron**: Lightweight, good for small streaming models (wake word)
   427→- **TensorFlowLite_ESP32**: Full-featured, needed for larger models (YAMNet)
   428→
   429→### Colab Training Pipelines
   430→- `audio_semantic_xtts_ipynb/` - Audio semantic embeddings with XTTS-v2
   431→- `llm_qa_scaled_training/` - LLM Q&A fine-tuning with phases
   432→- `wakeword_training_ipynb_poc/` - Custom wake word training
   433→
   434→## OAISYS Badge Implementation Phases
   435→
   436→The unified `oaisys_badge` firmware is built in 8 phases. See `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current progress.
   437→
   438→| Phase | Description | Key Files |
   439→|-------|-------------|-----------|
   440→| 1 | Core (Video + Button + Text) | `video_player.cpp`, `orientation.cpp` |
   441→| 2 | Wake Word + Recording | `wake_word.cpp`, `audio_recorder.cpp` |
   442→| 3 | Embedding + Similarity | `yamnet_embed.cpp`, `embed_search.cpp` |
   443→| 4 | LLM Integration | `llm_core.cpp`, `tokenizer.cpp` |
   444→| 5 | Robotic TTS (SAM) | `robot_tts.cpp` |
   445→| 6 | Deep Sleep + Wake | `sleep_manager.cpp` |
   446→| 7 | WiFi + Model Updates | `wifi_manager.cpp`, `model_updater.cpp` |
   447→| 8 | Stash Upload | `stash_manager.cpp`, `data_uploader.cpp` |
   448→| Backend | FastAPI + Redis | `main.py`, `workers.py` |
   449→
   450→### State Machine Flow
   451→```
   452→BOOT → LOGO_LOOP ←→ DEEP_SLEEP (5min idle)
   453→         ↓ (button/wake word)
   454→      RECORDING (3-5 sec)
   455→         ↓
   456→      EMBEDDING → SIMILARITY
   457→         ↓
   458→   score ≥ 0.7 → LLM_INFERENCE → DISPLAY → TTS → LOGO_LOOP
   459→   score < 0.7 → TTS_SORRY → STASH_DATA → LOGO_LOOP
   460→```
   461→
   462→### Memory Management
   463→- Only ONE ML model loaded at a time
   464→- 6MB memory pool in PSRAM for model swapping
   465→- Load/unload via `begin()`/`end()` pattern
   466→
   467→### Working Methodology
   468→1. Check `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current phase
   469→2. Reference original prototypes in `working_protos/0X_*` for implementation patterns
   470→3. Update TODO tracker after completing each task
   471→4. Test each phase before moving to next
   472→
```

Based on the search results, here's what I found about Arduino IDE and compiling cpp files in subdirectories:

## Key Findings

### The `src` Subfolder Solution

In Arduino IDE 1.6.5-r5 and older, no recursive compilation was done. In Arduino IDE 1.6.6 - 1.6.9, recursive compilation was done of all subfolders of the sketch folder. In Arduino IDE 1.6.10 and newer, recursive compilation is limited to the src subfolder of the sketch folder. So, putting your source code files into 'src' subfolder should solve the problem.(no content)This was tested in "Arduino IDE" v2.0.3.

### The Core Problem

The Arduino IDE doesn't compile within the directory your sketch is in. Instead it writes out a fresh copy of all the files directly from the tabs in the IDE into a temporary build folder (munging them as it goes if they are .INO or .PDE) and then compiles them there. Anything else within your sketch folder is completely ignored.(no content)When the IDE tries to link, all references to implementations (c source files) in the subfolders generate "undefined reference" errors. Almost as if the IDE is completely ignoring the C source files. The handling of subfolders by the IDE seems to be all over the place. Some versions only acknowledge headers in subfolders, others work if you put everything in a "src" folder.

### Library vs Sketch Folder Behavior

src and util are used in library folder structure, not for project folder.(no content)This could be caused by your library not using the "src" folder format. Please refer to the Arduino library specification for details.

### Workarounds

1. **Use the `src` subfolder**: With recent versions you can put the files in a src subfolder of your sketch folder.

2. **Use alternative IDEs**: The Arduino "IDE" really isn't suitable for larger projects. If you add one or two additional files it may be fine, but anything beyond should really use something else. There's a reason that the Arduino IDE calls its programs "Sketches" because if you got beyond prototyping with it you should use something else. Visual Studio Code with the Arduino extension or Visual Studio Community Edition with Visual Micro are recommended.

3. **For Arduino-Makefile users**: A workaround involves defining source folders manually: "SOURCE_FOLDERS = src src/Player src/Weapon" and using LOCAL_C_SRCS and LOCAL_CPP_SRCS variables with wildcard patterns.

### 2024 Update on PlatformIO

Even after code separation and explicitly including a header file in a subfolder of the networking subfolder, the code in "nbiot" is still being compiled. This reveals that PlatformIO selects the files to be compiled based on the direct subfolders of "src" folder regardless if there is further code separation within the subfolders.

    87→            break;
    88→
    89→        default:
    90→            break;
    91→    }
    92→}
    93→
    94→void onButtonDoubleClick() {
    95→    resetActivityTimer();
    96→
    97→    // Double-click: Show demo text overlay
    98→    if (currentState == STATE_LOGO_LOOP) {
    99→        video.showText("Hello! I am OAISYS, your AI conference badge. Ask me anything!");
   100→        setState(STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE);
   101→    }
   102→}
   103→
   104→void onButtonLongPressStart() {
   105→    resetActivityTimer();
   106→
   107→    // Long press: Toggle power (blank screen)
   108→    video.togglePower();
   109→}
   110→
   111→//==============================================================================
   112→// State Handlers
   113→//==============================================================================
   114→
   115→void handleLogoLoop() {
   116→    // Update orientation
   117→    orientation.update();
   118→    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
   119→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
   120→    }
   121→
   122→    // Play video frame
   123→    video.play();
   124→
   125→    // Check for idle timeout (Phase 6 will add deep sleep)
   126→    // For now, just track activity
   127→}
   128→
   129→void handleDisplayResponse() {
   130→    // Just wait for button press to dismiss
   131→    // In full implementation, this would have timeout
   132→}
   133→
   134→//==============================================================================
   135→// Main Loop State Machine
   136→//==============================================================================
   137→
   138→void loop() {
   139→    // Process button events
   140→    button.tick();
   141→
   142→    // State-specific handling
   143→    switch (currentState) {
   144→        case STATE_BOOT:
   145→            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop
   146→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   147→            break;
   148→
   149→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   150→            handleLogoLoop();
   151→            break;
   152→
   153→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   154→            handleDisplayResponse();
   155→            break;
   156→
   157→        // Future states (Phase 2+)
   158→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   159→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   160→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   161→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   162→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   163→        case STATE_STASH_DATA:
   164→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   165→        case STATE_DEEP_SLEEP:
   166→            // Not implemented yet - return to logo
   167→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   168→            break;
   169→    }
   170→}
   171→
   172→//==============================================================================
   173→// Setup
   174→//==============================================================================
   175→
   176→void setup() {
   177→    Serial.begin(115200);
   178→    Serial.println("\n=== OAISYS25 Badge Starting ===");
   179→
   180→    // Initialize orientation sensor (non-fatal if fails)
   181→    if (!orientation.begin()) {
   182→        Serial.println("IMU init failed - rotation disabled");
   183→    } else {
   184→        Serial.println("IMU initialized");
   185→    }
   186→
   187→    // Initialize video player
   188→    Serial.println("Loading video...");
   189→    if (!video.begin()) {
   190→        Serial.println("ERROR: Video init failed!");
   191→        // Blink LED to indicate error
   192→        pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
   193→        while (1) {
   194→            digitalWrite(LCD_BL, !digitalRead(LCD_BL));
   195→            delay(500);
   196→        }
   197→    }
   198→    Serial.println("Video loaded");
   199→
   200→    // Setup button callbacks
   201→    button.attachClick(onButtonClick);
   202→    button.attachDoubleClick(onButtonDoubleClick);
   203→    button.attachLongPressStart(onButtonLongPressStart);
   204→
   205→    // Ready to go
   206→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   207→    currentState = STATE_BOOT;
   208→
   209→    Serial.println("=== Badge Ready ===");
   210→    Serial.println("Controls:");
   211→    Serial.println("  Click: Pause/resume video");
   212→    Serial.println("  Double-click: Show demo text");
   213→    Serial.println("  Long press: Power off/on");
   214→}

    56→  const unsigned long DEBOUNCE_MS = 1000; // 1 second stability required

    58→
    59→  uint8_t currentRotation;    // Stable rotation: 1 (USB right) or 3 (USB left)
    60→  uint8_t pendingRotation;    // Candidate rotation during debounce (0 = none)

   100→      pendingRotation = 0; // Cancel any pending transition

   135→### 1.3 Memory Management Strategy
   136→
   137→**Problem**: PSRAM is ~8MB, but models compete for space:
   138→- Wake word: ~700KB
   139→- YAMNet + projection: ~1MB
   140→- LLM: ~6MB
   141→- Video buffer: ~2MB
   142→
   143→**Solution**: Sequential model loading with explicit unload
   144→
   145→```cpp
   146→// Memory pool reserved in PSRAM
   147→#define ML_POOL_SIZE (6 * 1024 * 1024)  // 6MB for largest model
   148→static uint8_t* ml_pool = nullptr;
   149→
   150→// Each ML module uses pool, not direct ps_malloc
   151→class MLModule {
   152→public:
   153→    virtual bool load(uint8_t* pool, size_t pool_size) = 0;
   154→    virtual void unload() = 0;
   155→    virtual size_t requiredMemory() = 0;
   156→};
   157→
   158→// State transitions trigger load/unload:
   159→// LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   160→// RECORDING: wake_word.unload()
   161→// EMBEDDING: yamnet.load() → yamnet.unload()
   162→// LLM_INFER: llm.load() → llm.unload()
   163→// Return to LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   164→```
   165→

   248→//=============================================================================
   249→// MAIN LOOP
   250→//=============================================================================
   251→
   252→void loop() {
   253→  if (!captureAudio()) {
   254→    return;
   255→  }
   256→
   257→  while (audio_buffer_pos >= FEATURE_STRIDE_SAMPLES) {
   258→    size_t num_samples_read;
   259→    FrontendOutput frontend_output = FrontendProcessSamples(
   260→        &frontend_state, audio_buffer, audio_buffer_pos, &num_samples_read);
   261→
   262→    if (num_samples_read == 0) {
   263→      break;
   264→    }
   265→
   266→    if (num_samples_read < audio_buffer_pos) {
   267→      memmove(audio_buffer, audio_buffer + num_samples_read,
   268→              (audio_buffer_pos - num_samples_read) * sizeof(int16_t));
   269→    }
   270→    audio_buffer_pos -= num_samples_read;
   271→
   272→    if (frontend_output.size == FEATURE_BINS) {
   273→      if (feature_frame_count >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   274→        memmove(feature_buffer, feature_buffer + FEATURE_BINS,
   275→                (FEATURE_FRAMES - 1) * FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   276→        feature_frame_count = FEATURE_FRAMES - 1;
   277→      }
   278→
   279→      memcpy(feature_buffer + feature_frame_count * FEATURE_BINS,
   280→             frontend_output.values, FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   281→      feature_frame_count++;
   282→
   283→      if (feature_frame_count >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   284→#if DEBUG_FEATURES
   285→        static int debug_count = 0;
   286→        if (++debug_count >= 30) {
   287→          debug_count = 0;
   288→          uint32_t energy = 0;
   289→          uint16_t max_feat = 0;
   290→          for (int i = 0; i < FEATURE_FRAMES * FEATURE_BINS; i++) {
   291→            energy += feature_buffer[i];
   292→            if (feature_buffer[i] > max_feat) max_feat = feature_buffer[i];
   293→          }
   294→          Serial.printf("Features: max=%u, sum=%lu\n", max_feat, energy);
   295→        }
   296→#endif
   297→        float prob = runInference();
   298→
   299→        if (detectWakeword(prob)) {
   300→          Serial.printf("\n>>> %s DETECTED! <<<\n\n", config.wake_word);
   301→          digitalWrite(LED_PIN, HIGH);
   302→          delay(500);
   303→          digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW);
   304→
   305→          for (int i = 0; i < config.sliding_window_size; i++) {
   306→            probability_window[i] = 0.0f;
   307→          }
   308→          window_filled = false;
   309→        }
   310→      }
   311→    }
   312→  }
   313→}

   319→bool loadConfig(const char* path) {
   320→  File f = SD.open(path);
   321→  if (!f) {
   322→    Serial.printf("Cannot open config: %s\n", path);
   323→    return false;
   324→  }
   325→
   326→  // Parse JSON
   327→  StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
   328→  DeserializationError error = deserializeJson(doc, f);
   329→  f.close();
   330→
   331→  if (error) {
   332→    Serial.printf("JSON parse error: %s\n", error.c_str());
   333→    return false;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Load wake word name
   337→  const char* wake_word = doc["wake_word"] | "Hey Daisy";
   338→  strncpy(config.wake_word, wake_word, sizeof(config.wake_word) - 1);
   339→
   340→  // Load detection parameters from "micro" object
   341→  JsonObject micro = doc["micro"];
   342→  if (micro) {
   343→    config.probability_cutoff = micro["probability_cutoff"] | 0.5f;
   344→    config.sliding_window_size = micro["sliding_window_average_size"] | 10;
   345→    config.min_high_frames = micro["min_high_frames"] | 6;
   346→    config.min_frame_prob = micro["min_frame_prob"] | 0.5f;
   347→    config.cooldown_ms = micro["cooldown_ms"] | 1500;
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  // Clamp sliding window size to max
   351→  if (config.sliding_window_size > MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW) {
   352→    config.sliding_window_size = MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW;
   353→  }
   354→
   355→  Serial.printf("Config loaded: %s\n", path);
   356→  return true;
   357→}

   363→bool initInterpreter() {
   364→  const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(model_data);
   365→  if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
   366→    Serial.printf("Model version mismatch: %d vs %d\n",
   367→                  model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
   368→    return false;
   369→  }
   370→
   371→  var_allocator = tflite::MicroAllocator::Create(var_arena, VAR_ARENA_SIZE);
   372→  if (!var_allocator) {
   373→    Serial.println("Failed to create var allocator");
   374→    return false;
   375→  }
   376→
   377→  resource_vars = tflite::MicroResourceVariables::Create(var_allocator, MAX_RESOURCE_VARS);
   378→  if (!resource_vars) {
   379→    Serial.println("Failed to create resource variables");
   380→    return false;
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  static tflite::MicroInterpreter static_interpreter(
   384→      model, resolver, tensor_arena, TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE, resource_vars);
   385→  interpreter = &static_interpreter;
   386→
   387→  if (interpreter->AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
   388→    Serial.println("AllocateTensors failed");
   389→    return false;
   390→  }
   391→
   392→  input_tensor = interpreter->input(0);
   393→  output_tensor = interpreter->output(0);
   394→
   395→  if (!input_tensor || !output_tensor) {
   396→    Serial.println("Failed to get tensors");
   397→    return false;
   398→  }
   399→
   400→  return true;
   401→}

   477→bool captureAudio() {
   478→  int space_available = AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE - audio_buffer_pos;
   479→  if (space_available < 256) {
   480→    return true;
   481→  }
   482→
   483→  int samples_to_read = min(256, space_available);
   484→  size_t bytes_read;
   485→  if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, i2s_buffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   486→    return false;
   487→  }
   488→
   489→  int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   490→
   491→  static int audio_debug = 0;
   492→  int32_t max_sample = 0;
   493→
   494→  for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
   495→    int32_t sample = i2s_buffer[i] >> 14;
   496→    audio_buffer[audio_buffer_pos++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   497→    if (abs(sample) > max_sample) max_sample = abs(sample);
   498→  }
   499→
   500→#if DEBUG_FEATURES
   501→  if (++audio_debug >= 300) {
   502→    audio_debug = 0;
   503→    Serial.printf("Audio: amp=%ld, buf=%d\n", max_sample, audio_buffer_pos);
   504→  }
   505→#endif
   506→
   507→  return true;
   508→}
