    "print(f\"  Questions: {len(questions)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Speakers: {len(speaker_files)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Resume from: q{start_q_idx}, s{start_s_idx}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Already generated: {total_generated}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create output directory for each bucket\n",
    "for bucket_id in buckets.keys():\n",
    "    (AUDIO_DIR / f'bucket_{bucket_id}').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Generate audio for all questions\n",
    "# Organized by bucket for easier contrastive batch sampling later\n",
    "\n",
    "metadata = []  # Track all audio-text pairs with bucket info\n",
    "\n",
    "for q_idx, question in enumerate(tqdm(questions[start_q_idx:], initial=start_q_idx, total=len(questions))):\n",
    "    actual_q_idx = start_q_idx + q_idx\n",
    "    bucket_id = int(cluster_labels[actual_q_idx])\n",
    "    output_dir = AUDIO_DIR / f'bucket_{bucket_id}'\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for s_idx, speaker_file in enumerate(speaker_files):\n",
    "        if actual_q_idx == start_q_idx and s_idx < start_s_idx:\n",
    "            continue  # Skip already processed\n",
    "        \n",
    "        base_name = f'q{actual_q_idx:04d}_s{s_idx}'\n",
    "        audio_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}.wav'\n",
    "        \n",
    "        if not audio_file.exists():\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                # Generate base audio\n",
    "                generate_audio_for_text(question, speaker_file, str(audio_file))\n",
    "                \n",
    "                # Load for processing\n",
    "                audio, sr = librosa.load(str(audio_file), sr=16000, mono=True)\n",
    "                \n",
    "                # Record base audio\n",
    "                metadata.append({\n",
    "                    'file': str(audio_file),\n",
    "                    'text': question,\n",
    "                    'question_idx': actual_q_idx,\n",
    "                    'bucket_id': bucket_id,\n",
    "                    'speaker': s_idx,\n",
    "                    'variant': 'original'\n",
    "                })\n",
    "                \n",
    "                # Maybe add background noise\n",
    "                if random.random() < NOISE_PROBABILITY:\n",
    "                    noise_type = random.choice(BACKGROUND_NOISE_TYPES)\n",
    "                    audio_noisy = add_background_noise(audio, sr, noise_type, NOISE_SNR_DB)\n",
    "                    noisy_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}_noise.wav'\n",
    "                    sf.write(str(noisy_file), audio_noisy, sr)\n",
    "                    metadata.append({\n",
    "                        'file': str(noisy_file),\n",
    "                        'text': question,\n",
    "                        'question_idx': actual_q_idx,\n",
    "                        'bucket_id': bucket_id,\n",
    "                        'speaker': s_idx,\n",
    "                        'variant': f'noise_{noise_type}'\n",
    "                    })\n",
    "                \n",
    "                # Create augmented version\n",
    "                audio_aug = apply_augmentation(audio, sr)\n",
    "                aug_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}_aug.wav'\n",
    "                sf.write(str(aug_file), audio_aug, sr)\n",
    "                metadata.append({\n",
    "                    'file': str(aug_file),\n",
    "                    'text': question,\n",
    "                    'question_idx': actual_q_idx,\n",
    "                    'bucket_id': bucket_id,\n",
    "                    'speaker': s_idx,\n",
    "                    'variant': 'augmented'\n",
    "                })\n",
    "                \n",
    "                total_generated += 2  # base + augmented (noise is bonus)\n",
    "            except Exception as e:\n",
    "                print(f\"\\nError generating {base_name}: {e}\")\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Save state periodically\n",
    "        if total_generated % 100 == 0:\n",
    "            save_generation_state(actual_q_idx, s_idx, total_generated)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save final metadata\n",
    "metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / 'metadata.json'\n",
    "with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n",
    "    json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nGeneration complete!\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Total generated: {total_generated}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Metadata entries: {len(metadata)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Metadata saved: {metadata_file}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 10. Load Pre-trained Models (YAMNet)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import tensorflow_hub as hub\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Loading YAMNet...\")\n",
    "yamnet_model = hub.load('https://tfhub.dev/google/yamnet/1')\n",
    "print(\"YAMNet loaded!\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 11. Extract YAMNet Embeddings"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path, target_sr=16000, target_length=3):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Load and prepare audio for YAMNet (3 seconds, 16kHz)\"\"\"\n",
    "    audio, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Pad or trim to target length\n",
    "    target_samples = target_length * target_sr\n",
    "    if len(audio) < target_samples:\n",
    "        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, target_samples - len(audio)))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        audio = audio[:target_samples]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return audio.astype(np.float32)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load metadata if not in memory\n",
    "if 'metadata' not in dir() or len(metadata) == 0:\n",
    "    metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / 'metadata.json'\n",
    "    with open(metadata_file) as f:\n",
    "        metadata = json.load(f)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Extracting YAMNet embeddings...\")\n",
    "print(f\"Total files: {len(metadata)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "audio_embeddings = []\n",
    "valid_metadata = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for item in tqdm(metadata):\n",
    "    file_path = item['file']\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if not Path(file_path).exists():\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    \n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        audio = load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path)\n",
    "        _, embeddings, _ = yamnet_model(audio)\n",
    "        avg_embedding = tf.reduce_mean(embeddings, axis=0).numpy()\n",
    "        \n",
    "        audio_embeddings.append(avg_embedding)\n",
    "        valid_metadata.append(item)\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        print(f\"\\nError processing {file_path}: {e}\")\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "audio_embeddings = np.array(audio_embeddings)\n",
    "print(f\"\\nYAMNet embeddings shape: {audio_embeddings.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Valid samples: {len(valid_metadata)}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 12. Prepare Text Embeddings (Per Bucket)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Get text embeddings for each audio sample\n",
    "# Key: use the bucket's representative embedding for contrastive learning\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create bucket -> representative embedding mapping\n",
    "# Use mean of all question embeddings in each bucket\n",
    "bucket_embeddings = {}\n",
    "for bucket_id, items in buckets.items():\n",
    "    bucket_embs = np.array([item['embedding'] for item in items])\n",
    "    bucket_embeddings[bucket_id] = np.mean(bucket_embs, axis=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get text embedding for each audio sample based on its bucket\n",
    "text_embeddings = []\n",
    "bucket_ids = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for item in valid_metadata:\n",
    "    bucket_id = item['bucket_id']\n",
    "    text_embeddings.append(bucket_embeddings[bucket_id])\n",
    "    bucket_ids.append(bucket_id)\n",
    "\n",
    "text_embeddings = np.array(text_embeddings)\n",
    "bucket_ids = np.array(bucket_ids)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Text embeddings shape: {text_embeddings.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Unique buckets in training data: {len(np.unique(bucket_ids))}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 13. Build Projection Models"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Audio projection: 1024 -> 256\n",
    "audio_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(YAMNET_DIM,)),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Dense(512, activation='relu'),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Dropout(0.2),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))\n",
    "], name='audio_projection')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Text projection: 384 -> 256\n",
    "text_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(TEXT_DIM,)),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))\n",
    "], name='text_projection')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Audio Projection Model:\")\n",
    "audio_projection.summary()\n",
    "print(\"\\nText Projection Model:\")\n",
    "text_projection.summary()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 14. Bucketed Batch Sampler for Contrastive Learning\n",
    "\n",
    "**Key insight**: For contrastive loss to work, each batch must have:\n",
    "- ONE audio sample per bucket (no duplicates from same bucket)\n",
    "- This ensures all other samples in the batch are true negatives"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "class BucketedBatchGenerator:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Generate batches where each sample is from a different bucket.\n",
    "    \n",
    "    This ensures proper contrastive learning where negatives are truly\n",
    "    from different questions, not just different audio of the same question.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def __init__(self, audio_embs, text_embs, bucket_ids, batch_size):\n",
    "        self.audio_embs = audio_embs\n",
    "        self.text_embs = text_embs\n",
    "        self.bucket_ids = bucket_ids\n",
    "        self.batch_size = batch_size\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Group samples by bucket\n",
    "        self.bucket_to_indices = defaultdict(list)\n",
    "        for idx, bid in enumerate(bucket_ids):\n",
    "            self.bucket_to_indices[bid].append(idx)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        self.all_buckets = list(self.bucket_to_indices.keys())\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Ensure batch_size <= num_buckets\n",
    "        if batch_size > len(self.all_buckets):\n",
    "            print(f\"Warning: batch_size ({batch_size}) > num_buckets ({len(self.all_buckets)})\")\n",
    "            print(f\"Reducing batch_size to {len(self.all_buckets)}\")\n",
    "            self.batch_size = len(self.all_buckets)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def __len__(self):\n",
    "        return len(self.audio_embs) // self.batch_size\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def generate_batch(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Generate one batch with one sample per bucket.\"\"\"\n",
    "        # Randomly select batch_size buckets\n",
    "        selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        batch_audio = []\n",
    "        batch_text = []\n",
    "        \n",
    "        for bucket_id in selected_buckets:\n",
    "            # Randomly select one sample from this bucket\n",
    "            idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])\n",
    "            batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])\n",
    "            batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])\n",
    "        \n",
    "        return np.array(batch_audio), np.array(batch_text)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def generate_epoch(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Generate batches for one epoch.\"\"\"\n",
    "        for _ in range(len(self)):\n",
    "            yield self.generate_batch()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create batch generator\n",
    "batch_generator = BucketedBatchGenerator(\n",
    "    audio_embeddings,\n",
    "    text_embeddings,\n",
    "    bucket_ids,\n",
    "    BATCH_SIZE\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Bucketed Batch Generator:\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Samples: {len(audio_embeddings)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Buckets: {len(batch_generator.all_buckets)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 15. Contrastive Training with Bucketed Sampling"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "class ContrastiveLoss(tf.keras.losses.Loss):\n",
    "    def __init__(self, temperature=0.2, **kwargs):\n",
    "        super().__init__(**kwargs)\n",
    "        self.temperature = temperature\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def call(self, audio_emb, text_emb):\n",
    "        logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / self.temperature\n",
    "        batch_size = tf.shape(audio_emb)[0]\n",
    "        labels = tf.range(batch_size)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        loss_a2t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)\n",
    "        loss_t2a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))\n",
    "        \n",
    "        return (tf.reduce_mean(loss_a2t) + tf.reduce_mean(loss_t2a)) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "# Setup\n",
    "optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)\n",
    "loss_fn = ContrastiveLoss(temperature=TEMPERATURE)\n",
    "\n",
    "@tf.function\n",
    "def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):\n",
    "    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:\n",
    "        audio_proj = audio_projection(audio_batch, training=True)\n",
    "        text_proj = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)\n",
    "        loss = loss_fn(audio_proj, text_proj)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    variables = audio_projection.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables\n",
    "    gradients = tape.gradient(loss, variables)\n",
    "    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, variables))\n",
    "    return loss\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Training setup complete\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Training loop\n",
    "print(f\"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs with bucketed sampling...\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "history = {'loss': []}\n",
    "best_loss = float('inf')\n",
    "\n",
    "for epoch in range(EPOCHS):\n",
    "    epoch_losses = []\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for audio_batch, text_batch in batch_generator.generate_epoch():\n",
    "        audio_batch = tf.constant(audio_batch, dtype=tf.float32)\n",
    "        text_batch = tf.constant(text_batch, dtype=tf.float32)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)\n",
    "        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())\n",
    "    \n",
    "    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)\n",
    "    history['loss'].append(avg_loss)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Learning rate decay\n",
    "    if epoch > 0 and epoch % 50 == 0:\n",
    "        if avg_loss >= best_loss:\n",
    "            new_lr = optimizer.learning_rate.numpy() * 0.5\n",
    "            if new_lr >= 1e-6:\n",
    "                optimizer.learning_rate.assign(new_lr)\n",
    "                print(f\"\\nEpoch {epoch}: LR reduced to {new_lr:.2e}\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if avg_loss < best_loss:\n",
    "        best_loss = avg_loss\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:\n",
    "        print(f\"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nTraining complete!\")\n",
    "print(f\"Final loss: {history['loss'][-1]:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Plot training history\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))\n",
    "plt.plot(history['loss'])\n",
    "plt.title('Contrastive Loss (Bucketed Sampling)')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Epoch')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Loss')\n",
    "plt.grid(True)\n",
    "plt.axhline(y=1.0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Target')\n",
    "plt.axhline(y=0.5, color='g', linestyle='--', label='Excellent')\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.savefig(str(MODEL_DIR / 'training_loss.png'), dpi=150)\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 16. Evaluation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Project embeddings\n",
    "audio_projected = audio_projection.predict(audio_embeddings)\n",
    "text_projected = text_projection.predict(text_embeddings)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Compute similarity matrix (sample for visualization)\n",
    "sample_size = min(500, len(audio_projected))\n",
    "similarity_matrix = cosine_similarity(\n",
    "    audio_projected[:sample_size],\n",
    "    text_projected[:sample_size]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Accuracy (match to same bucket, not exact index)\n",
    "predictions = np.argmax(similarity_matrix, axis=1)\n",
    "pred_buckets = bucket_ids[:sample_size][predictions]\n",
    "true_buckets = bucket_ids[:sample_size]\n",
    "bucket_accuracy = np.mean(pred_buckets == true_buckets)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n",
    "print(f\"EVALUATION RESULTS\")\n",
    "print(f\"{'='*60}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Bucket Matching Accuracy: {bucket_accuracy*100:.2f}%\")\n",
    "print(f\"Mean diagonal similarity: {np.mean(np.diag(similarity_matrix)):.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Mean off-diagonal: {np.mean(similarity_matrix[~np.eye(sample_size, dtype=bool)]):.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Similarity gap: {np.mean(np.diag(similarity_matrix)) - np.mean(similarity_matrix[~np.eye(sample_size, dtype=bool)]):.3f}\")"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",

   "source": [
    "## 17. Export for ESP32"

  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "source": [
    "# Save Keras model\n",
    "audio_projection.save(str(MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection.h5'))\n",
    "print(f\"Saved Keras model: {MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection.h5'}\")\n",

    "# Convert to TFLite with quantization\n",
    "converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_keras_model(audio_projection)\n",
    "converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Representative dataset for quantization\n",
    "def representative_dataset():\n",
    "    for i in range(min(100, len(audio_embeddings))):\n",

    "\n",
    "converter.representative_dataset = representative_dataset\n",
    "converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS_INT8]\n",
    "converter.inference_input_type = tf.float32\n",
    "converter.inference_output_type = tf.float32\n",
    "\n",
    "tflite_model = converter.convert()\n",
    "\n",
    "tflite_path = MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection_quantized.tflite'\n",
    "with open(tflite_path, 'wb') as f:\n",
    "    f.write(tflite_model)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Quantized TFLite model: {tflite_path}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Size: {len(tflite_model) / 1024:.2f} KB\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Generate query embeddings (one per unique question)\n",
    "unique_questions = list(dict.fromkeys(questions))  # Preserve order, remove duplicates\n",
    "print(f\"Unique questions: {len(unique_questions)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get text embeddings for unique questions\n",
    "query_text_embeddings = text_encoder.encode(unique_questions)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Project to 256-dim\n",
    "query_embeddings = text_projection.predict(query_text_embeddings)\n",
    "print(f\"Query embeddings shape: {query_embeddings.shape}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save as binary (256 floats per query)\n",
    "embeddings_path = MODEL_DIR / 'embeddings.bin'\n",
    "with open(embeddings_path, 'wb') as f:\n",
    "    for emb in query_embeddings:\n",
    "        f.write(struct.pack(f'{EMBEDDING_DIM}f', *emb))\n",

   167→    "## 3. Load Dataset & Create Buckets\n",
   168→    "\n",
   169→    "For contrastive learning to work properly:\n",
   170→    "- Similar questions (e.g., \"What is the email\" vs \"Tell me the email address\") should be in the SAME bucket\n",
   171→    "- During training, we sample ONE audio per bucket per batch\n",
   172→    "- This ensures negatives are truly different questions, not just audio variations of the same question"
   173→   ]

   181→    "from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer\n",
   182→    "from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering\n",
   183→    "from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity\n",
   184→    "\n",
   185→    "# Load text encoder for bucketing\n",
   186→    "print(\"Loading MiniLM for question bucketing...\")\n",
   187→    "text_encoder = SentenceTransformer('sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')\n",
   188→    "\n",
   189→    "# Load questions\n",
   190→    "qa_file = DATA_DIR / 'full.csv'\n",
   191→    "if not qa_file.exists():\n",
   192→    "    raise FileNotFoundError(f\"full.csv not found at {qa_file}\")\n",
   193→    "\n",
   194→    "qa_df = pd.read_csv(qa_file)\n",
   195→    "questions = qa_df['question'].tolist()\n",
   196→    "answers = qa_df['answer'].tolist() if 'answer' in qa_df.columns else [None] * len(questions)\n",
   197→    "\n",
   198→    "print(f\"Loaded {len(questions)} questions\")"
   199→   ]

   202→   "cell_type": "code",

   205→   "outputs": [],
   206→   "source": [
   207→    "# Encode all questions for clustering\n",
   208→    "print(\"Encoding questions for clustering...\")\n",
   209→    "question_embeddings = text_encoder.encode(questions, show_progress_bar=True)\n",
   210→    "print(f\"Question embeddings shape: {question_embeddings.shape}\")"
   211→   ]
   212→  },
   213→  {
   214→   "cell_type": "code",
   215→   "execution_count": null,
   216→   "metadata": {},

   218→   "source": [
   219→    "# Cluster similar questions into buckets\n",
   220→    "print(f\"Clustering questions (similarity threshold: {SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD})...\")\n",
   221→    "\n",
   222→    "# Use Agglomerative Clustering with cosine distance\n",
   223→    "distance_threshold = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD  # Convert similarity to distance\n",
   224→    "clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(\n",
   225→    "    n_clusters=None,\n",
   226→    "    distance_threshold=distance_threshold,\n",
   227→    "    metric='cosine',\n",
   228→    "    linkage='average'\n",
   229→    ")\n",
   230→    "cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(question_embeddings)\n",
   231→    "\n",
   232→    "# Create buckets\n",
   233→    "buckets = defaultdict(list)\n",
   234→    "for idx, label in enumerate(cluster_labels):\n",

   240→    "    })\n",
   241→    "\n",

   400→    "    noise_files[noise_type] = str(wav_file)\n",
   401→    "\n",
   402→    "print(f\"\\nReady with {len(noise_files)} background noise samples\")"

   432→    "## 7. Audio Generation Utilities"
   433→   ]
   434→  },
   435→  {
   436→   "cell_type": "code",
   437→   "execution_count": null,
   438→   "metadata": {},
   439→   "outputs": [],
   440→   "source": [
   441→    "from audiomentations import Compose, AddGaussianNoise, TimeStretch, PitchShift\n",
   442→    "\n",
   443→    "# Audio augmentation pipeline\n",
   444→    "augmenter = Compose([\n",
   445→    "    AddGaussianNoise(min_amplitude=0.001, max_amplitude=0.015, p=0.5),\n",
   446→    "    TimeStretch(min_rate=0.9, max_rate=1.1, p=0.5),\n",
   447→    "    PitchShift(min_semitones=-2, max_semitones=2, p=0.5),\n",
   448→    "])\n",
   449→    "\n",
   450→    "def add_background_noise(audio, sr, noise_type, snr_db=15):\n",
   451→    "    \"\"\"Mix background noise at specified SNR\"\"\"\n",
   452→    "    if noise_type not in noise_files:\n",
   453→    "        return audio\n",
   454→    "    \n",
   455→    "    noise, _ = librosa.load(noise_files[noise_type], sr=sr, mono=True)\n",
   456→    "    \n",
   457→    "    # Loop noise if shorter than audio\n",
   458→    "    while len(noise) < len(audio):\n",
   459→    "        noise = np.concatenate([noise, noise])\n",
   460→    "    \n",
   461→    "    # Random start point\n",
   462→    "    start = random.randint(0, max(0, len(noise) - len(audio)))\n",
   463→    "    noise = noise[start:start + len(audio)]\n",
   464→    "    \n",
   465→    "    # Calculate scale factor for desired SNR\n",
   466→    "    audio_power = np.mean(audio ** 2)\n",
   467→    "    noise_power = np.mean(noise ** 2)\n",
   468→    "    if noise_power > 0:\n",
   469→    "        scale = np.sqrt(audio_power / (10 ** (snr_db / 10) * noise_power))\n",
   470→    "        mixed = audio + noise * scale\n",
   471→    "        return mixed / np.max(np.abs(mixed))  # Normalize\n",
   472→    "    return audio\n",
   473→    "\n",
   474→    "def apply_augmentation(audio, sr):\n",
   475→    "    \"\"\"Apply random augmentation\"\"\"\n",
   476→    "    return augmenter(samples=audio, sample_rate=sr)\n",
   477→    "\n",
   478→    "def generate_audio_for_text(text, speaker_wav, output_path):\n",
   479→    "    \"\"\"Generate audio using XTTS-v2\"\"\"\n",
   480→    "    tts.tts_to_file(\n",
   481→    "        text=text,\n",
   482→    "        file_path=output_path,\n",
   483→    "        speaker_wav=speaker_wav,\n",
   484→    "        language=\"en\"\n",
   485→    "    )\n",
   486→    "\n",
   487→    "print(\"Audio generation utilities defined\")"
   488→   ]
   489→  },

   521→    "            return json.load(f)\n",

   523→    "\n",
   524→    "print(\"State persistence utilities defined\")"
   525→   ]

   673→    "## 11. Extract YAMNet Embeddings"
   674→   ]

   676→  {
   677→   "cell_type": "code",
   678→   "execution_count": null,
   679→   "metadata": {},
   680→   "outputs": [],
   681→   "source": [
   682→    "def load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path, target_sr=16000, target_length=3):\n",
   683→    "    \"\"\"Load and prepare audio for YAMNet (3 seconds, 16kHz)\"\"\"\n",
   684→    "    audio, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)\n",
   685→    "    \n",
   686→    "    # Pad or trim to target length\n",
   687→    "    target_samples = target_length * target_sr\n",
   688→    "    if len(audio) < target_samples:\n",
   689→    "        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, target_samples - len(audio)))\n",
   690→    "    else:\n",
   691→    "        audio = audio[:target_samples]\n",
   692→    "    \n",
   693→    "    return audio.astype(np.float32)\n",
   694→    "\n",
   695→    "# Load metadata if not in memory\n",
   696→    "if 'metadata' not in dir() or len(metadata) == 0:\n",
   697→    "    metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / 'metadata.json'\n",
   698→    "    with open(metadata_file) as f:\n",
   699→    "        metadata = json.load(f)\n",
   700→    "\n",
   701→    "print(f\"Extracting YAMNet embeddings...\")\n",
   702→    "print(f\"Total files: {len(metadata)}\")\n",
   703→    "\n",
   704→    "audio_embeddings = []\n",
   705→    "valid_metadata = []\n",
   706→    "\n",
   707→    "for item in tqdm(metadata):\n",
   708→    "    file_path = item['file']\n",
   709→    "    \n",
   710→    "    if not Path(file_path).exists():\n",
   711→    "        continue\n",
   712→    "    \n",
   713→    "    try:\n",
   714→    "        audio = load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path)\n",
   715→    "        _, embeddings, _ = yamnet_model(audio)\n",
   716→    "        avg_embedding = tf.reduce_mean(embeddings, axis=0).numpy()\n",
   717→    "        \n",
   718→    "        audio_embeddings.append(avg_embedding)\n",
   719→    "        valid_metadata.append(item)\n",
   720→    "    except Exception as e:\n",
   721→    "        print(f\"\\nError processing {file_path}: {e}\")\n",
   722→    "        continue\n",
   723→    "\n",
   724→    "audio_embeddings = np.array(audio_embeddings)\n",
   725→    "print(f\"\\nYAMNet embeddings shape: {audio_embeddings.shape}\")\n",
   726→    "print(f\"Valid samples: {len(valid_metadata)}\")"
   727→   ]
   728→  },

   732→   "source": [
   733→    "## 12. Prepare Text Embeddings (Per Bucket)"
   734→   ]
   735→  },
   736→  {
   737→   "cell_type": "code",
   738→   "execution_count": null,
   739→   "metadata": {},
   740→   "outputs": [],
   741→   "source": [
   742→    "# Get text embeddings for each audio sample\n",
   743→    "# Key: use the bucket's representative embedding for contrastive learning\n",
   744→    "\n",
   745→    "# Create bucket -> representative embedding mapping\n",
   746→    "# Use mean of all question embeddings in each bucket\n",
   747→    "bucket_embeddings = {}\n",

   750→    "    bucket_embeddings[bucket_id] = np.mean(bucket_embs, axis=0)\n",
   751→    "\n",
   752→    "# Get text embedding for each audio sample based on its bucket\n",
   753→    "text_embeddings = []\n",
   754→    "bucket_ids = []\n",
   755→    "\n",
   756→    "for item in valid_metadata:\n",
   757→    "    bucket_id = item['bucket_id']\n",
   758→    "    text_embeddings.append(bucket_embeddings[bucket_id])\n",
   759→    "    bucket_ids.append(bucket_id)\n",
   760→    "\n",
   761→    "text_embeddings = np.array(text_embeddings)\n",
   762→    "bucket_ids = np.array(bucket_ids)\n",
   763→    "\n",
   764→    "print(f\"Text embeddings shape: {text_embeddings.shape}\")\n",
   765→    "print(f\"Unique buckets in training data: {len(np.unique(bucket_ids))}\")"
   766→   ]

   776→   "cell_type": "code",

   780→   "source": [
   781→    "# Audio projection: 1024 -> 256\n",
   782→    "audio_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([\n",

   786→    "    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",

   790→    "], name='audio_projection')\n",
   791→    "\n",
   792→    "# Text projection: 384 -> 256\n",

   795→    "    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
   796→    "    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),\n",
   797→    "    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))\n",
   798→    "], name='text_projection')\n",
   799→    "\n",
   800→    "print(\"Audio Projection Model:\")\n",
   801→    "audio_projection.summary()\n",
   802→    "print(\"\\nText Projection Model:\")\n",
   803→    "text_projection.summary()"
   804→   ]

   806→  {
   807→   "cell_type": "markdown",
   808→   "metadata": {},
   809→   "source": [
   810→    "## 14. Bucketed Batch Sampler for Contrastive Learning\n",
   811→    "\n",
   812→    "**Key insight**: For contrastive loss to work, each batch must have:\n",
   813→    "- ONE audio sample per bucket (no duplicates from same bucket)\n",
   814→    "- This ensures all other samples in the batch are true negatives"
   815→   ]
   816→  },
   817→  {
   818→   "cell_type": "code",
   819→   "execution_count": null,
   820→   "metadata": {},
   821→   "outputs": [],
   822→   "source": [
   823→    "class BucketedBatchGenerator:\n",
   824→    "    \"\"\"Generate batches where each sample is from a different bucket.\n",
   825→    "    \n",
   826→    "    This ensures proper contrastive learning where negatives are truly\n",
   827→    "    from different questions, not just different audio of the same question.\n",
   828→    "    \"\"\"\n",
   829→    "    \n",
   830→    "    def __init__(self, audio_embs, text_embs, bucket_ids, batch_size):\n",
   831→    "        self.audio_embs = audio_embs\n",
   832→    "        self.text_embs = text_embs\n",
   833→    "        self.bucket_ids = bucket_ids\n",
   834→    "        self.batch_size = batch_size\n",
   835→    "        \n",
   836→    "        # Group samples by bucket\n",
   837→    "        self.bucket_to_indices = defaultdict(list)\n",
   838→    "        for idx, bid in enumerate(bucket_ids):\n",
   839→    "            self.bucket_to_indices[bid].append(idx)\n",
   840→    "        \n",
   841→    "        self.all_buckets = list(self.bucket_to_indices.keys())\n",
   842→    "        \n",
   843→    "        # Ensure batch_size <= num_buckets\n",
   844→    "        if batch_size > len(self.all_buckets):\n",
   845→    "            print(f\"Warning: batch_size ({batch_size}) > num_buckets ({len(self.all_buckets)})\")\n",
   846→    "            print(f\"Reducing batch_size to {len(self.all_buckets)}\")\n",
   847→    "            self.batch_size = len(self.all_buckets)\n",
   848→    "    \n",
   849→    "    def __len__(self):\n",
   850→    "        return len(self.audio_embs) // self.batch_size\n",
   851→    "    \n",
   852→    "    def generate_batch(self):\n",
   853→    "        \"\"\"Generate one batch with one sample per bucket.\"\"\"\n",
   854→    "        # Randomly select batch_size buckets\n",
   855→    "        selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)\n",
   856→    "        \n",
   857→    "        batch_audio = []\n",
   858→    "        batch_text = []\n",
   859→    "        \n",
   860→    "        for bucket_id in selected_buckets:\n",
   861→    "            # Randomly select one sample from this bucket\n",
   862→    "            idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])\n",
   863→    "            batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])\n",
   864→    "            batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])\n",
   865→    "        \n",
   866→    "        return np.array(batch_audio), np.array(batch_text)\n",
   867→    "    \n",
   868→    "    def generate_epoch(self):\n",
   869→    "        \"\"\"Generate batches for one epoch.\"\"\"\n",
   870→    "        for _ in range(len(self)):\n",
   871→    "            yield self.generate_batch()\n",
   872→    "\n",
   873→    "# Create batch generator\n",
   874→    "batch_generator = BucketedBatchGenerator(\n",
   875→    "    audio_embeddings,\n",
   876→    "    text_embeddings,\n",
   877→    "    bucket_ids,\n",
   878→    "    BATCH_SIZE\n",
   879→    ")\n",

   892→    "## 15. Contrastive Training with Bucketed Sampling"
   893→   ]
   894→  },
   895→  {
   896→   "cell_type": "code",
   897→   "execution_count": null,
   898→   "metadata": {},
   899→   "outputs": [],
   900→   "source": [
   901→    "class ContrastiveLoss(tf.keras.losses.Loss):\n",
   902→    "    def __init__(self, temperature=0.2, **kwargs):\n",
   903→    "        super().__init__(**kwargs)\n",
   904→    "        self.temperature = temperature\n",
   905→    "    \n",
   906→    "    def call(self, audio_emb, text_emb):\n",
   907→    "        logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / self.temperature\n",
   908→    "        batch_size = tf.shape(audio_emb)[0]\n",
   909→    "        labels = tf.range(batch_size)\n",
   910→    "        \n",
   911→    "        loss_a2t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)\n",
   912→    "        loss_t2a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))\n",
   913→    "        \n",
   914→    "        return (tf.reduce_mean(loss_a2t) + tf.reduce_mean(loss_t2a)) / 2\n",
   915→    "\n",
   916→    "# Setup\n",
   917→    "optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)\n",
   918→    "loss_fn = ContrastiveLoss(temperature=TEMPERATURE)\n",
   919→    "\n",
   920→    "@tf.function\n",
   921→    "def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):\n",
   922→    "    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:\n",
   923→    "        audio_proj = audio_projection(audio_batch, training=True)\n",
   924→    "        text_proj = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)\n",
   925→    "        loss = loss_fn(audio_proj, text_proj)\n",
   926→    "    \n",
   927→    "    variables = audio_projection.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables\n",
   928→    "    gradients = tape.gradient(loss, variables)\n",
   929→    "    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, variables))\n",
   930→    "    return loss\n",
   931→    "\n",
   932→    "print(\"Training setup complete\")"
   933→   ]
   934→  },

       class BucketedBatchGenerator:
           def generate_batch(self):
               selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)
               batch_audio = []
               batch_text = []
               for bucket_id in selected_buckets:
                   idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])
                   batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])
                   batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])

<cell id="cell-0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># Audio Embedding Dataset Generator for ESP32-S3 Phase 3

Generate a large audio-text dataset (~32k-50k samples) for training audio embeddings.

## Pipeline
1. Load 2008 questions from `full.csv`
2. Cluster similar questions into buckets for contrastive learning
3. Generate audio with 8 TED voices (XTTS-v2)
4. Add conference background noise
5. Apply audio augmentation
6. Extract YAMNet embeddings
7. Train contrastive learning model (with bucketed sampling)
8. Export TFLite for ESP32

## Key Insight for Contrastive Learning
- **Positive pairs**: Audio + text from SAME question
- **Negative pairs**: Audio + text from DIFFERENT questions
- Bucket similar questions together so variants of "What is email" are treated as same class

## Output
- `audio_projection_quantized.tflite` (~663KB)
- `embeddings.bin` (2008 x 256-dim)
- `intents.txt` (2008 question strings)

---</cell id="cell-0">
<cell id="cell-1"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 1. Configuration</cell id="cell-1">
<cell id="cell-2">#=============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
#=============================================================================

# Processing
VOICES_PER_TEXT = 8          # 8 TED speakers
AUGMENTATIONS_PER_AUDIO = 2  # Original + 1 augmented

# Background noise
BACKGROUND_NOISE_TYPES = ['crowd_murmur', 'hvac_hum', 'announcements', 'footsteps']
NOISE_PROBABILITY = 0.5      # 50% chance to add noise
NOISE_SNR_DB = 15            # Signal-to-noise ratio (higher = cleaner speech)

# Bucketing for contrastive learning
# Questions are grouped by semantic similarity so audio variations
# of the same question are treated as positives, not negatives
SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.85  # Questions above this similarity are in same bucket
MIN_BUCKET_SIZE = 1          # Minimum questions per bucket
MAX_BUCKET_SIZE = 10         # Maximum questions per bucket

# Embedding dimensions
YAMNET_DIM = 1024            # YAMNet output dimension
TEXT_DIM = 384               # MiniLM output dimension
EMBEDDING_DIM = 256          # Final projection dimension

# Training
BATCH_SIZE = 32              # Must be <= number of buckets for proper contrastive learning
EPOCHS = 500
LEARNING_RATE = 3e-4
TEMPERATURE = 0.2            # Contrastive loss temperature

# Paths
from pathlib import Path
WORK_DIR = Path('/workspace') if Path('/workspace').exists() else Path('.')
DATA_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'data' / 'raw'
SPEAKER_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'speaker_voices'
NOISE_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'background_noise'
AUDIO_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'audio_data'
MODEL_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'models'

# Calculated totals

<cell id="cell-7"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 3. Load Dataset & Create Buckets

For contrastive learning to work properly:
- Similar questions (e.g., "What is the email" vs "Tell me the email address") should be in the SAME bucket
- During training, we sample ONE audio per bucket per batch
- This ensures negatives are truly different questions, not just audio variations of the same question</cell id="cell-7">
<cell id="cell-8">from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Load text encoder for bucketing
print("Loading MiniLM for question bucketing...")
text_encoder = SentenceTransformer('sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')

# Load questions
qa_file = DATA_DIR / 'full.csv'
if not qa_file.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"full.csv not found at {qa_file}")

qa_df = pd.read_csv(qa_file)
questions = qa_df['question'].tolist()
answers = qa_df['answer'].tolist() if 'answer' in qa_df.columns else [None] * len(questions)

print(f"Loaded {len(questions)} questions")</cell id="cell-8">
<cell id="cell-9"># Encode all questions for clustering
print("Encoding questions for clustering...")
question_embeddings = text_encoder.encode(questions, show_progress_bar=True)
print(f"Question embeddings shape: {question_embeddings.shape}")</cell id="cell-9">
<cell id="cell-10"># Cluster similar questions into buckets
print(f"Clustering questions (similarity threshold: {SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD})...")

# Use Agglomerative Clustering with cosine distance
distance_threshold = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD  # Convert similarity to distance
clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(
    n_clusters=None,
    distance_threshold=distance_threshold,
    metric='cosine',
    linkage='average'
)
cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(question_embeddings)

# Create buckets
buckets = defaultdict(list)
for idx, label in enumerate(cluster_labels):
    buckets[label].append({
        'idx': idx,
        'question': questions[idx],
        'answer': answers[idx],
        'embedding': question_embeddings[idx]
    })

num_buckets = len(buckets)
bucket_sizes = [len(b) for b in buckets.values()]

print(f"\nBucketing Results:")
print(f"  Total questions: {len(questions)}")
print(f"  Number of buckets: {num_buckets}")
print(f"  Avg bucket size: {np.mean(bucket_sizes):.1f}")
print(f"  Min bucket size: {min(bucket_sizes)}")
print(f"  Max bucket size: {max(bucket_sizes)}")

# Show sample buckets
print(f"\nSample buckets (showing first 3):")
for i, (label, items) in enumerate(list(buckets.items())[:3]):
    print(f"  Bucket {label} ({len(items)} questions):")
    for item in items[:3]:
        print(f"    - {item['question'][:60]}...")</cell id="cell-10">
<cell id="cell-11"># Save bucket mapping for reference
bucket_mapping = {
    'num_buckets': num_buckets,
    'questions_per_bucket': {str(k): len(v) for k, v in buckets.items()},
    'bucket_assignments': {str(i): int(cluster_labels[i]) for i in range(len(questions))}
}

with open(LOG_DIR / 'bucket_mapping.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(bucket_mapping, f, indent=2)

print(f"Bucket mapping saved to {LOG_DIR / 'bucket_mapping.json'}")</cell id="cell-11">

<cell id="cell-18"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 7. Audio Generation Utilities</cell id="cell-18">
<cell id="cell-19">from audiomentations import Compose, AddGaussianNoise, TimeStretch, PitchShift

# Audio augmentation pipeline
augmenter = Compose([
    AddGaussianNoise(min_amplitude=0.001, max_amplitude=0.015, p=0.5),
    TimeStretch(min_rate=0.9, max_rate=1.1, p=0.5),
    PitchShift(min_semitones=-2, max_semitones=2, p=0.5),
])

def add_background_noise(audio, sr, noise_type, snr_db=15):
    """Mix background noise at specified SNR"""
    if noise_type not in noise_files:
        return audio
    
    noise, _ = librosa.load(noise_files[noise_type], sr=sr, mono=True)
    
    # Loop noise if shorter than audio
    while len(noise) < len(audio):
        noise = np.concatenate([noise, noise])
    
    # Random start point
    start = random.randint(0, max(0, len(noise) - len(audio)))
    noise = noise[start:start + len(audio)]
    
    # Calculate scale factor for desired SNR
    audio_power = np.mean(audio ** 2)
    noise_power = np.mean(noise ** 2)
    if noise_power > 0:
        scale = np.sqrt(audio_power / (10 ** (snr_db / 10) * noise_power))
        mixed = audio + noise * scale
        return mixed / np.max(np.abs(mixed))  # Normalize
    return audio

def apply_augmentation(audio, sr):
    """Apply random augmentation"""
    return augmenter(samples=audio, sample_rate=sr)

def generate_audio_for_text(text, speaker_wav, output_path):
    """Generate audio using XTTS-v2"""
    tts.tts_to_file(
        text=text,
        file_path=output_path,
        speaker_wav=speaker_wav,
        language="en"
    )

print("Audio generation utilities defined")</cell id="cell-19">
<cell id="cell-20"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 8. State Persistence (Resume Capability)</cell id="cell-20">
<cell id="cell-21"># State tracking for resume capability
state_file = LOG_DIR / 'generation_state.json'

def save_generation_state(question_idx, speaker_idx, total_generated):
    """Save generation progress for resume"""
    state = {
        'question_idx': question_idx,
        'speaker_idx': speaker_idx,
        'total_generated': total_generated,
        'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
    }
    with open(state_file, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(state, f, indent=2)

def load_generation_state():
    """Load generation progress for resume"""
    if state_file.exists():
        with open(state_file) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    return None

print("State persistence utilities defined")</cell id="cell-21">
<cell id="cell-22"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 9. Audio Generation

Generate audio for all questions with all speakers.
Each question gets 8 voice variants + augmented versions.</cell id="cell-22">
<cell id="cell-23"># Check for resume

start_q_idx = state['question_idx'] if state else 0
start_s_idx = state['speaker_idx'] if state else 0
total_generated = state['total_generated'] if state else 0

print(f"Audio Generation")

# Create output directory for each bucket

<cell id="cell-24"># Generate audio for all questions
# Organized by bucket for easier contrastive batch sampling later

metadata = []  # Track all audio-text pairs with bucket info

for q_idx, question in enumerate(tqdm(questions[start_q_idx:], initial=start_q_idx, total=len(questions))):
    actual_q_idx = start_q_idx + q_idx
    bucket_id = int(cluster_labels[actual_q_idx])
    output_dir = AUDIO_DIR / f'bucket_{bucket_id}'
    
    for s_idx, speaker_file in enumerate(speaker_files):
        if actual_q_idx == start_q_idx and s_idx < start_s_idx:
            continue  # Skip already processed
        
        base_name = f'q{actual_q_idx:04d}_s{s_idx}'
        audio_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}.wav'
        
        if not audio_file.exists():
            try:
                # Generate base audio
                generate_audio_for_text(question, speaker_file, str(audio_file))
                
                # Load for processing
                audio, sr = librosa.load(str(audio_file), sr=16000, mono=True)
                
                # Record base audio
                metadata.append({
                    'file': str(audio_file),
                    'text': question,
                    'question_idx': actual_q_idx,
                    'bucket_id': bucket_id,
                    'speaker': s_idx,
                    'variant': 'original'
                })
                
                # Maybe add background noise
                if random.random() < NOISE_PROBABILITY:
                    noise_type = random.choice(BACKGROUND_NOISE_TYPES)
                    audio_noisy = add_background_noise(audio, sr, noise_type, NOISE_SNR_DB)
                    noisy_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}_noise.wav'
                    sf.write(str(noisy_file), audio_noisy, sr)
                    metadata.append({
                        'file': str(noisy_file),
                        'text': question,
                        'question_idx': actual_q_idx,
                        'bucket_id': bucket_id,
                        'speaker': s_idx,
                        'variant': f'noise_{noise_type}'
                    })
                
                # Create augmented version
                audio_aug = apply_augmentation(audio, sr)
                aug_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}_aug.wav'
                sf.write(str(aug_file), audio_aug, sr)
                metadata.append({
                    'file': str(aug_file),
                    'text': question,
                    'question_idx': actual_q_idx,
                    'bucket_id': bucket_id,
                    'speaker': s_idx,
                    'variant': 'augmented'
                })
                
                total_generated += 2  # base + augmented (noise is bonus)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"\nError generating {base_name}: {e}")
                continue
        
        # Save state periodically
        if total_generated % 100 == 0:
            save_generation_state(actual_q_idx, s_idx, total_generated)

# Save final metadata
metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / 'metadata.json'
with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2)

print(f"\nGeneration complete!")
print(f"  Total generated: {total_generated}")
print(f"  Metadata entries: {len(metadata)}")
print(f"  Metadata saved: {metadata_file}")</cell id="cell-24">

print("YAMNet loaded!")</cell id="cell-26">
<cell id="cell-27"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 11. Extract YAMNet Embeddings</cell id="cell-27">
<cell id="cell-28">def load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path, target_sr=16000, target_length=3):
    """Load and prepare audio for YAMNet (3 seconds, 16kHz)"""
    audio, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)
    
    # Pad or trim to target length
    target_samples = target_length * target_sr
    if len(audio) < target_samples:
        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, target_samples - len(audio)))
    else:
        audio = audio[:target_samples]
    
    return audio.astype(np.float32)

# Load metadata if not in memory
if 'metadata' not in dir() or len(metadata) == 0:
    metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / 'metadata.json'
    with open(metadata_file) as f:
        metadata = json.load(f)

print(f"Extracting YAMNet embeddings...")
print(f"Total files: {len(metadata)}")

audio_embeddings = []
valid_metadata = []

for item in tqdm(metadata):
    file_path = item['file']
    
    if not Path(file_path).exists():
        continue
    
    try:
        audio = load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path)
        _, embeddings, _ = yamnet_model(audio)
        avg_embedding = tf.reduce_mean(embeddings, axis=0).numpy()
        
        audio_embeddings.append(avg_embedding)
        valid_metadata.append(item)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\nError processing {file_path}: {e}")
        continue

audio_embeddings = np.array(audio_embeddings)
print(f"\nYAMNet embeddings shape: {audio_embeddings.shape}")
print(f"Valid samples: {len(valid_metadata)}")</cell id="cell-28">
<cell id="cell-29"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 12. Prepare Text Embeddings (Per Bucket)</cell id="cell-29">
<cell id="cell-30"># Get text embeddings for each audio sample
# Key: use the bucket's representative embedding for contrastive learning

# Create bucket -> representative embedding mapping
# Use mean of all question embeddings in each bucket
bucket_embeddings = {}
for bucket_id, items in buckets.items():
    bucket_embs = np.array([item['embedding'] for item in items])
    bucket_embeddings[bucket_id] = np.mean(bucket_embs, axis=0)

# Get text embedding for each audio sample based on its bucket
text_embeddings = []
bucket_ids = []

for item in valid_metadata:
    bucket_id = item['bucket_id']
    text_embeddings.append(bucket_embeddings[bucket_id])
    bucket_ids.append(bucket_id)

text_embeddings = np.array(text_embeddings)
bucket_ids = np.array(bucket_ids)

print(f"Text embeddings shape: {text_embeddings.shape}")
print(f"Unique buckets in training data: {len(np.unique(bucket_ids))}")</cell id="cell-30">
<cell id="cell-31"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 13. Build Projection Models</cell id="cell-31">
<cell id="cell-32"># Audio projection: 1024 -> 256
audio_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(YAMNET_DIM,)),
    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(512, activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),
    tf.keras.layers.Dropout(0.2),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),
    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))
], name='audio_projection')

# Text projection: 384 -> 256
text_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(TEXT_DIM,)),
    tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),
    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))
], name='text_projection')

print("Audio Projection Model:")
audio_projection.summary()
print("\nText Projection Model:")
text_projection.summary()</cell id="cell-32">
<cell id="cell-33"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 14. Bucketed Batch Sampler for Contrastive Learning

**Key insight**: For contrastive loss to work, each batch must have:
- ONE audio sample per bucket (no duplicates from same bucket)
- This ensures all other samples in the batch are true negatives</cell id="cell-33">
<cell id="cell-34">class BucketedBatchGenerator:
    """Generate batches where each sample is from a different bucket.
    
    This ensures proper contrastive learning where negatives are truly
    from different questions, not just different audio of the same question.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, audio_embs, text_embs, bucket_ids, batch_size):
        self.audio_embs = audio_embs
        self.text_embs = text_embs
        self.bucket_ids = bucket_ids
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        
        # Group samples by bucket
        self.bucket_to_indices = defaultdict(list)
        for idx, bid in enumerate(bucket_ids):
            self.bucket_to_indices[bid].append(idx)
        
        self.all_buckets = list(self.bucket_to_indices.keys())
        
        # Ensure batch_size <= num_buckets
        if batch_size > len(self.all_buckets):
            print(f"Warning: batch_size ({batch_size}) > num_buckets ({len(self.all_buckets)})")
            print(f"Reducing batch_size to {len(self.all_buckets)}")
            self.batch_size = len(self.all_buckets)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.audio_embs) // self.batch_size
    
    def generate_batch(self):
        """Generate one batch with one sample per bucket."""
        # Randomly select batch_size buckets
        selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)
        
        batch_audio = []
        batch_text = []
        
        for bucket_id in selected_buckets:
            # Randomly select one sample from this bucket
            idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])
            batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])
            batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])
        
        return np.array(batch_audio), np.array(batch_text)
    
    def generate_epoch(self):
        """Generate batches for one epoch."""
        for _ in range(len(self)):
            yield self.generate_batch()

# Create batch generator
batch_generator = BucketedBatchGenerator(
    audio_embeddings,
    text_embeddings,
    bucket_ids,
    BATCH_SIZE
)

print(f"Bucketed Batch Generator:")
print(f"  Samples: {len(audio_embeddings)}")
print(f"  Buckets: {len(batch_generator.all_buckets)}")
print(f"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}")
print(f"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}")</cell id="cell-34">
<cell id="cell-35"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 15. Contrastive Training with Bucketed Sampling</cell id="cell-35">
<cell id="cell-36">class ContrastiveLoss(tf.keras.losses.Loss):
    def __init__(self, temperature=0.2, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.temperature = temperature
    
    def call(self, audio_emb, text_emb):
        logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / self.temperature
        batch_size = tf.shape(audio_emb)[0]
        labels = tf.range(batch_size)
        
        loss_a2t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
        loss_t2a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))
        
        return (tf.reduce_mean(loss_a2t) + tf.reduce_mean(loss_t2a)) / 2

# Setup
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
loss_fn = ContrastiveLoss(temperature=TEMPERATURE)

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        audio_proj = audio_projection(audio_batch, training=True)
        text_proj = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)
        loss = loss_fn(audio_proj, text_proj)
    
    variables = audio_projection.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables
    gradients = tape.gradient(loss, variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, variables))
    return loss

print("Training setup complete")</cell id="cell-36">
<cell id="cell-37"># Training loop
print(f"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs with bucketed sampling...")
print(f"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}")
print(f"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}")

history = {'loss': []}
best_loss = float('inf')

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    epoch_losses = []
    
    for audio_batch, text_batch in batch_generator.generate_epoch():
        audio_batch = tf.constant(audio_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        text_batch = tf.constant(text_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        
        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)
        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())
    
    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)
    history['loss'].append(avg_loss)
    
    # Learning rate decay
    if epoch > 0 and epoch % 50 == 0:
        if avg_loss >= best_loss:
            new_lr = optimizer.learning_rate.numpy() * 0.5
            if new_lr >= 1e-6:
                optimizer.learning_rate.assign(new_lr)
                print(f"\nEpoch {epoch}: LR reduced to {new_lr:.2e}")
    
    if avg_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = avg_loss
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}")

print(f"\nTraining complete!")
print(f"Final loss: {history['loss'][-1]:.4f}")
print(f"Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}")</cell id="cell-37">
<cell id="cell-38"># Plot training history
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
plt.plot(history['loss'])
plt.title('Contrastive Loss (Bucketed Sampling)')
plt.xlabel('Epoch')
plt.ylabel('Loss')
plt.grid(True)
plt.axhline(y=1.0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Target')
plt.axhline(y=0.5, color='g', linestyle='--', label='Excellent')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig(str(MODEL_DIR / 'training_loss.png'), dpi=150)
plt.show()</cell id="cell-38">
<cell id="cell-39"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 16. Evaluation</cell id="cell-39">
<cell id="cell-40"># Project embeddings
audio_projected = audio_projection.predict(audio_embeddings)
text_projected = text_projection.predict(text_embeddings)

# Compute similarity matrix (sample for visualization)
sample_size = min(500, len(audio_projected))
similarity_matrix = cosine_similarity(
    audio_projected[:sample_size],
    text_projected[:sample_size]
)

# Accuracy (match to same bucket, not exact index)
predictions = np.argmax(similarity_matrix, axis=1)
pred_buckets = bucket_ids[:sample_size][predictions]
true_buckets = bucket_ids[:sample_size]
bucket_accuracy = np.mean(pred_buckets == true_buckets)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"EVALUATION RESULTS")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Bucket Matching Accuracy: {bucket_accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Mean diagonal similarity: {np.mean(np.diag(similarity_matrix)):.3f}")
print(f"Mean off-diagonal: {np.mean(similarity_matrix[~np.eye(sample_size, dtype=bool)]):.3f}")
print(f"Similarity gap: {np.mean(np.diag(similarity_matrix)) - np.mean(similarity_matrix[~np.eye(sample_size, dtype=bool)]):.3f}")</cell id="cell-40">
<cell id="cell-41"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 17. Export for ESP32</cell id="cell-41">
<cell id="cell-42"># Save Keras model
audio_projection.save(str(MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection.h5'))
print(f"Saved Keras model: {MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection.h5'}")

# Convert to TFLite with quantization
converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_keras_model(audio_projection)
converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]

# Representative dataset for quantization
def representative_dataset():
    for i in range(min(100, len(audio_embeddings))):
        yield [audio_embeddings[i:i+1].astype(np.float32)]

converter.representative_dataset = representative_dataset
converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS_INT8]
converter.inference_input_type = tf.float32
converter.inference_output_type = tf.float32

tflite_model = converter.convert()

tflite_path = MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection_quantized.tflite'
with open(tflite_path, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(tflite_model)

print(f"Quantized TFLite model: {tflite_path}")
print(f"Size: {len(tflite_model) / 1024:.2f} KB")</cell id="cell-42">

<cell id="cell-0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># Audio Embedding Dataset Generator for ESP32-S3 Phase 3

Generate a large audio-text dataset (~32k-50k samples) for training audio embeddings.

## Pipeline
1. Load 2008 questions from `full.csv`
2. Cluster similar questions into buckets for contrastive learning
3. Generate audio with 8 TED voices (XTTS-v2)
4. Add conference background noise
5. Apply audio augmentation
6. Extract YAMNet embeddings
7. Train contrastive learning model (with bucketed sampling)
8. Export TFLite for ESP32

## Key Insight for Contrastive Learning
- **Positive pairs**: Audio + text from SAME question
- **Negative pairs**: Audio + text from DIFFERENT questions
- Bucket similar questions together so variants of "What is email" are treated as same class

## Output
- `audio_projection_quantized.tflite` (~663KB)
- `embeddings.bin` (2008 x 256-dim)
- `intents.txt` (2008 question strings)

---</cell id="cell-0">

<cell id="cell-18"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 7. Audio Generation Utilities</cell id="cell-18">
<cell id="cell-19">from audiomentations import Compose, AddGaussianNoise, TimeStretch, PitchShift

# Audio augmentation pipeline
augmenter = Compose([
    AddGaussianNoise(min_amplitude=0.001, max_amplitude=0.015, p=0.5),
    TimeStretch(min_rate=0.9, max_rate=1.1, p=0.5),
    PitchShift(min_semitones=-2, max_semitones=2, p=0.5),
])

def add_background_noise(audio, sr, noise_type, snr_db=15):
    """Mix background noise at specified SNR"""
    if noise_type not in noise_files:
        return audio
    
    noise, _ = librosa.load(noise_files[noise_type], sr=sr, mono=True)
    
    # Loop noise if shorter than audio
    while len(noise) < len(audio):
        noise = np.concatenate([noise, noise])
    
    # Random start point
    start = random.randint(0, max(0, len(noise) - len(audio)))
    noise = noise[start:start + len(audio)]
    
    # Calculate scale factor for desired SNR
    audio_power = np.mean(audio ** 2)
    noise_power = np.mean(noise ** 2)
    if noise_power > 0:
        scale = np.sqrt(audio_power / (10 ** (snr_db / 10) * noise_power))
        mixed = audio + noise * scale
        return mixed / np.max(np.abs(mixed))  # Normalize
    return audio

def apply_augmentation(audio, sr):
    """Apply random augmentation"""
    return augmenter(samples=audio, sample_rate=sr)

def generate_audio_for_text(text, speaker_wav, output_path):
    """Generate audio using XTTS-v2"""
    tts.tts_to_file(
        text=text,
        file_path=output_path,
        speaker_wav=speaker_wav,
        language="en"
    )

print("Audio generation utilities defined")</cell id="cell-19">

<cell id="cell-27"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 11. Extract YAMNet Embeddings</cell id="cell-27">
<cell id="cell-28">def load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path, target_sr=16000, target_length=3):
    """Load and prepare audio for YAMNet (3 seconds, 16kHz)"""
    audio, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)
    
    # Pad or trim to target length
    target_samples = target_length * target_sr
    if len(audio) < target_samples:
        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, target_samples - len(audio)))
    else:
        audio = audio[:target_samples]
    
    return audio.astype(np.float32)

# Load metadata if not in memory

    if not Path(file_path).exists():

        avg_embedding = tf.reduce_mean(embeddings, axis=0).numpy()
        
        audio_embeddings.append(avg_embedding)

<cell id="cell-33"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 14. Bucketed Batch Sampler for Contrastive Learning

**Key insight**: For contrastive loss to work, each batch must have:
- ONE audio sample per bucket (no duplicates from same bucket)
- This ensures all other samples in the batch are true negatives</cell id="cell-33">
<cell id="cell-34">class BucketedBatchGenerator:
    """Generate batches where each sample is from a different bucket.
    
    This ensures proper contrastive learning where negatives are truly
    from different questions, not just different audio of the same question.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, audio_embs, text_embs, bucket_ids, batch_size):
        self.audio_embs = audio_embs
        self.text_embs = text_embs
        self.bucket_ids = bucket_ids
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        
        # Group samples by bucket
        self.bucket_to_indices = defaultdict(list)
        for idx, bid in enumerate(bucket_ids):
            self.bucket_to_indices[bid].append(idx)
        
        self.all_buckets = list(self.bucket_to_indices.keys())
        
        # Ensure batch_size <= num_buckets
        if batch_size > len(self.all_buckets):
            print(f"Warning: batch_size ({batch_size}) > num_buckets ({len(self.all_buckets)})")
            print(f"Reducing batch_size to {len(self.all_buckets)}")
            self.batch_size = len(self.all_buckets)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.audio_embs) // self.batch_size
    
    def generate_batch(self):
        """Generate one batch with one sample per bucket."""
        # Randomly select batch_size buckets
        selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)
        
        batch_audio = []
        batch_text = []
        
        for bucket_id in selected_buckets:
            # Randomly select one sample from this bucket
            idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])
            batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])
            batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])
        
        return np.array(batch_audio), np.array(batch_text)
    
    def generate_epoch(self):
        """Generate batches for one epoch."""
        for _ in range(len(self)):
            yield self.generate_batch()

# Create batch generator
batch_generator = BucketedBatchGenerator(
    audio_embeddings,
    text_embeddings,
    bucket_ids,
    BATCH_SIZE
)

print(f"Bucketed Batch Generator:")
print(f"  Samples: {len(audio_embeddings)}")
print(f"  Buckets: {len(batch_generator.all_buckets)}")
print(f"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}")
print(f"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}")</cell id="cell-34">
<cell id="cell-35"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 15. Contrastive Training with Bucketed Sampling</cell id="cell-35">
<cell id="cell-36">class ContrastiveLoss(tf.keras.losses.Loss):
    def __init__(self, temperature=0.2, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.temperature = temperature
    
    def call(self, audio_emb, text_emb):
        logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / self.temperature
        batch_size = tf.shape(audio_emb)[0]
        labels = tf.range(batch_size)
        
        loss_a2t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
        loss_t2a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))
        
        return (tf.reduce_mean(loss_a2t) + tf.reduce_mean(loss_t2a)) / 2

# Setup
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
loss_fn = ContrastiveLoss(temperature=TEMPERATURE)

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        audio_proj = audio_projection(audio_batch, training=True)
        text_proj = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)
        loss = loss_fn(audio_proj, text_proj)
    
    variables = audio_projection.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables
    gradients = tape.gradient(loss, variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, variables))
    return loss

print("Training setup complete")</cell id="cell-36">
<cell id="cell-37"># Training loop
print(f"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs with bucketed sampling...")
print(f"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}")
print(f"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}")

history = {'loss': []}
best_loss = float('inf')

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    epoch_losses = []
    
    for audio_batch, text_batch in batch_generator.generate_epoch():
        audio_batch = tf.constant(audio_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        text_batch = tf.constant(text_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        
        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)
        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())
    
    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)
    history['loss'].append(avg_loss)
    
    # Learning rate decay
    if epoch > 0 and epoch % 50 == 0:
        if avg_loss >= best_loss:
            new_lr = optimizer.learning_rate.numpy() * 0.5
            if new_lr >= 1e-6:
                optimizer.learning_rate.assign(new_lr)
                print(f"\nEpoch {epoch}: LR reduced to {new_lr:.2e}")
    
    if avg_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = avg_loss
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}")

print(f"\nTraining complete!")
print(f"Final loss: {history['loss'][-1]:.4f}")
print(f"Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}")</cell id="cell-37">
<cell id="cell-38"># Plot training history
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
plt.plot(history['loss'])
plt.title('Contrastive Loss (Bucketed Sampling)')
plt.xlabel('Epoch')
plt.ylabel('Loss')
plt.grid(True)
plt.axhline(y=1.0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Target')
plt.axhline(y=0.5, color='g', linestyle='--', label='Excellent')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig(str(MODEL_DIR / 'training_loss.png'), dpi=150)
plt.show()</cell id="cell-38">
<cell id="cell-39"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 16. Evaluation</cell id="cell-39">
<cell id="cell-40"># Project embeddings
audio_projected = audio_projection.predict(audio_embeddings)
text_projected = text_projection.predict(text_embeddings)

# Compute similarity matrix (sample for visualization)
sample_size = min(500, len(audio_projected))
similarity_matrix = cosine_similarity(
    audio_projected[:sample_size],
    text_projected[:sample_size]
)

# Accuracy (match to same bucket, not exact index)
predictions = np.argmax(similarity_matrix, axis=1)
pred_buckets = bucket_ids[:sample_size][predictions]
true_buckets = bucket_ids[:sample_size]
bucket_accuracy = np.mean(pred_buckets == true_buckets)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"EVALUATION RESULTS")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Bucket Matching Accuracy: {bucket_accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Mean diagonal similarity: {np.mean(np.diag(similarity_matrix)):.3f}")
print(f"Mean off-diagonal: {np.mean(similarity_matrix[~np.eye(sample_size, dtype=bool)]):.3f}")
print(f"Similarity gap: {np.mean(np.diag(similarity_matrix)) - np.mean(similarity_matrix[~np.eye(sample_size, dtype=bool)]):.3f}")</cell id="cell-40">
<cell id="cell-41"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 17. Export for ESP32</cell id="cell-41">
<cell id="cell-42"># Save Keras model
audio_projection.save(str(MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection.h5'))
print(f"Saved Keras model: {MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection.h5'}")

# Convert to TFLite with quantization
converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_keras_model(audio_projection)
converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]

# Representative dataset for quantization
def representative_dataset():
    for i in range(min(100, len(audio_embeddings))):
        yield [audio_embeddings[i:i+1].astype(np.float32)]

converter.representative_dataset = representative_dataset
converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS_INT8]
converter.inference_input_type = tf.float32
converter.inference_output_type = tf.float32

tflite_model = converter.convert()

tflite_path = MODEL_DIR / 'audio_projection_quantized.tflite'
with open(tflite_path, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(tflite_model)

print(f"Quantized TFLite model: {tflite_path}")
print(f"Size: {len(tflite_model) / 1024:.2f} KB")</cell id="cell-42">

<cell id="cell-0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># Audio Embedding Dataset Generator for ESP32-S3 Phase 3

Generate a large audio-text dataset (~32k-50k samples) for training audio embeddings.

## Pipeline
1. Load 2008 questions from `full.csv`
2. Cluster similar questions into buckets for contrastive learning
3. Generate audio with 8 TED voices (XTTS-v2)
4. Add conference background noise
5. Apply audio augmentation
6. Extract YAMNet embeddings
7. Train contrastive learning model (with bucketed sampling)
8. Export TFLite for ESP32

## Key Insight for Contrastive Learning
- **Positive pairs**: Audio + text from SAME question
- **Negative pairs**: Audio + text from DIFFERENT questions
- Bucket similar questions together so variants of "What is email" are treated as same class

## Output
- `audio_projection_quantized.tflite` (~663KB)
- `embeddings.bin` (2008 x 256-dim)
- `intents.txt` (2008 question strings)

---</cell id="cell-0">
<cell id="cell-1"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 1. Configuration</cell id="cell-1">

MAX_BUCKET_SIZE = 10         # Maximum questions per bucket

# Embedding dimensions
YAMNET_DIM = 1024            # YAMNet output dimension
TEXT_DIM = 768               # MPNet output dimension (was 384 for MiniLM)
EMBEDDING_DIM = 256          # Final projection dimension

# Training
BATCH_SIZE = 32              # Must be <= number of buckets for proper contrastive learning
EPOCHS = 500
LEARNING_RATE = 3e-4
TEMPERATURE = 0.2            # Contrastive loss temperature

# Paths

SPEAKER_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'speaker_voices'

<cell id="cell-7"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 3. Load Dataset & Create Buckets

For contrastive learning to work properly:
- Similar questions (e.g., "What is the email" vs "Tell me the email address") should be in the SAME bucket
- During training, we sample ONE audio per bucket per batch
- This ensures negatives are truly different questions, not just audio variations of the same question</cell id="cell-7">

<cell id="cell-10"># Cluster similar questions into buckets
print(f"Clustering questions (similarity threshold: {SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD})...")

# Use Agglomerative Clustering with cosine distance
distance_threshold = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD  # Convert similarity to distance
clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(
    n_clusters=None,
    distance_threshold=distance_threshold,
    metric='cosine',
    linkage='average'
)
cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(question_embeddings)

# Create buckets
buckets = defaultdict(list)
for idx, label in enumerate(cluster_labels):
    buckets[label].append({
        'idx': idx,
        'question': questions[idx],
        'answer': answers[idx],
        'embedding': question_embeddings[idx]
    })

num_buckets = len(buckets)
bucket_sizes = [len(b) for b in buckets.values()]

print(f"\nBucketing Results:")
print(f"  Total questions: {len(questions)}")
print(f"  Number of buckets: {num_buckets}")
print(f"  Avg bucket size: {np.mean(bucket_sizes):.1f}")
print(f"  Min bucket size: {min(bucket_sizes)}")
print(f"  Max bucket size: {max(bucket_sizes)}")

# Show sample buckets

for i, (label, items) in enumerate(list(buckets.items())[:3]):

<cell id="cell-17">from audiomentations import Compose, AddGaussianNoise, TimeStretch, PitchShift

# Audio augmentation pipeline
augmenter = Compose([
    AddGaussianNoise(min_amplitude=0.001, max_amplitude=0.015, p=0.5),
    TimeStretch(min_rate=0.9, max_rate=1.1, p=0.5),
    PitchShift(min_semitones=-2, max_semitones=2, p=0.5),
])

def add_background_noise(audio, sr, noise_type, snr_db=15):
    """Mix background noise at specified SNR"""
    if noise_type not in noise_files:
        return audio
    
    noise, _ = librosa.load(noise_files[noise_type], sr=sr, mono=True)
    
    # Loop noise if shorter than audio
    while len(noise) < len(audio):
        noise = np.concatenate([noise, noise])
    
    # Random start point
    start = random.randint(0, max(0, len(noise) - len(audio)))
    noise = noise[start:start + len(audio)]
    
    # Calculate scale factor for desired SNR
    audio_power = np.mean(audio ** 2)
    noise_power = np.mean(noise ** 2)
    if noise_power > 0:
        scale = np.sqrt(audio_power / (10 ** (snr_db / 10) * noise_power))
        mixed = audio + noise * scale
        return mixed / np.max(np.abs(mixed))  # Normalize
    return audio

def apply_augmentation(audio, sr):
    """Apply random augmentation"""
    return augmenter(samples=audio, sample_rate=sr)

def generate_audio_for_text(text, speaker_wav, output_path):
    """Generate audio using XTTS-v2"""
    tts.tts_to_file(
        text=text,
        file_path=output_path,
        speaker_wav=speaker_wav,
        language="en"
    )

print("Audio generation utilities defined")</cell id="cell-17">

<cell id="cell-25"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 11. Extract YAMNet Embeddings</cell id="cell-25">
<cell id="cell-26">def load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path, target_sr=16000, target_length=3):
    """Load and prepare audio for YAMNet (3 seconds, 16kHz)"""
    audio, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)
    
    # Pad or trim to target length
    target_samples = target_length * target_sr
    if len(audio) < target_samples:
        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, target_samples - len(audio)))
    else:
        audio = audio[:target_samples]
    
    return audio.astype(np.float32)

# Load metadata if not in memory

for item in tqdm(metadata):

    if not Path(file_path).exists():
        continue
    
    try:
        audio = load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path)
        _, embeddings, _ = yamnet_model(audio)
        avg_embedding = tf.reduce_mean(embeddings, axis=0).numpy()
