/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - YAMNet-256 Audio Embedding Implementation
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "yamnet_embed.h"
#include "../../config.h"

#include <SD.h>
#include <esp_dsp.h>
#include <math.h>

// TensorFlow Lite includes
#include <TensorFlowLite_ESP32.h>
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/micro_mutable_op_resolver.h"
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/micro_interpreter.h"
#include "tensorflow/lite/schema/schema_generated.h"

YamNetEmbedder::YamNetEmbedder()
    : _melFilterbank(nullptr)
    , _fftInput(nullptr)
    , _fftOutput(nullptr)
    , _window(nullptr)
    , _melFeatures(nullptr)
    , _melInitialized(false)
    , _modelData(nullptr)
    , _modelSize(0)
    , _tensorArena(nullptr)
    , _interpreter(nullptr)
    , _inputTensor(nullptr)
    , _outputTensor(nullptr)
    , _loaded(false)
{
}

YamNetEmbedder::~YamNetEmbedder() {
    end();
}

bool YamNetEmbedder::begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize, const char* modelPath) {
    if (_loaded) return true;

    // Check pool size
    if (poolSize < YAMNET_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Pool too small");
        return false;
    }

    _tensorArena = pool;

    // Initialize mel-spectrogram
    if (!_initMelSpectrogram()) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Mel init failed");
        return false;
    }

    // Load model from SD
    if (!_loadModel(modelPath)) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Model load failed");
        _endMelSpectrogram();
        return false;
    }

    // Initialize TFLite interpreter
    if (!_initInterpreter()) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Interpreter init failed");
        if (_modelData) {
            free(_modelData);
            _modelData = nullptr;
        }
        _endMelSpectrogram();
        return false;
    }

    _loaded = true;
    Serial.printf("YamNet: Loaded (%.1fKB model)\n", _modelSize / 1024.0f);
    return true;
}

void YamNetEmbedder::end() {
    _interpreter = nullptr;
    _inputTensor = nullptr;
    _outputTensor = nullptr;
    _tensorArena = nullptr;

    if (_modelData) {
        free(_modelData);
        _modelData = nullptr;
    }

    _endMelSpectrogram();
    _loaded = false;
}

//==============================================================================
// Mel-Spectrogram Implementation
//==============================================================================

bool YamNetEmbedder::_initMelSpectrogram() {
    int numFreqBins = YAMNET_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;

    // Allocate mel filterbank
    _melFilterbank = (float*)ps_malloc(YAMNET_MEL_BINS * numFreqBins * sizeof(float));
    if (!_melFilterbank) return false;

    // Allocate working buffers
    _fftInput = (float*)ps_malloc(YAMNET_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
    _fftOutput = (float*)ps_malloc(YAMNET_FFT_SIZE * 2 * sizeof(float));
    _window = (float*)ps_malloc(YAMNET_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
    _melFeatures = (float*)ps_malloc(YAMNET_MEL_FRAMES * YAMNET_MEL_BINS * sizeof(float));

    if (!_fftInput || !_fftOutput || !_window || !_melFeatures) {
        _endMelSpectrogram();
        return false;
    }

    // Initialize ESP-DSP FFT
    esp_err_t ret = dsps_fft2r_init_fc32(NULL, YAMNET_FFT_SIZE);
    if (ret != ESP_OK) {
        _endMelSpectrogram();
        return false;
    }

    // Create Hann window
    for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
        _window[i] = 0.5f * (1.0f - cosf(2.0f * M_PI * i / (YAMNET_FFT_SIZE - 1)));
    }

    // Initialize mel filterbank
    float minFreq = 125.0f;
    float maxFreq = 7500.0f;
    float minMel = _hzToMel(minFreq);
    float maxMel = _hzToMel(maxFreq);

    // Create mel filter centers
    float* melCenters = (float*)malloc((YAMNET_MEL_BINS + 2) * sizeof(float));
    for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_MEL_BINS + 2; i++) {
        float mel = minMel + (maxMel - minMel) * i / (YAMNET_MEL_BINS + 1);
        melCenters[i] = _melToHz(mel);
    }

    // Build triangular filters
    float freqRes = (float)YAMNET_SAMPLE_RATE / YAMNET_FFT_SIZE;

    for (int m = 0; m < YAMNET_MEL_BINS; m++) {
        float left = melCenters[m];
        float center = melCenters[m + 1];
        float right = melCenters[m + 2];

        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
            float freq = k * freqRes;
            float weight = 0.0f;

            if (freq >= left && freq <= center) {
                weight = (freq - left) / (center - left);
            } else if (freq > center && freq <= right) {
                weight = (right - freq) / (right - center);
            }

            _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] = weight;
        }
    }

    free(melCenters);
    _melInitialized = true;
    return true;
}

void YamNetEmbedder::_endMelSpectrogram() {
    if (_melFilterbank) { free(_melFilterbank); _melFilterbank = nullptr; }
    if (_fftInput) { free(_fftInput); _fftInput = nullptr; }
    if (_fftOutput) { free(_fftOutput); _fftOutput = nullptr; }
    if (_window) { free(_window); _window = nullptr; }
    if (_melFeatures) { free(_melFeatures); _melFeatures = nullptr; }
    _melInitialized = false;
}

bool YamNetEmbedder::_computeMelSpectrogram(const int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* melOutput) {
    if (!_melInitialized) return false;

    float globalMin = 1e10f;
    float globalMax = -1e10f;

    // Generate frames
    for (int frame = 0; frame < YAMNET_MEL_FRAMES; frame++) {
        int startIdx = frame * YAMNET_HOP_LENGTH;

        if (startIdx + YAMNET_FFT_SIZE > (int)samples) {
            // Zero-pad remaining frames
            for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_MEL_BINS; i++) {
                melOutput[frame * YAMNET_MEL_BINS + i] = -80.0f;
            }
            continue;
        }

        // Compute power spectrum
        float powerSpectrum[YAMNET_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1];
        _computeFFTFrame(audio, startIdx, powerSpectrum);

        // Apply mel filterbank
        float melFrame[YAMNET_MEL_BINS];
        _applyMelFilterbank(powerSpectrum, melFrame);

        // Store (frames × bins format)
        for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_MEL_BINS; i++) {
            melOutput[frame * YAMNET_MEL_BINS + i] = melFrame[i];
            if (melFrame[i] < globalMin) globalMin = melFrame[i];
            if (melFrame[i] > globalMax) globalMax = melFrame[i];
        }
    }

    // Normalize to [0, 1] range (like training)
    float range = globalMax - globalMin;
    if (range > 1e-8f) {
        for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_MEL_FRAMES * YAMNET_MEL_BINS; i++) {
            melOutput[i] = (melOutput[i] - globalMin) / range;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

void YamNetEmbedder::_computeFFTFrame(const int16_t* audio, int startIdx, float* powerSpectrum) {
    // Apply window and convert to float
    for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
        _fftInput[i] = (float)audio[startIdx + i] * _window[i] / 32768.0f;
    }

    // Prepare complex input (real part only)
    for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
        _fftOutput[i * 2] = _fftInput[i];
        _fftOutput[i * 2 + 1] = 0.0f;
    }

    // Compute FFT using ESP-DSP
    dsps_fft2r_fc32(_fftOutput, YAMNET_FFT_SIZE);
    dsps_bit_rev_fc32(_fftOutput, YAMNET_FFT_SIZE);

    // Compute power spectrum: |X[k]|^2
    for (int k = 0; k < YAMNET_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1; k++) {
        float real = _fftOutput[k * 2];
        float imag = _fftOutput[k * 2 + 1];
        powerSpectrum[k] = real * real + imag * imag;
    }
}

void YamNetEmbedder::_applyMelFilterbank(float* powerSpectrum, float* melOutput) {
    int numFreqBins = YAMNET_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;

    for (int m = 0; m < YAMNET_MEL_BINS; m++) {
        float sum = 0.0f;

        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
            sum += _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] * powerSpectrum[k];
        }

        // Log transform
        melOutput[m] = log10f(sum + 1e-10f);
    }
}

float YamNetEmbedder::_hzToMel(float hz) {
    return 2595.0f * log10f(1.0f + hz / 700.0f);
}

float YamNetEmbedder::_melToHz(float mel) {
    return 700.0f * (powf(10.0f, mel / 2595.0f) - 1.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
// TFLite Implementation
//==============================================================================

bool YamNetEmbedder::_loadModel(const char* path) {
    File f = SD.open(path);
    if (!f) {
        Serial.printf("YamNet: Cannot open %s\n", path);
        return false;
    }

    _modelSize = f.size();
    _modelData = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_modelSize);
    if (!_modelData) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Model alloc failed");
        f.close();
        return false;
    }

    if (f.read(_modelData, _modelSize) != _modelSize) {
        free(_modelData);
        _modelData = nullptr;
        f.close();
        return false;
    }
    f.close();
    return true;
}

bool YamNetEmbedder::_initInterpreter() {
    const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(_modelData);
    if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
        Serial.printf("YamNet: Model version mismatch: %d vs %d\n",
                      model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
        return false;
    }

    // Op resolver for YAMNet-256
    static tflite::MicroMutableOpResolver<10> resolver;
    resolver.AddConv2D();
    resolver.AddDepthwiseConv2D();
    resolver.AddReshape();
    resolver.AddFullyConnected();
    resolver.AddMean();
    resolver.AddSoftmax();
    resolver.AddQuantize();
    resolver.AddDequantize();
    resolver.AddPad();
    resolver.AddLogistic();

    // Create interpreter
    static tflite::MicroInterpreter staticInterpreter(
        model, resolver, _tensorArena, YAMNET_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE);
    _interpreter = &staticInterpreter;

    if (_interpreter->AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: AllocateTensors failed");
        return false;
    }

    _inputTensor = _interpreter->input(0);
    _outputTensor = _interpreter->output(0);

    if (!_inputTensor || !_outputTensor) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Failed to get tensors");
        return false;
    }

    Serial.printf("YamNet: Input shape [%d, %d, %d]\n",
                  _inputTensor->dims->data[1],
                  _inputTensor->dims->data[2],
                  _inputTensor->dims->data[3]);
    Serial.printf("YamNet: Output shape [%d]\n", _outputTensor->dims->data[1]);

    return true;
}

bool YamNetEmbedder::_runInference(const float* melFeatures, float* embedding) {
    // Get input details
    int inputH = _inputTensor->dims->data[1];  // frames (96)
    int inputW = _inputTensor->dims->data[2];  // bins (64)
    int inputTotal = inputH * inputW;

    // Fill input tensor
    if (_inputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
        int8_t* inputData = _inputTensor->data.int8;
        float scale = _inputTensor->params.scale;
        int32_t zeroPoint = _inputTensor->params.zero_point;

        for (int i = 0; i < inputTotal; i++) {
            int32_t quantized = (int32_t)(melFeatures[i] / scale + zeroPoint);
            inputData[i] = constrain(quantized, -128, 127);
        }
    } else {
        // Float input
        float* inputData = _inputTensor->data.f;
        memcpy(inputData, melFeatures, inputTotal * sizeof(float));
    }

    // Run inference
    if (_interpreter->Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Invoke failed");
        return false;
    }

    // Extract embedding
    int outputDim = _outputTensor->dims->data[1];

    if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
        int8_t* outputData = _outputTensor->data.int8;
        float scale = _outputTensor->params.scale;
        int32_t zeroPoint = _outputTensor->params.zero_point;

        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
            embedding[i] = (outputData[i] - zeroPoint) * scale;
        }
    } else {
        float* outputData = _outputTensor->data.f;
        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
            embedding[i] = outputData[i];
        }
    }

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// Public API
//==============================================================================

bool YamNetEmbedder::embed(const int16_t* audio, size_t sampleCount, float* output) {
    if (!_loaded) return false;

    unsigned long startTime = millis();

    // Step 1: Compute mel-spectrogram
    if (!_computeMelSpectrogram(audio, sampleCount, _melFeatures)) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Mel computation failed");
        return false;
    }

    unsigned long melTime = millis();
    Serial.printf("YamNet: Mel-spec took %lu ms\n", melTime - startTime);

    // Step 2: Run YAMNet inference
    if (!_runInference(_melFeatures, output)) {
        Serial.println("YamNet: Inference failed");
        return false;
    }

    unsigned long inferTime = millis();
    Serial.printf("YamNet: Inference took %lu ms\n", inferTime - melTime);
    Serial.printf("YamNet: Total embed time: %lu ms\n", inferTime - startTime);

    return true;
}

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Embedding Similarity Search Module
 *
 * Performs cosine similarity search against pre-computed query embeddings
 * to find the closest matching intent for a given audio embedding.
 ******************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <Arduino.h>

//==============================================================================
// Search Result
//==============================================================================
struct SearchResult {
    int intentIdx;          // Index in intents file (0-based)
    float score;            // Cosine similarity score (0-1)
    char intent[256];       // Intent text string
};

//==============================================================================
// EmbeddingSearch - Cosine similarity search against pre-computed embeddings
//==============================================================================
class EmbeddingSearch {
public:
    EmbeddingSearch();
    ~EmbeddingSearch();

    // Load embeddings and intents from SD card
    // embeddingsPath: binary file with N × 256 float32 values
    // intentsPath: text file with N lines (one intent per line)
    bool begin(const char* embeddingsPath, const char* intentsPath);
    void end();

    // Search for closest embedding
    // embedding: float[256] query embedding
    // Returns SearchResult with best match
    SearchResult search(const float* embedding);

    // Get number of loaded embeddings
    int getCount() const { return _count; }

    // Check if loaded
    bool isLoaded() const { return _loaded; }

private:
    // Cosine similarity between two 256-dim vectors
    float _cosineSimilarity(const float* a, const float* b);

    // Load embeddings binary file
    bool _loadEmbeddings(const char* path);

    // Load intents text file
    bool _loadIntents(const char* path);

    // Get intent string by index
    void _getIntent(int idx, char* buffer, size_t bufSize);

    // Data
    float* _embeddings;      // N × 256 floats (in PSRAM)
    char* _intentsData;      // Raw intents text data
    int* _intentOffsets;     // Offsets into _intentsData for each intent
    int _count;              // Number of embeddings/intents

    bool _loaded;
};

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Embedding Similarity Search Implementation
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "embed_search.h"
#include "yamnet_embed.h"  // For YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM
#include "../../config.h"

#include <SD.h>
#include <math.h>

EmbeddingSearch::EmbeddingSearch()
    : _embeddings(nullptr)
    , _intentsData(nullptr)
    , _intentOffsets(nullptr)
    , _count(0)
    , _loaded(false)
{
}

EmbeddingSearch::~EmbeddingSearch() {
    end();
}

bool EmbeddingSearch::begin(const char* embeddingsPath, const char* intentsPath) {
    if (_loaded) return true;

    // Load embeddings first
    if (!_loadEmbeddings(embeddingsPath)) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Embeddings load failed");
        return false;
    }

    // Load intents
    if (!_loadIntents(intentsPath)) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Intents load failed");
        end();
        return false;
    }

    _loaded = true;
    Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Loaded %d embeddings (%.1fKB)\n",
                  _count, (_count * YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float)) / 1024.0f);
    return true;
}

void EmbeddingSearch::end() {
    if (_embeddings) {
        free(_embeddings);
        _embeddings = nullptr;
    }
    if (_intentsData) {
        free(_intentsData);
        _intentsData = nullptr;
    }
    if (_intentOffsets) {
        free(_intentOffsets);
        _intentOffsets = nullptr;
    }
    _count = 0;
    _loaded = false;
}

bool EmbeddingSearch::_loadEmbeddings(const char* path) {
    File f = SD.open(path);
    if (!f) {
        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Cannot open %s\n", path);
        return false;
    }

    // Calculate number of embeddings
    size_t fileSize = f.size();
    _count = fileSize / (YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float));

    if (_count == 0) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Empty embeddings file");
        f.close();
        return false;
    }

    Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: File size %d bytes, %d embeddings\n", fileSize, _count);

    // Allocate in PSRAM
    _embeddings = (float*)ps_malloc(_count * YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float));
    if (!_embeddings) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Embeddings alloc failed");
        f.close();
        return false;
    }

    // Read all embeddings
    size_t bytesRead = f.read((uint8_t*)_embeddings, fileSize);
    f.close();

    if (bytesRead != fileSize) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Embeddings read incomplete");
        free(_embeddings);
        _embeddings = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

bool EmbeddingSearch::_loadIntents(const char* path) {
    File f = SD.open(path);
    if (!f) {
        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Cannot open %s\n", path);
        return false;
    }

    // Read entire file into memory
    size_t fileSize = f.size();
    _intentsData = (char*)ps_malloc(fileSize + 1);
    if (!_intentsData) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Intents alloc failed");
        f.close();
        return false;
    }

    f.read((uint8_t*)_intentsData, fileSize);
    _intentsData[fileSize] = '\0';
    f.close();

    // Count lines and build offset table
    int lineCount = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < fileSize; i++) {
        if (_intentsData[i] == '\n') lineCount++;
    }
    // Add 1 if file doesn't end with newline
    if (fileSize > 0 && _intentsData[fileSize - 1] != '\n') lineCount++;

    // Verify line count matches embedding count
    if (lineCount < _count) {
        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Intent count mismatch: %d lines vs %d embeddings\n",
                      lineCount, _count);
        // Use minimum
        _count = lineCount;
    }

    // Build offset table
    _intentOffsets = (int*)ps_malloc(_count * sizeof(int));
    if (!_intentOffsets) {
        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Offsets alloc failed");
        free(_intentsData);
        _intentsData = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    int line = 0;
    _intentOffsets[0] = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < fileSize && line < _count; i++) {
        if (_intentsData[i] == '\n') {
            _intentsData[i] = '\0';  // Replace newline with null terminator
            line++;
            if (line < _count) {
                _intentOffsets[line] = i + 1;
            }
        }
    }

    Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Loaded %d intents\n", _count);
    return true;
}

void EmbeddingSearch::_getIntent(int idx, char* buffer, size_t bufSize) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= _count || !_intentsData || !_intentOffsets) {
        buffer[0] = '\0';
        return;
    }

    const char* intentStr = _intentsData + _intentOffsets[idx];
    strncpy(buffer, intentStr, bufSize - 1);
    buffer[bufSize - 1] = '\0';
}

float EmbeddingSearch::_cosineSimilarity(const float* a, const float* b) {
    float dot = 0.0f;
    float normA = 0.0f;
    float normB = 0.0f;

    // Unrolled loop for better performance
    for (int i = 0; i < YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM; i += 4) {
        dot += a[i] * b[i] + a[i+1] * b[i+1] + a[i+2] * b[i+2] + a[i+3] * b[i+3];
        normA += a[i] * a[i] + a[i+1] * a[i+1] + a[i+2] * a[i+2] + a[i+3] * a[i+3];
        normB += b[i] * b[i] + b[i+1] * b[i+1] + b[i+2] * b[i+2] + b[i+3] * b[i+3];
    }

    float denom = sqrtf(normA) * sqrtf(normB);
    if (denom < 1e-8f) return 0.0f;

    return dot / denom;
}

SearchResult EmbeddingSearch::search(const float* embedding) {
    SearchResult result;
    result.intentIdx = -1;
    result.score = -1.0f;
    result.intent[0] = '\0';

    if (!_loaded || !embedding) {
        return result;
    }

    unsigned long startTime = millis();

    float bestScore = -1.0f;
    int bestIdx = -1;

    // Linear search through all embeddings
    for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++) {
        float score = _cosineSimilarity(embedding, &_embeddings[i * YAMNET_EMBEDDING_DIM]);

        if (score > bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
            bestIdx = i;
        }
    }

    unsigned long searchTime = millis() - startTime;
    Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Searched %d embeddings in %lu ms\n", _count, searchTime);

    if (bestIdx >= 0) {
        result.intentIdx = bestIdx;
        result.score = bestScore;
        _getIntent(bestIdx, result.intent, sizeof(result.intent));
    }

    return result;
}

    65→void setState(BadgeState newState) {

    68→    Serial.printf("State: %d -> %d\n", currentState, newState);

    70→    // Exit current state

   - Contrastive learning with text projection (768-dim MPNet → 256-dim)
   - Cosine similarity search for intent matching

   134→
   135→### 1.3 Memory Management Strategy
   136→
   137→**Problem**: PSRAM is ~8MB, but models compete for space:
   138→- Wake word: ~700KB
   139→- YAMNet + projection: ~1MB
   140→- LLM: ~6MB
   141→- Video buffer: ~2MB
   142→
   143→**Solution**: Sequential model loading with explicit unload
   144→
   145→```cpp
   146→// Memory pool reserved in PSRAM
   147→#define ML_POOL_SIZE (6 * 1024 * 1024)  // 6MB for largest model
   148→static uint8_t* ml_pool = nullptr;
   149→
   150→// Each ML module uses pool, not direct ps_malloc
   151→class MLModule {
   152→public:
   153→    virtual bool load(uint8_t* pool, size_t pool_size) = 0;
   154→    virtual void unload() = 0;
   155→    virtual size_t requiredMemory() = 0;
   156→};
   157→
   158→// State transitions trigger load/unload:
   159→// LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   160→// RECORDING: wake_word.unload()
   161→// EMBEDDING: yamnet.load() → yamnet.unload()
   162→// LLM_INFER: llm.load() → llm.unload()
   163→// Return to LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   164→```
   165→
   166→### 1.4 Module Interfaces
   167→
   168→Each module follows `begin()`/`end()` pattern:
   169→
   170→```cpp
   171→// video_player.h
   172→class VideoPlayer {
   173→public:
   174→    bool begin(const char* mjpeg_path);  // Load video to PSRAM
   175→    void play();                          // Decode one frame
   176→    void pause();
   177→    void resume();
   178→    void setRotation(uint8_t r);
   179→    void showText(const char* text);     // Overlay text, pause video
   180→    void hideText();                      // Resume video
   181→    void end();
   182→};
   183→
   184→// wake_word.h
   185→class WakeWordDetector {
   186→public:
   187→    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, const char* model_path, const char* config_path);
   188→    bool detect();       // Returns true on wake word
   189→    void end();          // Free all memory
   190→};
   191→
   192→// yamnet_embed.h
   193→class YamnetEmbedder {
   194→public:
   195→    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, const char* model_path, const char* proj_path);
   196→    bool extract(int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* embedding_out);
   197→    void end();
   198→};
   199→
   200→// llm_core.h (already exists, minor adaptations)
   201→class LLMInference {
   202→public:
   203→    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, const char* model_path, const char* tok_path);
   204→    void generate(const char* prompt, void (*on_token)(const char*));
   205→    void end();
   206→};
   207→
   208→// robot_tts.h
   209→class RobotTTS {
   210→public:
   211→    bool begin();
   212→    void speak(const char* text);  // Blocking, outputs to I2S speaker
   213→    void end();
   214→};
   215→```

   342→## Part 2: Cloud Backend (FastAPI + Redis)
   343→
   344→### 2.1 Architecture
   345→
   346→```
   347→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   348→│                    Lightsail Instance                       │
   349→│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐  │
   350→│  │   FastAPI   │  │    Redis    │  │   File Storage     │  │
   351→│  │   Server    │◄─┤    Queue    │  │   /data/models/    │  │
   352→│  │   :8000     │  │   :6379     │  │   /data/stash/     │  │
   353→│  └──────┬──────┘  └─────────────┘  │   /data/dataset/   │  │
   354→│         │                          └─────────────────────┘  │
   355→│         │                                                   │
   356→│  ┌──────▼──────┐                                           │
   357→│  │   Worker    │  Background transcription                  │
   358→│  │  (rq/arq)   │  Whisper API or local                     │
   359→│  └─────────────┘                                           │
   360→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

   363→### 2.2 API Endpoints
   364→
   365→```python
   366→# Model Management
   367→GET  /api/models/manifest

   394→
   395→# Health

   401→

   508→## Part 4: Key Implementation Details
   509→
   510→### 4.1 Text Overlay on Video (LVGL)
   511→
   512→**Chosen: LVGL Overlay** - Rich typography, word wrap, polished look
   513→
   514→```cpp
   515→// text_overlay.cpp
   516→#include <lvgl.h>
   517→
   518→static lv_obj_t* text_layer = nullptr;
   519→static lv_obj_t* label = nullptr;
   520→
   521→void initTextOverlay() {
   522→    // Create semi-transparent container
   523→    text_layer = lv_obj_create(lv_scr_act());
   524→    lv_obj_set_size(text_layer, 230, 120);
   525→    lv_obj_align(text_layer, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -10);
   526→    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(text_layer, LV_OPA_80, 0);
   527→    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x001100), 0);
   528→    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(text_layer, 2, 0);
   529→    lv_obj_set_style_border_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);
   530→    lv_obj_set_style_radius(text_layer, 8, 0);
   531→
   532→    // Create label with retro monospace font
   533→    label = lv_label_create(text_layer);
   534→    lv_label_set_long_mode(label, LV_LABEL_LONG_WRAP);
   535→    lv_obj_set_width(label, 210);
   536→    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);  // Matrix green
   537→    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
   538→    lv_obj_center(label);
   539→
   540→    // Initially hidden
   541→    lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   542→}
   543→
   544→void showText(const char* text) {
   545→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   546→        lv_label_set_text(label, text);
   547→        lv_obj_clear_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   548→        lvgl_unlock();
   549→    }
   550→}
   551→
   552→void hideText() {
   553→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   554→        lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   555→        lvgl_unlock();
   556→    }
   557→}
   558→
   559→// For streaming LLM output character-by-character
   560→void appendText(const char* chunk) {
   561→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   562→        const char* current = lv_label_get_text(label);
   563→        String updated = String(current) + chunk;
   564→        lv_label_set_text(label, updated.c_str());
   565→        lvgl_unlock();
   566→    }
   567→}
   568→```

   570→### 4.2 Wake Word → Recording Transition
   571→
   572→```cpp
   573→void transitionToRecording() {
   574→    // 1. Stop wake word detection
   575→    wakeWord.end();  // Frees ~700KB PSRAM
   576→
   577→    // 2. Reconfigure I2S for recording (same pins, different buffer size)
   578→    recorder.begin(RECORD_DURATION_MS);
   579→
   580→    // 3. Visual feedback
   581→    video.showText("Listening...");
   582→
   583→    // 4. Record
   584→    int16_t* audio = recorder.record();  // Blocking, returns PSRAM buffer
   585→    size_t samples = recorder.getSampleCount();
   586→
   587→    // 5. Save to SD
   588→    saveAudioToSD(audio, samples);
   589→
   590→    // 6. Transition to embedding
   591→    transitionToEmbedding(audio, samples);
   592→}
   593→```
   594→
   595→### 4.3 Cosine Similarity Search
   596→
   597→```cpp
   598→// embed_search.cpp
   599→class EmbeddingSearch {
   600→    float* embeddings;      // 300 × 256 floats from SD
   601→    char** intents;         // 300 strings from SD
   602→    int count;
   603→
   604→public:
   605→    bool begin(const char* embed_path, const char* intent_path) {
   606→        // Load embeddings.bin (307KB) to PSRAM
   607→        embeddings = (float*)ps_malloc(300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
   608→        File f = SD.open(embed_path);
   609→        f.read((uint8_t*)embeddings, 300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
   610→
   611→        // Load intents.txt (one per line)
   612→        // ...
   613→    }
   614→
   615→    SearchResult search(float* query_embed) {
   616→        float best_score = -1;
   617→        int best_idx = -1;
   618→
   619→        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   620→            float score = cosineSimilarity(query_embed, &embeddings[i * 256], 256);
   621→            if (score > best_score) {
   622→                best_score = score;
   623→                best_idx = i;
   624→            }
   625→        }
   626→
   627→        return {intents[best_idx], best_score};
   628→    }
   629→
   630→private:
   631→    float cosineSimilarity(float* a, float* b, int len) {
   632→        float dot = 0, norm_a = 0, norm_b = 0;
   633→        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   634→            dot += a[i] * b[i];
   635→            norm_a += a[i] * a[i];
   636→            norm_b += b[i] * b[i];
   637→        }
   638→        return dot / (sqrtf(norm_a) * sqrtf(norm_b));
   639→    }
   640→};
   641→```
   642→
   643→### 4.4 Robotic TTS with SAM (Software Automatic Mouth)
   644→
   645→**Chosen: SAM** - Any text input, classic 1980s computer voice
   646→
   647→SAM is the legendary Commodore 64 / Apple II speech synthesizer. It converts
   648→arbitrary English text to phonemes and synthesizes robotic speech. Perfect for
   649→that retro "talking computer" vibe!
   650→
   651→```cpp
   652→// robot_tts.cpp
   653→// Using ESP32-SAM port: https://github.com/pschatzmann/ESP32-SAM
   654→
   655→#include "ESP32SAM.h"
   656→#include "AudioOutputI2S.h"
   657→
   658→class RobotTTS {
   659→private:
   660→    AudioOutputI2S* out = nullptr;
   661→    ESP32SAM* sam = nullptr;
   662→
   663→public:
   664→    bool begin() {
   665→        // Configure I2S for MAX98357A speaker
   666→        out = new AudioOutputI2S();
   667→        out->SetPinout(6, 7, 8);  // BCLK, LRC, DOUT
   668→        out->SetGain(0.5);        // Volume control
   669→        out->begin();
   670→
   671→        sam = new ESP32SAM();
   672→        return true;
   673→    }
   674→
   675→    void speak(const char* text) {
   676→        // SAM handles text-to-phoneme conversion internally
   677→        // Output: 22050Hz mono audio
   678→        sam->Say(out, text);
   679→    }
   680→
   681→    // For more robotic effect, adjust voice parameters
   682→    void setRoboticVoice() {
   683→        sam->SetSpeed(72);      // Default 72, lower = slower
   684→        sam->SetPitch(64);      // Default 64, higher = squeakier
   685→        sam->SetThroat(128);    // Default 128, affects resonance
   686→        sam->SetMouth(128);     // Default 128, affects articulation
   687→    }
   688→
   689→    // Ultra robotic: pitch down, slow, mechanical
   690→    void setUltraRobotic() {
   691→        sam->SetSpeed(50);      // Slow and deliberate
   692→        sam->SetPitch(40);      // Deep, mechanical
   693→        sam->SetThroat(160);    // More robotic resonance
   694→        sam->SetMouth(100);     // Slightly muffled
   695→    }
   696→
   697→    void end() {
   698→        if (sam) { delete sam; sam = nullptr; }
   699→        if (out) { delete out; out = nullptr; }
   700→    }
   701→};
   702→
   703→// Usage in main sketch:
   704→RobotTTS tts;
   705→
   706→void setup() {
   707→    tts.begin();
   708→    tts.setUltraRobotic();  // Maximum robot vibes!
   709→}
   710→
   711→void speakResponse(const char* text) {
   712→    video.showText(text);      // Show on screen
   713→    tts.speak(text);           // Speak robotically
   714→    delay(2000);               // Pause after speaking
   715→    video.hideText();          // Resume logo
   716→}
   717→```
   718→
   719→**Memory footprint**: ~50KB ROM for SAM phoneme tables
   720→**Latency**: Near-instant start (no model loading)
   721→**Quality**: Authentic 1980s computer voice - perfect for badge aesthetic!
   722→
   723→### 4.5 Deep Sleep with Accelerometer Wake
   724→
   725→```cpp
   726→// sleep_manager.cpp
   727→#include "esp_sleep.h"
   728→#include "driver/rtc_io.h"
   729→
   730→#define ACCEL_INT_PIN GPIO_NUM_XX  // QMI8658 INT pin (check schematic)
   731→
   732→void enterDeepSleep() {
   733→    // Save state to RTC memory
   734→    RTC_DATA_ATTR static uint8_t last_rotation;
   735→    last_rotation = video.getRotation();
   736→
   737→    // Configure QMI8658 motion interrupt
   738→    // (Set high-g threshold, enable interrupt output)
   739→    configureAccelInterrupt();
   740→
   741→    // Configure wake source
   742→    esp_sleep_enable_ext0_wakeup(ACCEL_INT_PIN, 1);  // Wake on HIGH
   743→
   744→    // Enter deep sleep
   745→    esp_deep_sleep_start();
   746→}
   747→
   748→void setup() {
   749→    if (esp_sleep_get_wakeup_cause() == ESP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_EXT0) {
   750→        // Woke from shake - restore state
   751→        video.setRotation(last_rotation);
   752→    }
   753→    // Normal boot...
   754→}
   755→```

   783→
   784→## Part 6: Risk Mitigation
   785→
   786→| Risk | Mitigation |
   787→|------|------------|
   788→| PSRAM fragmentation | Use fixed memory pool, sequential load/unload |
   789→| Wake word false positives | Tune threshold in config.json, add cooldown |
   790→| Embedding mismatch | Start with high threshold (0.8), tune down |
   791→| LLM hallucination | Train on exact Q&A, use low temperature |
   792→| TTS unintelligible | Test Talkie vs SAM, choose clearer one |
   793→| WiFi unreliable | Graceful degradation, work fully offline |
   794→| Deep sleep instability | Test thoroughly, add watchdog timer |
   795→| SD card corruption | Use safe write patterns, checksums |
   796→

   798→
   799→## Implementation Order (Sequential)
   800→
   801→**Chosen approach**: Complete each phase before starting next - safer, easier to debug
   802→
   803→```

     1→// llm_core.cpp - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
     2→// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size
     3→
     4→#include "llm_core.h"
     5→#include <math.h>
     6→#include <string.h>
     7→#include <esp_heap_caps.h>  // For heap_caps_aligned_alloc (16-byte aligned SIMD buffers)
     8→
     9→// Global group size (read from model header, typically 32 or 64)
    10→int GS = 64;
    11→
    12→// ============================================================================
    13→// Quantization Functions
    14→// ============================================================================
    15→
    16→void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    17→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    18→        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    19→    }
    20→}
    21→
    22→void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    23→    int num_groups = n / GS;
    24→    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;
    25→
    26→    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
    27→        float* gx = x + group * GS;
    28→        int8_t* gq = qx->q + group * GS;
    29→
    30→        // Find max absolute value using SIMD dot product trick:
    31→        // max(|x|) ≈ sqrt(max element of x²) but that's expensive
    32→        // Instead, unroll the loop for better pipelining
    33→        float wmax = 0.0f;
    34→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i += 4) {
    35→            float v0 = fabsf(gx[i]);
    36→            float v1 = fabsf(gx[i+1]);
    37→            float v2 = fabsf(gx[i+2]);
    38→            float v3 = fabsf(gx[i+3]);
    39→            if (v0 > wmax) wmax = v0;
    40→            if (v1 > wmax) wmax = v1;
    41→            if (v2 > wmax) wmax = v2;
    42→            if (v3 > wmax) wmax = v3;
    43→        }
    44→
    45→        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
    46→        qx->s[group] = scale;
    47→
    48→        // Quantize with reciprocal multiply (faster than division)
    49→        float inv_scale = (scale > 1e-10f) ? Q_MAX / wmax : 0.0f;
    50→        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i += 4) {
    51→            gq[i]   = (int8_t)(gx[i]   * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i]   < 0));
    52→            gq[i+1] = (int8_t)(gx[i+1] * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i+1] < 0));
    53→            gq[i+2] = (int8_t)(gx[i+2] * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i+2] < 0));
    54→            gq[i+3] = (int8_t)(gx[i+3] * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i+3] < 0));
    55→        }
    56→    }
    57→}
    58→
    59→// ============================================================================
    60→// Neural Network Operations
    61→// ============================================================================
    62→
    63→void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    64→    // Sum of squares using SIMD dot product
    65→    float ss = 0.0f;
    66→    dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(x, x, &ss, size);
    67→
    68→    // Normalization factor
    69→    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss / size + 1e-5f);
    70→
    71→    // Scale x by ss, then multiply by weight
    72→    // o[i] = weight[i] * (ss * x[i])
    73→    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(x, o, size, ss, 1, 1);       // o = x * ss
    74→    dsps_mul_f32_ae32(o, weight, o, size, 1, 1, 1); // o = o * weight
    75→}
    76→
    77→void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    78→    // Find max (no SIMD equivalent that's faster for small arrays)
    79→    float max_val = x[0];
    80→    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
    81→        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    82→    }
    83→
    84→    // Exp and sum (expf() is the bottleneck, can't SIMD this)
    85→    float sum = 0.0f;
    86→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    87→        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
    88→        sum += x[i];
    89→    }
    90→
    91→    // Vectorized division using SIMD multiply by inverse
    92→    float inv_sum = 1.0f / sum;
    93→    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(x, x, size, inv_sum, 1, 1);
    94→}
    95→
    96→// PIE SIMD int8 dot product - returns full int32 accumulator
    97→// Processes 16 int8 pairs at a time using ESP32-S3 PIE vector instructions
    98→// Requirements: len must be multiple of 16, both pointers must be 16-byte aligned
    99→static inline int32_t dotprod_s8_simd(const int8_t* a, const int8_t* b, int len) {
   100→    int32_t result;
   101→    int chunks = len >> 4;  // len / 16
   102→
   103→    asm volatile(
   104→        // Clear 40-bit accumulator
   105→        "wur.accx_0 %[zero]\n"
   106→        "wur.accx_1 %[zero]\n"
   107→
   108→        // Process 16 int8 pairs per iteration
   109→        "loopnez %[chunks], 1f\n"
   110→        "ee.vld.128.ip q0, %[a], 16\n"    // Load 16 int8s from a
   111→        "ee.vld.128.ip q1, %[b], 16\n"    // Load 16 int8s from b
   112→        "ee.vmulas.s8.accx q0, q1\n"      // MAC: accx += sum(q0[i] * q1[i])
   113→        "1:\n"
   114→
   115→        // Read low 32 bits of accumulator
   116→        "rur.accx_0 %[result]\n"
   117→
   118→        : [result] "=r" (result), [a] "+r" (a), [b] "+r" (b)
   119→        : [chunks] "r" (chunks), [zero] "r" (0)
   120→        : "memory"
   121→    );
   122→
   123→    return result;
   124→}
   125→
   126→void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
   127→    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
   128→        float val = 0.0f;
   129→        int in = i * n;
   130→
   131→        // Process each quantization group with SIMD
   132→        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
   133→            // SIMD dot product for this group (GS elements)
   134→            int32_t ival = dotprod_s8_simd(x->q + j, w->q + in + j, GS);
   135→
   136→            // Scale by quantization scales
   137→            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
   138→        }
   139→        xout[i] = val;
   140→    }
   141→}
   142→
   143→// ============================================================================
   144→// Memory Allocation
   145→// ============================================================================
   146→
   147→static bool malloc_run_state(RunState* s, Config* p) {
   148→    int kv_dim = (p->dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   149→
   150→    size_t kv_cache_size = (size_t)p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim * sizeof(float);
   151→    size_t total_needed =
   152→        3 * p->dim * sizeof(float) +
   153→        2 * p->hidden_dim * sizeof(float) +
   154→        p->dim * sizeof(float) +
   155→        p->n_heads * p->seq_len * sizeof(float) +
   156→        p->vocab_size * sizeof(float) +
   157→        2 * kv_cache_size +
   158→        p->dim + p->dim / GS * sizeof(float) +
   159→        p->hidden_dim + p->hidden_dim / GS * sizeof(float);
   160→
   161→    if (total_needed > ESP.getFreePsram()) {
   162→        Serial.println("ERROR: Not enough PSRAM for RunState!");
   163→        return false;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    s->x = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   167→    s->xb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   168→    s->xb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   169→    s->hb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
   170→    s->hb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
   171→    s->q = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
   172→    s->att = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_heads * p->seq_len, sizeof(float));
   173→    s->logits = (float*)ps_calloc(p->vocab_size, sizeof(float));
   174→
   175→    s->key_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
   176→    s->value_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
   177→
   178→    // Quantized activation buffers - MUST be 16-byte aligned for PIE SIMD
   179→    s->xq.q = (int8_t*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, p->dim * sizeof(int8_t), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   180→    s->xq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim / GS, sizeof(float));
   181→    s->hq.q = (int8_t*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, p->hidden_dim * sizeof(int8_t), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   182→    s->hq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim / GS, sizeof(float));
   183→
   184→    if (!s->x || !s->xb || !s->xb2 || !s->hb || !s->hb2 || !s->q ||
   185→        !s->att || !s->logits || !s->key_cache || !s->value_cache ||
   186→        !s->xq.q || !s->xq.s || !s->hq.q || !s->hq.s) {
   187→        Serial.println("ERROR: RunState allocation failed!");
   188→        return false;
   189→    }
   190→
   191→    return true;
   192→}
   193→
   194→static void free_run_state(RunState* s) {
   195→    free(s->x);
   196→    free(s->xb);
   197→    free(s->xb2);
   198→    free(s->hb);
   199→    free(s->hb2);
   200→    free(s->q);
   201→    free(s->att);
   202→    free(s->logits);
   203→    free(s->key_cache);
   204→    free(s->value_cache);
   205→    free(s->xq.q);
   206→    free(s->xq.s);
   207→    free(s->hq.q);
   208→    free(s->hq.s);
   209→}
   210→
   211→// ============================================================================
   212→// Weight Memory Mapping (Q8_0 Format)
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→
   215→static QuantizedTensor* init_quantized_tensors(void** ptr, int n, int size_each) {
   216→    void* p = *ptr;
   217→    QuantizedTensor* res = (QuantizedTensor*)malloc(n * sizeof(QuantizedTensor));
   218→
   219→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   220→        res[i].q = (int8_t*)p;
   221→        p = (int8_t*)p + size_each;
   222→        res[i].s = (float*)p;
   223→        p = (float*)p + size_each / GS;
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    *ptr = p;
   227→    return res;
   228→}
   229→
   230→static void memory_map_weights(TransformerWeights* w, Config* p, void* ptr, uint8_t shared_classifier) {
   231→    int head_size = p->dim / p->n_heads;
   232→
   233→    float* fptr = (float*)ptr;
   234→    w->rms_att_weight = fptr;
   235→    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
   236→    w->rms_ffn_weight = fptr;
   237→    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
   238→    w->rms_final_weight = fptr;
   239→    fptr += p->dim;
   240→
   241→    ptr = (void*)fptr;
   242→
   243→    w->q_tokens = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->vocab_size * p->dim);
   244→    w->wq = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_heads * head_size));
   245→    w->wk = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
   246→    w->wv = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
   247→    w->wo = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, (p->n_heads * head_size) * p->dim);
   248→    w->w1 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
   249→    w->w2 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->hidden_dim * p->dim);
   250→    w->w3 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
   251→    w->wcls = shared_classifier ? w->q_tokens : init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->dim * p->vocab_size);
   252→}
   253→
   254→// ============================================================================
   255→// Transformer Build/Free
   256→// ============================================================================
   257→
   258→bool build_transformer_q8(Transformer* t, const char* checkpoint_path, int max_seq_len) {
   259→    File file = SD.open(checkpoint_path, FILE_READ);
   260→    if (!file) {
   261→        Serial.printf("Failed to open model: %s\n", checkpoint_path);
   262→        return false;
   263→    }
   264→
   265→    uint32_t magic, version;
   266→    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
   267→    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);
   268→
   269→    if (magic != 0x616b3432) {
   270→        Serial.printf("Invalid magic: 0x%08X\n", magic);
   271→        file.close();
   272→        return false;
   273→    }
   274→    if (version != 2) {
   275→        Serial.printf("Invalid version: %d\n", version);
   276→        file.close();
   277→        return false;
   278→    }
   279→
   280→    file.read((uint8_t*)&t->config, sizeof(Config));
   281→    file.read(&t->shared_classifier, 1);
   282→    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);
   283→
   284→    if (max_seq_len > 0 && max_seq_len < t->config.seq_len) {
   285→        t->config.seq_len = max_seq_len;
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    Serial.printf("Model: dim=%d, layers=%d, vocab=%d, seq=%d\n",
   289→                  t->config.dim, t->config.n_layers,
   290→                  t->config.vocab_size, t->config.seq_len);
   291→
   292→    t->file_size = file.size();
   293→    // MUST be 16-byte aligned for PIE SIMD weight access
   294→    t->raw_data = (uint8_t*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, t->file_size, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   295→    if (!t->raw_data) {
   296→        Serial.println("PSRAM allocation failed!");
   297→        file.close();
   298→        return false;
   299→    }
   300→
   301→    file.seek(0);
   302→    size_t bytes_read = file.read(t->raw_data, t->file_size);
   303→    file.close();
   304→
   305→    if (bytes_read != t->file_size) {
   306→        free(t->raw_data);
   307→        return false;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    memory_map_weights(&t->weights, &t->config, t->raw_data + 256, t->shared_classifier);
   311→
   312→    int emb_size = t->config.vocab_size * t->config.dim;
   313→    t->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
   314→    if (!t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
   315→        Serial.println("Embedding allocation failed!");
   316→        free(t->raw_data);
   317→        return false;
   318→    }
   319→
   320→    dequantize(t->weights.q_tokens, t->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);
   321→
   322→    if (!malloc_run_state(&t->state, &t->config)) {
   323→        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
   324→        free(t->raw_data);
   325→        return false;
   326→    }
   327→
   328→    // Initialize RoPE cache
   329→    init_rope_cache(t);
   330→
   331→    Serial.println("Model ready!");
   332→    return true;
   333→}
   334→
   335→void init_rope_cache(Transformer* t) {
   336→    int head_size = t->config.dim / t->config.n_heads;
   337→    int half_head = head_size / 2;
   338→    int cache_size = t->config.seq_len * half_head;
   339→
   340→    t->rope_cos = (float*)ps_malloc(cache_size * sizeof(float));
   341→    t->rope_sin = (float*)ps_malloc(cache_size * sizeof(float));
   342→
   343→    if (!t->rope_cos || !t->rope_sin) {
   344→        Serial.println("Warning: RoPE cache allocation failed, using runtime trig");
   345→        return;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    // Precompute sin/cos for all positions and head dimensions
   349→    for (int pos = 0; pos < t->config.seq_len; pos++) {
   350→        for (int i = 0; i < half_head; i++) {
   351→            float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, (2.0f * i) / head_size);
   352→            float val = pos * freq;
   353→            t->rope_cos[pos * half_head + i] = cosf(val);
   354→            t->rope_sin[pos * half_head + i] = sinf(val);
   355→        }
   356→    }
   357→
   358→    Serial.printf("RoPE cache: %d KB\n", (cache_size * 2 * sizeof(float)) / 1024);
   359→}
   360→
   361→void free_transformer(Transformer* t) {
   362→    if (t->raw_data) {
   363→        free(t->raw_data);
   364→        t->raw_data = nullptr;
   365→    }
   366→    if (t->weights.token_embedding_table) {
   367→        free(t->weights.token_embedding_table);
   368→        t->weights.token_embedding_table = nullptr;
   369→    }
   370→    if (t->rope_cos) {
   371→        free(t->rope_cos);
   372→        t->rope_cos = nullptr;
   373→    }
   374→    if (t->rope_sin) {
   375→        free(t->rope_sin);
   376→        t->rope_sin = nullptr;
   377→    }
   378→
   379→    free(t->weights.q_tokens);
   380→    free(t->weights.wq);
   381→    free(t->weights.wk);
   382→    free(t->weights.wv);
   383→    free(t->weights.wo);
   384→    free(t->weights.w1);
   385→    free(t->weights.w2);
   386→    free(t->weights.w3);
   387→    if (!t->shared_classifier) {
   388→        free(t->weights.wcls);
   389→    }
   390→
   391→    free_run_state(&t->state);
   392→}
   393→
   394→// ============================================================================
   395→// Forward Pass
   396→// ============================================================================
   397→
   398→float* forward(Transformer* transformer, int token, int pos) {
   399→    Config* p = &transformer->config;
   400→    TransformerWeights* w = &transformer->weights;
   401→    RunState* s = &transformer->state;
   402→
   403→    int dim = p->dim;
   404→    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
   405→    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
   406→    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
   407→    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;
   408→
   409→    if (token < 0 || token >= p->vocab_size) {
   410→        return nullptr;
   411→    }
   412→
   413→    // Copy token embedding
   414→    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
   415→    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));
   416→
   417→    // Forward through all layers
   418→    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
   419→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);
   420→
   421→        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;
   422→        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   423→        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
   424→
   425→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   426→        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
   427→        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
   428→        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);
   429→
   430→        // RoPE with cached sin/cos lookup (eliminates runtime trig)
   431→        int half_head = head_size / 2;
   432→        float* cos_ptr = transformer->rope_cos + pos * half_head;
   433→        float* sin_ptr = transformer->rope_sin + pos * half_head;
   434→
   435→        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
   436→            int idx = (i / 2) % half_head;
   437→            float fcr = cos_ptr[idx];
   438→            float fci = sin_ptr[idx];
   439→            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
   440→            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
   441→                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
   442→                float v0 = vec[i];
   443→                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
   444→                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
   445→                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
   446→            }
   447→        }
   448→
   449→        // Multi-head attention with SIMD
   450→        float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf(head_size);
   451→        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
   452→            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
   453→            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;
   454→
   455→            // Attention scoring with SIMD dot product
   456→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   457→                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   458→                float score = 0.0f;
   459→                dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(q, k, &score, head_size);
   460→                att[t] = score * scale;
   461→            }
   462→
   463→            softmax(att, pos + 1);
   464→
   465→            // Attention aggregation with SIMD
   466→            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
   467→            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
   468→            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
   469→                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
   470→                float a = att[t];
   471→                // xb += a * v using SIMD: temp = v * a, xb += temp
   472→                dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(v, s->xb2, head_size, a, 1, 1);
   473→                dsps_add_f32_ae32(xb, s->xb2, xb, head_size, 1, 1, 1);
   474→            }
   475→        }
   476→
   477→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   478→        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);
   479→
   480→        // Residual connection with SIMD
   481→        dsps_add_f32_ae32(s->x, s->xb2, s->x, dim, 1, 1, 1);
   482→
   483→        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);
   484→
   485→        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
   486→        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   487→        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);
   488→
   489→        // SwiGLU with fast sigmoid approximation
   490→        // sigmoid(x) ≈ 0.5 + 0.5 * tanh(x * 0.5) ≈ x / (1 + |x|) for speed
   491→        // But for SiLU we need decent accuracy, use: 1/(1+exp(-x)) ≈ fast approx
   492→        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i += 4) {
   493→            // Unrolled for better pipelining
   494→            float v0 = s->hb[i], v1 = s->hb[i+1], v2 = s->hb[i+2], v3 = s->hb[i+3];
   495→            // SiLU: x * sigmoid(x)
   496→            v0 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v0));
   497→            v1 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v1));
   498→            v2 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v2));
   499→            v3 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v3));
   500→            // Gate multiply
   501→            s->hb[i]   = v0 * s->hb2[i];
   502→            s->hb[i+1] = v1 * s->hb2[i+1];
   503→            s->hb[i+2] = v2 * s->hb2[i+2];
   504→            s->hb[i+3] = v3 * s->hb2[i+3];
   505→        }
   506→
   507→        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
   508→        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);
   509→
   510→        // Residual connection with SIMD
   511→        dsps_add_f32_ae32(s->x, s->xb, s->x, dim, 1, 1, 1);
   512→    }
   513→
   514→    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);
   515→
   516→    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
   517→    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);
   518→
   519→    return s->logits;
   520→}
   521→

    64→        t->vocab[i] = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
    65→        if (!t->vocab[i]) {
    66→            file.close();
    67→            return false;
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        if (file.read((uint8_t*)t->vocab[i], len) != len) {
    71→            file.close();
    72→            return false;
    73→        }
    74→        t->vocab[i][len] = '\0';
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    file.close();
    78→    return true;
    79→}
    80→
    81→void free_tokenizer(Tokenizer* t) {
    82→    for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
    83→        free(t->vocab[i]);
    84→    }
    85→    free(t->vocab);
    86→    free(t->vocab_scores);
    87→    free(t->sorted_vocab);
    88→}
    89→
    90→char* decode(Tokenizer* t, int prev_token, int token) {
    91→    char* piece = t->vocab[token];
    92→    if (prev_token == 1 && piece[0] == ' ') {
    93→        piece++;
    94→    }
    95→    unsigned char byte_val;
    96→    if (sscanf(piece, "<0x%02hhX>", &byte_val) == 1) {
    97→        piece = (char*)t->byte_pieces + byte_val * 2;
    98→    }
    99→    return piece;
   100→}
   101→
   102→void encode(Tokenizer* t, char* text, int8_t bos, int8_t eos, int* tokens, int* n_tokens) {
   103→    if (text == NULL) return;
   104→
   105→    // Build sorted_vocab on first call
   106→    if (t->sorted_vocab == NULL) {
   107→        t->sorted_vocab = (TokenIndex*)malloc(t->vocab_size * sizeof(TokenIndex));
   108→        if (!t->sorted_vocab) return;
   109→
   110→        for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
   111→            t->sorted_vocab[i].str = t->vocab[i];
   112→            t->sorted_vocab[i].id = i;
   113→        }
   114→        qsort(t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size, sizeof(TokenIndex), compare_tokens);
   115→    }
   116→
   117→    // Allocate working buffer
   118→    int buf_size = t->max_token_length * 2 + 3;
   119→    char* str_buffer = (char*)malloc(buf_size);
   120→    if (!str_buffer) return;
   121→
   122→    size_t str_len = 0;
   123→    *n_tokens = 0;
   124→
   125→    // Add BOS if requested
   126→    if (bos) {
   127→        tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;
   128→    }
   129→
   130→    // Add space prefix if text not empty
   131→    // SentencePiece uses "▁" (U+2581) for space prefix, not ASCII " "
   132→    if (text[0] != '\0') {
   133→        int dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)"\xE2\x96\x81", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   134→        if (dummy_prefix < 0) {
   135→            dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)" ", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   136→        }
   137→        if (dummy_prefix >= 0 && dummy_prefix < t->vocab_size) {
   138→            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = dummy_prefix;
   139→        }
   140→    }
   141→
   142→    // Special tokens to detect (must match training)
   143→    const char* special_tokens[] = {"<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|end|>", "<pad>", "<unk>", "<s>", "</s>"};
   144→    const int special_ids[] = {4, 5, 6, 0, 1, 2, 3};
   145→    const int num_special = 7;
   146→
   147→    // Tokenize with special token detection
   148→    char* c = text;
   149→    while (*c != '\0') {
   150→        // Check for special tokens at current position
   151→        bool found_special = false;
   152→        for (int s = 0; s < num_special; s++) {
   153→            int slen = strlen(special_tokens[s]);
   154→            if (strncmp(c, special_tokens[s], slen) == 0) {
   155→                tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = special_ids[s];
   156→                c += slen;
   157→                found_special = true;
   158→                break;
   159→            }
   160→        }
   161→        if (found_special) continue;
   162→
   163→        // Regular character processing
   164→        if ((*c & 0xC0) != 0x80) {
   165→            str_len = 0;
   166→        }
   167→        str_buffer[str_len++] = *c;
   168→        str_buffer[str_len] = '\0';
   169→        c++;
   170→
   171→        // Continue for UTF-8 multi-byte
   172→        if ((*c & 0xC0) == 0x80 && str_len < 4) {
   173→            continue;
   174→        }
   175→
   176→        int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   177→        if (id != -1) {
   178→            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = id;
   179→        } else {
   180→            // Fallback: try SentencePiece byte tokens like "<0xAB>" or use UNK
   181→            for (int i = 0; i < str_len; i++) {
   182→                char byte_token[8];
   183→                snprintf(byte_token, sizeof(byte_token), "<0x%02X>", (unsigned char)str_buffer[i]);
   184→                int byte_id = str_lookup(byte_token, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   185→                if (byte_id != -1) {
   186→                    tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = byte_id;
   187→                } else {
   188→                    tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;  // UNK token
   189→                }
   190→            }
   191→        }
   192→        str_len = 0;
   193→    }
   194→
   195→    // BPE merge loop
   196→    while (1) {
   197→        v4sf best_score = -1e10;
   198→        int best_id = -1;
   199→        int best_idx = -1;
   200→
   201→        for (int i = 0; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
   202→            int t1 = tokens[i];
   203→            int t2 = tokens[i + 1];
   204→
   205→            if (t1 < 0 || t1 >= t->vocab_size || t2 < 0 || t2 >= t->vocab_size) {
   206→                continue;
   207→            }
   208→            if (!t->vocab[t1] || !t->vocab[t2]) {
   209→                continue;
   210→            }
   211→
   212→            sprintf(str_buffer, "%s%s", t->vocab[t1], t->vocab[t2]);
   213→            int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
   214→            if (id != -1 && t->vocab_scores[id] > best_score) {
   215→                best_score = t->vocab_scores[id];
   216→                best_id = id;
   217→                best_idx = i;
   218→            }
   219→        }
   220→
   221→        if (best_idx == -1) break;
   222→
   223→        // Apply merge
   224→        tokens[best_idx] = best_id;
   225→        for (int i = best_idx + 1; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
   226→            tokens[i] = tokens[i + 1];
   227→        }
   228→        (*n_tokens)--;
   229→    }
   230→
   231→    // Add EOS if requested
   232→    if (eos) {
   233→        tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 2;
   234→    }
   235→
   236→    free(str_buffer);
   237→}
   238→

   111→void generate(const char* prompt, int steps) {
   112→    // Wrap prompt with special tokens
   113→    String wrapped = wrapPrompt(prompt);
   114→    Serial.printf("[DEBUG] Wrapped prompt: %s\n", wrapped.c_str());
   115→
   116→    // Allocate token buffer (prompt length + some extra)
   117→    int max_prompt_tokens = wrapped.length() + 10;
   118→    int* prompt_tokens = (int*)malloc(max_prompt_tokens * sizeof(int));
   119→    if (!prompt_tokens) {
   120→        Serial.println("Token buffer allocation failed!");
   121→        return;
   122→    }
   123→
   124→    // Encode wrapped prompt
   125→    int num_prompt_tokens = 0;
   126→    encode(&tokenizer, (char*)wrapped.c_str(), 0, 0, prompt_tokens, &num_prompt_tokens);
   127→
   128→    if (num_prompt_tokens < 1) {
   129→        Serial.println("Encoding failed!");
   130→        free(prompt_tokens);
   131→        return;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    // Debug: print encoded tokens
   135→    Serial.printf("[DEBUG] Encoded %d tokens: ", num_prompt_tokens);
   136→    for (int i = 0; i < num_prompt_tokens && i < 20; i++) {
   137→        Serial.printf("%d ", prompt_tokens[i]);
   138→    }
   139→    Serial.println();
   140→
   141→    // Generation loop
   142→    unsigned long start_time = 0;
   143→    int token = prompt_tokens[0];
   144→    int pos = 0;
   145→
   146→    Serial.printf("[DEBUG] First token=%d, vocab_size=%d\n", token, transformer.config.vocab_size);
   147→    int generated = 0;
   148→
   149→    while (pos < steps) {
   150→        // Forward pass
   151→        float* logits = forward(&transformer, token, pos);
   152→        if (!logits) {
   153→            Serial.println("\nForward pass failed!");
   154→            break;
   155→        }
   156→
   157→        // Get next token
   158→        int next;
   159→        if (pos < num_prompt_tokens - 1) {
   160→            // Still processing prompt
   161→            next = prompt_tokens[pos + 1];
   162→        } else {
   163→            // Sample from logits
   164→            next = sample(&sampler, logits);
   165→            generated++;
   166→        }
   167→        pos++;
   168→
   169→        // Decode and print token
   170→        char* piece = decode(&tokenizer, token, next);
   171→        if (piece && piece[0] != '\0') {
   172→            // Check for end token
   173→            if (isEndToken(piece)) {
   174→                break;
   175→            }
   176→
   177→            // Print token (filter control characters)
   178→            if (piece[1] == '\0') {
   179→                unsigned char byte_val = piece[0];
   180→                if (isprint(byte_val) || isspace(byte_val)) {
   181→                    Serial.print(piece);
   182→                }
   183→            } else {
   184→                Serial.print(piece);
   185→            }
   186→        }
   187→
   188→        token = next;
   189→
   190→        // Start timer after prompt processing
   191→        if (start_time == 0 && pos >= num_prompt_tokens) {
   192→            start_time = millis();
   193→        }
   194→    }
   195→
   196→    // Print performance stats
   197→    if (generated > 0 && start_time > 0) {
   198→        unsigned long elapsed = millis() - start_time;
   199→        float tokens_per_sec = (float)generated / (elapsed / 1000.0f);
   200→        Serial.printf("\n\n[%d tokens, %.1f tok/s]\n", generated, tokens_per_sec);
   201→    }
   202→
   203→    free(prompt_tokens);
   204→}

     1→// sampler.cpp - Token sampling implementation
     2→
     3→#include "sampler.h"
     4→#include "dsps_mulc.h"  // For SIMD temperature scaling
     5→
     6→// Forward declarations
     7→static int sample_argmax(v4sf* probabilities, int n);
     8→static int sample_mult(v4sf* probabilities, int n, v4sf coin);
     9→static int sample_topp(v4sf* probabilities, int n, v4sf topp, ProbIndex* probindex, v4sf coin);
    10→static unsigned int random_u32(unsigned long long* state);
    11→static v4sf random_f32(unsigned long long* state);
    12→static void softmax_sampling(v4sf* x, int size);
    13→
    14→static int sample_argmax(v4sf* probabilities, int n) {
    15→    int max_i = 0;
    16→    v4sf max_p = probabilities[0];
    17→    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    18→        if (probabilities[i] > max_p) {
    19→            max_i = i;
    20→            max_p = probabilities[i];
    21→        }
    22→    }
    23→    return max_i;
    24→}
    25→
    26→static int sample_mult(v4sf* probabilities, int n, v4sf coin) {
    27→    v4sf cdf = 0.0f;
    28→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    29→        cdf += probabilities[i];
    30→        if (coin < cdf) {
    31→            return i;
    32→        }
    33→    }
    34→    return n - 1;
    35→}
    36→
    37→static int compare_prob(const void* a, const void* b) {
    38→    ProbIndex* a_ = (ProbIndex*)a;
    39→    ProbIndex* b_ = (ProbIndex*)b;
    40→    if (a_->prob > b_->prob) return -1;
    41→    if (a_->prob < b_->prob) return 1;
    42→    return 0;
    43→}
    44→
    45→static int sample_topp(v4sf* probabilities, int n, v4sf topp, ProbIndex* probindex, v4sf coin) {
    46→    int n0 = 0;
    47→    const v4sf cutoff = (1.0f - topp) / (n - 1);
    48→    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    49→        if (probabilities[i] >= cutoff) {
    50→            probindex[n0].index = i;
    51→            probindex[n0].prob = probabilities[i];
    52→            n0++;
    53→        }
    54→    }
    55→    qsort(probindex, n0, sizeof(ProbIndex), compare_prob);
    56→
    57→    v4sf cumulative_prob = 0.0f;
    58→    int last_idx = n0 - 1;
    59→    for (int i = 0; i < n0; i++) {
    60→        cumulative_prob += probindex[i].prob;
    61→        if (cumulative_prob > topp) {
    62→            last_idx = i;
    63→            break;
    64→        }
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    v4sf r = coin * cumulative_prob;
    68→    v4sf cdf = 0.0f;
    69→    for (int i = 0; i <= last_idx; i++) {
    70→        cdf += probindex[i].prob;
    71→        if (r < cdf) {
    72→            return probindex[i].index;
    73→        }
    74→    }
    75→    return probindex[last_idx].index;
    76→}
    77→
    78→static unsigned int random_u32(unsigned long long* state) {
    79→    *state ^= *state >> 12;
    80→    *state ^= *state << 25;
    81→    *state ^= *state >> 27;
    82→    return (*state * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dull) >> 32;
    83→}
    84→
    85→static v4sf random_f32(unsigned long long* state) {
    86→    return (random_u32(state) >> 8) / 16777216.0f;
    87→}
    88→
    89→static void softmax_sampling(v4sf* x, int size) {
    90→    // Find max (unrolled for pipelining)
    91→    v4sf max_val = x[0];
    92→    for (int i = 1; i < size; i += 4) {
    93→        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    94→        if (i+1 < size && x[i+1] > max_val) max_val = x[i+1];
    95→        if (i+2 < size && x[i+2] > max_val) max_val = x[i+2];
    96→        if (i+3 < size && x[i+3] > max_val) max_val = x[i+3];
    97→    }
    98→
    99→    // Exp and sum
   100→    v4sf sum = 0.0f;
   101→    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
   102→        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
   103→        sum += x[i];
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    // Vectorized division using SIMD multiply by inverse
   107→    v4sf inv_sum = 1.0f / sum;
   108→    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(x, x, size, inv_sum, 1, 1);
   109→}
   110→
   111→void build_sampler(Sampler* sampler, int vocab_size, float temperature, float topp, unsigned long long rng_seed) {
   112→    sampler->vocab_size = vocab_size;
   113→    sampler->temperature = temperature;
   114→    sampler->topp = topp;
   115→    sampler->rng_state = rng_seed;
   116→    sampler->probindex = (ProbIndex*)malloc(sampler->vocab_size * sizeof(ProbIndex));
   117→    Serial.println("Sampler built");
   118→}
   119→
   120→void free_sampler(Sampler* sampler) {
   121→    free(sampler->probindex);
   122→}
   123→
   124→int sample(Sampler* sampler, v4sf* logits) {
   125→    int next;
   126→    if (sampler->temperature == 0.0f) {
   127→        next = sample_argmax(logits, sampler->vocab_size);
   128→    } else {
   129→        // Temperature scaling using SIMD (multiply by 1/temperature)
   130→        v4sf inv_temp = 1.0f / sampler->temperature;
   131→        dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(logits, logits, sampler->vocab_size, inv_temp, 1, 1);
   132→
   133→        softmax_sampling(logits, sampler->vocab_size);
   134→        v4sf coin = random_f32(&sampler->rng_state);
   135→        if (sampler->topp <= 0 || sampler->topp >= 1) {
   136→            next = sample_mult(logits, sampler->vocab_size, coin);
   137→        } else {
   138→            next = sample_topp(logits, sampler->vocab_size, sampler->topp, sampler->probindex, coin);
   139→        }
   140→    }
   141→    return next;
   142→}

    13→// Include MjpegClass inline to avoid separate header management

    16→class MjpegClass {
    17→public:
    18→    bool setup(Stream *input, uint8_t *mjpeg_buf, JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *pfnDraw,
    19→               bool useBigEndian, int x, int y, int widthLimit, int heightLimit) {
    20→        _input = input;
    21→        _mjpeg_buf = mjpeg_buf;
    22→        _pfnDraw = pfnDraw;
    23→        _useBigEndian = useBigEndian;
    24→        _x = x;
    25→        _y = y;
    26→        _widthLimit = widthLimit;
    27→        _heightLimit = heightLimit;
    28→        _inputindex = 0;
    29→
    30→        if (!_read_buf) {
    31→            _read_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    32→        }
    33→        return _read_buf != nullptr;
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    bool readMjpegBuf() {
    37→        if (_inputindex == 0) {
    38→            _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    39→            _inputindex += _buf_read;
    40→        }
    41→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    42→        int i = 0;
    43→        bool found_FFD8 = false;
    44→
    45→        while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    46→            i = 0;
    47→            while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    48→                if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
    49→                    found_FFD8 = true;
    50→                }
    51→                ++i;
    52→            }
    53→            if (found_FFD8) {
    54→                --i;
    55→            } else {
    56→                _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    57→            }
    58→        }
    59→
    60→        uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
    61→        _buf_read -= i;
    62→        bool found_FFD9 = false;
    63→
    64→        if (_buf_read > 0) {
    65→            i = 3;
    66→            while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    67→                if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
    68→                    found_FFD9 = true;
    69→                } else {
    70→                    while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    71→                        if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
    72→                            found_FFD9 = true;
    73→                            ++i;
    74→                        }
    75→                        ++i;
    76→                    }
    77→                }
    78→
    79→                memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
    80→                _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
    81→                size_t o = _buf_read - i;
    82→
    83→                if (o > 0) {
    84→                    memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
    85→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
    86→                    _p = _read_buf;
    87→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    88→                    _buf_read += o;
    89→                } else {
    90→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    91→                    _p = _read_buf;
    92→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    93→                }
    94→                i = 0;
    95→            }
    96→            return found_FFD9;
    97→        }
    98→        return false;
    99→    }

   112→            if (ratio <= 1) {

   146→        _jpeg.close();

   171→//==============================================================================

   174→
   175→MemoryStream::MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size)
   176→    : _buffer(buffer), _size(size), _position(0) {}
   177→
   178→int MemoryStream::available() {
   179→    return _size - _position;
   180→}
   181→
   182→int MemoryStream::read() {
   183→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position++] : -1;
   184→}
   185→
   186→int MemoryStream::peek() {
   187→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position] : -1;
   188→}
   189→
   190→size_t MemoryStream::readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) {
   191→    size_t n = min(length, _size - _position);
   192→    memcpy(buffer, _buffer + _position, n);
   193→    _position += n;
   194→    return n;
   195→}
   196→
   197→void MemoryStream::reset() {
   198→    _position = 0;
   199→}

   248→bool VideoPlayer::_loadVideo(const char* path) {
   249→    File f;

   251→    // Initialize SPI bus (FSPI) and SD card - same bus as display
   252→    static SPIClass sdSpi(FSPI);
   253→    sdSpi.begin(SD_SCK, SD_MISO, SD_MOSI, SD_CS);
   254→    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS, sdSpi)) {
   255→        Serial.println("SD card init failed!");
   256→        return false;
   257→    }

   259→    // Use provided path or default VIDEO_PATH
   260→    const char* videoFile = path ? path : VIDEO_PATH;
   261→    f = SD.open(videoFile, FILE_READ);
   262→
   263→    if (!f) {
   264→        return false;
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    _videoSize = f.size();
   268→    _videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_videoSize);
   269→    if (!_videoBuf) {
   270→        f.close();
   271→        return false;
   272→    }
   273→
   274→    if (f.read(_videoBuf, _videoSize) != _videoSize) {
   275→        free(_videoBuf);
   276→        _videoBuf = nullptr;
   277→        f.close();
   278→        return false;
   279→    }
   280→    f.close();
   281→
   282→    // Create stream and decoder
   283→    _stream = new MemoryStream(_videoBuf, _videoSize);
   284→    _decodeBuf = (uint8_t*)malloc(LCD_WIDTH * LCD_HEIGHT / 2);
   285→    if (!_decodeBuf) {
   286→        return false;
   287→    }

   289→    _decoder = new MjpegClass();
   290→    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;

   292→    // Note: With rotation=1, effective display is 320x240 (landscape)
   293→    // MjpegClass uses these for scaling and centering calculations
   294→    return mjpeg->setup(_stream, _decodeBuf, _drawCallback, true, 0, 0, LCD_HEIGHT, LCD_WIDTH);
