   399→void VideoPlayer::_drawTextBox() {
   400→    if (!_display || _currentText.length() == 0) return;
   401→
   402→    // Get actual display dimensions (accounts for rotation)
   403→    int dispWidth = _display->width();
   404→    int dispHeight = _display->height();
   405→
   406→    // Text box dimensions
   407→    const int boxHeight = 80;
   408→    const int boxMargin = 5;
   409→    const int textPadding = 8;
   410→    const int boxY = dispHeight - boxHeight - boxMargin;
   411→
   412→    // Draw semi-transparent background
   413→    _display->fillRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BG_COLOR);
   414→
   415→    // Draw border
   416→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   417→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin + 1, boxY + 1, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2, boxHeight - 2, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   418→
   419→    // Draw text
   420→    _display->setTextColor(TEXT_COLOR);
   421→    _display->setTextSize(2);
   422→    _display->setTextWrap(true);
   423→
   424→    // Calculate text position
   425→    int textX = boxMargin + textPadding;
   426→    int textY = boxY + textPadding;
   427→
   428→    _display->setCursor(textX, textY);
   429→
   430→    // Word wrap manually for better control
   431→    String remaining = _currentText;
   432→    int lineWidth = dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2 * textPadding;
   433→    int charWidth = 12;  // Approximate width per char at size 2
   434→    int charsPerLine = lineWidth / charWidth;
   435→    int lineHeight = 20;
   436→    int maxLines = (boxHeight - 2 * textPadding) / lineHeight;
   437→
   438→    int line = 0;
   439→    while (remaining.length() > 0 && line < maxLines) {
   440→        String lineToPrint;
   441→        if (remaining.length() <= charsPerLine) {
   442→            lineToPrint = remaining;
   443→            remaining = "";
   444→        } else {
   445→            // Find last space before limit
   446→            int breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   447→            while (breakPoint > 0 && remaining[breakPoint] != ' ') {
   448→                breakPoint--;
   449→            }
   450→            if (breakPoint == 0) breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   451→
   452→            lineToPrint = remaining.substring(0, breakPoint);
   453→            remaining = remaining.substring(breakPoint);
   454→            remaining.trim();
   455→        }
   456→
   457→        _display->setCursor(textX, textY + line * lineHeight);
   458→        _display->print(lineToPrint);
   459→        line++;
   460→    }
   461→}

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - LLM Inference Module
 *
 * Wrapper around llm_core for pool-based memory management.
 * Supports Q8_0 quantized models from llama2.c
 ******************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <Arduino.h>

// Forward declarations to keep header clean
struct Transformer;
struct Tokenizer;
struct Sampler;

//==============================================================================
// Token callback for streaming output
//==============================================================================
typedef void (*TokenCallback)(const char* token, void* userData);

//==============================================================================
// LLM Inference - Pool-based LLM for badge integration
//==============================================================================
class LLMInference {
public:
    LLMInference();
    ~LLMInference();

    // Initialize with memory pool
    // pool: Pre-allocated PSRAM buffer for model weights
    // poolSize: Size of pool (needs ~6MB for typical model)
    // modelPath: Path to Q8_0 model file on SD card
    // tokenizerPath: Path to tokenizer.bin on SD card
    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
               const char* modelPath, const char* tokenizerPath);
    void end();

    // Check if model is loaded
    bool isLoaded() const { return _loaded; }

    // Configure generation parameters
    void setTemperature(float temp) { _temperature = temp; }
    void setTopP(float topp) { _topp = topp; }
    void setMaxTokens(int max) { _maxTokens = max; }

    // Generate response from prompt
    // prompt: User's question/intent (will be wrapped with special tokens)
    // callback: Called for each generated token
    // userData: Passed to callback
    // Returns: Number of tokens generated
    int generate(const char* prompt, TokenCallback callback, void* userData = nullptr);

    // Get model info
    int getVocabSize() const;
    int getDimension() const;
    int getNumLayers() const;

    // Memory requirements
    static size_t requiredPoolSize() { return 6 * 1024 * 1024; }  // 6MB

private:
    Transformer* _transformer;
    Tokenizer* _tokenizer;
    Sampler* _sampler;

    uint8_t* _pool;
    size_t _poolSize;

    float _temperature;
    float _topp;
    int _maxTokens;

    bool _loaded;

    // Wrap prompt with Q&A tokens
    String _wrapPrompt(const char* userInput);

    // Check if token is end marker
    bool _isEndToken(const char* piece);
};

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - LLM Inference Implementation
 *
 * Adapted from llama2.c/runq.c for ESP32-S3 with Q8_0 quantization
 * Uses ESP-DSP SIMD for accelerated inference
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "llm_inference.h"
#include "../../config.h"

#include <SD.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <esp_heap_caps.h>

// ESP-DSP library
#include "dsps_dotprod.h"
#include "dsps_mulc.h"
#include "dsps_add.h"
#include "dsps_mul.h"

//==============================================================================
// Internal Structures (from llm_core)
//==============================================================================

// Global group size for quantization
static int GS = 64;

typedef struct {
    int8_t* q;
    float* s;
} QuantizedTensor;

typedef struct {
    int dim;
    int hidden_dim;
    int n_layers;
    int n_heads;
    int n_kv_heads;
    int vocab_size;
    int seq_len;
} Config;

typedef struct {
    QuantizedTensor *q_tokens;
    float* token_embedding_table;
    float* rms_att_weight;
    float* rms_ffn_weight;
    float* rms_final_weight;
    QuantizedTensor *wq;
    QuantizedTensor *wk;
    QuantizedTensor *wv;
    QuantizedTensor *wo;
    QuantizedTensor *w1;
    QuantizedTensor *w2;
    QuantizedTensor *w3;
    QuantizedTensor *wcls;
} TransformerWeights;

typedef struct {
    float *x, *xb, *xb2, *hb, *hb2;
    QuantizedTensor xq, hq;
    float *q, *k, *v, *att, *logits;
    float *key_cache, *value_cache;
} RunState;

struct Transformer {
    Config config;
    TransformerWeights weights;
    RunState state;
    uint8_t* raw_data;
    size_t file_size;
    uint8_t shared_classifier;
    float *rope_cos, *rope_sin;
};

typedef struct {
    char* str;
    int id;
} TokenIndex;

struct Tokenizer {
    char** vocab;
    float* vocab_scores;
    TokenIndex* sorted_vocab;
    int vocab_size;
    unsigned int max_token_length;
    unsigned char byte_pieces[512];
};

typedef struct {
    float prob;
    int index;
} ProbIndex;

struct Sampler {
    int vocab_size;
    ProbIndex* probindex;
    float temperature;
    float topp;
    unsigned long long rng_state;
};

//==============================================================================
// Quantization Functions
//==============================================================================

static void dequantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        x[i] = qx->q[i] * qx->s[i / GS];
    }
}

static void quantize(QuantizedTensor *qx, float* x, int n) {
    int num_groups = n / GS;
    float Q_MAX = 127.0f;

    for (int group = 0; group < num_groups; group++) {
        float* gx = x + group * GS;
        int8_t* gq = qx->q + group * GS;

        float wmax = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i += 4) {
            float v0 = fabsf(gx[i]);
            float v1 = fabsf(gx[i+1]);
            float v2 = fabsf(gx[i+2]);
            float v3 = fabsf(gx[i+3]);
            if (v0 > wmax) wmax = v0;
            if (v1 > wmax) wmax = v1;
            if (v2 > wmax) wmax = v2;
            if (v3 > wmax) wmax = v3;
        }

        float scale = wmax / Q_MAX;
        qx->s[group] = scale;

        float inv_scale = (scale > 1e-10f) ? Q_MAX / wmax : 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i += 4) {
            gq[i]   = (int8_t)(gx[i]   * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i]   < 0));
            gq[i+1] = (int8_t)(gx[i+1] * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i+1] < 0));
            gq[i+2] = (int8_t)(gx[i+2] * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i+2] < 0));
            gq[i+3] = (int8_t)(gx[i+3] * inv_scale + 0.5f - (gx[i+3] < 0));
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// Neural Network Operations
//==============================================================================

static void rmsnorm(float* o, float* x, float* weight, int size) {
    float ss = 0.0f;
    dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(x, x, &ss, size);
    ss = 1.0f / sqrtf(ss / size + 1e-5f);
    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(x, o, size, ss, 1, 1);
    dsps_mul_f32_ae32(o, weight, o, size, 1, 1, 1);
}

static void softmax(float* x, int size) {
    float max_val = x[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
        if (x[i] > max_val) max_val = x[i];
    }
    float sum = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        x[i] = expf(x[i] - max_val);
        sum += x[i];
    }
    float inv_sum = 1.0f / sum;
    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(x, x, size, inv_sum, 1, 1);
}

// PIE SIMD int8 dot product
static inline int32_t dotprod_s8_simd(const int8_t* a, const int8_t* b, int len) {
    int32_t result;
    int chunks = len >> 4;

    asm volatile(
        "wur.accx_0 %[zero]\n"
        "wur.accx_1 %[zero]\n"
        "loopnez %[chunks], 1f\n"
        "ee.vld.128.ip q0, %[a], 16\n"
        "ee.vld.128.ip q1, %[b], 16\n"
        "ee.vmulas.s8.accx q0, q1\n"
        "1:\n"
        "rur.accx_0 %[result]\n"
        : [result] "=r" (result), [a] "+r" (a), [b] "+r" (b)
        : [chunks] "r" (chunks), [zero] "r" (0)
        : "memory"
    );

    return result;
}

static void matmul_q8(float* xout, QuantizedTensor* x, QuantizedTensor* w, int n, int d) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
        float val = 0.0f;
        int in = i * n;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n - GS; j += GS) {
            int32_t ival = dotprod_s8_simd(x->q + j, w->q + in + j, GS);
            val += (float)ival * w->s[(in + j) / GS] * x->s[j / GS];
        }
        xout[i] = val;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// Memory Allocation
//==============================================================================

static bool malloc_run_state(RunState* s, Config* p) {
    int kv_dim = (p->dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;

    s->x = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->xb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->xb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->hb = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->hb2 = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->q = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim, sizeof(float));
    s->att = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_heads * p->seq_len, sizeof(float));
    s->logits = (float*)ps_calloc(p->vocab_size, sizeof(float));
    s->key_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));
    s->value_cache = (float*)ps_calloc(p->n_layers * p->seq_len * kv_dim, sizeof(float));

    s->xq.q = (int8_t*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, p->dim, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
    s->xq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->dim / GS, sizeof(float));
    s->hq.q = (int8_t*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, p->hidden_dim, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
    s->hq.s = (float*)ps_calloc(p->hidden_dim / GS, sizeof(float));

    return s->x && s->xb && s->xb2 && s->hb && s->hb2 && s->q &&
           s->att && s->logits && s->key_cache && s->value_cache &&
           s->xq.q && s->xq.s && s->hq.q && s->hq.s;
}

static void free_run_state(RunState* s) {
    free(s->x); free(s->xb); free(s->xb2);
    free(s->hb); free(s->hb2); free(s->q);
    free(s->att); free(s->logits);
    free(s->key_cache); free(s->value_cache);
    free(s->xq.q); free(s->xq.s);
    free(s->hq.q); free(s->hq.s);
}

//==============================================================================
// Weight Memory Mapping
//==============================================================================

static QuantizedTensor* init_quantized_tensors(void** ptr, int n, int size_each) {
    void* p = *ptr;
    QuantizedTensor* res = (QuantizedTensor*)malloc(n * sizeof(QuantizedTensor));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        res[i].q = (int8_t*)p;
        p = (int8_t*)p + size_each;
        res[i].s = (float*)p;
        p = (float*)p + size_each / GS;
    }

    *ptr = p;
    return res;
}

static void memory_map_weights(TransformerWeights* w, Config* p, void* ptr, uint8_t shared_classifier) {
    int head_size = p->dim / p->n_heads;

    float* fptr = (float*)ptr;
    w->rms_att_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
    w->rms_ffn_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->n_layers * p->dim;
    w->rms_final_weight = fptr;
    fptr += p->dim;

    ptr = (void*)fptr;

    w->q_tokens = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->vocab_size * p->dim);
    w->wq = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_heads * head_size));
    w->wk = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
    w->wv = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * (p->n_kv_heads * head_size));
    w->wo = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, (p->n_heads * head_size) * p->dim);
    w->w1 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
    w->w2 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->hidden_dim * p->dim);
    w->w3 = init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, p->n_layers, p->dim * p->hidden_dim);
    w->wcls = shared_classifier ? w->q_tokens : init_quantized_tensors(&ptr, 1, p->dim * p->vocab_size);
}

//==============================================================================
// Forward Pass
//==============================================================================

static float* forward(Transformer* t, int token, int pos) {
    Config* p = &t->config;
    TransformerWeights* w = &t->weights;
    RunState* s = &t->state;

    int dim = p->dim;
    int kv_dim = (dim * p->n_kv_heads) / p->n_heads;
    int kv_mul = p->n_heads / p->n_kv_heads;
    int hidden_dim = p->hidden_dim;
    int head_size = dim / p->n_heads;

    if (token < 0 || token >= p->vocab_size) return nullptr;

    float* content_row = w->token_embedding_table + token * dim;
    memcpy(s->x, content_row, dim * sizeof(float));

    for (int l = 0; l < p->n_layers; l++) {
        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_att_weight + l * dim, dim);

        int loff = l * p->seq_len * kv_dim;
        s->k = s->key_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;
        s->v = s->value_cache + loff + pos * kv_dim;

        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->q, &s->xq, &w->wq[l], dim, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->k, &s->xq, &w->wk[l], dim, kv_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->v, &s->xq, &w->wv[l], dim, kv_dim);

        // RoPE with cached lookup
        int half_head = head_size / 2;
        float* cos_ptr = t->rope_cos + pos * half_head;
        float* sin_ptr = t->rope_sin + pos * half_head;

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i += 2) {
            int idx = (i / 2) % half_head;
            float fcr = cos_ptr[idx];
            float fci = sin_ptr[idx];
            int rotn = i < kv_dim ? 2 : 1;
            for (int v = 0; v < rotn; v++) {
                float* vec = v == 0 ? s->q : s->k;
                float v0 = vec[i];
                float v1 = vec[i + 1];
                vec[i] = v0 * fcr - v1 * fci;
                vec[i + 1] = v0 * fci + v1 * fcr;
            }
        }

        // Multi-head attention
        float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf(head_size);
        for (int h = 0; h < p->n_heads; h++) {
            float* q = s->q + h * head_size;
            float* att = s->att + h * p->seq_len;

            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
                float* k = s->key_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
                float score = 0.0f;
                dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3(q, k, &score, head_size);
                att[t] = score * scale;
            }

            softmax(att, pos + 1);

            float* xb = s->xb + h * head_size;
            memset(xb, 0, head_size * sizeof(float));
            for (int t = 0; t <= pos; t++) {
                float* v = s->value_cache + loff + t * kv_dim + (h / kv_mul) * head_size;
                float a = att[t];
                dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(v, s->xb2, head_size, a, 1, 1);
                dsps_add_f32_ae32(xb, s->xb2, xb, head_size, 1, 1, 1);
            }
        }

        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb2, &s->xq, &w->wo[l], dim, dim);
        dsps_add_f32_ae32(s->x, s->xb2, s->x, dim, 1, 1, 1);

        rmsnorm(s->xb, s->x, w->rms_ffn_weight + l * dim, dim);
        quantize(&s->xq, s->xb, dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb, &s->xq, &w->w1[l], dim, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->hb2, &s->xq, &w->w3[l], dim, hidden_dim);

        // SwiGLU
        for (int i = 0; i < hidden_dim; i += 4) {
            float v0 = s->hb[i], v1 = s->hb[i+1], v2 = s->hb[i+2], v3 = s->hb[i+3];
            v0 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v0));
            v1 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v1));
            v2 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v2));
            v3 *= 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-v3));
            s->hb[i]   = v0 * s->hb2[i];
            s->hb[i+1] = v1 * s->hb2[i+1];
            s->hb[i+2] = v2 * s->hb2[i+2];
            s->hb[i+3] = v3 * s->hb2[i+3];
        }

        quantize(&s->hq, s->hb, hidden_dim);
        matmul_q8(s->xb, &s->hq, &w->w2[l], hidden_dim, dim);
        dsps_add_f32_ae32(s->x, s->xb, s->x, dim, 1, 1, 1);
    }

    rmsnorm(s->x, s->x, w->rms_final_weight, dim);
    quantize(&s->xq, s->x, dim);
    matmul_q8(s->logits, &s->xq, w->wcls, dim, p->vocab_size);

    return s->logits;
}

//==============================================================================
// Tokenizer Functions
//==============================================================================

static int compare_tokens(const void* a, const void* b) {
    return strcmp(((TokenIndex*)a)->str, ((TokenIndex*)b)->str);
}

static int str_lookup(char* str, TokenIndex* sorted_vocab, int vocab_size) {
    TokenIndex tok = {.str = str};
    TokenIndex* res = (TokenIndex*)bsearch(&tok, sorted_vocab, vocab_size, sizeof(TokenIndex), compare_tokens);
    return res != NULL ? res->id : -1;
}

static bool build_tokenizer(Tokenizer* t, const char* path, int vocab_size) {
    t->vocab_size = vocab_size;
    t->vocab = (char**)malloc(vocab_size * sizeof(char*));
    t->vocab_scores = (float*)malloc(vocab_size * sizeof(float));
    t->sorted_vocab = NULL;

    if (!t->vocab || !t->vocab_scores) return false;

    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        t->byte_pieces[i * 2] = (unsigned char)i;
        t->byte_pieces[i * 2 + 1] = '\0';
    }

    File file = SD.open(path, FILE_READ);
    if (!file) return false;

    if (file.read((uint8_t*)&t->max_token_length, sizeof(int)) != sizeof(int)) {
        file.close();
        return false;
    }

    int len;
    for (int i = 0; i < vocab_size; i++) {
        file.read((uint8_t*)(t->vocab_scores + i), sizeof(float));
        file.read((uint8_t*)&len, sizeof(int));

        t->vocab[i] = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
        if (!t->vocab[i]) { file.close(); return false; }

        file.read((uint8_t*)t->vocab[i], len);
        t->vocab[i][len] = '\0';
    }

    file.close();
    return true;
}

static void free_tokenizer(Tokenizer* t) {
    for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
        free(t->vocab[i]);
    }
    free(t->vocab);
    free(t->vocab_scores);
    free(t->sorted_vocab);
}

static char* decode_token(Tokenizer* t, int prev_token, int token) {
    char* piece = t->vocab[token];
    if (prev_token == 1 && piece[0] == ' ') piece++;
    unsigned char byte_val;
    if (sscanf(piece, "<0x%02hhX>", &byte_val) == 1) {
        piece = (char*)t->byte_pieces + byte_val * 2;
    }
    return piece;
}

static void encode_prompt(Tokenizer* t, char* text, int* tokens, int* n_tokens) {
    if (!text) return;

    if (!t->sorted_vocab) {
        t->sorted_vocab = (TokenIndex*)malloc(t->vocab_size * sizeof(TokenIndex));
        for (int i = 0; i < t->vocab_size; i++) {
            t->sorted_vocab[i].str = t->vocab[i];
            t->sorted_vocab[i].id = i;
        }
        qsort(t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size, sizeof(TokenIndex), compare_tokens);
    }

    char* str_buffer = (char*)malloc(t->max_token_length * 2 + 3);
    size_t str_len = 0;
    *n_tokens = 0;

    // Add space prefix
    int dummy_prefix = str_lookup((char*)" ", t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
    if (dummy_prefix >= 0) tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = dummy_prefix;

    // Special tokens
    const char* special_tokens[] = {"<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|end|>"};
    const int special_ids[] = {4, 5, 6};

    char* c = text;
    while (*c != '\0') {
        bool found_special = false;
        for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
            int slen = strlen(special_tokens[s]);
            if (strncmp(c, special_tokens[s], slen) == 0) {
                tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = special_ids[s];
                c += slen;
                found_special = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (found_special) continue;

        if ((*c & 0xC0) != 0x80) str_len = 0;
        str_buffer[str_len++] = *c;
        str_buffer[str_len] = '\0';
        c++;

        if ((*c & 0xC0) == 0x80 && str_len < 4) continue;

        int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
        if (id != -1) {
            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = id;
        } else {
            tokens[(*n_tokens)++] = 1;  // UNK
        }
        str_len = 0;
    }

    // BPE merge loop
    while (1) {
        float best_score = -1e10;
        int best_id = -1, best_idx = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
            sprintf(str_buffer, "%s%s", t->vocab[tokens[i]], t->vocab[tokens[i + 1]]);
            int id = str_lookup(str_buffer, t->sorted_vocab, t->vocab_size);
            if (id != -1 && t->vocab_scores[id] > best_score) {
                best_score = t->vocab_scores[id];
                best_id = id;
                best_idx = i;
            }
        }

        if (best_idx == -1) break;

        tokens[best_idx] = best_id;
        for (int i = best_idx + 1; i < (*n_tokens - 1); i++) {
            tokens[i] = tokens[i + 1];
        }
        (*n_tokens)--;
    }

    free(str_buffer);
}

//==============================================================================
// Sampler Functions
//==============================================================================

static unsigned int random_u32(unsigned long long* state) {
    *state ^= *state >> 12;
    *state ^= *state << 25;
    *state ^= *state >> 27;
    return (*state * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dull) >> 32;
}

static float random_f32(unsigned long long* state) {
    return (random_u32(state) >> 8) / 16777216.0f;
}

static int sample_argmax(float* probs, int n) {
    int max_i = 0;
    float max_p = probs[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (probs[i] > max_p) { max_i = i; max_p = probs[i]; }
    }
    return max_i;
}

static int compare_prob(const void* a, const void* b) {
    ProbIndex* a_ = (ProbIndex*)a;
    ProbIndex* b_ = (ProbIndex*)b;
    if (a_->prob > b_->prob) return -1;
    if (a_->prob < b_->prob) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static int sample_topp(float* probs, int n, float topp, ProbIndex* probindex, float coin) {
    int n0 = 0;
    float cutoff = (1.0f - topp) / (n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (probs[i] >= cutoff) {
            probindex[n0].index = i;
            probindex[n0].prob = probs[i];
            n0++;
        }
    }
    qsort(probindex, n0, sizeof(ProbIndex), compare_prob);

    float cumulative = 0.0f;
    int last_idx = n0 - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n0; i++) {
        cumulative += probindex[i].prob;
        if (cumulative > topp) { last_idx = i; break; }
    }

    float r = coin * cumulative;
    float cdf = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i <= last_idx; i++) {
        cdf += probindex[i].prob;
        if (r < cdf) return probindex[i].index;
    }
    return probindex[last_idx].index;
}

static int sample(Sampler* s, float* logits) {
    if (s->temperature == 0.0f) {
        return sample_argmax(logits, s->vocab_size);
    }

    float inv_temp = 1.0f / s->temperature;
    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(logits, logits, s->vocab_size, inv_temp, 1, 1);

    // Softmax
    float max_val = logits[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < s->vocab_size; i++) {
        if (logits[i] > max_val) max_val = logits[i];
    }
    float sum = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < s->vocab_size; i++) {
        logits[i] = expf(logits[i] - max_val);
        sum += logits[i];
    }
    float inv_sum = 1.0f / sum;
    dsps_mulc_f32_ae32(logits, logits, s->vocab_size, inv_sum, 1, 1);

    float coin = random_f32(&s->rng_state);
    if (s->topp <= 0 || s->topp >= 1) {
        // Sample from full distribution
        float cdf = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < s->vocab_size; i++) {
            cdf += logits[i];
            if (coin < cdf) return i;
        }
        return s->vocab_size - 1;
    }
    return sample_topp(logits, s->vocab_size, s->topp, s->probindex, coin);
}

//==============================================================================
// LLMInference Class Implementation
//==============================================================================

LLMInference::LLMInference()
    : _transformer(nullptr)
    , _tokenizer(nullptr)
    , _sampler(nullptr)
    , _pool(nullptr)
    , _poolSize(0)
    , _temperature(DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE)
    , _topp(DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP)
    , _maxTokens(128)
    , _loaded(false)
{}

LLMInference::~LLMInference() {
    end();
}

bool LLMInference::begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
                          const char* modelPath, const char* tokenizerPath) {
    if (_loaded) return true;

    _pool = pool;
    _poolSize = poolSize;

    // Allocate transformer struct
    _transformer = new Transformer();
    if (!_transformer) return false;
    memset(_transformer, 0, sizeof(Transformer));

    // Load model from SD
    File file = SD.open(modelPath, FILE_READ);
    if (!file) {
        Serial.printf("LLM: Cannot open %s\n", modelPath);
        delete _transformer;
        _transformer = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t magic, version;
    file.read((uint8_t*)&magic, 4);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&version, 4);

    if (magic != 0x616b3432 || version != 2) {
        Serial.println("LLM: Invalid model format");
        file.close();
        delete _transformer;
        _transformer = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    file.read((uint8_t*)&_transformer->config, sizeof(Config));
    file.read(&_transformer->shared_classifier, 1);
    file.read((uint8_t*)&GS, 4);

    // Limit seq_len to reduce KV cache
    if (_transformer->config.seq_len > 128) {
        _transformer->config.seq_len = 128;
    }

    Serial.printf("LLM: dim=%d, layers=%d, vocab=%d, seq=%d\n",
                  _transformer->config.dim, _transformer->config.n_layers,
                  _transformer->config.vocab_size, _transformer->config.seq_len);

    // Load model into PSRAM (16-byte aligned for SIMD)
    _transformer->file_size = file.size();
    _transformer->raw_data = (uint8_t*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16, _transformer->file_size, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
    if (!_transformer->raw_data) {
        Serial.println("LLM: PSRAM allocation failed");
        file.close();
        delete _transformer;
        _transformer = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    file.seek(0);
    file.read(_transformer->raw_data, _transformer->file_size);
    file.close();

    // Memory map weights
    memory_map_weights(&_transformer->weights, &_transformer->config,
                       _transformer->raw_data + 256, _transformer->shared_classifier);

    // Dequantize token embeddings
    int emb_size = _transformer->config.vocab_size * _transformer->config.dim;
    _transformer->weights.token_embedding_table = (float*)ps_malloc(emb_size * sizeof(float));
    if (!_transformer->weights.token_embedding_table) {
        free(_transformer->raw_data);
        delete _transformer;
        _transformer = nullptr;
        return false;
    }
    dequantize(_transformer->weights.q_tokens, _transformer->weights.token_embedding_table, emb_size);

    // Allocate run state
    if (!malloc_run_state(&_transformer->state, &_transformer->config)) {
        free(_transformer->weights.token_embedding_table);
        free(_transformer->raw_data);
        delete _transformer;
        _transformer = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    // Initialize RoPE cache
    int head_size = _transformer->config.dim / _transformer->config.n_heads;
    int half_head = head_size / 2;
    int cache_size = _transformer->config.seq_len * half_head;

    _transformer->rope_cos = (float*)ps_malloc(cache_size * sizeof(float));
    _transformer->rope_sin = (float*)ps_malloc(cache_size * sizeof(float));

    if (_transformer->rope_cos && _transformer->rope_sin) {
        for (int pos = 0; pos < _transformer->config.seq_len; pos++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < half_head; i++) {
                float freq = 1.0f / powf(10000.0f, (2.0f * i) / head_size);
                float val = pos * freq;
                _transformer->rope_cos[pos * half_head + i] = cosf(val);
                _transformer->rope_sin[pos * half_head + i] = sinf(val);
            }
        }
    }

    // Load tokenizer
    _tokenizer = new Tokenizer();
    if (!build_tokenizer(_tokenizer, tokenizerPath, _transformer->config.vocab_size)) {
        Serial.printf("LLM: Cannot load tokenizer %s\n", tokenizerPath);
        end();
        return false;
    }

    // Build sampler
    _sampler = new Sampler();
    _sampler->vocab_size = _transformer->config.vocab_size;
    _sampler->temperature = _temperature;
    _sampler->topp = _topp;
    _sampler->rng_state = millis();
    _sampler->probindex = (ProbIndex*)malloc(_sampler->vocab_size * sizeof(ProbIndex));

    _loaded = true;
    Serial.printf("LLM: Loaded (%.1fKB model)\n", _transformer->file_size / 1024.0f);
    return true;
}

void LLMInference::end() {
    if (_sampler) {
        free(_sampler->probindex);
        delete _sampler;
        _sampler = nullptr;
    }

    if (_tokenizer) {
        free_tokenizer(_tokenizer);
        delete _tokenizer;
        _tokenizer = nullptr;
    }

    if (_transformer) {
        free_run_state(&_transformer->state);
        free(_transformer->rope_cos);
        free(_transformer->rope_sin);
        free(_transformer->weights.token_embedding_table);
        free(_transformer->raw_data);
        free(_transformer->weights.q_tokens);
        free(_transformer->weights.wq);
        free(_transformer->weights.wk);
        free(_transformer->weights.wv);
        free(_transformer->weights.wo);
        free(_transformer->weights.w1);
        free(_transformer->weights.w2);
        free(_transformer->weights.w3);
        if (!_transformer->shared_classifier) {
            free(_transformer->weights.wcls);
        }
        delete _transformer;
        _transformer = nullptr;
    }

    _loaded = false;
}

String LLMInference::_wrapPrompt(const char* userInput) {
    return String("<|user|>") + userInput + "<|assistant|>";
}

bool LLMInference::_isEndToken(const char* piece) {
    return piece && strstr(piece, "<|end|>") != nullptr;
}

int LLMInference::generate(const char* prompt, TokenCallback callback, void* userData) {
    if (!_loaded) return 0;

    // Update sampler params
    _sampler->temperature = _temperature;
    _sampler->topp = _topp;

    // Wrap prompt
    String wrapped = _wrapPrompt(prompt);

    // Encode
    int* tokens = (int*)malloc((wrapped.length() + 10) * sizeof(int));
    if (!tokens) return 0;

    int numTokens = 0;
    encode_prompt(_tokenizer, (char*)wrapped.c_str(), tokens, &numTokens);

    if (numTokens < 1) {
        free(tokens);
        return 0;
    }

    // Generate
    int token = tokens[0];
    int pos = 0;
    int generated = 0;

    while (pos < _maxTokens) {
        float* logits = forward(_transformer, token, pos);
        if (!logits) break;

        int next;
        if (pos < numTokens - 1) {
            next = tokens[pos + 1];
        } else {
            next = sample(_sampler, logits);
            generated++;

            // Decode and output
            char* piece = decode_token(_tokenizer, token, next);
            if (piece && piece[0] != '\0') {
                if (_isEndToken(piece)) break;

                // Filter control characters
                bool printable = true;
                if (piece[1] == '\0') {
                    unsigned char byte_val = piece[0];
                    printable = isprint(byte_val) || isspace(byte_val);
                }

                if (printable && callback) {
                    callback(piece, userData);
                }
            }
        }

        token = next;
        pos++;
    }

    free(tokens);
    return generated;
}

int LLMInference::getVocabSize() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer->config.vocab_size : 0;
}

int LLMInference::getDimension() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer->config.dim : 0;
}

int LLMInference::getNumLayers() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer->config.n_layers : 0;
}

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - LLM Inference Wrapper
 *
 * Thin wrapper around the optimized llm_core/tokenizer/sampler from 05_llm_finetuned.
 * Provides simplified interface for badge state machine integration.
 ******************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <Arduino.h>
#include "llm_core.h"
#include "tokenizer.h"
#include "sampler.h"

//==============================================================================
// Token callback for streaming output
//==============================================================================
typedef void (*TokenCallback)(const char* token, void* userData);

//==============================================================================
// LLM Inference Wrapper
//==============================================================================
class LLMInference {
public:
    LLMInference();
    ~LLMInference();

    // Initialize with memory pool (pool not directly used - kept for API consistency)
    // modelPath: Path to Q8_0 model file on SD card
    // tokenizerPath: Path to tokenizer.bin on SD card
    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
               const char* modelPath, const char* tokenizerPath);
    void end();

    // Check if model is loaded
    bool isLoaded() const { return _loaded; }

    // Configure generation parameters
    void setTemperature(float temp);
    void setTopP(float topp);
    void setMaxTokens(int max) { _maxTokens = max; }

    // Generate response from prompt
    // prompt: User's question/intent (will be wrapped with Q&A tokens)
    // callback: Called for each generated token
    // userData: Passed to callback
    // Returns: Number of tokens generated
    int generate(const char* prompt, TokenCallback callback, void* userData = nullptr);

    // Get model info
    int getVocabSize() const;
    int getDimension() const;
    int getNumLayers() const;
    int getSeqLen() const;

    // Memory requirements
    static size_t requiredPoolSize() { return 6 * 1024 * 1024; }

private:
    Transformer _transformer;
    Tokenizer _tokenizer;
    Sampler _sampler;

    int _maxTokens;
    bool _loaded;

    // Wrap prompt with Q&A special tokens
    String _wrapPrompt(const char* userInput);

    // Check if token piece contains end marker
    bool _isEndToken(const char* piece);
};

```

```cpp
/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - LLM Inference Wrapper Implementation
 *
 * Thin wrapper that delegates to the optimized llm_core/tokenizer/sampler.
 * The core inference code is unchanged from 05_llm_finetuned.
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "llm_inference.h"
#include "../../config.h"

LLMInference::LLMInference()
    : _maxTokens(128)
    , _loaded(false)
{
    memset(&_transformer, 0, sizeof(Transformer));
    memset(&_tokenizer, 0, sizeof(Tokenizer));
    memset(&_sampler, 0, sizeof(Sampler));
}

LLMInference::~LLMInference() {
    end();
}

bool LLMInference::begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
                          const char* modelPath, const char* tokenizerPath) {
    if (_loaded) return true;

    Serial.printf("LLM: Loading model %s\n", modelPath);

    // Build transformer (uses its own PSRAM allocation)
    // max_seq_len = 128 to reduce KV cache memory
    if (!build_transformer_q8(&_transformer, modelPath, 128)) {
        Serial.println("LLM: Model load failed");
        return false;
    }

    Serial.printf("LLM: Loading tokenizer %s\n", tokenizerPath);

    // Build tokenizer
    if (!build_tokenizer(&_tokenizer, tokenizerPath, _transformer.config.vocab_size)) {
        Serial.println("LLM: Tokenizer load failed");
        free_transformer(&_transformer);
        return false;
    }

    // Build sampler
    unsigned long long seed = millis();
    build_sampler(&_sampler, _transformer.config.vocab_size,
                  DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE, DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP, seed);

    _loaded = true;
    Serial.printf("LLM: Ready (dim=%d, layers=%d, vocab=%d)\n",
                  _transformer.config.dim,
                  _transformer.config.n_layers,
                  _transformer.config.vocab_size);
    return true;
}

void LLMInference::end() {
    if (!_loaded) return;

    free_sampler(&_sampler);
    free_tokenizer(&_tokenizer);
    free_transformer(&_transformer);

    _loaded = false;
    Serial.println("LLM: Unloaded");
}

void LLMInference::setTemperature(float temp) {
    _sampler.temperature = temp;
}

void LLMInference::setTopP(float topp) {
    _sampler.topp = topp;
}

String LLMInference::_wrapPrompt(const char* userInput) {
    return String("<|user|>") + userInput + "<|assistant|>";
}

bool LLMInference::_isEndToken(const char* piece) {
    return piece && strstr(piece, "<|end|>") != nullptr;
}

int LLMInference::generate(const char* prompt, TokenCallback callback, void* userData) {
    if (!_loaded) return 0;

    // Wrap prompt with Q&A tokens
    String wrapped = _wrapPrompt(prompt);

    // Allocate token buffer
    int maxPromptTokens = wrapped.length() + 10;
    int* promptTokens = (int*)malloc(maxPromptTokens * sizeof(int));
    if (!promptTokens) {
        Serial.println("LLM: Token buffer alloc failed");
        return 0;
    }

    // Encode prompt
    int numPromptTokens = 0;
    encode(&_tokenizer, (char*)wrapped.c_str(), 0, 0, promptTokens, &numPromptTokens);

    if (numPromptTokens < 1) {
        Serial.println("LLM: Encoding failed");
        free(promptTokens);
        return 0;
    }

    Serial.printf("LLM: Encoded %d prompt tokens\n", numPromptTokens);

    // Generation loop
    int token = promptTokens[0];
    int pos = 0;
    int generated = 0;
    unsigned long startTime = 0;

    int totalSteps = numPromptTokens + _maxTokens;

    while (pos < totalSteps) {
        // Forward pass
        float* logits = forward(&_transformer, token, pos);
        if (!logits) {
            Serial.println("LLM: Forward pass failed");
            break;
        }

        // Get next token
        int next;
        if (pos < numPromptTokens - 1) {
            // Still processing prompt
            next = promptTokens[pos + 1];
        } else {
            // Sample from logits
            next = sample(&_sampler, logits);
            generated++;

            // Start timer after prompt processing
            if (startTime == 0) {
                startTime = millis();
            }

            // Decode and output token
            char* piece = decode(&_tokenizer, token, next);
            if (piece && piece[0] != '\0') {
                // Check for end token
                if (_isEndToken(piece)) {
                    break;
                }

                // Filter control characters
                bool printable = true;
                if (piece[1] == '\0') {
                    unsigned char byte_val = piece[0];
                    printable = isprint(byte_val) || isspace(byte_val);
                }

                if (printable && callback) {
                    callback(piece, userData);
                }
            }
        }

        token = next;
        pos++;

        // Check for max tokens
        if (generated >= _maxTokens) break;
    }

    // Print performance stats
    if (generated > 0 && startTime > 0) {
        unsigned long elapsed = millis() - startTime;
        float tokensPerSec = (float)generated / (elapsed / 1000.0f);
        Serial.printf("LLM: Generated %d tokens (%.1f tok/s)\n", generated, tokensPerSec);
    }

    free(promptTokens);
    return generated;
}

int LLMInference::getVocabSize() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer.config.vocab_size : 0;
}

int LLMInference::getDimension() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer.config.dim : 0;
}

int LLMInference::getNumLayers() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer.config.n_layers : 0;
}

int LLMInference::getSeqLen() const {
    return _loaded ? _transformer.config.seq_len : 0;
}

    74→void setState(BadgeState newState) {

    79→    // Exit current state

   172→void handleLogoLoop() {
   173→    // Update orientation
   174→    orientation.update();

   176→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());

   178→

   189→            }
   190→        }
   191→    }
   192→}
   193→
   194→void handleRecording() {
   195→    // Update recording
   196→    if (recorder.update()) {
   197→        // Recording complete
   198→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   199→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());

   209→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");

   215→}

   222→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);

   224→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD) {

   236→}

Phase 4 (LLM Integration) firmware is now complete. Here's the summary:

## Phase 4 Completed

**Files Copied (unchanged from 05_llm_finetuned):**
- `src/ml/llm_core.cpp/h` - SIMD-optimized transformer forward pass
- `src/ml/tokenizer.cpp/h` - BPE tokenizer
- `src/ml/sampler.cpp/h` - Temperature/top-p sampling

**Files Created:**
- `src/ml/llm_inference.cpp/h` - Thin wrapper class with:
  - `begin(pool, size, modelPath, tokenizerPath)` - Load model
  - `generate(prompt, callback, userData)` - Streaming generation
  - `end()` - Unload and free memory

**State Machine Updates:**
- Added `STATE_LLM_INFERENCE` handler
- Added `onLLMToken()` callback that streams tokens to display
- High-confidence similarity match → LLM generation → streaming display
- Auto-timeout to logo loop after 5 seconds

## Full Pipeline Now

```
Wake word → Recording → YAMNet-256 embed → Similarity search
                                              ↓
                              score ≥ 0.7 → LLM generates response
                                              ↓
                                          Display (streaming)
                                              ↓
                              score < 0.7 → "Sorry..." message
```

   - `llm_model.bin` → `/models/llm_model.bin` (from llm_qa_scaled_training)
   - `tokenizer.bin` → `/models/tokenizer.bin`
3. **Test the full pipeline**

Here's what I found about the ESP32-SAM Arduino library by pschatzmann for speech synthesis:

## Overview

"SAM" is a project that provides SAM as an Arduino Library which offers a simple API and supports different output alternatives. SAM is a very small Text-To-Speech (TTS) program written in C that runs on most popular platforms.(no content)It includes a Text-To-Phoneme converter called reciter and a Phoneme-To-Speech routine for the final output.(no content)It is so small that it will work also on embedded computers.

## GitHub Repository

The library is available at: **https://github.com/pschatzmann/arduino-SAM**

It's described as "Software Automatic Mouth - Tiny Speech Synthesizer."

## Voice Parameters

The library supports various voice configurations with parameters for SPEED, PITCH, THROAT, and MOUTH. Example presets include: Elf (72/64/110/160), Little Robot (92/60/190/190), Stuffy Guy (82/72/110/105), Little Old Lady (82/32/145/145), Extra-Terrestrial (100/64/150/200), and default SAM (72/64/128/128).

## Technical Details

The requirements have been determined by compiling the project with an ESP32.(no content)The software is a reverse-engineered version of a commercial software published more than 30 years ago. The current copyright holder is SoftVoice, Inc. (www.text2speech.com). Any attempt to contact the company failed, and the website was last updated in the year 2009.

## Integration with Audio Tools

SAM is listed as a Text to Speech Engine in pschatzmann's arduino-audio-tools optional libraries, alongside other TTS options like TalkiePCM, TTS, and flite.(no content)The author also tested the SAM TTS Library with the AI Thinker Audio Kit, finding and correcting some bugs in the library before getting it working as expected.

## Comparison with Other TTS Options

According to pschatzmann, "FLITE is best – but it comes at the price of high memory consumption."(no content)As a general conclusion, sound quality is directly related with memory consumption, so high quality speech from microcontrollers is limited due to memory constraints.

# SAM TTS Implementation on Arduino

## Code Example

The article provides this sketch demonstrating SAM TTS with web streaming:

```cpp
#include "AudioServer.h"
#include "sam_arduino.h"

using namespace audio_tools;  

AudioWAVServer server("ssid","password");
int channels = 1;
int bits_per_sample = 8;

void outputData(Stream &out){
  Serial.print("providing data...");
  SAM sam(out, false);
  sam.setOutputChannels(channels);
  sam.setOutputBitsPerSample(bits_per_sample);
  sam.say("hallo, I am SAM");
}

void setup(){
  Serial.begin(115200);
  server.begin(outputData, SAM::sampleRate(), channels, bits_per_sample);
}

void loop() {
  server.doLoop();  
}
```

## Required Includes

- `"AudioServer.h"` (from arduino-audio-tools library)
- `"sam_arduino.h"` (SAM TTS library)

## SAM API Methods

Based on the example, the primary API includes:

- `SAM(Stream&, bool)` - Constructor accepting output stream
- `setOutputChannels(int)` - Configure channel count
- `setOutputBitsPerSample(int)` - Set bit depth
- `say(string)` - Generate speech from text
- `SAM::sampleRate()` - Static method returning sample rate

**Note:** The author mentions the library is available on GitHub as "arduino-SAM" and that I2S integration faced performance limitations.

   138→void playTone(float frequency, int duration_ms) {
   139→  Serial.printf("Playing %d Hz for %d ms\n", (int)frequency, duration_ms);
   140→
   141→  unsigned long start = millis();
   142→  int samples_sent = 0;
   143→
   144→  while (millis() - start < duration_ms) {
   145→    // Generate sine wave samples
   146→    for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
   147→      float t = (float)(samples_sent + i) / SAMPLE_RATE;
   148→      float sample = sin(2.0 * PI * frequency * t);
   149→
   150→      // Convert to 16-bit with 50% volume (to prevent clipping)
   151→      audio_buffer[i] = (int16_t)(sample * 16000);
   152→    }
   153→
   154→    // Send to speaker
   155→    size_t bytes_written;
   156→    i2s_write(I2S_PORT, audio_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(int16_t), &bytes_written, portMAX_DELAY);
   157→
   158→    samples_sent += BUFFER_SIZE;
   159→
   160→    // Blink LED while playing
   161→    if ((millis() / 100) % 2 == 0) {
   162→      digitalWrite(LED_PIN, HIGH);
   163→    } else {
   164→      digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW);
   165→    }
   166→  }
   167→}

   162→  digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW);
   163→  delay(500);
   164→
   165→  if (!recordStereoToPSRAM()) {
   166→    Serial.println("\nRecording FAILED!");
   167→    error_blink();
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  Serial.println("\n========================================");
   171→  Serial.println("Recording complete!");
   172→  Serial.println("========================================\n");
   173→
   174→  // Downmix to mono using HYBRID
   175→  Serial.print("Applying HYBRID downmix... ");
   176→  downmixHybrid();
   177→  Serial.println("OK");
   178→
   179→  // Analyze and normalize
   180→  normalizeAudio();
   181→  Serial.println();
   182→
   183→  Serial.println("========================================");
   184→  Serial.println("Starting playback loop...");
   185→  Serial.println("========================================\n");
   186→
   187→  digitalWrite(LED_PIN, HIGH);
   188→}
   189→
   190→void loop() {
   191→  playMonoBuffer();
   192→}
   193→
   194→bool recordStereoToPSRAM() {
   195→  uint32_t samples_written = 0;
   196→  uint32_t last_percent = 0;
   197→  unsigned long start_time = millis();
   198→
   199→  while (samples_written < STEREO_SAMPLES) {
   200→    // Blink LED
   201→    if ((millis() / 200) % 2 == 0) {
   202→      digitalWrite(LED_PIN, HIGH);
   203→    } else {
   204→      digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW);
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    // Read I2S
   208→    size_t bytes_read = 0;
   209→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, i2s_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(int32_t),
   210→                 &bytes_read, portMAX_DELAY) != ESP_OK) {
   211→      return false;
   212→    }
   213→
   214→    // Convert and store
   215→    int samples_read = bytes_read / sizeof(int32_t);
   216→    for (int i = 0; i < samples_read && samples_written < STEREO_SAMPLES; i++) {
   217→      stereo_buffer[samples_written++] = (int16_t)(i2s_buffer[i] >> 16);
   218→    }
   219→
   220→    // Progress
   221→    uint32_t percent = (samples_written * 100) / STEREO_SAMPLES;
   222→    if (percent != last_percent && percent % 10 == 0) {
   223→      Serial.printf("Progress: %u%% (%u / %u samples)\n",
   224→                    percent, samples_written, STEREO_SAMPLES);
   225→      last_percent = percent;
   226→    }
   227→  }
   228→
   229→  Serial.printf("\nRecorded: %u samples in %lu ms\n", samples_written, millis() - start_time);
   230→  return true;
   231→}
   232→
   233→void downmixHybrid() {
   234→  float left_energy = 0.0f;
   235→  float right_energy = 0.0f;
   236→  const float ENERGY_DECAY = 0.95f;
   237→  const float MIN_WEIGHT = 0.30f;  // Minimum 30% per channel
   238→  const float MAX_WEIGHT = 0.70f;  // Maximum 70% per channel
   239→  const float GAIN_BOOST = 4.0f;   // 4x volume boost (compensates for 9dB hardware gain)
   240→
   241→  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MONO_SAMPLES; i++) {
   242→    int16_t left = stereo_buffer[i * 2];
   243→    int16_t right = stereo_buffer[i * 2 + 1];
   244→
   245→    // Track energy of each channel
   246→    left_energy = left_energy * ENERGY_DECAY + abs(left) * (1.0f - ENERGY_DECAY);
   247→    right_energy = right_energy * ENERGY_DECAY + abs(right) * (1.0f - ENERGY_DECAY);
   248→
   249→    // Calculate raw weights
   250→    float total_energy = left_energy + right_energy;
   251→    float left_weight = (total_energy > 0) ? (left_energy / total_energy) : 0.5f;
   252→
   253→    // Constrain to 30%-70% range
   254→    if (left_weight < MIN_WEIGHT) left_weight = MIN_WEIGHT;
   255→    if (left_weight > MAX_WEIGHT) left_weight = MAX_WEIGHT;
   256→
   257→    float right_weight = 1.0f - left_weight;
   258→
   259→    // Weighted mix with gain boost and clipping protection
   260→    int32_t mixed = (int32_t)(left * left_weight + right * right_weight) * GAIN_BOOST;
   261→    if (mixed > 32767) mixed = 32767;
   262→    if (mixed < -32768) mixed = -32768;
   263→    mono_buffer[i] = (int16_t)mixed;
   264→  }
   265→}
   266→
   267→void normalizeAudio() {
   268→  // Find peak level in recording
   269→  int16_t peak = 0;
   270→  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MONO_SAMPLES; i++) {
   271→    int16_t abs_val = abs(mono_buffer[i]);
   272→    if (abs_val > peak) peak = abs_val;
   273→  }
   274→
   275→  Serial.printf("Peak level: %d / 32767 (%.1f%%)\n", peak, (peak * 100.0f) / 32767.0f);
   276→
   277→  // Calculate normalization gain to maximize volume
   278→  if (peak > 0) {
   279→    float norm_gain = 32000.0f / peak;  // Leave small headroom (32000 instead of 32767)
   280→
   281→    // Limit max boost to 8x to avoid amplifying noise too much
   282→    if (norm_gain > 8.0f) norm_gain = 8.0f;
   283→
   284→    Serial.printf("Applying normalization: %.2fx gain\n", norm_gain);
   285→
   286→    // Apply normalization
   287→    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MONO_SAMPLES; i++) {
   288→      int32_t normalized = (int32_t)(mono_buffer[i] * norm_gain);
   289→      if (normalized > 32767) normalized = 32767;
   290→      if (normalized < -32768) normalized = -32768;
   291→      mono_buffer[i] = (int16_t)normalized;
   292→    }
   293→  } else {
   294→    Serial.println("WARNING: Recording is silent (peak = 0)!");
   295→  }
   296→}
   297→
   298→void playMonoBuffer() {
   299→  size_t bytes_written = 0;
   300→  static unsigned long last_print = 0;
   301→
   302→  // Play entire mono buffer
   303→  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MONO_SAMPLES; i += BUFFER_SIZE) {
   304→    uint32_t samples_to_write = min((uint32_t)BUFFER_SIZE, MONO_SAMPLES - i);
   305→
   306→    i2s_write(I2S_NUM_1, &mono_buffer[i], samples_to_write * sizeof(int16_t),
   307→              &bytes_written, portMAX_DELAY);
   308→
   309→    // Print status every ~2 seconds
   310→    if (millis() - last_print > 2000) {
   311→      Serial.printf("Playing... sample %u / %u\n", i, MONO_SAMPLES);
   312→      last_print = millis();
   313→    }
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  Serial.println("Playback complete, looping...\n");
   317→}
   318→
   319→void error_blink() {
   320→  while(1) {
   321→    digitalWrite(LED_PIN, !digitalRead(LED_PIN));
   322→    delay(200);
   323→  }
   324→}
   325→

       llmInference.end();

       }

   258→
   259→    size_t len_written = out_ptr->write((const uint8_t *)buffer, len);
   260→    if (len != len_written) {
   261→      SAM_LOG("Error - Could not write all data: %d of %d", len_written, len);
   262→      return false;
   263→    }
   264→    return true;
   265→  }
   266→
   267→ protected:
   268→  Print *out_ptr;
   269→  int output_channels;

   272→/**

   276→class SAMPrintStream : public SAMOutputStream {
   277→ public:
   278→  SAMPrintStream(Print &out) : SAMOutputStream(out) {}
   279→
   280→  const char *name() { return "SAMPrintStream"; }
   281→
   282→  virtual bool write(byte *buffer, int bytes_count) {
   283→    // copy from 1 to 2 channels
   284→    int16_t *buffer16 = (int16_t *)buffer;
   285→    for (int j = 0; j < bytes_count / 2; j++) {
   286→      out_ptr->print(buffer16[j]);
   287→      if (j < channels() - 1) {
   288→        out_ptr->print(",");
   289→      }
   290→      if (j == channels() - 1) {
   291→        out_ptr->println();
   292→      }
   293→    }
   294→
   295→    return true;
   296→  }
   297→};

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Robotic TTS Module
 *
 * Uses ESP32-SAM library for 1980s-style robotic speech synthesis.
 * Outputs audio via I2S to MAX98357A speaker.
 ******************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <driver/i2s.h>
#include <sam_arduino.h>

//==============================================================================
// Custom I2S Output for SAM (using legacy I2S driver)
//==============================================================================
class SAMI2SOutput : public SAMOutputBase {
public:
    SAMI2SOutput(i2s_port_t port, int bclk, int lrc, int dout);
    ~SAMI2SOutput();

    void open() override;
    int close() override;
    int drain() override;
    bool write(byte* buffer, int bytes_count) override;
    const char* name() override { return "SAMI2SOutput"; }
    int channels() override { return 2; }  // SAM outputs stereo
    void setChannels(int ch) override {}   // Fixed at stereo

private:
    i2s_port_t _port;
    int _bclk;
    int _lrc;
    int _dout;
    bool _driverInstalled;
};

//==============================================================================
// Robot TTS Wrapper
//==============================================================================
class RobotTTS {
public:
    // Voice presets for different characters
    enum Voice {
        ROBOT,          // Ultra-robotic (custom settings)
        LITTLE_ROBOT,   // SAM's LittleRobot preset
        ALIEN,          // SAM's ExtraTerrestrial preset
        ELF,            // SAM's Elf preset
        SAM_DEFAULT     // SAM's default voice
    };

    RobotTTS();
    ~RobotTTS();

    // Initialize TTS with I2S output
    // Returns false if initialization fails
    bool begin();
    void end();

    // Check if initialized
    bool isReady() const { return _ready; }

    // Speak text (blocking)
    // Returns true if speech completed successfully
    bool speak(const char* text);

    // Speak phonemes directly (for precise control)
    bool speakPhonemes(const char* phonemes);

    // Voice configuration
    void setVoice(Voice voice);
    void setSpeed(uint8_t speed);      // 0-255 (default: 72)
    void setPitch(uint8_t pitch);      // 0-255 (default: 64)
    void setMouth(uint8_t mouth);      // 0-255 (default: 128)
    void setThroat(uint8_t throat);    // 0-255 (default: 128)

    // Volume control (0-100)
    void setVolume(uint8_t percent);

    // Sing mode for musical speech
    void setSingMode(bool enable);

private:
    SAM* _sam;
    SAMI2SOutput* _output;
    bool _ready;
};

/*******************************************************************************
 * OAISYS Badge - Robotic TTS Module Implementation
 *
 * Uses ESP32-SAM library for 1980s-style robotic speech synthesis.
 ******************************************************************************/

#include "robot_tts.h"
#include "../../config.h"

//==============================================================================
// SAMI2SOutput Implementation
//==============================================================================

SAMI2SOutput::SAMI2SOutput(i2s_port_t port, int bclk, int lrc, int dout)
    : _port(port)
    , _bclk(bclk)
    , _lrc(lrc)
    , _dout(dout)
    , _driverInstalled(false)
{
}

SAMI2SOutput::~SAMI2SOutput() {
    if (_driverInstalled) {
        close();
    }
}

void SAMI2SOutput::open() {
    if (_driverInstalled) return;

    // Configure I2S for SAM's native sample rate (22050 Hz, stereo, 16-bit)
    i2s_config_t i2s_config = {
        .mode = (i2s_mode_t)(I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_TX),
        .sample_rate = SAMOutputBase::sampleRate(),  // 22050 Hz
        .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_16BIT,
        .channel_format = I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_RIGHT_LEFT,  // Stereo
        .communication_format = I2S_COMM_FORMAT_STAND_I2S,
        .intr_alloc_flags = ESP_INTR_FLAG_LEVEL1,
        .dma_buf_count = 8,
        .dma_buf_len = 256,
        .use_apll = false,
        .tx_desc_auto_clear = true,
        .fixed_mclk = 0
    };

    i2s_pin_config_t pin_config = {
        .bck_io_num = _bclk,
        .ws_io_num = _lrc,
        .data_out_num = _dout,
        .data_in_num = I2S_PIN_NO_CHANGE
    };

    if (i2s_driver_install(_port, &i2s_config, 0, NULL) != ESP_OK) {
        Serial.println("TTS: I2S driver install failed");
        return;
    }

    if (i2s_set_pin(_port, &pin_config) != ESP_OK) {
        Serial.println("TTS: I2S pin config failed");
        i2s_driver_uninstall(_port);
        return;
    }

    _driverInstalled = true;
    SAMOutputBase::open();
    Serial.printf("TTS: I2S initialized at %d Hz\n", SAMOutputBase::sampleRate());
}

int SAMI2SOutput::close() {
    if (_driverInstalled) {
        i2s_zero_dma_buffer(_port);
        i2s_driver_uninstall(_port);
        _driverInstalled = false;
    }
    return SAMOutputBase::close();
}

int SAMI2SOutput::drain() {
    if (_driverInstalled) {
        i2s_zero_dma_buffer(_port);
    }
    return 0;
}

bool SAMI2SOutput::write(byte* buffer, int bytes_count) {
    if (!_driverInstalled) return false;

    size_t bytes_written;
    esp_err_t result = i2s_write(_port, buffer, bytes_count, &bytes_written, portMAX_DELAY);

    if (result != ESP_OK) {
        Serial.println("TTS: I2S write failed");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// RobotTTS Implementation
//==============================================================================

RobotTTS::RobotTTS()
    : _sam(nullptr)
    , _output(nullptr)
    , _ready(false)
{
}

RobotTTS::~RobotTTS() {
    end();
}

bool RobotTTS::begin() {
    if (_ready) return true;

    // Create I2S output for speaker
    _output = new SAMI2SOutput(SPK_I2S_PORT, SPK_BCLK, SPK_LRC, SPK_DOUT);
    if (!_output) {
        Serial.println("TTS: Output alloc failed");
        return false;
    }

    // Create SAM instance with our I2S output
    _sam = new SAM(_output);
    if (!_sam) {
        Serial.println("TTS: SAM alloc failed");
        delete _output;
        _output = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    // Set default ultra-robotic voice
    setVoice(ROBOT);

    _ready = true;
    Serial.println("TTS: Ready (SAM with I2S output)");
    return true;
}

void RobotTTS::end() {
    if (_sam) {
        _sam->end();
        delete _sam;
        _sam = nullptr;
    }
    if (_output) {
        _output->close();
        delete _output;
        _output = nullptr;
    }
    _ready = false;
}

bool RobotTTS::speak(const char* text) {
    if (!_ready || !text || strlen(text) == 0) return false;

    Serial.printf("TTS: Speaking \"%s\"\n", text);
    bool result = _sam->say(text);

    if (!result) {
        Serial.println("TTS: Speech failed");
    }
    return result;
}

bool RobotTTS::speakPhonemes(const char* phonemes) {
    if (!_ready || !phonemes || strlen(phonemes) == 0) return false;

    Serial.printf("TTS: Phonemes \"%s\"\n", phonemes);
    return _sam->sayPhone(phonemes);
}

void RobotTTS::setVoice(Voice voice) {
    if (!_sam) return;

    switch (voice) {
        case ROBOT:
            // Ultra-robotic: slow, low pitch, harsh throat/mouth
            _sam->setSpeed(100);    // Slower for dramatic effect
            _sam->setPitch(50);     // Lower pitch
            _sam->setThroat(200);   // Harsh throat
            _sam->setMouth(200);    // Wide mouth resonance
            break;
        case LITTLE_ROBOT:
            _sam->setVoice(SAM::LittleRobot);
            break;
        case ALIEN:
            _sam->setVoice(SAM::ExtraTerrestrial);
            break;
        case ELF:
            _sam->setVoice(SAM::Elf);
            break;
        case SAM_DEFAULT:
        default:
            _sam->setVoice(SAM::Sam);
            break;
    }
}

void RobotTTS::setSpeed(uint8_t speed) {
    if (_sam) _sam->setSpeed(speed);
}

void RobotTTS::setPitch(uint8_t pitch) {
    if (_sam) _sam->setPitch(pitch);
}

void RobotTTS::setMouth(uint8_t mouth) {
    if (_sam) _sam->setMouth(mouth);
}

void RobotTTS::setThroat(uint8_t throat) {
    if (_sam) _sam->setThroat(throat);
}

void RobotTTS::setVolume(uint8_t percent) {
    if (_sam) _sam->setVolume(percent);
}

void RobotTTS::setSingMode(bool enable) {
    if (_sam) _sam->setSingMode(enable);
}

   207→void handleLogoLoop() {

   226→    }

   229→void handleRecording() {
   230→    // Update recording
   231→    if (recorder.update()) {
   232→        // Recording complete
   233→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   234→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());
   235→
   236→        // Phase 3: Extract embedding from recording
   237→        setState(STATE_EMBEDDING);

   239→}

   241→void handleEmbedding() {
   242→    // Run YAMNet embedding extraction (blocking operation)
   243→    if (yamnetEmbed.embed(recorder.getBuffer(), recorder.getSampleCount(), queryEmbedding)) {
   244→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");
   245→        setState(STATE_SIMILARITY);
   246→    } else {
   247→        Serial.println("Embedding extraction failed");
   248→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   249→    }
   250→}
   251→
   252→void handleSimilarity() {
   253→    // Search for closest embedding
   254→    lastSearchResult = embedSearch.search(queryEmbedding);
   255→
   256→    Serial.printf("Best match: %s (score: %.3f)\n",
   257→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);
   258→
   259→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD) {
   260→        // Good match - run LLM inference
   261→        Serial.println("High confidence match!");
   262→        setState(STATE_LLM_INFERENCE);
   263→    } else {
   264→        // Low confidence - stash and apologize
   265→        Serial.println("Low confidence - stashing");
   266→        // TODO Phase 8: stash audio and embedding
   267→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   268→    }
   269→}
   270→
   271→void handleLLMInference() {
   272→    if (!llmGenerating) {
   273→        // Already done, wait for display timeout
   274→        if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 5000) {
   275→            llmInference.end();
   276→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   277→        }
   278→        return;
   279→    }
   280→
   281→    // Run LLM generation (blocking, but streams tokens via callback)
   282→    Serial.printf("\nLLM generating response for: %s\n", lastSearchResult.intent);
   283→    int tokensGenerated = llmInference.generate(lastSearchResult.intent, onLLMToken, nullptr);
   284→    Serial.printf("\nLLM done: %d tokens\n", tokensGenerated);
   285→
   286→    llmGenerating = false;
   287→
   288→    // Unload LLM to free memory
   289→    llmInference.end();
   290→
   291→    // Reset timer for display timeout
   292→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   293→
   294→    // If no tokens generated, show just the intent
   295→    if (tokensGenerated == 0 && llmResponse.length() == 0) {
   296→        video.showText(lastSearchResult.intent);
   297→    }
   298→
   299→    // Stay in this state for display, will timeout to LOGO_LOOP
   300→}
   301→
   302→void handleDisplayResponse() {
   303→    // Auto-return to logo loop after 3 seconds
   304→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 3000) {
   305→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   306→    }
   307→}
   308→
   309→void handleTtsSorry() {
   310→    // Auto-return to logo loop after 2 seconds
   311→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 2000) {
   312→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   313→    }

   316→//==============================================================================
   317→// Main Loop State Machine
   318→//==============================================================================
   319→
   320→void loop() {
   321→    // State-specific handling
   322→    switch (currentState) {
   323→        case STATE_BOOT:
   324→            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop

   327→
   328→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:

   336→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   337→            handleDisplayResponse();
   338→            break;
   339→

   341→            handleEmbedding();
   342→            break;
   343→
   344→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   345→            handleSimilarity();
   346→            break;
   347→
   348→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:

   350→            break;
   351→
   352→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:

   354→            break;
   355→
   356→        // Future states (Phase 5+)

   358→        case STATE_STASH_DATA:

## Phase 5: Robotic TTS - Complete

### Files Created

**`src/tts/robot_tts.h`**

- `RobotTTS` class - Wrapper with voice presets (ROBOT, LITTLE_ROBOT, ALIEN, ELF, SAM_DEFAULT)

**`src/tts/robot_tts.cpp`**
- I2S1 configuration at 22050 Hz (SAM's native rate) for MAX98357A
- Ultra-robotic voice preset: speed=100, pitch=50, throat=200, mouth=200
- `speak()` method for text-to-speech

### State Machine Updates (`oaisys_badge.ino`)
- Added `RobotTTS tts` global instance
- **STATE_TTS_OUTPUT**: Speaks LLM response, then returns to logo
- **STATE_TTS_SORRY**: Speaks "Sorry, I could not understand that."
- Startup greeting: "Hello. I am ready."
- Flow: LLM → TTS_OUTPUT → LOGO_LOOP

### Full Pipeline Flow
```
LOGO_LOOP (listening)
    ↓ "Hey Daisy"
RECORDING (3 sec, RED screen)
    ↓
EMBEDDING (YAMNet-256)
    ↓
SIMILARITY (cosine search)
    ↓
score ≥ 0.7 → LLM_INFERENCE → TTS_OUTPUT → LOGO_LOOP
score < 0.7 → TTS_SORRY → LOGO_LOOP
```

### Remaining Tasks
1. **Run `retrain_yamnet256.ipynb` on vast.ai** - Generate embeddings for your intents
2. **Copy models to SD card**:
   - `/models/wake_word.tflite`
   - `/models/yamnet_256.tflite`
   - `/models/llm_model.bin` + `/models/tokenizer.bin`
   - `/data/embeddings.bin` + `/data/intents.txt`
3. **Test full pipeline** with actual hardware

<cell id="cell-0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># Retrain Embeddings with YAMNet-256

Re-extract audio embeddings using STM32's YAMNet-256 TFLite model (~182KB)
instead of the large TF Hub YAMNet (~13MB).

## vast.ai Compatible
- Uses `uv` for dependency management
- Works with /workspace directory structure
- Upload your existing audio_data folder before running

## Why Retrain?
- Original training used TF Hub YAMNet (1024-dim, 13MB) - too big for ESP32
- STM32's YAMNet-256 outputs 256-dim directly and is only ~182KB
- We have 4GB of generated audio files - just need to re-extract embeddings

## Pre-requisites
Before running this notebook on vast.ai:
1. Upload `audio_data/` folder (4GB of generated audio)
2. Upload `data/raw/full.csv` (2008 questions)

## Pipeline
1. Download YAMNet-256 TFLite from STM32 Model Zoo
2. Load existing audio files from metadata
3. Generate mel-spectrograms (64 bins x 96 frames)
4. Extract 256-dim embeddings using TFLite
5. Train text projection (768 -> 256)
6. Export for ESP32

## Output
- `yamnet_256.tflite` (~182KB) - Audio embedding model
- `embeddings_yamnet256.bin` (~2MB) - Pre-computed query embeddings  
- `intents_yamnet256.txt` - Question strings</cell id="cell-0">

<cell id="cell-12"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 5. Mel-Spectrogram Generation</cell id="cell-12">
<cell id="cell-13">def compute_mel_spectrogram(audio_path, target_sr=SAMPLE_RATE, n_mels=MEL_BINS, 
                            n_fft=N_FFT, hop_length=HOP_LENGTH, n_frames=MEL_FRAMES):
    """
    Compute mel-spectrogram for YAMNet-256.
    Output shape: (n_frames, n_mels) = (96, 64)
    """
    # Load audio
    audio, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)
    
    # Ensure minimum length for mel-spectrogram
    min_samples = hop_length * (n_frames - 1) + n_fft
    if len(audio) < min_samples:
        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, min_samples - len(audio)))
    
    # Compute mel-spectrogram
    mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(
        y=audio, sr=sr, n_mels=n_mels, n_fft=n_fft, 
        hop_length=hop_length, fmin=125.0, fmax=7500.0
    )
    
    # Convert to log scale (dB)
    mel_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel, ref=np.max)
    
    # Transpose to (frames, bins) and truncate/pad to n_frames
    mel_db = mel_db.T  # (time, freq)
    
    if mel_db.shape[0] < n_frames:
        mel_db = np.pad(mel_db, ((0, n_frames - mel_db.shape[0]), (0, 0)))
    else:
        mel_db = mel_db[:n_frames, :]
    
    # Normalize to [0, 1] range (typical for TFLite models)
    mel_db = (mel_db - mel_db.min()) / (mel_db.max() - mel_db.min() + 1e-8)
    
    return mel_db.astype(np.float32)

# Test on first audio file
test_audio = metadata[0]['file']
test_mel = compute_mel_spectrogram(test_audio)
print(f"Test mel-spectrogram shape: {test_mel.shape}")
print(f"Value range: [{test_mel.min():.3f}, {test_mel.max():.3f}]")</cell id="cell-13">

<cell id="cell-15"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 6. Extract YAMNet-256 Embeddings</cell id="cell-15">
<cell id="cell-16">def extract_yamnet_embedding(interpreter, mel_spectrogram):
    """
    Run YAMNet-256 TFLite inference on mel-spectrogram.
    Input: (96, 64) mel-spectrogram
    Output: (256,) embedding vector
    """
    input_details = interpreter.get_input_details()
    output_details = interpreter.get_output_details()
    
    # Reshape input to match model expectations
    # STM32 YAMNet-256 expects: [batch, frames, mels] or [batch, frames, mels, 1]
    input_shape = input_details[0]['shape']
    
    if len(input_shape) == 3:
        # [batch, frames, mels]
        input_data = mel_spectrogram.reshape(1, MEL_FRAMES, MEL_BINS)
    elif len(input_shape) == 4:
        # [batch, frames, mels, 1]
        input_data = mel_spectrogram.reshape(1, MEL_FRAMES, MEL_BINS, 1)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected input shape: {input_shape}")
    
    input_data = input_data.astype(input_details[0]['dtype'])
    
    interpreter.set_tensor(input_details[0]['index'], input_data)
    interpreter.invoke()
    
    output_data = interpreter.get_tensor(output_details[0]['index'])
    return output_data.flatten()

# Test embedding extraction
test_embedding = extract_yamnet_embedding(interpreter, test_mel)
print(f"Test embedding shape: {test_embedding.shape}")
print(f"Embedding stats: mean={test_embedding.mean():.4f}, std={test_embedding.std():.4f}")</cell id="cell-16">

<cell id="cell-24"># Bucketed batch generator (same as original)
import random

class BucketedBatchGenerator:
    def __init__(self, audio_embs, text_embs, bucket_ids, batch_size):
        self.audio_embs = audio_embs
        self.text_embs = text_embs
        self.bucket_ids = bucket_ids
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        
        self.bucket_to_indices = defaultdict(list)
        for idx, bid in enumerate(bucket_ids):
            self.bucket_to_indices[bid].append(idx)
        
        self.all_buckets = list(self.bucket_to_indices.keys())
        
        if batch_size > len(self.all_buckets):
            self.batch_size = len(self.all_buckets)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.audio_embs) // self.batch_size
    
    def generate_batch(self):
        selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)
        
        batch_audio = []
        batch_text = []
        
        for bucket_id in selected_buckets:
            idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])
            batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])
            batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])
        
        return np.array(batch_audio), np.array(batch_text)
    
    def generate_epoch(self):
        for _ in range(len(self)):
            yield self.generate_batch()

batch_generator = BucketedBatchGenerator(
    audio_embeddings_normalized,
    text_embeddings,
    bucket_ids,
    BATCH_SIZE
)

print(f"Batch generator: {len(batch_generator)} batches per epoch")</cell id="cell-24">
<cell id="cell-25"># Contrastive loss
class ContrastiveLoss(tf.keras.losses.Loss):
    def __init__(self, temperature=0.2, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.temperature = temperature
    
    def call(self, audio_emb, text_emb):
        logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / self.temperature
        batch_size = tf.shape(audio_emb)[0]
        labels = tf.range(batch_size)
        
        loss_a2t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
        loss_t2a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))
        
        return (tf.reduce_mean(loss_a2t) + tf.reduce_mean(loss_t2a)) / 2

optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
loss_fn = ContrastiveLoss(temperature=TEMPERATURE)

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        # Audio embeddings are pre-normalized, just use them directly
        audio_proj = tf.constant(audio_batch)  # Already normalized 256-dim
        text_proj = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)  # 768 -> 256 normalized
        loss = loss_fn(audio_proj, text_proj)
    
    gradients = tape.gradient(loss, text_projection.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, text_projection.trainable_variables))
    return loss

print("Training setup complete")</cell id="cell-25">
<cell id="cell-26"># Training loop
print(f"Training text projection for {EPOCHS} epochs...")

history = {'loss': []}
best_loss = float('inf')

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    epoch_losses = []
    
    for audio_batch, text_batch in batch_generator.generate_epoch():
        audio_batch = tf.constant(audio_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        text_batch = tf.constant(text_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        
        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)
        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())
    
    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)
    history['loss'].append(avg_loss)
    
    if avg_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = avg_loss
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 50 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}")

print(f"\nTraining complete! Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}")</cell id="cell-26">

Updated cell undefined with def compute_mel_spectrogram(audio_path, target_sr=SAMPLE_RATE, n_mels=MEL_BINS, 
                            n_fft=N_FFT, hop_length=HOP_LENGTH, n_frames=MEL_FRAMES):
    """
    Compute mel-spectrogram for YAMNet-256.
    Output shape: (n_mels, n_frames) = (64, 96) to match model input [1, 64, 96, 1]
    """
    # Load audio
    audio, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)
    
    # Ensure minimum length for mel-spectrogram
    min_samples = hop_length * (n_frames - 1) + n_fft
    if len(audio) < min_samples:
        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, min_samples - len(audio)))
    
    # Compute mel-spectrogram - shape is (n_mels, time)
    mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(
        y=audio, sr=sr, n_mels=n_mels, n_fft=n_fft, 
        hop_length=hop_length, fmin=125.0, fmax=7500.0
    )
    
    # Convert to log scale (dB)
    mel_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel, ref=np.max)
    
    # mel_db shape is (n_mels, time) = (64, time)
    # Truncate/pad time axis to n_frames
    if mel_db.shape[1] < n_frames:
        mel_db = np.pad(mel_db, ((0, 0), (0, n_frames - mel_db.shape[1])))
    else:
        mel_db = mel_db[:, :n_frames]
    
    # Normalize to [0, 1] range
    mel_db = (mel_db - mel_db.min()) / (mel_db.max() - mel_db.min() + 1e-8)
    
    # Return shape (n_mels, n_frames) = (64, 96) - matches model input!
    return mel_db.astype(np.float32)

    return output_data.flatten()
