```ipynb
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Load Data (1 sample per question only!)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Load metadata and keep ONLY 1 sample per bucket\n",
    "print(\"Loading metadata...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "all_metadata = []\n",
    "for mf in sorted(AUDIO_DIR.glob('metadata_worker_*.json')):\n",
    "    with open(mf) as f:\n",
    "        all_metadata.extend(json.load(f))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Total samples: {len(all_metadata)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Keep only 1 sample per bucket (drastically reduces data)\n",
    "bucket_to_sample = {}\n",
    "for item in all_metadata:\n",
    "    bid = item['bucket_id']\n",
    "    if bid not in bucket_to_sample:\n",
    "        if Path(item['file']).exists():\n",
    "            bucket_to_sample[bid] = item\n",
    "\n",
    "metadata = list(bucket_to_sample.values())\n",
    "print(f\"Reduced to: {len(metadata)} samples (1 per question)\")\n",
    "print(f\"Reduction: {len(all_metadata)} -> {len(metadata)} ({100*len(metadata)/len(all_metadata):.1f}%)\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Extract Mel-Spectrograms"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import librosa\n",
    "import tensorflow as tf\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract_mel_spectrogram(audio_path):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Extract mel-spectrogram matching ESP32 format: (64, 96)\"\"\"\n",
    "    # Load audio\n",
    "    y, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=SAMPLE_RATE, mono=True)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Pad or trim to ~3 seconds (48000 samples)\n",
    "    target_len = SAMPLE_RATE * 3\n",
    "    if len(y) < target_len:\n",
    "        y = np.pad(y, (0, target_len - len(y)))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y = y[:target_len]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Extract mel-spectrogram\n",
    "    mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(\n",
    "        y=y, sr=sr,\n",
    "        n_mels=MEL_BINS,\n",
    "        n_fft=1024,\n",
    "        hop_length=512,\n",
    "        fmin=125,\n",
    "        fmax=7500\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Convert to log scale\n",
    "    mel_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel, ref=np.max)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Normalize to [0, 1]\n",
    "    mel_norm = (mel_db - mel_db.min()) / (mel_db.max() - mel_db.min() + 1e-8)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Pad/trim to exact frame count\n",
    "    if mel_norm.shape[1] < MEL_FRAMES:\n",
    "        mel_norm = np.pad(mel_norm, ((0,0), (0, MEL_FRAMES - mel_norm.shape[1])))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        mel_norm = mel_norm[:, :MEL_FRAMES]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return mel_norm.astype(np.float32)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Test\n",
    "test_mel = extract_mel_spectrogram(metadata[0]['file'])\n",
    "print(f\"Mel-spectrogram shape: {test_mel.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Value range: [{test_mel.min():.3f}, {test_mel.max():.3f}]\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Extract all mel-spectrograms (FAST - only ~1700 samples)\n",
    "print(f\"Extracting mel-spectrograms for {len(metadata)} samples...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "mel_spectrograms = []\n",
    "valid_metadata = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for item in tqdm(metadata):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        mel = extract_mel_spectrogram(item['file'])\n",
    "        mel_spectrograms.append(mel)\n",
    "        valid_metadata.append(item)\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        print(f\"Error: {item['file']}: {e}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "mel_spectrograms = np.array(mel_spectrograms)\n",
    "print(f\"\\nExtracted: {mel_spectrograms.shape}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Get Text Embeddings"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Loading text encoder...\")\n",
    "text_encoder = SentenceTransformer('sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get text embeddings for each audio sample\n",
    "texts = [item['text'] for item in valid_metadata]\n",
    "text_embeddings = text_encoder.encode(texts, show_progress_bar=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Text embeddings: {text_embeddings.shape}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. Build Simple Audio Encoder (for ESP32)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Simple CNN that runs on ESP32\n",
    "# Input: (64, 96, 1) mel-spectrogram\n",
    "# Output: 256-dim L2-normalized embedding\n",
    "\n",
    "audio_encoder = tf.keras.Sequential([\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(MEL_BINS, MEL_FRAMES, 1)),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Conv block 1: 64x96 -> 32x48\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Conv block 2: 32x48 -> 16x24  \n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Conv block 3: 16x24 -> 8x12\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Conv block 4: 8x12 -> 4x6\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Global average pooling -> 128\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D(),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Dense to embedding dim\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # L2 normalize\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))\n",
    "], name='audio_encoder')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Text projection (768 -> 256)\n",
    "text_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(768,)),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),\n",
    "    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))\n",
    "], name='text_projection')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Audio Encoder (runs on ESP32):\")\n",
    "audio_encoder.summary()\n",
    "print(f\"\\nText Projection:\")\n",
    "text_projection.summary()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 5. Train with Contrastive Loss"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Prepare data\n",
    "X_audio = mel_spectrograms[..., np.newaxis]  # Add channel dim\n",
    "X_text = text_embeddings\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Audio input: {X_audio.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Text input: {X_text.shape}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create dataset\n",
    "dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((X_audio, X_text))\n",
    "dataset = dataset.shuffle(len(X_audio)).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Batches per epoch: {len(X_audio) // BATCH_SIZE}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Contrastive loss\n",
    "def contrastive_loss(audio_emb, text_emb, temperature=TEMPERATURE):\n",
    "    logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / temperature\n",
    "    labels = tf.range(tf.shape(audio_emb)[0])\n",
    "    loss_a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)\n",
    "    loss_t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))\n",
    "    return tf.reduce_mean(loss_a + loss_t) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)\n",
    "all_vars = audio_encoder.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables\n",
    "\n",
    "@tf.function\n",
    "def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):\n",
    "    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:\n",
    "        audio_emb = audio_encoder(audio_batch, training=True)\n",
    "        text_emb = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)\n",
    "        loss = contrastive_loss(audio_emb, text_emb)\n",
    "    grads = tape.gradient(loss, all_vars)\n",
    "    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, all_vars))\n",
    "    return loss"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# FAST training loop\n",
    "print(f\"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs...\")\n",
    "print(f\"Expected time: ~{EPOCHS * len(X_audio) // BATCH_SIZE * 0.05 / 60:.1f} minutes\")\n",
    "\n",
    "history = []\n",
    "best_loss = float('inf')\n",
    "\n",
    "for epoch in range(EPOCHS):\n",
    "    epoch_losses = []\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for audio_batch, text_batch in dataset:\n",
    "        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)\n",
    "        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())\n",
    "    \n",
    "    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)\n",
    "    history.append(avg_loss)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if avg_loss < best_loss:\n",
    "        best_loss = avg_loss\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:\n",
    "        print(f\"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nTraining complete! Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Plot loss\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "plt.plot(history)\n",
    "plt.title('Training Loss')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Epoch')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Contrastive Loss')\n",
    "plt.grid(True)\n",
    "plt.savefig(str(MODEL_DIR / 'training_loss.png'))\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 6. Evaluate"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get embeddings\n",
    "audio_embs = audio_encoder.predict(X_audio)\n",
    "text_embs = text_projection.predict(X_text)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Similarity matrix\n",
    "sim_matrix = cosine_similarity(audio_embs, text_embs)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Accuracy: does audio match its own text?\n",
    "predictions = np.argmax(sim_matrix, axis=1)\n",
    "accuracy = np.mean(predictions == np.arange(len(predictions)))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Matching accuracy: {accuracy*100:.2f}%\")\n",
    "print(f\"Mean diagonal similarity: {np.mean(np.diag(sim_matrix)):.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Mean off-diagonal: {np.mean(sim_matrix[~np.eye(len(sim_matrix), dtype=bool)]):.3f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 7. Export for ESP32"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Save audio encoder as TFLite (for ESP32)\n",
    "print(\"Converting audio encoder to TFLite...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_keras_model(audio_encoder)\n",
    "converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]\n",
    "converter.target_spec.supported_types = [tf.int8]  # Full int8 quantization\n",
    "\n",
    "# Representative dataset for quantization\n",
    "def representative_dataset():\n",
    "    for i in range(min(100, len(X_audio))):\n",
    "        yield [X_audio[i:i+1].astype(np.float32)]\n",
    "\n",
    "converter.representative_dataset = representative_dataset\n",
    "converter.inference_input_type = tf.float32  # Keep float input for simplicity\n",
    "converter.inference_output_type = tf.float32\n",
    "\n",
    "tflite_model = converter.convert()\n",
    "\n",
    "tflite_path = MODEL_DIR / 'audio_encoder.tflite'\n",
    "with open(tflite_path, 'wb') as f:\n",
    "    f.write(tflite_model)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Saved: {tflite_path}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Size: {len(tflite_model) / 1024:.1f} KB\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Generate query embeddings (text -> 256-dim)\n",

   ]
  },
  {
```

```
import numpy as np
import json
import struct
import random
from tqdm import tqdm
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Paths
WORK_DIR = Path('/workspace') if Path('/workspace').exists() else Path('.').resolve()
AUDIO_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'audio_data'
MODEL_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'models'
DATA_DIR = WORK_DIR / 'data' / 'raw'
MODEL_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Audio specs (MUST match ESP32 code)
SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
MEL_BINS = 64
MEL_FRAMES = 96
EMBEDDING_DIM = 256

# Training (FAST settings)
BATCH_SIZE = 64
EPOCHS = 100  # Reduced from 5000!
LEARNING_RATE = 1e-3
TEMPERATURE = 0.1

print(f"Work dir: {WORK_DIR}")
print(f"Audio dir: {AUDIO_DIR}")
print(f"Mel-spectrogram: {MEL_BINS}x{MEL_FRAMES} -> {EMBEDDING_DIM}-dim")</cell id="cell-2">
<cell id="cell-3"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 1. Load Data (1 sample per question only!)</cell id="cell-3">

<cell id="cell-5"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 2. Extract Mel-Spectrograms</cell id="cell-5">
<cell id="cell-6">import librosa
import tensorflow as tf

def extract_mel_spectrogram(audio_path):
    """Extract mel-spectrogram matching ESP32 format: (64, 96)"""
    # Load audio
    y, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=SAMPLE_RATE, mono=True)
    
    # Pad or trim to ~3 seconds (48000 samples)
    target_len = SAMPLE_RATE * 3
    if len(y) < target_len:
        y = np.pad(y, (0, target_len - len(y)))
    else:
        y = y[:target_len]
    
    # Extract mel-spectrogram
    mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(
        y=y, sr=sr,
        n_mels=MEL_BINS,
        n_fft=1024,
        hop_length=512,
        fmin=125,
        fmax=7500
    )
    
    # Convert to log scale
    mel_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel, ref=np.max)
    
    # Normalize to [0, 1]
    mel_norm = (mel_db - mel_db.min()) / (mel_db.max() - mel_db.min() + 1e-8)
    
    # Pad/trim to exact frame count
    if mel_norm.shape[1] < MEL_FRAMES:
        mel_norm = np.pad(mel_norm, ((0,0), (0, MEL_FRAMES - mel_norm.shape[1])))
    else:
        mel_norm = mel_norm[:, :MEL_FRAMES]
    
    return mel_norm.astype(np.float32)

# Test
test_mel = extract_mel_spectrogram(metadata[0]['file'])
print(f"Mel-spectrogram shape: {test_mel.shape}")
print(f"Value range: [{test_mel.min():.3f}, {test_mel.max():.3f}]")</cell id="cell-6">
<cell id="cell-7"># Extract all mel-spectrograms (FAST - only ~1700 samples)

        valid_metadata.append(item)
    except Exception as e:

mel_spectrograms = np.array(mel_spectrograms)
print(f"\nExtracted: {mel_spectrograms.shape}")</cell id="cell-7">

<cell id="cell-10"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 4. Build Simple Audio Encoder (for ESP32)</cell id="cell-10">
<cell id="cell-11"># Simple CNN that runs on ESP32
# Input: (64, 96, 1) mel-spectrogram
# Output: 256-dim L2-normalized embedding

audio_encoder = tf.keras.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(MEL_BINS, MEL_FRAMES, 1)),
    
    # Conv block 1: 64x96 -> 32x48
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Conv block 2: 32x48 -> 16x24  
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Conv block 3: 16x24 -> 8x12
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Conv block 4: 8x12 -> 4x6
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Global average pooling -> 128
    tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D(),
    
    # Dense to embedding dim
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),
    
    # L2 normalize
    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))
], name='audio_encoder')

# Text projection (768 -> 256)
text_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(768,)),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),
    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))
], name='text_projection')

print("Audio Encoder (runs on ESP32):")
audio_encoder.summary()
print(f"\nText Projection:")
text_projection.summary()</cell id="cell-11">
<cell id="cell-12"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 5. Train with Contrastive Loss</cell id="cell-12">
<cell id="cell-13"># Prepare data
X_audio = mel_spectrograms[..., np.newaxis]  # Add channel dim
X_text = text_embeddings

print(f"Audio input: {X_audio.shape}")
print(f"Text input: {X_text.shape}")

# Create dataset
dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((X_audio, X_text))
dataset = dataset.shuffle(len(X_audio)).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

print(f"Batches per epoch: {len(X_audio) // BATCH_SIZE}")</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14"># Contrastive loss
def contrastive_loss(audio_emb, text_emb, temperature=TEMPERATURE):
    logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / temperature
    labels = tf.range(tf.shape(audio_emb)[0])
    loss_a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
    loss_t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))
    return tf.reduce_mean(loss_a + loss_t) / 2

optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
all_vars = audio_encoder.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        audio_emb = audio_encoder(audio_batch, training=True)
        text_emb = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)
        loss = contrastive_loss(audio_emb, text_emb)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, all_vars)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, all_vars))
    return loss</cell id="cell-14">
<cell id="cell-15"># FAST training loop
print(f"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs...")
print(f"Expected time: ~{EPOCHS * len(X_audio) // BATCH_SIZE * 0.05 / 60:.1f} minutes")

history = []
best_loss = float('inf')

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    epoch_losses = []
    
    for audio_batch, text_batch in dataset:
        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)
        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())
    
    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)
    history.append(avg_loss)
    
    if avg_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = avg_loss
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}")

print(f"\nTraining complete! Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}")</cell id="cell-15">
<cell id="cell-16"># Plot loss
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
plt.plot(history)
plt.title('Training Loss')
plt.xlabel('Epoch')
plt.ylabel('Contrastive Loss')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig(str(MODEL_DIR / 'training_loss.png'))
plt.show()</cell id="cell-16">
<cell id="cell-17"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 6. Evaluate</cell id="cell-17">
<cell id="cell-18">from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Get embeddings
audio_embs = audio_encoder.predict(X_audio)
text_embs = text_projection.predict(X_text)

# Similarity matrix
sim_matrix = cosine_similarity(audio_embs, text_embs)

# Accuracy: does audio match its own text?
predictions = np.argmax(sim_matrix, axis=1)
accuracy = np.mean(predictions == np.arange(len(predictions)))

print(f"Matching accuracy: {accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Mean diagonal similarity: {np.mean(np.diag(sim_matrix)):.3f}")
print(f"Mean off-diagonal: {np.mean(sim_matrix[~np.eye(len(sim_matrix), dtype=bool)]):.3f}")</cell id="cell-18">
<cell id="cell-19"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 7. Export for ESP32</cell id="cell-19">
<cell id="cell-20"># Save audio encoder as TFLite (for ESP32)
print("Converting audio encoder to TFLite...")

converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_keras_model(audio_encoder)
converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]
converter.target_spec.supported_types = [tf.int8]  # Full int8 quantization

# Representative dataset for quantization
def representative_dataset():
    for i in range(min(100, len(X_audio))):
        yield [X_audio[i:i+1].astype(np.float32)]

converter.representative_dataset = representative_dataset
converter.inference_input_type = tf.float32  # Keep float input for simplicity
converter.inference_output_type = tf.float32

tflite_model = converter.convert()

tflite_path = MODEL_DIR / 'audio_encoder.tflite'
with open(tflite_path, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(tflite_model)

print(f"Saved: {tflite_path}")
print(f"Size: {len(tflite_model) / 1024:.1f} KB")</cell id="cell-20">
```

**The problem:**
If we have a batch like:

- audio[1]: bucket_415, speaker 1 → text: "What is his birth month and year" (SAME TEXT!)

The contrastive loss with `labels = [0, 1]` will:
- Tell audio[0] to be similar to text[0] and dissimilar to text[1]
- Tell audio[1] to be similar to text[1] and dissimilar to text[0]

- audio[0] should be similar to "What is his birth month and year" (text[0])
- audio[0] should be dissimilar to "What is his birth month and year" (text[1])

The model can't satisfy both constraints, so the loss oscillates or increases.

Now I understand! Here's the issue:

## The Bug: Duplicate Texts in Contrastive Loss

**Your data structure (correct):**
```
bucket_415:
  - audio[0]: speaker 0, text = "What is his birth month and year"
  - audio[1]: speaker 1, text = "What is his birth month and year"  ← SAME TEXT
```

**Current training code (buggy):**
```python
# Creates text embedding for EACH audio sample
texts = [item['text'] for item in valid_metadata]  # Duplicates!
text_embeddings = text_encoder.encode(texts)  # [N_samples × 768]

# Contrastive loss assumes each sample is unique
labels = tf.range(batch_size)  # [0, 1, 2, ...]
# audio[0] → match text[0], push away from text[1]
# audio[1] → match text[1], push away from text[0]
```

**The contradiction:**
```
In a batch with audio[0] and audio[1] from same bucket:
- Loss tells audio[0]: "be similar to text[0], dissimilar to text[1]"
- Loss tells audio[1]: "be similar to text[1], dissimilar to text[0]"

But text[0] == text[1]! So:
- audio[0] should be SIMILAR to "What is his birth month..."
- audio[0] should be DISSIMILAR to "What is his birth month..." 

→ Impossible! Model gets conflicting gradients → loss goes UP
```

## The Fix

We need **one text embedding per unique bucket**, and map all audio samples from that bucket to the same target index:

```python
# CORRECT approach:
unique_texts = list(dict.fromkeys(texts))  # Deduplicate
text_embeddings = encode(unique_texts)     # [N_buckets × 768]

# Map each audio sample to its bucket's text index
bucket_to_idx = {text: i for i, text in enumerate(unique_texts)}
labels = [bucket_to_idx[item['text']] for item in valid_metadata]

# Now in batch:
# audio[0] from bucket_415 → label = 42
# audio[1] from bucket_415 → label = 42  ← SAME! Correct!
```

This way, both audio samples from the same question learn to map to the **same** text embedding, which is what we want.

```
Updated cell undefined with # Project ALL text embeddings once (not per batch)
# This creates the target embedding space
X_text_768 = tf.constant(X_text_full, dtype=tf.float32)

# Contrastive loss with proper labels
# audio_emb: [batch, 256] - audio embeddings
# labels: [batch] - index of correct text for each audio
# all_text_emb: [num_texts, 256] - all projected text embeddings
def contrastive_loss(audio_emb, labels, all_text_emb, temperature=TEMPERATURE):
    # Compute similarity of each audio to ALL texts
    logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, all_text_emb, transpose_b=True) / temperature  # [batch, num_texts]
    
    # Cross-entropy loss: each audio should match its labeled text
    loss = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
    return tf.reduce_mean(loss)

optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
all_vars = audio_encoder.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, label_batch, all_text_768):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        # Project text embeddings (done every step to update text_projection weights)
        all_text_emb = text_projection(all_text_768, training=True)  # [num_texts, 256]
        
        # Get audio embeddings for this batch
        audio_emb = audio_encoder(audio_batch, training=True)  # [batch, 256]
        
        # Compute loss
        loss = contrastive_loss(audio_emb, label_batch, all_text_emb)
    
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, all_vars)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, all_vars))
    return loss

print(f"Text embeddings shape: {X_text_768.shape}")
print(f"Each audio will be compared against {len(unique_texts)} possible texts")
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-5-20251101)**_

Great question! Here's a practical guide:

## Loss Targets

With ~1,680 unique questions, the cross-entropy loss behaves like this:

| Loss | Meaning | Top-1 Accuracy | Demo Quality |
|------|---------|----------------|--------------|
| **7.4** | Random guessing (`log(1680)`) | ~0.06% | ❌ Broken |
| **5.0** | Model starting to learn | ~1-5% | ❌ Not usable |
| **3.0** | Learning but confused | ~20-40% | ⚠️ Frustrating |
| **2.0** | Decent | ~50-70% | ✅ Demo-able |
| **1.5** | Good | ~70-85% | ✅ Good demo |
| **1.0** | Very good | ~85-95% | ✅ Solid |
| **< 0.5** | Excellent | ~95%+ | ✅ Production ready |

## For Your Badge Demo

**Target: Loss ≤ 2.0** (ideally < 1.5)

Why this is enough:
1. **Top-5 matters more** - If correct answer is in top 5 matches, similarity scores will be close, and LLM handles the rest
2. **Threshold filters bad matches** - Your `embed_threshold: 0.7` rejects low-confidence matches
3. **Similar questions = similar answers** - "What is OAISYS?" and "Tell me about OAISYS" should have similar embeddings anyway

## Quick Check During Training

```
Epoch 10:  Loss ~5.0  → Still warming up
Epoch 30:  Loss ~3.0  → Learning
Epoch 50:  Loss ~2.0  → Getting useful ✓
Epoch 80:  Loss ~1.5  → Good for demo ✓
Epoch 100: Loss ~1.0  → Great ✓
```

If loss plateaus above 3.0, something's wrong. If it drops below 2.0 by epoch 50-60, you're on track.

**Bottom line: Stop when loss < 2.0 and you'll have a demo-able model.**

```
<cell id="cell-3"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 1. Load Data (2 samples per question for voice diversity)</cell id="cell-3">
<cell id="cell-4"># Load metadata and keep 2 samples per bucket (male + female voice diversity)
print("Loading metadata...")

SAMPLES_PER_QUESTION = 2  # For voice diversity (male + female)

all_metadata = []
for mf in sorted(AUDIO_DIR.glob('metadata_worker_*.json')):
    with open(mf) as f:
        all_metadata.extend(json.load(f))

print(f"Total samples: {len(all_metadata)}")

# Group samples by bucket
from collections import defaultdict
bucket_samples = defaultdict(list)
for item in all_metadata:
    if Path(item['file']).exists():
        bucket_samples[item['bucket_id']].append(item)

# Select up to SAMPLES_PER_QUESTION per bucket
# Try to pick diverse samples (different files = different voices)
metadata = []
for bid, samples in bucket_samples.items():
    # Shuffle to get random voice selection
    random.shuffle(samples)
    # Take up to N samples
    for sample in samples[:SAMPLES_PER_QUESTION]:
        metadata.append(sample)

<cell id="cell-5"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 2. Extract Mel-Spectrograms</cell id="cell-5">
<cell id="cell-6">import librosa
import tensorflow as tf

def extract_mel_spectrogram(audio_path):
    """Extract mel-spectrogram matching ESP32 format: (64, 96)"""
    # Load audio
    y, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=SAMPLE_RATE, mono=True)
    
    # Pad or trim to ~3 seconds (48000 samples)
    target_len = SAMPLE_RATE * 3
    if len(y) < target_len:
        y = np.pad(y, (0, target_len - len(y)))
    else:
        y = y[:target_len]
    
    # Extract mel-spectrogram
    mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(
        y=y, sr=sr,
        n_mels=MEL_BINS,
        n_fft=1024,
        hop_length=512,
        fmin=125,
        fmax=7500
    )
    
    # Convert to log scale
    mel_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel, ref=np.max)
    
    # Normalize to [0, 1]
    mel_norm = (mel_db - mel_db.min()) / (mel_db.max() - mel_db.min() + 1e-8)
    
    # Pad/trim to exact frame count
    if mel_norm.shape[1] < MEL_FRAMES:
        mel_norm = np.pad(mel_norm, ((0,0), (0, MEL_FRAMES - mel_norm.shape[1])))
    else:
        mel_norm = mel_norm[:, :MEL_FRAMES]
    
    return mel_norm.astype(np.float32)

# Test
test_mel = extract_mel_spectrogram(metadata[0]['file'])
print(f"Mel-spectrogram shape: {test_mel.shape}")
print(f"Value range: [{test_mel.min():.3f}, {test_mel.max():.3f}]")</cell id="cell-6">

<cell id="cell-10"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 4. Build Simple Audio Encoder (for ESP32)</cell id="cell-10">
<cell id="cell-11"># Simple CNN that runs on ESP32
# Input: (64, 96, 1) mel-spectrogram
# Output: 256-dim L2-normalized embedding

audio_encoder = tf.keras.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(MEL_BINS, MEL_FRAMES, 1)),
    
    # Conv block 1: 64x96 -> 32x48
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Conv block 2: 32x48 -> 16x24  
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Conv block 3: 16x24 -> 8x12
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Conv block 4: 8x12 -> 4x6
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2),
    
    # Global average pooling -> 128
    tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D(),
    
    # Dense to embedding dim
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),
    
    # L2 normalize
    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))
], name='audio_encoder')

# Text projection (768 -> 256)
text_projection = tf.keras.Sequential([
    tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(768,)),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(EMBEDDING_DIM),
    tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1))
], name='text_projection')

print("Audio Encoder (runs on ESP32):")
audio_encoder.summary()
print(f"\nText Projection:")
text_projection.summary()</cell id="cell-11">

<cell id="cell-12"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 5. Train with Contrastive Loss</cell id="cell-12">
<cell id="cell-13"># Prepare data
X_audio = mel_spectrograms[..., np.newaxis]  # Add channel dim
X_labels = sample_labels  # Index into text_embeddings for each audio sample

# Project text embeddings to 256-dim (will be done by text_projection model)
# For now, just store the 768-dim embeddings
X_text_full = text_embeddings  # [num_unique_texts, 768]

print(f"Audio input: {X_audio.shape}")
print(f"Labels: {X_labels.shape} (range: {X_labels.min()}-{X_labels.max()})")
print(f"Unique text embeddings: {X_text_full.shape}")

# Create dataset with (audio, label) pairs
dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((X_audio, X_labels))
dataset = dataset.shuffle(len(X_audio)).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

print(f"Batches per epoch: {len(X_audio) // BATCH_SIZE}")</cell id="cell-13">

Audio input: (3360, 64, 96, 1)
Labels: (3360,) (range: 0-1791)
Unique text embeddings: (1792, 768)
Batches per epoch: 52

<cell id="cell-14"># Project ALL text embeddings once (not per batch)
# This creates the target embedding space
X_text_768 = tf.constant(X_text_full, dtype=tf.float32)

# Contrastive loss with proper labels
# audio_emb: [batch, 256] - audio embeddings
# labels: [batch] - index of correct text for each audio
# all_text_emb: [num_texts, 256] - all projected text embeddings
def contrastive_loss(audio_emb, labels, all_text_emb, temperature=TEMPERATURE):
    # Compute similarity of each audio to ALL texts
    logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, all_text_emb, transpose_b=True) / temperature  # [batch, num_texts]
    
    # Cross-entropy loss: each audio should match its labeled text
    loss = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
    return tf.reduce_mean(loss)

optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
all_vars = audio_encoder.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, label_batch, all_text_768):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        # Project text embeddings (done every step to update text_projection weights)
        all_text_emb = text_projection(all_text_768, training=True)  # [num_texts, 256]
        
        # Get audio embeddings for this batch
        audio_emb = audio_encoder(audio_batch, training=True)  # [batch, 256]
        
        # Compute loss
        loss = contrastive_loss(audio_emb, label_batch, all_text_emb)
    
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, all_vars)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, all_vars))
    return loss

print(f"Text embeddings shape: {X_text_768.shape}")
print(f"Each audio will be compared against {len(unique_texts)} possible texts")</cell id="cell-14">

Text embeddings shape: (1792, 768)
Each audio will be compared against 1792 possible texts

<cell id="cell-15"># FAST training loop
print(f"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs...")
print(f"Samples: {len(X_audio)}, Unique texts: {len(unique_texts)}")
print(f"Expected time: ~{EPOCHS * len(X_audio) // BATCH_SIZE * 0.1 / 60:.1f} minutes")

history = []
best_loss = float('inf')

for epoch in range(200):
    epoch_losses = []
    
    for audio_batch, label_batch in dataset:
        loss = train_step(audio_batch, label_batch, X_text_768)
        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())
    
    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)
    history.append(avg_loss)
    
    if avg_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = avg_loss
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}")

print(f"\nTraining complete! Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}")</cell id="cell-15">

<cell id="cell-17"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 6. Evaluate</cell id="cell-17">
<cell id="cell-18">from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Get embeddings
audio_embs = audio_encoder.predict(X_audio)  # [num_samples, 256]
text_embs = text_projection.predict(X_text_full)  # [num_unique_texts, 256]

print(f"Audio embeddings: {audio_embs.shape}")
print(f"Text embeddings: {text_embs.shape}")

# Similarity: each audio vs all texts
sim_matrix = cosine_similarity(audio_embs, text_embs)  # [num_samples, num_unique_texts]

# Accuracy: does each audio's top match equal its true label?
predictions = np.argmax(sim_matrix, axis=1)
accuracy = np.mean(predictions == X_labels)

# Top-5 accuracy
top5_preds = np.argsort(sim_matrix, axis=1)[:, -5:]
top5_acc = np.mean([X_labels[i] in top5_preds[i] for i in range(len(X_labels))])

print(f"\nTop-1 accuracy: {accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Top-5 accuracy: {top5_acc*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Mean similarity (correct pairs): {np.mean([sim_matrix[i, X_labels[i]] for i in range(len(X_labels))]):.3f}")
print(f"Mean similarity (wrong pairs): {np.mean(sim_matrix) - np.mean([sim_matrix[i, X_labels[i]] for i in range(len(X_labels))]) / len(unique_texts):.3f}")</cell id="cell-18">

<cell id="cell-20"># Save audio encoder as TFLite (for ESP32)

# Representative dataset for quantization
def representative_dataset():

        yield [X_audio[i:i+1].astype(np.float32)]

converter.inference_input_type = tf.float32  # Keep float input for simplicity
converter.inference_output_type = tf.float32

tflite_model = converter.convert()

tflite_path = MODEL_DIR / 'audio_encoder.tflite'
```

     ```cpp
     struct RuntimeConfig {
         float wakeWordThreshold = DEFAULT_WAKE_THRESHOLD;
         float embedThreshold = DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD;
         float llmTemperature = DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE;
         float llmTopP = DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP;
         int llmMaxTokens = 128;
         unsigned long idleSleepMs = IDLE_SLEEP_MS;
         int recordDurationMs = RECORD_DURATION_MS;
     } runtimeConfig;

     bool loadConfig() {
         File f = SD.open(CONFIG_PATH);
         if (!f) { return false; }
         StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
         DeserializationError error = deserializeJson(doc, f);
         f.close();
         if (error) { return false; }
         runtimeConfig.embedThreshold = doc["embed_threshold"] | DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD;
         runtimeConfig.llmTemperature = doc["llm_temperature"] | DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE;
         // ... etc
         return true;
     }
     ```

     ```python
     # Get UNIQUE texts only (one per bucket, not per audio sample!)

     sample_labels = np.array([text_to_idx[item['text']] for item in valid_metadata])
     
     # Contrastive loss with proper labels
     def contrastive_loss(audio_emb, labels, all_text_emb, temperature=TEMPERATURE):
         logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, all_text_emb, transpose_b=True) / temperature
         loss = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
         return tf.reduce_mean(loss)
     ```

```
   119→    runtimeConfig.embedThreshold = doc["embed_threshold"] | DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD;

   121→    runtimeConfig.llmTopP = doc["llm_topp"] | DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP;

   148→
   149→void setState(BadgeState newState) {
   150→    if (currentState == newState) return;
   151→
   152→    Serial.printf("State: %d -> %d\n", currentState, newState);
   153→
   154→    // Exit current state
   155→    switch (currentState) {
   156→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   157→            // Stop wake word detection and mic stream

   164→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   165→            video.hideText();
   166→            break;
   167→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   168→            recorder.stopRecording();
   169→            break;
   170→        default:
   171→            break;
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    currentState = newState;
   175→    lastActivityTime = millis();

   177→    // Enter new state
   178→    switch (newState) {

   180→            video.resume();

   182→            if (mlPool) {

   185→                        wakeWordActive = true;
   186→                        Serial.printf("Listening for \"%s\"...\n", wakeWord.getWakeWord());
   187→                        // Refresh display after SD card access (wake word model loading)
   188→                        video.refreshDisplay();
   189→                    } else {
   190→                        Serial.println("Wake word init failed");
   191→                        micStream.end();
   192→                    }
   193→                } else {
   194→                    Serial.println("Mic stream init failed");
   195→                }
   196→            }
   197→            break;
   198→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   199→            video.pause();
   200→            video.refreshDisplay();  // Ensure display works after any SD access
   201→            // Fill screen RED to indicate recording (text overlay TBD)
   202→            video.fillScreen(0xF800);  // RED in RGB565
   203→            recorder.startRecording(runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs / 1000.0f);
   204→            break;
   205→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   206→            video.pause();
   207→            video.refreshDisplay();  // Ensure display works
   208→            // Fill screen GREEN to indicate done (text overlay TBD)
   209→            video.fillScreen(0x07E0);  // GREEN in RGB565
   210→            break;
   211→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   212→            video.pause();
   213→            video.refreshDisplay();
   214→            // Fill screen YELLOW to indicate processing
   215→            video.fillScreen(0xFFE0);  // YELLOW in RGB565
   216→            video.showText("Processing...");
   217→            // Load audio encoder model
   218→            if (!audioEmbed.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, AUDIO_ENCODER_PATH)) {
   219→                Serial.println("Audio encoder init failed - returning to logo");
   220→                setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   221→            }
   222→            break;
   223→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   224→            // Audio encoder unloaded, search against embeddings
   225→            audioEmbed.end();
   226→            video.showText("Searching...");
   227→            break;
   228→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   229→            video.pause();
   230→            video.refreshDisplay();
   231→            video.fillScreen(0xF800);  // RED
   232→            video.showText("Sorry, I couldn't\nunderstand that.");

   236→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:

   239→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK

   244→            ttsSpeaking = true;

   246→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:

   251→            video.showText("");  // Initialize empty text box
   252→            llmResponse = "";

   276→
   277→//==============================================================================
   278→// State Handlers
   279→//==============================================================================
   280→
   281→void handleLogoLoop() {
   282→    // Update orientation
   283→    orientation.update();
   284→    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
   285→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    // Play video frame
   289→    video.play();
   290→
   291→    // Check wake word if active
   292→    if (wakeWordActive) {
   293→        if (micStream.update()) {
   294→            // New features available, run wake word detection
   295→            if (wakeWord.detect(micStream.getFeatures())) {
   296→                Serial.println(">>> WAKE WORD DETECTED! <<<");
   297→                setState(STATE_RECORDING);
   298→            }
   299→        }
   300→    }
   301→}
   302→
   303→void handleRecording() {
   304→    // Update recording
   305→    if (recorder.update()) {
   306→        // Recording complete
   307→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   308→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());
   309→
   310→        // Phase 3: Extract embedding from recording
   311→        setState(STATE_EMBEDDING);
   312→    }
   313→}
   314→
   315→void handleEmbedding() {
   316→    // Run audio embedding extraction (blocking operation)
   317→    if (audioEmbed.embed(recorder.getBuffer(), recorder.getSampleCount(), queryEmbedding)) {
   318→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");
   319→        setState(STATE_SIMILARITY);
   320→    } else {
   321→        Serial.println("Embedding extraction failed");
   322→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   323→    }
   324→}
   325→
   326→void handleSimilarity() {
   327→    // Search for closest embedding
   328→    lastSearchResult = embedSearch.search(queryEmbedding);
   329→
   330→    Serial.printf("Best match: %s (score: %.3f)\n",
   331→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);
   332→
   333→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= runtimeConfig.embedThreshold) {
   334→        // Good match - run LLM inference
   335→        Serial.println("High confidence match!");
   336→        setState(STATE_LLM_INFERENCE);
   337→    } else {
   338→        // Low confidence - stash and apologize
   339→        Serial.println("Low confidence - stashing");
   340→        // TODO Phase 8: stash audio and embedding
   341→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   342→    }
   343→}
   344→
   345→void handleLLMInference() {
   346→    if (!llmGenerating) {
   347→        // Generation done - shouldn't normally get here as we transition immediately
   348→        setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   349→        return;
   350→    }
   351→
   352→    // Run LLM generation (blocking, but streams tokens via callback)
   353→    Serial.printf("\nLLM generating response for: %s\n", lastSearchResult.intent);
   354→    int tokensGenerated = llmInference.generate(lastSearchResult.intent, onLLMToken, nullptr);
   355→    Serial.printf("\nLLM done: %d tokens\n", tokensGenerated);
   356→
   357→    llmGenerating = false;
   358→
   359→    // Unload LLM to free memory
   360→    llmInference.end();
   361→
   362→    // If no tokens generated, use the intent as fallback
   363→    if (tokensGenerated == 0 && llmResponse.length() == 0) {
   364→        llmResponse = lastSearchResult.intent;
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    // Transition to TTS to speak the response
   368→    setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   369→}
   370→
   371→void handleDisplayResponse() {

   373→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 3000) {

   378→void handleTtsSorry() {

   386→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo

   392→void handleTtsOutput() {

   408→//==============================================================================

   412→void loop() {

   461→//==============================================================================

   465→void setup() {
```

```
   101→bool loadConfig() {
   102→    File f = SD.open(CONFIG_PATH);
   103→    if (!f) {

   105→        return false;
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
   109→    DeserializationError error = deserializeJson(doc, f);
   110→    f.close();
   111→
   112→    if (error) {
   113→        Serial.printf("Config: Parse error - %s\n", error.c_str());
   114→        return false;
   115→    }
   116→
   117→    // Load values with defaults as fallback
   118→    runtimeConfig.wakeWordThreshold = doc["wake_word_threshold"] | DEFAULT_WAKE_THRESHOLD;
   119→    runtimeConfig.embedThreshold = doc["embed_threshold"] | DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD;
   120→    runtimeConfig.llmTemperature = doc["llm_temperature"] | DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE;
   121→    runtimeConfig.llmTopP = doc["llm_topp"] | DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP;
   122→    runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens = doc["llm_max_tokens"] | 128;
   123→    runtimeConfig.idleSleepMs = doc["idle_sleep_ms"] | IDLE_SLEEP_MS;
   124→    runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs = doc["record_duration_ms"] | RECORD_DURATION_MS;
   125→
   126→    Serial.println("Config: Loaded from SD card");
   127→    Serial.printf("  embed_threshold: %.2f\n", runtimeConfig.embedThreshold);
   128→    Serial.printf("  llm_temperature: %.2f\n", runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   129→    Serial.printf("  llm_max_tokens: %d\n", runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   130→
   131→    return true;
   132→}

   145→//==============================================================================

   148→
   149→void setState(BadgeState newState) {
   150→    if (currentState == newState) return;
   151→
   152→    Serial.printf("State: %d -> %d\n", currentState, newState);
   153→
   154→    // Exit current state
   155→    switch (currentState) {
   156→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   157→            // Stop wake word detection and mic stream
   158→            if (wakeWordActive) {
   159→                wakeWord.end();
   160→                micStream.end();
   161→                wakeWordActive = false;
   162→            }
   163→            break;
   164→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   165→            video.hideText();
   166→            break;
   167→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   168→            recorder.stopRecording();
   169→            break;
   170→        default:
   171→            break;
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    currentState = newState;
   175→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   176→
   177→    // Enter new state
   178→    switch (newState) {
   179→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   180→            video.resume();
   181→            // Start wake word detection
   182→            if (mlPool) {
   183→                if (micStream.begin()) {
   184→                    if (wakeWord.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, WAKE_MODEL_PATH, WAKE_CONFIG_PATH)) {
   185→                        wakeWordActive = true;
   186→                        Serial.printf("Listening for \"%s\"...\n", wakeWord.getWakeWord());
   187→                        // Refresh display after SD card access (wake word model loading)
   188→                        video.refreshDisplay();
   189→                    } else {
   190→                        Serial.println("Wake word init failed");
   191→                        micStream.end();
   192→                    }
   193→                } else {
   194→                    Serial.println("Mic stream init failed");
   195→                }
   196→            }
   197→            break;
   198→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   199→            video.pause();
   200→            video.refreshDisplay();  // Ensure display works after any SD access
   201→            // Fill screen RED to indicate recording (text overlay TBD)
   202→            video.fillScreen(0xF800);  // RED in RGB565
   203→            recorder.startRecording(runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs / 1000.0f);
   204→            break;
   205→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   206→            video.pause();
   207→            video.refreshDisplay();  // Ensure display works
   208→            // Fill screen GREEN to indicate done (text overlay TBD)
   209→            video.fillScreen(0x07E0);  // GREEN in RGB565
   210→            break;
   211→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   212→            video.pause();
   213→            video.refreshDisplay();
   214→            // Fill screen YELLOW to indicate processing
   215→            video.fillScreen(0xFFE0);  // YELLOW in RGB565
   216→            video.showText("Processing...");
   217→            // Load audio encoder model
   218→            if (!audioEmbed.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, AUDIO_ENCODER_PATH)) {
   219→                Serial.println("Audio encoder init failed - returning to logo");
   220→                setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   221→            }
   222→            break;
   223→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   224→            // Audio encoder unloaded, search against embeddings
   225→            audioEmbed.end();
   226→            video.showText("Searching...");
   227→            break;
   228→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   229→            video.pause();
   230→            video.refreshDisplay();
   231→            video.fillScreen(0xF800);  // RED
   232→            video.showText("Sorry, I couldn't\nunderstand that.");
   233→            // Speak apology
   234→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   235→            break;
   236→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   237→            video.pause();
   238→            video.refreshDisplay();
   239→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK
   240→            // Show the response text while speaking
   241→            if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   242→                video.showText(llmResponse.c_str());
   243→            }
   244→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   245→            break;
   246→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   247→            video.pause();
   248→            video.refreshDisplay();
   249→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK
   250→            video.clearText();
   251→            video.showText("");  // Initialize empty text box
   252→            llmResponse = "";
   253→            llmGenerating = true;
   254→            // Load LLM model
   255→            Serial.println("Loading LLM model...");
   256→            if (!llmInference.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, LLM_MODEL_PATH, TOKENIZER_PATH)) {
   257→                Serial.println("LLM init failed - showing intent only");
   258→                video.showText(lastSearchResult.intent);
   259→                llmGenerating = false;
   260→                setState(STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE);
   261→            } else {
   262→                // Apply runtime config
   263→                llmInference.setTemperature(runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   264→                llmInference.setTopP(runtimeConfig.llmTopP);
   265→                llmInference.setMaxTokens(runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   266→            }
   267→            break;
   268→        default:
   269→            break;
   270→    }
   271→}

   276→
   277→//==============================================================================
   278→// State Handlers
   279→//==============================================================================
   280→
   281→void handleLogoLoop() {
   282→    // Update orientation
   283→    orientation.update();
   284→    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
   285→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    // Play video frame
   289→    video.play();
   290→
   291→    // Check wake word if active
   292→    if (wakeWordActive) {
   293→        if (micStream.update()) {
   294→            // New features available, run wake word detection
   295→            if (wakeWord.detect(micStream.getFeatures())) {
   296→                Serial.println(">>> WAKE WORD DETECTED! <<<");
   297→                setState(STATE_RECORDING);
   298→            }
   299→        }
   300→    }
   301→}
   302→
   303→void handleRecording() {
   304→    // Update recording
   305→    if (recorder.update()) {
   306→        // Recording complete
   307→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   308→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());
   309→
   310→        // Phase 3: Extract embedding from recording
   311→        setState(STATE_EMBEDDING);
   312→    }
   313→}
   314→
   315→void handleEmbedding() {
   316→    // Run audio embedding extraction (blocking operation)
   317→    if (audioEmbed.embed(recorder.getBuffer(), recorder.getSampleCount(), queryEmbedding)) {
   318→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");
   319→        setState(STATE_SIMILARITY);
   320→    } else {
   321→        Serial.println("Embedding extraction failed");
   322→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   323→    }
   324→}
   325→
   326→void handleSimilarity() {
   327→    // Search for closest embedding
   328→    lastSearchResult = embedSearch.search(queryEmbedding);
   329→
   330→    Serial.printf("Best match: %s (score: %.3f)\n",
   331→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);
   332→
   333→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= runtimeConfig.embedThreshold) {
   334→        // Good match - run LLM inference
   335→        Serial.println("High confidence match!");
   336→        setState(STATE_LLM_INFERENCE);
   337→    } else {
   338→        // Low confidence - stash and apologize
   339→        Serial.println("Low confidence - stashing");
   340→        // TODO Phase 8: stash audio and embedding
   341→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   342→    }
   343→}
   344→
   345→void handleLLMInference() {
   346→    if (!llmGenerating) {
   347→        // Generation done - shouldn't normally get here as we transition immediately
   348→        setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   349→        return;
   350→    }
   351→
   352→    // Run LLM generation (blocking, but streams tokens via callback)
   353→    Serial.printf("\nLLM generating response for: %s\n", lastSearchResult.intent);
   354→    int tokensGenerated = llmInference.generate(lastSearchResult.intent, onLLMToken, nullptr);
   355→    Serial.printf("\nLLM done: %d tokens\n", tokensGenerated);
   356→
   357→    llmGenerating = false;
   358→
   359→    // Unload LLM to free memory
   360→    llmInference.end();
   361→
   362→    // If no tokens generated, use the intent as fallback
   363→    if (tokensGenerated == 0 && llmResponse.length() == 0) {
   364→        llmResponse = lastSearchResult.intent;
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    // Transition to TTS to speak the response
   368→    setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   369→}
   370→
   371→void handleDisplayResponse() {
   372→    // Auto-return to logo loop after 3 seconds
   373→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 3000) {
   374→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   375→    }
   376→}
   377→
   378→void handleTtsSorry() {
   379→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   380→        // Speak apology (blocking)
   381→        tts.speak("Sorry, I could not understand that.");

   383→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   384→    }
   385→
   386→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo

   389→    }
   390→}
   391→
   392→void handleTtsOutput() {

   394→        // Speak the LLM response (blocking)

   398→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   399→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   400→    }
   401→
   402→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   403→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   404→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   405→    }
   406→}
   407→
   408→//==============================================================================
   409→// Main Loop State Machine
   410→//==============================================================================
   411→
   412→void loop() {
   413→    // State-specific handling
   414→    switch (currentState) {
   415→        case STATE_BOOT:
   416→            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop
   417→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   418→            break;
   419→
   420→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   421→            handleLogoLoop();

   423→
   424→        case STATE_RECORDING:

   427→
   428→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:

   431→
   432→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   433→            handleEmbedding();

   435→
   436→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   437→            handleSimilarity();

   439→
   440→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:

   442→            break;
   443→
   444→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:

   447→
   448→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:

   451→
   452→        // Future states (Phase 6+)
   453→        case STATE_STASH_DATA:

   458→    }
   459→}

   464→

   482→        // Blink LED to indicate error
   483→        pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);

   487→        }
   488→    }
   489→    Serial.println("Video: OK");

   491→    // Load runtime configuration from SD card
   492→    loadConfig();

   494→    // Allocate ML memory pool (after video to avoid fragmentation)
   495→    if (!initMemoryPool()) {

   498→
   499→    // Initialize audio recorder (allocates PSRAM buffer)
   500→    if (!recorder.begin()) {

   502→    } else {
   503→        Serial.println("Recorder: OK");
   504→    }
   505→
   506→    // Phase 3: Allocate query embedding buffer
   507→    queryEmbedding = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float));
   508→    if (!queryEmbedding) {
   509→        Serial.println("WARNING: Query embedding buffer alloc failed!");
   510→    } else {
   511→        Serial.println("Query buffer: OK");
   512→    }
   513→
   514→    // Phase 3: Load embedding search database (stays in memory)
   515→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   516→        Serial.println("WARNING: Embedding search init failed!");
   517→        Serial.println("  Make sure SD card has /data/embeddings.bin and /data/intents.txt");
   518→    } else {

   520→    }
   521→
   522→    // Phase 5: Initialize TTS (non-fatal if fails)
   523→    if (!tts.begin()) {
   524→        Serial.println("WARNING: TTS init failed - speech disabled");
   525→    } else {
   526→        Serial.println("TTS: OK (SAM robotic voice)");
   527→        // Say hello on startup
   528→        tts.speak("Hello. I am ready.");
   529→    }
   530→
   531→    // Ready to go
   532→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   533→    currentState = STATE_BOOT;
   534→
```

```
     1→/*******************************************************************************
```
```
     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Video Player Implementation
     3→ ******************************************************************************/
     4→
     5→#include "video_player.h"
     6→#include "../../config.h"
     7→
     8→#include <SD.h>
     9→#include <SPI.h>
    10→#include <Arduino_GFX_Library.h>
    11→#include <JPEGDEC.h>
    12→
    13→// Include MjpegClass inline to avoid separate header management
    14→#define READ_BUFFER_SIZE 1024
    15→
    16→class MjpegClass {
    17→public:
    18→    bool setup(Stream *input, uint8_t *mjpeg_buf, JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *pfnDraw,
    19→               bool useBigEndian, int x, int y, int widthLimit, int heightLimit) {
    20→        _input = input;
    21→        _mjpeg_buf = mjpeg_buf;
    22→        _pfnDraw = pfnDraw;
    23→        _useBigEndian = useBigEndian;
    24→        _x = x;
    25→        _y = y;
    26→        _widthLimit = widthLimit;
    27→        _heightLimit = heightLimit;
    28→        _inputindex = 0;
    29→
    30→        if (!_read_buf) {
    31→            _read_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    32→        }
    33→        return _read_buf != nullptr;
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    bool readMjpegBuf() {
    37→        if (_inputindex == 0) {
    38→            _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    39→            _inputindex += _buf_read;
    40→        }
    41→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    42→        int i = 0;
    43→        bool found_FFD8 = false;
    44→
    45→        while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    46→            i = 0;
    47→            while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    48→                if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
    49→                    found_FFD8 = true;
    50→                }
    51→                ++i;
    52→            }
    53→            if (found_FFD8) {
    54→                --i;
    55→            } else {
    56→                _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    57→            }
    58→        }
    59→
    60→        uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
    61→        _buf_read -= i;
    62→        bool found_FFD9 = false;
    63→
    64→        if (_buf_read > 0) {
    65→            i = 3;
    66→            while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    67→                if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
    68→                    found_FFD9 = true;
    69→                } else {
    70→                    while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    71→                        if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
    72→                            found_FFD9 = true;
    73→                            ++i;
    74→                        }
    75→                        ++i;
    76→                    }
    77→                }
    78→
    79→                memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
    80→                _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
    81→                size_t o = _buf_read - i;
    82→
    83→                if (o > 0) {
    84→                    memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
    85→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
    86→                    _p = _read_buf;
    87→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    88→                    _buf_read += o;
    89→                } else {
    90→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    91→                    _p = _read_buf;
    92→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    93→                }
    94→                i = 0;
    95→            }
    96→            return found_FFD9;
    97→        }
    98→        return false;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    bool drawJpg() {
   102→        _remain = _mjpeg_buf_offset;
   103→
   104→        if (_jpeg.openRAM(_mjpeg_buf, _remain, _pfnDraw) != 1) return false;
   105→
   106→        if (_scale == -1) {
   107→            int iMaxMCUs;
   108→            int w = _jpeg.getWidth();
   109→            int h = _jpeg.getHeight();
   110→            float ratio = (float)h / _heightLimit;
   111→
   112→            if (ratio <= 1) {
   113→                _scale = 0;
   114→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 16;
   115→            } else if (ratio <= 2) {
   116→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_HALF;
   117→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 8;
   118→                w /= 2;
   119→                h /= 2;
   120→            } else if (ratio <= 4) {
   121→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_QUARTER;
   122→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 4;
   123→                w /= 4;
   124→                h /= 4;
   125→            } else {
   126→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_EIGHTH;
   127→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 2;
   128→                w /= 8;
   129→                h /= 8;
   130→            }
   131→
   132→            _jpeg.setMaxOutputSize(iMaxMCUs);
   133→            _x = (w > _widthLimit) ? 0 : ((_widthLimit - w) / 2);
   134→            _y = (_heightLimit - h) / 2;
   135→        }
   136→
   137→        if (_useBigEndian) {
   138→            _jpeg.setPixelType(RGB565_BIG_ENDIAN);
   139→        }
   140→
   141→        if (_jpeg.decode(_x, _y, _scale) != 1) {
   142→            _jpeg.close();
   143→            return false;
   144→        }
   145→
   146→        _jpeg.close();
   147→        return true;
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    void reset() {
   151→        _inputindex = 0;
   152→        _buf_read = 0;
   153→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   154→    }
   155→
   156→private:
   157→    Stream *_input;
   158→    uint8_t *_mjpeg_buf;
   159→    JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *_pfnDraw;
   160→    bool _useBigEndian;
   161→    int _x, _y, _widthLimit, _heightLimit;
   162→    uint8_t *_read_buf = nullptr;
   163→    int32_t _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   164→    JPEGDEC _jpeg;
   165→    int _scale = -1;
   166→    int32_t _inputindex = 0;
   167→    int32_t _buf_read;
   168→    int32_t _remain = 0;
   169→};
   170→
   171→//==============================================================================
   172→// MemoryStream Implementation
   173→//==============================================================================
   174→
   175→MemoryStream::MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size)
   176→    : _buffer(buffer), _size(size), _position(0) {}
   177→
   178→int MemoryStream::available() {
   179→    return _size - _position;
   180→}
   181→
   182→int MemoryStream::read() {
   183→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position++] : -1;
   184→}
   185→
   186→int MemoryStream::peek() {
   187→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position] : -1;
   188→}
   189→
   190→size_t MemoryStream::readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) {
   191→    size_t n = min(length, _size - _position);
   192→    memcpy(buffer, _buffer + _position, n);
   193→    _position += n;
   194→    return n;
   195→}
   196→
   197→void MemoryStream::reset() {
   198→    _position = 0;
   199→}
   200→
   201→//==============================================================================
   202→// VideoPlayer Implementation
   203→//==============================================================================
   204→
   205→VideoPlayer* VideoPlayer::_instance = nullptr;
   206→
   207→VideoPlayer::VideoPlayer()
   208→    : _display(nullptr)
   209→    , _rotation(1)
   210→    , _videoBuf(nullptr)
   211→    , _videoSize(0)
   212→    , _stream(nullptr)
   213→    , _decodeBuf(nullptr)
   214→    , _decoder(nullptr)
   215→    , _paused(false)
   216→    , _powered(true)
   217→    , _initialized(false)
   218→    , _textVisible(false)
   219→{
   220→    _instance = this;
   221→}
   222→
   223→VideoPlayer::~VideoPlayer() {
   224→    end();
   225→}
   226→
   227→int VideoPlayer::_drawCallback(JPEGDRAW* pDraw) {
   228→    if (_instance && _instance->_display) {
   229→        _instance->_display->draw16bitBeRGBBitmap(pDraw->x, pDraw->y, pDraw->pPixels, pDraw->iWidth, pDraw->iHeight);
   230→    }
   231→    return 1;
   232→}
   233→
   234→void VideoPlayer::_initDisplay() {
   235→    // Use FSPI bus explicitly (same as factory demo) to avoid conflicts with SD card
   236→    Arduino_DataBus* bus = new Arduino_ESP32SPI(LCD_DC, LCD_CS, LCD_SCK, LCD_MOSI, LCD_MISO, FSPI, true);
   237→    _display = new Arduino_ST7789(bus, -1, _rotation, true, LCD_WIDTH, LCD_HEIGHT);
   238→
   239→    if (!_display->begin()) {
   240→        return;
   241→    }
   242→
   243→    pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
   244→    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, HIGH);
   245→    _display->fillScreen(BLACK);
   246→}
   247→
   248→bool VideoPlayer::_loadVideo(const char* path) {
   249→    File f;
   250→
   251→    // Initialize SPI bus (FSPI) and SD card - same bus as display
   252→    static SPIClass sdSpi(FSPI);
   253→    sdSpi.begin(SD_SCK, SD_MISO, SD_MOSI, SD_CS);
   254→    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS, sdSpi)) {
   255→        Serial.println("SD card init failed!");
   256→        return false;
   257→    }
   258→
   259→    // Use provided path or default VIDEO_PATH
   260→    const char* videoFile = path ? path : VIDEO_PATH;
   261→    f = SD.open(videoFile, FILE_READ);
   262→
   263→    if (!f) {
   264→        return false;
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    _videoSize = f.size();
   268→    _videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_videoSize);
   269→    if (!_videoBuf) {
   270→        f.close();
   271→        return false;
   272→    }
   273→
   274→    if (f.read(_videoBuf, _videoSize) != _videoSize) {
   275→        free(_videoBuf);
   276→        _videoBuf = nullptr;
   277→        f.close();
   278→        return false;
   279→    }
   280→    f.close();
   281→
   282→    // Create stream and decoder
   283→    _stream = new MemoryStream(_videoBuf, _videoSize);
   284→    _decodeBuf = (uint8_t*)malloc(LCD_WIDTH * LCD_HEIGHT / 2);
   285→    if (!_decodeBuf) {
   286→        return false;
   287→    }
   288→
   289→    _decoder = new MjpegClass();
   290→    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
   291→
   292→    // Note: With rotation=1, effective display is 320x240 (landscape)
   293→    // MjpegClass uses these for scaling and centering calculations
   294→    return mjpeg->setup(_stream, _decodeBuf, _drawCallback, true, 0, 0, LCD_HEIGHT, LCD_WIDTH);
   295→}
   296→
   297→bool VideoPlayer::begin(const char* videoPath) {
   298→    if (_initialized) return true;
   299→
   300→    _initDisplay();
   301→    if (!_display) return false;
   302→
   303→    if (!_loadVideo(videoPath)) {
   304→        return false;
   305→    }
   306→
   307→    _initialized = true;
   308→    return true;
   309→}
   310→
   311→void VideoPlayer::end() {
   312→    if (_decoder) {
   313→        delete (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
   314→        _decoder = nullptr;
   315→    }
   316→    if (_stream) {
   317→        delete _stream;
   318→        _stream = nullptr;
   319→    }
   320→    if (_decodeBuf) {
   321→        free(_decodeBuf);
   322→        _decodeBuf = nullptr;
   323→    }
   324→    if (_videoBuf) {
   325→        free(_videoBuf);
   326→        _videoBuf = nullptr;
   327→    }
   328→    _initialized = false;
   329→}
   330→
   331→void VideoPlayer::play() {
   332→    if (!_powered || _paused || _textVisible || !_initialized) {
   333→        static unsigned long lastDebug = 0;
   334→        if (millis() - lastDebug > 2000) {
   335→            lastDebug = millis();
   336→            Serial.printf("play() skip: pwr=%d pause=%d txt=%d init=%d\n",
   337→                          _powered, _paused, _textVisible, _initialized);
   338→        }
   339→        return;
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
   343→    if (mjpeg->readMjpegBuf()) {
   344→        mjpeg->drawJpg();
   345→    } else {
   346→        // Loop video
   347→        _stream->reset();

   399→void VideoPlayer::_drawTextBox() {
   400→    if (!_display || _currentText.length() == 0) return;
   401→
   402→    // Get actual display dimensions (accounts for rotation)
   403→    int dispWidth = _display->width();
   404→    int dispHeight = _display->height();
   405→
   406→    // Text box dimensions
   407→    const int boxHeight = 80;
   408→    const int boxMargin = 5;
   409→    const int textPadding = 8;
   410→    const int boxY = dispHeight - boxHeight - boxMargin;
   411→
   412→    // Draw semi-transparent background
   413→    _display->fillRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BG_COLOR);
   414→
   415→    // Draw border
   416→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   417→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin + 1, boxY + 1, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2, boxHeight - 2, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   418→
   419→    // Draw text
   420→    _display->setTextColor(TEXT_COLOR);
   421→    _display->setTextSize(2);
   422→    _display->setTextWrap(true);
   423→
   424→    // Calculate text position
   425→    int textX = boxMargin + textPadding;
   426→    int textY = boxY + textPadding;
   427→
   428→    _display->setCursor(textX, textY);
   429→
   430→    // Word wrap manually for better control
   431→    String remaining = _currentText;
   432→    int lineWidth = dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2 * textPadding;
   433→    int charWidth = 12;  // Approximate width per char at size 2
   434→    int charsPerLine = lineWidth / charWidth;
   435→    int lineHeight = 20;
   436→    int maxLines = (boxHeight - 2 * textPadding) / lineHeight;
   437→
   438→    int line = 0;
   439→    while (remaining.length() > 0 && line < maxLines) {
   440→        String lineToPrint;
   441→        if (remaining.length() <= charsPerLine) {
   442→            lineToPrint = remaining;
   443→            remaining = "";
   444→        } else {
   445→            // Find last space before limit
   446→            int breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   447→            while (breakPoint > 0 && remaining[breakPoint] != ' ') {
   448→                breakPoint--;
   449→            }
   450→            if (breakPoint == 0) breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   451→
   452→            lineToPrint = remaining.substring(0, breakPoint);
   453→            remaining = remaining.substring(breakPoint);
   454→            remaining.trim();
   455→        }
   456→
   457→        _display->setCursor(textX, textY + line * lineHeight);
   458→        _display->print(lineToPrint);
   459→        line++;
   460→    }
   461→}

   463→void VideoPlayer::showText(const char* text) {
```
