    13→// Include MjpegClass inline to avoid separate header management
    14→#define READ_BUFFER_SIZE 1024
    15→
    16→class MjpegClass {
    17→public:
    18→    bool setup(Stream *input, uint8_t *mjpeg_buf, JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *pfnDraw,
    19→               bool useBigEndian, int x, int y, int widthLimit, int heightLimit) {
    20→        _input = input;
    21→        _mjpeg_buf = mjpeg_buf;
    22→        _pfnDraw = pfnDraw;
    23→        _useBigEndian = useBigEndian;
    24→        _x = x;
    25→        _y = y;
    26→        _widthLimit = widthLimit;
    27→        _heightLimit = heightLimit;
    28→        _inputindex = 0;
    29→
    30→        if (!_read_buf) {
    31→            _read_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    32→        }
    33→        return _read_buf != nullptr;
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    bool readMjpegBuf() {
    37→        if (_inputindex == 0) {
    38→            _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    39→            _inputindex += _buf_read;
    40→        }
    41→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    42→        int i = 0;
    43→        bool found_FFD8 = false;
    44→
    45→        while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    46→            i = 0;
    47→            while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    48→                if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
    49→                    found_FFD8 = true;
    50→                }
    51→                ++i;
    52→            }
    53→            if (found_FFD8) {
    54→                --i;
    55→            } else {
    56→                _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    57→            }
    58→        }
    59→
    60→        uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
    61→        _buf_read -= i;
    62→        bool found_FFD9 = false;
    63→
    64→        if (_buf_read > 0) {
    65→            i = 3;
    66→            while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    67→                if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
    68→                    found_FFD9 = true;
    69→                } else {
    70→                    while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    71→                        if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
    72→                            found_FFD9 = true;
    73→                            ++i;
    74→                        }
    75→                        ++i;
    76→                    }
    77→                }
    78→
    79→                memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
    80→                _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
    81→                size_t o = _buf_read - i;
    82→
    83→                if (o > 0) {
    84→                    memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
    85→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
    86→                    _p = _read_buf;
    87→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    88→                    _buf_read += o;
    89→                } else {
    90→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    91→                    _p = _read_buf;
    92→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    93→                }
    94→                i = 0;
    95→            }
    96→            return found_FFD9;
    97→        }
    98→        return false;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    bool drawJpg() {
   102→        _remain = _mjpeg_buf_offset;
   103→
   104→        if (_jpeg.openRAM(_mjpeg_buf, _remain, _pfnDraw) != 1) return false;
   105→
   106→        if (_scale == -1) {
   107→            int iMaxMCUs;
   108→            int w = _jpeg.getWidth();
   109→            int h = _jpeg.getHeight();
   110→            float ratio = (float)h / _heightLimit;
   111→
   112→            if (ratio <= 1) {
   113→                _scale = 0;
   114→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 16;
   115→            } else if (ratio <= 2) {
   116→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_HALF;
   117→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 8;
   118→                w /= 2;
   119→                h /= 2;
   120→            } else if (ratio <= 4) {
   121→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_QUARTER;
   122→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 4;
   123→                w /= 4;
   124→                h /= 4;
   125→            } else {
   126→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_EIGHTH;
   127→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 2;
   128→                w /= 8;
   129→                h /= 8;
   130→            }
   131→
   132→            _jpeg.setMaxOutputSize(iMaxMCUs);
   133→            _x = (w > _widthLimit) ? 0 : ((_widthLimit - w) / 2);
   134→            _y = (_heightLimit - h) / 2;
   135→        }
   136→
   137→        if (_useBigEndian) {
   138→            _jpeg.setPixelType(RGB565_BIG_ENDIAN);
   139→        }
   140→
   141→        if (_jpeg.decode(_x, _y, _scale) != 1) {
   142→            _jpeg.close();
   143→            return false;
   144→        }
   145→
   146→        _jpeg.close();
   147→        return true;
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    void reset() {
   151→        _inputindex = 0;
   152→        _buf_read = 0;
   153→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   154→    }
   155→
   156→private:
   157→    Stream *_input;
   158→    uint8_t *_mjpeg_buf;
   159→    JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *_pfnDraw;
   160→    bool _useBigEndian;
   161→    int _x, _y, _widthLimit, _heightLimit;
   162→    uint8_t *_read_buf = nullptr;
   163→    int32_t _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   164→    JPEGDEC _jpeg;
   165→    int _scale = -1;
   166→    int32_t _inputindex = 0;
   167→    int32_t _buf_read;
   168→    int32_t _remain = 0;
   169→};

   171→//==============================================================================
   172→// MemoryStream Implementation
   173→//==============================================================================
   174→
   175→MemoryStream::MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size)
   176→    : _buffer(buffer), _size(size), _position(0) {}
   177→
   178→int MemoryStream::available() {
   179→    return _size - _position;
   180→}
   181→
   182→int MemoryStream::read() {
   183→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position++] : -1;
   184→}
   185→
   186→int MemoryStream::peek() {
   187→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position] : -1;
   188→}
   189→
   190→size_t MemoryStream::readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) {
   191→    size_t n = min(length, _size - _position);
   192→    memcpy(buffer, _buffer + _position, n);
   193→    _position += n;
   194→    return n;
   195→}
   196→
   197→void MemoryStream::reset() {
   198→    _position = 0;
   199→}

   234→void VideoPlayer::_initDisplay() {

   236→    Arduino_DataBus* bus = new Arduino_ESP32SPI(LCD_DC, LCD_CS, LCD_SCK, LCD_MOSI, LCD_MISO, FSPI, true);
   237→    _display = new Arduino_ST7789(bus, -1, _rotation, true, LCD_WIDTH, LCD_HEIGHT);
   238→

   248→bool VideoPlayer::_loadVideo(const char* path) {
   249→    File f;
   250→
   251→    // Initialize SPI bus (FSPI) and SD card - same bus as display
   252→    static SPIClass sdSpi(FSPI);
   253→    sdSpi.begin(SD_SCK, SD_MISO, SD_MOSI, SD_CS);
   254→    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS, sdSpi)) {
   255→        Serial.println("SD card init failed!");
   256→        return false;
   257→    }
   258→
   259→    // Use provided path or default VIDEO_PATH
   260→    const char* videoFile = path ? path : VIDEO_PATH;
   261→    f = SD.open(videoFile, FILE_READ);
   262→
   263→    if (!f) {
   264→        return false;
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    _videoSize = f.size();
   268→    _videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_videoSize);
   269→    if (!_videoBuf) {
   270→        f.close();
   271→        return false;
   272→    }
   273→
   274→    if (f.read(_videoBuf, _videoSize) != _videoSize) {
   275→        free(_videoBuf);
   276→        _videoBuf = nullptr;
   277→        f.close();
   278→        return false;
   279→    }
   280→    f.close();
   281→
   282→    // Create stream and decoder
   283→    _stream = new MemoryStream(_videoBuf, _videoSize);
   284→    _decodeBuf = (uint8_t*)malloc(LCD_WIDTH * LCD_HEIGHT / 2);
   285→    if (!_decodeBuf) {
   286→        return false;
   287→    }
   288→
   289→    _decoder = new MjpegClass();
   290→    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
   291→
   292→    // Note: With rotation=1, effective display is 320x240 (landscape)
   293→    // MjpegClass uses these for scaling and centering calculations
   294→    return mjpeg->setup(_stream, _decodeBuf, _drawCallback, true, 0, 0, LCD_HEIGHT, LCD_WIDTH);
   295→}

     1→/*******************************************************************************
     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Orientation Manager Implementation
     3→ ******************************************************************************/
     4→
     5→#include "orientation.h"
     6→#include "../../config.h"
     7→
     8→#include <Wire.h>
     9→#include <FastIMU.h>
    10→
    11→// Static constants
    12→const float OrientationManager::THRESHOLD = 0.5f;
    13→const unsigned long OrientationManager::DEBOUNCE_MS = ORIENTATION_DEBOUNCE_MS;
    14→const unsigned long OrientationManager::POLL_MS = ORIENTATION_POLL_MS;
    15→
    16→// IMU instance and data
    17→static QMI8658 imu;
    18→static calData calibration = {0};
    19→static AccelData accelData;
    20→
    21→OrientationManager::OrientationManager()
    22→    : _currentRotation(1)
    23→    , _pendingRotation(0)
    24→    , _debounceStart(0)
    25→    , _lastPoll(0)
    26→    , _rotationChanged(false)
    27→    , _imuAvailable(false)
    28→{
    29→}
    30→
    31→bool OrientationManager::begin() {
    32→    Wire.begin(I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL);
    33→
    34→    int err = imu.init(calibration, IMU_ADDRESS);
    35→    _imuAvailable = (err == 0);
    36→
    37→    return _imuAvailable;
    38→}
    39→
    40→void OrientationManager::update() {
    41→    if (!_imuAvailable) return;
    42→
    43→    unsigned long now = millis();
    44→    if (now - _lastPoll < POLL_MS) return;
    45→    _lastPoll = now;
    46→
    47→    // Read accelerometer
    48→    imu.update();
    49→    imu.getAccel(&accelData);
    50→    float accelY = accelData.accelY;
    51→
    52→    // Determine desired rotation based on accelY
    53→    uint8_t desiredRotation = 0;
    54→    if (accelY > THRESHOLD) {
    55→        desiredRotation = 1;  // USB on right (normal)
    56→    } else if (accelY < -THRESHOLD) {
    57→        desiredRotation = 3;  // USB on left (180 flip)
    58→    } else {
    59→        desiredRotation = _currentRotation;  // Hysteresis zone - keep current
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    // State machine logic
    63→    if (desiredRotation == _currentRotation) {
    64→        // Orientation matches current stable state
    65→        _pendingRotation = 0;  // Cancel any pending transition
    66→    } else if (_pendingRotation == 0) {
    67→        // Start new transition
    68→        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
    69→        _debounceStart = now;
    70→    } else if (_pendingRotation == desiredRotation) {
    71→        // Transition in progress, check if debounce time elapsed
    72→        if (now - _debounceStart >= DEBOUNCE_MS) {
    73→            // Commit rotation change
    74→            _currentRotation = _pendingRotation;
    75→            _pendingRotation = 0;
    76→            _rotationChanged = true;
    77→        }
    78→    } else {
    79→        // Desired rotation changed during debounce - restart
    80→        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
    81→        _debounceStart = now;
    82→    }
    83→}
    84→
    85→bool OrientationManager::hasChanged() {
    86→    if (_rotationChanged) {
    87→        _rotationChanged = false;
    88→        return true;
    89→    }
    90→    return false;
    91→}
    92→

    26→    , _frontendState(nullptr)

    37→bool MicStream::begin() {
    38→    if (_running) return true;
    39→
    40→    // Allocate buffers
    41→    _audioBuffer = (int16_t*)malloc(AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(int16_t));
    42→    _i2sBuffer = (int32_t*)malloc(512 * sizeof(int32_t));
    43→    _frontendState = (FrontendState*)malloc(sizeof(FrontendState));
    44→
    45→    if (!_audioBuffer || !_i2sBuffer || !_frontendState) {
    46→        end();

    48→    }
    49→
    50→    _audioBufferPos = 0;
    51→    _featureFrameCount = 0;
    52→
    53→    if (!_initI2S()) {
    54→        end();
    55→        return false;
    56→    }
    57→
    58→    if (!_initFrontend()) {
    59→        end();
    60→        return false;
    61→    }
    62→
    63→    _running = true;
    64→    return true;
    65→}
    66→
    67→void MicStream::end() {
    68→    if (_running) {

    72→    if (_audioBuffer) {
    73→        free(_audioBuffer);
    74→        _audioBuffer = nullptr;
    75→    }

   108→        .data_in_num = MIC_DIN
   109→    };
   110→
   111→    if (i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_0, &i2s_config, 0, NULL) != ESP_OK) {
   112→        return false;
   113→    }
   114→
   115→    if (i2s_set_pin(I2S_NUM_0, &pins) != ESP_OK) {
   116→        i2s_driver_uninstall(I2S_NUM_0);
   117→        return false;
   118→    }
   119→
   120→    return true;
   121→}

   123→bool MicStream::_initFrontend() {
   124→    FrontendConfig frontend_config;
   125→    frontend_config.window.size_ms = FEATURE_WINDOW_MS;
   126→    frontend_config.window.step_size_ms = FEATURE_STRIDE_MS;
   127→    frontend_config.filterbank.num_channels = FEATURE_BINS;
   128→    frontend_config.filterbank.lower_band_limit = 125.0f;
   129→    frontend_config.filterbank.upper_band_limit = 7500.0f;
   130→    frontend_config.noise_reduction.smoothing_bits = 10;
   131→    frontend_config.noise_reduction.even_smoothing = 0.025f;
   132→    frontend_config.noise_reduction.odd_smoothing = 0.06f;
   133→    frontend_config.noise_reduction.min_signal_remaining = 0.05f;
   134→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.enable_pcan = 1;
   135→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.strength = 0.95f;
   136→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.offset = 80.0f;
   137→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.gain_bits = 21;
   138→    frontend_config.log_scale.enable_log = 1;
   139→    frontend_config.log_scale.scale_shift = 6;
   140→
   141→    return FrontendPopulateState(&frontend_config, _frontendState, SAMPLE_RATE);
   142→}
   143→
   144→bool MicStream::_captureAudio() {
   145→    int space_available = AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE - _audioBufferPos;
   146→    if (space_available < 256) {
   147→        return true;  // Buffer full, will process
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    int samples_to_read = min(256, space_available);
   151→    size_t bytes_read;
   152→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   153→        return false;
   154→    }
   155→
   156→    int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   157→    int32_t max_sample = 0;
   158→
   159→    for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
   160→        // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame, shift down
   161→        int32_t sample = _i2sBuffer[i] >> 14;
   162→        _audioBuffer[_audioBufferPos++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   163→        if (abs(sample) > max_sample) max_sample = abs(sample);
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    _amplitude = max_sample;
   167→    return true;
   168→}

   170→bool MicStream::update() {
   171→    if (!_running) return false;
   172→
   173→    if (!_captureAudio()) {
   174→        return false;
   175→    }
   176→
   177→    bool newFrame = false;
   178→
   179→    // Process audio through frontend when we have enough samples
   180→    while (_audioBufferPos >= FEATURE_STRIDE_SAMPLES) {
   181→        size_t num_samples_read;
   182→        FrontendOutput frontend_output = FrontendProcessSamples(
   183→            _frontendState, _audioBuffer, _audioBufferPos, &num_samples_read);
   184→
   185→        if (num_samples_read == 0) {
   186→            break;
   187→        }
   188→
   189→        // Shift remaining samples to start of buffer
   190→        if (num_samples_read < (size_t)_audioBufferPos) {
   191→            memmove(_audioBuffer, _audioBuffer + num_samples_read,
   192→                    (_audioBufferPos - num_samples_read) * sizeof(int16_t));
   193→        }
   194→        _audioBufferPos -= num_samples_read;
   195→
   196→        // If we got features, add to feature buffer
   197→        if (frontend_output.size == FEATURE_BINS) {
   198→            // Shift feature frames if buffer is full
   199→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   200→                memmove(_featureBuffer, _featureBuffer + FEATURE_BINS,
   201→                        (FEATURE_FRAMES - 1) * FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   202→                _featureFrameCount = FEATURE_FRAMES - 1;
   203→            }
   204→
   205→            // Add new frame
   206→            memcpy(_featureBuffer + _featureFrameCount * FEATURE_BINS,
   207→                   frontend_output.values, FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   208→            _featureFrameCount++;
   209→
   210→            // Signal that we have a complete feature set
   211→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   212→                newFrame = true;
   213→            }
   214→        }
   215→    }
   216→
   217→    return newFrame;
   218→}
   219→
   220→int MicStream::getNewSamples(int16_t* buffer, size_t maxSamples) {
   221→    // This provides raw audio for recording purposes
   222→    // For now, return what's in buffer (caller should copy before next update)
   223→    int count = min((size_t)_audioBufferPos, maxSamples);
   224→    if (count > 0 && buffer) {
   225→        memcpy(buffer, _audioBuffer, count * sizeof(int16_t));
   226→    }
   227→    return count;
   228→}

     1→/*******************************************************************************
     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Audio Recorder Module
     3→ * Fixed duration recording for speech input after wake word
     4→ ******************************************************************************/
     5→
     6→#pragma once
     7→
     8→#include <Arduino.h>
     9→
    10→//==============================================================================
    11→// Recording constants
    12→//==============================================================================
    13→#define RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE   16000
    14→#define RECORDING_MAX_SECONDS   5
    15→#define RECORDING_BUFFER_SIZE   (RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE * RECORDING_MAX_SECONDS)
    16→
    17→//==============================================================================
    18→// AudioRecorder - Handles timed audio recording to PSRAM buffer
    19→//==============================================================================
    20→class AudioRecorder {
    21→public:
    22→    AudioRecorder();
    23→    ~AudioRecorder();
    24→
    25→    // Lifecycle
    26→    bool begin();  // Allocates PSRAM buffer
    27→    void end();    // Frees buffer
    28→
    29→    // Recording control
    30→    void startRecording(float durationSec = 3.0f);
    31→    void stopRecording();
    32→    bool isRecording() const { return _recording; }
    33→
    34→    // Call in loop while recording - captures audio
    35→    // Returns true when recording completes
    36→    bool update();
    37→
    38→    // Get recorded audio
    39→    const int16_t* getBuffer() const { return _buffer; }
    40→    size_t getSampleCount() const { return _sampleCount; }
    41→    float getDurationSec() const { return _sampleCount / (float)RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE; }
    42→
    43→    // Get recording progress (0.0 - 1.0)
    44→    float getProgress() const;
    45→
    46→    // Check if buffer is valid
    47→    bool hasRecording() const { return _sampleCount > 0; }
    48→
    49→private:
    50→    int16_t* _buffer;
    51→    size_t _targetSamples;
    52→    size_t _sampleCount;
    53→    bool _recording;
    54→    bool _initialized;
    55→
    56→    // I2S buffer for capture
    57→    int32_t* _i2sBuffer;
    58→
    59→    // Internal helpers
    60→    bool _captureChunk();
    61→};

     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Audio Recorder Implementation

    10→AudioRecorder::AudioRecorder()
    11→    : _buffer(nullptr)
    12→    , _targetSamples(0)
    13→    , _sampleCount(0)
    14→    , _recording(false)
    15→    , _initialized(false)
    16→    , _i2sBuffer(nullptr)
    17→{
    18→}

    20→AudioRecorder::~AudioRecorder() {
    21→    end();
    22→}
    23→
    24→bool AudioRecorder::begin() {
    25→    if (_initialized) return true;
    26→
    27→    // Allocate recording buffer in PSRAM
    28→    _buffer = (int16_t*)ps_malloc(RECORDING_BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(int16_t));
    29→    if (!_buffer) {
    30→        Serial.println("AudioRecorder: Buffer alloc failed");
    31→        return false;
    32→    }
    33→
    34→    // Allocate I2S read buffer
    35→    _i2sBuffer = (int32_t*)malloc(512 * sizeof(int32_t));
    36→    if (!_i2sBuffer) {
    37→        free(_buffer);
    38→        _buffer = nullptr;
    39→        return false;
    40→    }
    41→
    42→    // Note: I2S is initialized by MicStream, we share the same I2S port
    43→    // This recorder should be used AFTER MicStream.end() is called
    44→
    45→    _initialized = true;
    46→    _sampleCount = 0;
    47→    return true;
    48→}
    49→
    50→void AudioRecorder::end() {
    51→    stopRecording();
    52→
    53→    if (_buffer) {
    54→        free(_buffer);
    55→        _buffer = nullptr;
    56→    }
    57→    if (_i2sBuffer) {
    58→        free(_i2sBuffer);
    59→        _i2sBuffer = nullptr;
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    _initialized = false;
    63→}
    64→
    65→void AudioRecorder::startRecording(float durationSec) {
    66→    if (!_initialized || _recording) return;
    67→
    68→    // Clamp duration
    69→    if (durationSec > RECORDING_MAX_SECONDS) {
    70→        durationSec = RECORDING_MAX_SECONDS;
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    _targetSamples = (size_t)(durationSec * RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE);
    74→    _sampleCount = 0;
    75→    _recording = true;
    76→
    77→    // Initialize I2S for recording
    78→    i2s_config_t i2s_config = {
    79→        .mode = (i2s_mode_t)(I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_RX),
    80→        .sample_rate = RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE,
    81→        .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_32BIT,
    82→        .channel_format = I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_ONLY_LEFT,
    83→        .communication_format = I2S_COMM_FORMAT_STAND_I2S,
    84→        .intr_alloc_flags = ESP_INTR_FLAG_LEVEL1,
    85→        .dma_buf_count = 4,
    86→        .dma_buf_len = 256,
    87→        .use_apll = false,
    88→        .tx_desc_auto_clear = false,
    89→        .fixed_mclk = 0
    90→    };
    91→
    92→    i2s_pin_config_t pins = {
    93→        .bck_io_num = MIC_BCK,
    94→        .ws_io_num = MIC_WS,
    95→        .data_out_num = I2S_PIN_NO_CHANGE,
    96→        .data_in_num = MIC_DIN
    97→    };
    98→
    99→    if (i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_0, &i2s_config, 0, NULL) != ESP_OK) {
   100→        _recording = false;
   101→        return;
   102→    }
   103→    i2s_set_pin(I2S_NUM_0, &pins);
   104→
   105→    Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Started %.1fs recording\n", durationSec);
   106→}

   109→    if (_recording) {
   110→        i2s_driver_uninstall(I2S_NUM_0);

   117→bool AudioRecorder::_captureChunk() {
   118→    size_t remaining = _targetSamples - _sampleCount;
   119→    if (remaining == 0) return true;  // Done
   120→
   121→    int samples_to_read = min((size_t)256, remaining);
   122→    size_t bytes_read;
   123→
   124→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   125→        return false;
   126→    }
   127→
   128→    int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   129→
   130→    for (int i = 0; i < samples && _sampleCount < _targetSamples; i++) {
   131→        // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame
   132→        int32_t sample = _i2sBuffer[i] >> 14;
   133→        _buffer[_sampleCount++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   134→    }
   135→
   136→    return true;
   137→}
   138→
   139→bool AudioRecorder::update() {
   140→    if (!_recording) return false;
   141→
   142→    _captureChunk();
   143→
   144→    // Check if recording complete
   145→    if (_sampleCount >= _targetSamples) {
   146→        stopRecording();
   147→        return true;  // Recording complete
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    return false;  // Still recording
   151→}
   152→
   153→float AudioRecorder::getProgress() const {
   154→    if (_targetSamples == 0) return 0.0f;
   155→    return (float)_sampleCount / _targetSamples;
   156→}

    21→    : _modelData(nullptr)

    23→    , _tensorArena(nullptr)
    24→    , _varArena(nullptr)
    25→    , _varAllocator(nullptr)
    26→    , _resourceVars(nullptr)
    27→    , _interpreter(nullptr)
    28→    , _inputTensor(nullptr)
    29→    , _outputTensor(nullptr)
    30→    , _windowPos(0)

    32→    , _lastDetectionMs(0)
    33→    , _lastProbability(0.0f)
    34→    , _loaded(false)
    35→{
    36→    // Default config
    37→    strcpy(_config.wake_word, "Hey Daisy");
    38→    _config.probability_cutoff = 0.5f;
    39→    _config.sliding_window_size = 10;
    40→    _config.min_high_frames = 6;
    41→    _config.min_frame_prob = 0.5f;
    42→    _config.cooldown_ms = 1500;
    43→
    44→    memset(_probabilityWindow, 0, sizeof(_probabilityWindow));
    45→}
    46→
    47→WakeWordDetector::~WakeWordDetector() {
    48→    end();
    49→}
    50→
    51→bool WakeWordDetector::begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
    52→                              const char* modelPath, const char* configPath) {
    53→    if (_loaded) return true;
    54→
    55→    // Check pool size
    56→    if (poolSize < TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE + VAR_ARENA_SIZE) {
    57→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Pool too small");
    58→        return false;
    59→    }
    60→
    61→    // Assign pool regions
    62→    _tensorArena = pool;
    63→    _varArena = pool + TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE;
    64→
    65→    // Load config (optional - uses defaults if fails)
    66→    if (configPath) {
    67→        _loadConfig(configPath);
    68→    }
    69→
    70→    // Load model from SD
    71→    if (!_loadModel(modelPath)) {
    72→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Model load failed");
    73→        return false;
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    // Initialize TFLite interpreter
    77→    if (!_initInterpreter()) {
    78→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Interpreter init failed");
    79→        if (_modelData) {
    80→            free(_modelData);
    81→            _modelData = nullptr;
    82→        }
    83→        return false;
    84→    }
    85→
    86→    _resetWindow();
    87→    _loaded = true;
    88→    // Start with extended cooldown (3 sec) to let mic stabilize and avoid false triggers
    89→    _lastDetectionMs = millis() + 1500;  // Extra 1.5s beyond normal cooldown
    90→
    91→    Serial.printf("WakeWord: Loaded \"%s\" (%.1fKB model)\n",
    92→                  _config.wake_word, _modelSize / 1024.0f);
    93→    return true;
    94→}
    95→
    96→void WakeWordDetector::end() {

    98→    _interpreter = nullptr;
    99→    _inputTensor = nullptr;
   100→    _outputTensor = nullptr;
   101→    _varAllocator = nullptr;
   102→    _resourceVars = nullptr;

   104→    if (_modelData) {

   114→bool WakeWordDetector::_loadConfig(const char* path) {
   115→    File f = SD.open(path);
   116→    if (!f) {
   117→        return false;
   118→    }
   119→
   120→    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
   121→    DeserializationError error = deserializeJson(doc, f);
   122→    f.close();
   123→
   124→    if (error) {
   125→        return false;
   126→    }
   127→
   128→    // Load wake word name
   129→    const char* wake_word = doc["wake_word"] | "Hey Daisy";
   130→    strncpy(_config.wake_word, wake_word, sizeof(_config.wake_word) - 1);
   131→    _config.wake_word[sizeof(_config.wake_word) - 1] = '\0';
   132→
   133→    // Load detection parameters from "micro" object
   134→    JsonObject micro = doc["micro"];
   135→    if (micro) {
   136→        _config.probability_cutoff = micro["probability_cutoff"] | 0.5f;
   137→        _config.sliding_window_size = micro["sliding_window_average_size"] | 10;
   138→        _config.min_high_frames = micro["min_high_frames"] | 6;
   139→        _config.min_frame_prob = micro["min_frame_prob"] | 0.5f;
   140→        _config.cooldown_ms = micro["cooldown_ms"] | 1500;
   141→    }
   142→
   143→    // Clamp sliding window size
   144→    if (_config.sliding_window_size > MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW) {
   145→        _config.sliding_window_size = MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW;
   146→    }
   147→
   148→    return true;
   149→}
   150→
   151→bool WakeWordDetector::_loadModel(const char* path) {
   152→    File f = SD.open(path);
   153→    if (!f) {
   154→        Serial.printf("WakeWord: Cannot open %s\n", path);
   155→        return false;
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    _modelSize = f.size();
   159→    _modelData = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_modelSize);
   160→    if (!_modelData) {
   161→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Model alloc failed");
   162→        f.close();
   163→        return false;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    if (f.read(_modelData, _modelSize) != _modelSize) {
   167→        free(_modelData);
   168→        _modelData = nullptr;
   169→        f.close();
   170→        return false;
   171→    }
   172→    f.close();
   173→    return true;
   174→}
   175→
   176→bool WakeWordDetector::_initInterpreter() {
   177→    const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(_modelData);
   178→    if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
   179→        Serial.printf("WakeWord: Model version mismatch: %d vs %d\n",
   180→                      model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
   181→        return false;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    _varAllocator = tflite::MicroAllocator::Create(_varArena, VAR_ARENA_SIZE);
   185→    if (!_varAllocator) {
   186→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Var allocator failed");
   187→        return false;
   188→    }
   189→
   190→    _resourceVars = tflite::MicroResourceVariables::Create(_varAllocator, MAX_RESOURCE_VARS);
   191→    if (!_resourceVars) {
   192→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Resource vars failed");
   193→        return false;
   194→    }
   195→
   196→    // Static interpreter to avoid memory fragmentation
   197→    static tflite::MicroInterpreter static_interpreter(
   198→        model, resolver, _tensorArena, TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE, _resourceVars);
   199→    _interpreter = &static_interpreter;
   200→
   201→    if (_interpreter->AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
   202→        Serial.println("WakeWord: AllocateTensors failed");
   203→        return false;
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    _inputTensor = _interpreter->input(0);
   207→    _outputTensor = _interpreter->output(0);
   208→
   209→    if (!_inputTensor || !_outputTensor) {
   210→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Failed to get tensors");
   211→        return false;
   212→    }
   213→
   214→    return true;
   215→}
   216→
   217→float WakeWordDetector::_runInference(const uint16_t* features) {
   218→    int total_features = FEATURE_FRAMES * FEATURE_BINS;
   219→
   220→    // Quantize features to input tensor format
   221→    if (_inputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   222→        int8_t* input_data = _inputTensor->data.int8;
   223→        for (int i = 0; i < total_features; i++) {
   224→            int32_t scaled = ((int32_t)features[i] * 256 + 333) / 666 - 128;
   225→            input_data[i] = constrain(scaled, -128, 127);
   226→        }
   227→    } else {
   228→        // Float input
   229→        float* input_data = _inputTensor->data.f;
   230→        for (int i = 0; i < total_features; i++) {
   231→            input_data[i] = features[i] / 25.6f;
   232→        }
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    // Run inference
   236→    if (_interpreter->Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
   237→        return 0.0f;
   238→    }
   239→
   240→    // Dequantize output
   241→    float probability;
   242→    if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteUInt8) {
   243→        uint8_t output_value = _outputTensor->data.uint8[0];
   244→        probability = (output_value - _outputTensor->params.zero_point) *
   245→                      _outputTensor->params.scale;
   246→    } else if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   247→        int8_t output_value = _outputTensor->data.int8[0];
   248→        probability = (output_value - _outputTensor->params.zero_point) *
   249→                      _outputTensor->params.scale;
   250→    } else {
   251→        probability = _outputTensor->data.f[0];
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    return probability;
   255→}
   256→
   257→bool WakeWordDetector::detect(const uint16_t* features) {
   258→    if (!_loaded) return false;
   259→
   260→    // Run inference
   261→    float prob = _runInference(features);
   262→    _lastProbability = prob;
   263→
   264→    // Update sliding window
   265→    _probabilityWindow[_windowPos] = prob;
   266→    _windowPos = (_windowPos + 1) % _config.sliding_window_size;
   267→
   268→    if (_windowPos == 0) {
   269→        _windowFilled = true;
   270→    }
   271→
   272→    // Need full window before detection
   273→    if (!_windowFilled) {
   274→        return false;
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    // Check cooldown
   278→    if (millis() - _lastDetectionMs < (unsigned long)_config.cooldown_ms) {
   279→        return false;
   280→    }
   281→
   282→    // Calculate average and count high frames
   283→    float avg = 0.0f;
   284→    int high_frames = 0;
   285→    for (int i = 0; i < _config.sliding_window_size; i++) {
   286→        avg += _probabilityWindow[i];
   287→        if (_probabilityWindow[i] >= _config.min_frame_prob) {
   288→            high_frames++;
   289→        }
   290→    }
   291→    avg /= _config.sliding_window_size;
   292→
   293→    // Detection criteria
   294→    if (avg >= _config.probability_cutoff && high_frames >= _config.min_high_frames) {
   295→        _lastDetectionMs = millis();
   296→        _resetWindow();
   297→        return true;
   298→    }
   299→
   300→    return false;
   301→}
   302→
   303→float WakeWordDetector::getAverageProbability() const {
   304→    if (!_windowFilled) return 0.0f;
   305→
   306→    float sum = 0.0f;
   307→    for (int i = 0; i < _config.sliding_window_size; i++) {
   308→        sum += _probabilityWindow[i];
   309→    }
   310→    return sum / _config.sliding_window_size;
   311→}
   312→
   313→void WakeWordDetector::_resetWindow() {
   314→    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW; i++) {
   315→        _probabilityWindow[i] = 0.0f;
   316→    }
   317→    _windowPos = 0;
   318→    _windowFilled = false;
   319→}

    51→bool WakeWordDetector::begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
    52→                              const char* modelPath, const char* configPath) {
    53→    if (_loaded) return true;
    54→
    55→    // Check pool size
    56→    if (poolSize < TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE + VAR_ARENA_SIZE) {
    57→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Pool too small");
    58→        return false;
    59→    }
    60→
    61→    // Assign pool regions
    62→    _tensorArena = pool;
    63→    _varArena = pool + TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE;
    64→
    65→    // Load config (optional - uses defaults if fails)
    66→    if (configPath) {
    67→        _loadConfig(configPath);
    68→    }
    69→
    70→    // Load model from SD
    71→    if (!_loadModel(modelPath)) {
    72→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Model load failed");
    73→        return false;
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    // Initialize TFLite interpreter
    77→    if (!_initInterpreter()) {
    78→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Interpreter init failed");
    79→        if (_modelData) {
    80→            free(_modelData);
    81→            _modelData = nullptr;
    82→        }
    83→        return false;
    84→    }
    85→
    86→    _resetWindow();
    87→    _loaded = true;
    88→    // Start with extended cooldown (3 sec) to let mic stabilize and avoid false triggers
    89→    _lastDetectionMs = millis() + 1500;  // Extra 1.5s beyond normal cooldown
    90→
    91→    Serial.printf("WakeWord: Loaded \"%s\" (%.1fKB model)\n",
    92→                  _config.wake_word, _modelSize / 1024.0f);
    93→    return true;
    94→}

     1→/*******************************************************************************
     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Audio Embedding Module
     3→ *
     4→ * Generates 256-dimensional embeddings from recorded audio using:
     5→ * 1. Mel-spectrogram generation (64 bins x 96 frames)
     6→ * 2. Small CNN TFLite inference (~100-300KB model)
     7→ *
     8→ * Model architecture (trained with contrastive learning):
     9→ *   Input: (64, 96, 1) mel-spectrogram
    10→ *   Conv2D 32 -> MaxPool -> Conv2D 64 -> MaxPool ->
    11→ *   Conv2D 128 -> MaxPool -> Conv2D 128 -> GlobalAvgPool -> Dense 256
    12→ *   Output: 256-dim L2-normalized embedding
    13→ ******************************************************************************/
    14→
    15→#pragma once
    16→
    17→#include <Arduino.h>
    18→
    19→// Forward declarations
    20→namespace tflite {
    21→    class MicroInterpreter;
    22→}
    23→struct TfLiteTensor;
    24→
    25→//==============================================================================
    26→// Audio Encoder Specifications
    27→//==============================================================================
    28→
    29→// Mel-spectrogram parameters (must match training)
    30→#define AUDIO_MEL_BINS 64
    31→#define AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES 96
    32→#define AUDIO_FFT_SIZE 512
    33→#define AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH 160    // 10ms @ 16kHz
    34→#define AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE 16000
    35→
    36→// Embedding dimension
    37→#define AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM 256
    38→
    39→// TensorFlow Lite memory (small CNN needs ~100-200KB)
    40→#define AUDIO_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE (300 * 1024)  // 300KB arena
    41→
    42→//==============================================================================
    43→// AudioEmbedder - Audio to 256-dim embedding
    44→//==============================================================================
    45→class AudioEmbedder {
    46→public:
    47→    AudioEmbedder();
    48→    ~AudioEmbedder();
    49→
    50→    // Lifecycle - uses provided memory pool
    51→    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize, const char* modelPath);
    52→    void end();
    53→
    54→    // Process recorded audio -> 256-dim embedding
    55→    // audio: int16_t samples at 16kHz
    56→    // sampleCount: number of samples (should be ~3 seconds = 48000)
    57→    // output: float[256] embedding vector
    58→    bool embed(const int16_t* audio, size_t sampleCount, float* output);
    59→
    60→    // Check if loaded
    61→    bool isLoaded() const { return _loaded; }
    62→
    63→    // Memory requirement for pool
    64→    static size_t requiredMemory() { return AUDIO_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE + 100000; }
    65→
    66→private:
    67→    // Mel-spectrogram generation
    68→    bool _initMelSpectrogram();
    69→    void _endMelSpectrogram();
    70→    bool _computeMelSpectrogram(const int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* melOutput);
    71→    void _computeFFTFrame(const int16_t* audio, int startIdx, float* powerSpectrum);
    72→    void _applyMelFilterbank(float* powerSpectrum, float* melOutput);
    73→    float _hzToMel(float hz);
    74→    float _melToHz(float mel);
    75→
    76→    // TFLite inference

     1→/*******************************************************************************
     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Audio Embedding Module
     3→ *
     4→ * Generates 256-dimensional embeddings from recorded audio using:
     5→ * 1. Mel-spectrogram generation (64 bins x 96 frames)
     6→ * 2. Small CNN TFLite inference (~100-300KB model)
     7→ *
     8→ * Model architecture (trained with contrastive learning):
     9→ *   Input: (64, 96, 1) mel-spectrogram
    10→ *   Conv2D 32 -> MaxPool -> Conv2D 64 -> MaxPool ->
    11→ *   Conv2D 128 -> MaxPool -> Conv2D 128 -> GlobalAvgPool -> Dense 256
    12→ *   Output: 256-dim L2-normalized embedding
    13→ ******************************************************************************/
    14→

    16→

    18→

    41→

    44→//==============================================================================

    99→
   100→bool AudioEmbedder::_initMelSpectrogram() {
   101→    int numFreqBins = AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
   102→
   103→    // Allocate mel filterbank
   104→    _melFilterbank = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_MEL_BINS * numFreqBins * sizeof(float));
   105→    if (!_melFilterbank) return false;
   106→
   107→    // Allocate working buffers
   108→    _fftInput = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
   109→    _fftOutput = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * 2 * sizeof(float));
   110→    _window = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
   111→    _melFeatures = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES * sizeof(float));
   112→
   113→    if (!_fftInput || !_fftOutput || !_window || !_melFeatures) {
   114→        _endMelSpectrogram();
   115→        return false;
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    // Initialize ESP-DSP FFT
   119→    esp_err_t ret = dsps_fft2r_init_fc32(NULL, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   120→    if (ret != ESP_OK) {
   121→        _endMelSpectrogram();
   122→        return false;
   123→    }
   124→
   125→    // Create Hann window
   126→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   127→        _window[i] = 0.5f * (1.0f - cosf(2.0f * M_PI * i / (AUDIO_FFT_SIZE - 1)));
   128→    }
   129→
   130→    // Initialize mel filterbank
   131→    float minFreq = 125.0f;
   132→    float maxFreq = 7500.0f;
   133→    float minMel = _hzToMel(minFreq);
   134→    float maxMel = _hzToMel(maxFreq);
   135→
   136→    // Create mel filter centers
   137→    float* melCenters = (float*)malloc((AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 2) * sizeof(float));
   138→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 2; i++) {
   139→        float mel = minMel + (maxMel - minMel) * i / (AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 1);
   140→        melCenters[i] = _melToHz(mel);
   141→    }
   142→
   143→    // Build triangular filters
   144→    float freqRes = (float)AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE / AUDIO_FFT_SIZE;
   145→
   146→    for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
   147→        float left = melCenters[m];
   148→        float center = melCenters[m + 1];
   149→        float right = melCenters[m + 2];
   150→
   151→        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
   152→            float freq = k * freqRes;
   153→            float weight = 0.0f;
   154→
   155→            if (freq >= left && freq <= center) {
   156→                weight = (freq - left) / (center - left);
   157→            } else if (freq > center && freq <= right) {
   158→                weight = (right - freq) / (right - center);
   159→            }
   160→
   161→            _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] = weight;
   162→        }
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    free(melCenters);
   166→    _melInitialized = true;
   167→    return true;
   168→}
   169→
   170→void AudioEmbedder::_endMelSpectrogram() {
   171→    if (_melFilterbank) { free(_melFilterbank); _melFilterbank = nullptr; }
   172→    if (_fftInput) { free(_fftInput); _fftInput = nullptr; }
   173→    if (_fftOutput) { free(_fftOutput); _fftOutput = nullptr; }
   174→    if (_window) { free(_window); _window = nullptr; }
   175→    if (_melFeatures) { free(_melFeatures); _melFeatures = nullptr; }
   176→    _melInitialized = false;
   177→}
   178→
   179→bool AudioEmbedder::_computeMelSpectrogram(const int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* melOutput) {
   180→    if (!_melInitialized) return false;
   181→
   182→    float globalMin = 1e10f;
   183→    float globalMax = -1e10f;
   184→
   185→    // Generate frames - output format: (bins, frames) = (64, 96)
   186→    for (int frame = 0; frame < AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES; frame++) {
   187→        int startIdx = frame * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH;
   188→
   189→        if (startIdx + AUDIO_FFT_SIZE > (int)samples) {
   190→            // Zero-pad remaining frames
   191→            for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; i++) {
   192→                melOutput[i * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES + frame] = -80.0f;
   193→            }
   194→            continue;
   195→        }
   196→
   197→        // Compute power spectrum
   198→        float powerSpectrum[AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1];
   199→        _computeFFTFrame(audio, startIdx, powerSpectrum);
   200→
   201→        // Apply mel filterbank
   202→        float melFrame[AUDIO_MEL_BINS];
   203→        _applyMelFilterbank(powerSpectrum, melFrame);
   204→
   205→        // Store in (bins, frames) format for CNN input
   206→        for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; i++) {
   207→            melOutput[i * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES + frame] = melFrame[i];
   208→            if (melFrame[i] < globalMin) globalMin = melFrame[i];
   209→            if (melFrame[i] > globalMax) globalMax = melFrame[i];
   210→        }
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    // Normalize to [0, 1] range (like training)
   214→    float range = globalMax - globalMin;
   215→    if (range > 1e-8f) {
   216→        for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES; i++) {
   217→            melOutput[i] = (melOutput[i] - globalMin) / range;
   218→        }
   219→    }
   220→
   221→    return true;
   222→}
   223→
   224→void AudioEmbedder::_computeFFTFrame(const int16_t* audio, int startIdx, float* powerSpectrum) {
   225→    // Apply window and convert to float
   226→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   227→        _fftInput[i] = (float)audio[startIdx + i] * _window[i] / 32768.0f;
   228→    }
   229→
   230→    // Prepare complex input (real part only)
   231→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   232→        _fftOutput[i * 2] = _fftInput[i];
   233→        _fftOutput[i * 2 + 1] = 0.0f;
   234→    }
   235→
   236→    // Compute FFT using ESP-DSP
   237→    dsps_fft2r_fc32(_fftOutput, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   238→    dsps_bit_rev_fc32(_fftOutput, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   239→
   240→    // Compute power spectrum: |X[k]|^2
   241→    for (int k = 0; k < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1; k++) {
   242→        float real = _fftOutput[k * 2];
   243→        float imag = _fftOutput[k * 2 + 1];
   244→        powerSpectrum[k] = real * real + imag * imag;
   245→    }
   246→}
   247→
   248→void AudioEmbedder::_applyMelFilterbank(float* powerSpectrum, float* melOutput) {
   249→    int numFreqBins = AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
   250→
   251→    for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
   252→        float sum = 0.0f;
   253→
   254→        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
   255→            sum += _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] * powerSpectrum[k];
   256→        }
   257→
   258→        // Log transform
   259→        melOutput[m] = log10f(sum + 1e-10f);
   260→    }
   261→}
   262→
   263→float AudioEmbedder::_hzToMel(float hz) {
   264→    return 2595.0f * log10f(1.0f + hz / 700.0f);
   265→}
   266→
   267→float AudioEmbedder::_melToHz(float mel) {
   268→    return 700.0f * (powf(10.0f, mel / 2595.0f) - 1.0f);
   269→}
   270→
   271→//==============================================================================
   272→// TFLite Implementation
   273→//==============================================================================
   274→
   275→bool AudioEmbedder::_loadModel(const char* path) {
   276→    File f = SD.open(path);
   277→    if (!f) {
   278→        Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Cannot open %s\n", path);
   279→        return false;
   280→    }
   281→
   282→    _modelSize = f.size();
   283→    _modelData = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_modelSize);
   284→    if (!_modelData) {
   285→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Model alloc failed");
   286→        f.close();
   287→        return false;
   288→    }
   289→
   290→    if (f.read(_modelData, _modelSize) != _modelSize) {
   291→        free(_modelData);
   292→        _modelData = nullptr;
   293→        f.close();
   294→        return false;
   295→    }
   296→    f.close();
   297→    return true;
   298→}
   299→
   300→bool AudioEmbedder::_initInterpreter() {
   301→    const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(_modelData);
   302→    if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
   303→        Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Model version mismatch: %d vs %d\n",
   304→                      model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
   305→        return false;
   306→    }
   307→
   308→    // Op resolver for small CNN audio encoder
   309→    // Architecture: Conv2D -> MaxPool -> Conv2D -> MaxPool -> Conv2D -> MaxPool ->
   310→    //               Conv2D -> GlobalAvgPool -> Dense -> L2Normalize
   311→    static tflite::MicroMutableOpResolver<12> resolver;
   312→    resolver.AddConv2D();
   313→    resolver.AddMaxPool2D();
   314→    resolver.AddFullyConnected();
   315→    resolver.AddReshape();
   316→    resolver.AddMean();              // For GlobalAveragePooling2D
   317→    resolver.AddL2Normalization();   // For L2 normalize layer
   318→    resolver.AddQuantize();
   319→    resolver.AddDequantize();
   320→    resolver.AddRelu();              // Activation
   321→    resolver.AddPad();
   322→    resolver.AddSqueeze();
   323→    resolver.AddExpandDims();
   324→
   325→    // Create interpreter
   326→    static tflite::MicroInterpreter staticInterpreter(
   327→        model, resolver, _tensorArena, AUDIO_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE);
   328→    _interpreter = &staticInterpreter;
   329→
   330→    if (_interpreter->AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
   331→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: AllocateTensors failed");
   332→        return false;
   333→    }
   334→
   335→    _inputTensor = _interpreter->input(0);
   336→    _outputTensor = _interpreter->output(0);
   337→
   338→    if (!_inputTensor || !_outputTensor) {
   339→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Failed to get tensors");
   340→        return false;
   341→    }
   342→
   343→    // Log tensor shapes
   344→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Input [%d, %d, %d, %d]\n",
   345→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[0],
   346→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[1],
   347→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[2],
   348→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[3]);
   349→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Output [%d, %d]\n",
   350→                  _outputTensor->dims->data[0],
   351→                  _outputTensor->dims->data[1]);
   352→
   353→    return true;
   354→}
   355→
   356→bool AudioEmbedder::_runInference(const float* melFeatures, float* embedding) {
   357→    // Input shape: [1, 64, 96, 1] = [batch, bins, frames, channel]
   358→    int inputSize = AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES;
   359→
   360→    // Fill input tensor
   361→    if (_inputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   362→        int8_t* inputData = _inputTensor->data.int8;
   363→        float scale = _inputTensor->params.scale;
   364→        int32_t zeroPoint = _inputTensor->params.zero_point;
   365→
   366→        for (int i = 0; i < inputSize; i++) {
   367→            int32_t quantized = (int32_t)(melFeatures[i] / scale + zeroPoint);
   368→            inputData[i] = constrain(quantized, -128, 127);
   369→        }
   370→    } else {
   371→        // Float input
   372→        float* inputData = _inputTensor->data.f;
   373→        memcpy(inputData, melFeatures, inputSize * sizeof(float));
   374→    }
   375→
   376→    // Run inference
   377→    if (_interpreter->Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
   378→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Invoke failed");
   379→        return false;
   380→    }
   381→
   382→    // Extract embedding (256-dim)
   383→    int outputDim = _outputTensor->dims->data[1];
   384→
   385→    if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   386→        int8_t* outputData = _outputTensor->data.int8;
   387→        float scale = _outputTensor->params.scale;
   388→        int32_t zeroPoint = _outputTensor->params.zero_point;
   389→
   390→        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
   391→            embedding[i] = (outputData[i] - zeroPoint) * scale;
   392→        }
   393→    } else {
   394→        float* outputData = _outputTensor->data.f;
   395→        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
   396→            embedding[i] = outputData[i];
   397→        }
   398→    }
   399→
   400→    return true;
   401→}
   402→
   403→//==============================================================================
   404→// Public API
   405→//==============================================================================
   406→
   407→bool AudioEmbedder::embed(const int16_t* audio, size_t sampleCount, float* output) {
   408→    if (!_loaded) return false;
   409→
   410→    unsigned long startTime = millis();
   411→
   412→    // Step 1: Compute mel-spectrogram
   413→    if (!_computeMelSpectrogram(audio, sampleCount, _melFeatures)) {
   414→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Mel computation failed");
   415→        return false;
   416→    }
   417→
   418→    unsigned long melTime = millis();
   419→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Mel-spec took %lu ms\n", melTime - startTime);
   420→

   100→bool AudioEmbedder::_initMelSpectrogram() {
   101→    int numFreqBins = AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
   102→
   103→    // Allocate mel filterbank
   104→    _melFilterbank = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_MEL_BINS * numFreqBins * sizeof(float));
   105→    if (!_melFilterbank) return false;
   106→
   107→    // Allocate working buffers
   108→    _fftInput = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
   109→    _fftOutput = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * 2 * sizeof(float));
   110→    _window = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_FFT_SIZE * sizeof(float));
   111→    _melFeatures = (float*)ps_malloc(AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES * sizeof(float));
   112→
   113→    if (!_fftInput || !_fftOutput || !_window || !_melFeatures) {
   114→        _endMelSpectrogram();
   115→        return false;
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    // Initialize ESP-DSP FFT
   119→    esp_err_t ret = dsps_fft2r_init_fc32(NULL, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   120→    if (ret != ESP_OK) {
   121→        _endMelSpectrogram();
   122→        return false;
   123→    }
   124→
   125→    // Create Hann window
   126→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   127→        _window[i] = 0.5f * (1.0f - cosf(2.0f * M_PI * i / (AUDIO_FFT_SIZE - 1)));
   128→    }
   129→
   130→    // Initialize mel filterbank
   131→    float minFreq = 125.0f;
   132→    float maxFreq = 7500.0f;
   133→    float minMel = _hzToMel(minFreq);
   134→    float maxMel = _hzToMel(maxFreq);
   135→
   136→    // Create mel filter centers
   137→    float* melCenters = (float*)malloc((AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 2) * sizeof(float));
   138→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 2; i++) {
   139→        float mel = minMel + (maxMel - minMel) * i / (AUDIO_MEL_BINS + 1);
   140→        melCenters[i] = _melToHz(mel);
   141→    }
   142→
   143→    // Build triangular filters
   144→    float freqRes = (float)AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE / AUDIO_FFT_SIZE;
   145→
   146→    for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
   147→        float left = melCenters[m];
   148→        float center = melCenters[m + 1];
   149→        float right = melCenters[m + 2];
   150→
   151→        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
   152→            float freq = k * freqRes;
   153→            float weight = 0.0f;
   154→
   155→            if (freq >= left && freq <= center) {
   156→                weight = (freq - left) / (center - left);
   157→            } else if (freq > center && freq <= right) {
   158→                weight = (right - freq) / (right - center);
   159→            }
   160→
   161→            _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] = weight;
   162→        }
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    free(melCenters);
   166→    _melInitialized = true;
   167→    return true;
   168→}
   169→
   170→void AudioEmbedder::_endMelSpectrogram() {
   171→    if (_melFilterbank) { free(_melFilterbank); _melFilterbank = nullptr; }
   172→    if (_fftInput) { free(_fftInput); _fftInput = nullptr; }
   173→    if (_fftOutput) { free(_fftOutput); _fftOutput = nullptr; }
   174→    if (_window) { free(_window); _window = nullptr; }
   175→    if (_melFeatures) { free(_melFeatures); _melFeatures = nullptr; }
   176→    _melInitialized = false;
   177→}
   178→
   179→bool AudioEmbedder::_computeMelSpectrogram(const int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* melOutput) {
   180→    if (!_melInitialized) return false;
   181→
   182→    float globalMin = 1e10f;
   183→    float globalMax = -1e10f;
   184→
   185→    // Generate frames - output format: (bins, frames) = (64, 96)
   186→    for (int frame = 0; frame < AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES; frame++) {
   187→        int startIdx = frame * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH;
   188→
   189→        if (startIdx + AUDIO_FFT_SIZE > (int)samples) {
   190→            // Zero-pad remaining frames
   191→            for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; i++) {
   192→                melOutput[i * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES + frame] = -80.0f;
   193→            }
   194→            continue;
   195→        }
   196→
   197→        // Compute power spectrum
   198→        float powerSpectrum[AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1];
   199→        _computeFFTFrame(audio, startIdx, powerSpectrum);
   200→
   201→        // Apply mel filterbank
   202→        float melFrame[AUDIO_MEL_BINS];
   203→        _applyMelFilterbank(powerSpectrum, melFrame);
   204→
   205→        // Store in (bins, frames) format for CNN input
   206→        for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; i++) {
   207→            melOutput[i * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES + frame] = melFrame[i];
   208→            if (melFrame[i] < globalMin) globalMin = melFrame[i];
   209→            if (melFrame[i] > globalMax) globalMax = melFrame[i];
   210→        }
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    // Normalize to [0, 1] range (like training)
   214→    float range = globalMax - globalMin;
   215→    if (range > 1e-8f) {
   216→        for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES; i++) {
   217→            melOutput[i] = (melOutput[i] - globalMin) / range;
   218→        }
   219→    }
   220→
   221→    return true;
   222→}
   223→
   224→void AudioEmbedder::_computeFFTFrame(const int16_t* audio, int startIdx, float* powerSpectrum) {
   225→    // Apply window and convert to float
   226→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   227→        _fftInput[i] = (float)audio[startIdx + i] * _window[i] / 32768.0f;
   228→    }
   229→
   230→    // Prepare complex input (real part only)
   231→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE; i++) {
   232→        _fftOutput[i * 2] = _fftInput[i];
   233→        _fftOutput[i * 2 + 1] = 0.0f;
   234→    }
   235→
   236→    // Compute FFT using ESP-DSP
   237→    dsps_fft2r_fc32(_fftOutput, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   238→    dsps_bit_rev_fc32(_fftOutput, AUDIO_FFT_SIZE);
   239→
   240→    // Compute power spectrum: |X[k]|^2
   241→    for (int k = 0; k < AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1; k++) {
   242→        float real = _fftOutput[k * 2];
   243→        float imag = _fftOutput[k * 2 + 1];
   244→        powerSpectrum[k] = real * real + imag * imag;
   245→    }
   246→}
   247→
   248→void AudioEmbedder::_applyMelFilterbank(float* powerSpectrum, float* melOutput) {
   249→    int numFreqBins = AUDIO_FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;
   250→
   251→    for (int m = 0; m < AUDIO_MEL_BINS; m++) {
   252→        float sum = 0.0f;
   253→
   254→        for (int k = 0; k < numFreqBins; k++) {
   255→            sum += _melFilterbank[m * numFreqBins + k] * powerSpectrum[k];
   256→        }
   257→
   258→        // Log transform
   259→        melOutput[m] = log10f(sum + 1e-10f);
   260→    }
   261→}
   262→
   263→float AudioEmbedder::_hzToMel(float hz) {
   264→    return 2595.0f * log10f(1.0f + hz / 700.0f);
   265→}
   266→
   267→float AudioEmbedder::_melToHz(float mel) {
   268→    return 700.0f * (powf(10.0f, mel / 2595.0f) - 1.0f);
   269→}

   271→//==============================================================================
   272→// TFLite Implementation
   273→//==============================================================================
   274→
   275→bool AudioEmbedder::_loadModel(const char* path) {
   276→    File f = SD.open(path);
   277→    if (!f) {
   278→        Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Cannot open %s\n", path);
   279→        return false;
   280→    }
   281→
   282→    _modelSize = f.size();
   283→    _modelData = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_modelSize);
   284→    if (!_modelData) {
   285→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Model alloc failed");
   286→        f.close();
   287→        return false;
   288→    }
   289→
   290→    if (f.read(_modelData, _modelSize) != _modelSize) {
   291→        free(_modelData);
   292→        _modelData = nullptr;
   293→        f.close();
   294→        return false;
   295→    }
   296→    f.close();
   297→    return true;
   298→}
   299→
   300→bool AudioEmbedder::_initInterpreter() {
   301→    const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(_modelData);
   302→    if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
   303→        Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Model version mismatch: %d vs %d\n",
   304→                      model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
   305→        return false;
   306→    }
   307→
   308→    // Op resolver for small CNN audio encoder
   309→    // Architecture: Conv2D -> MaxPool -> Conv2D -> MaxPool -> Conv2D -> MaxPool ->
   310→    //               Conv2D -> GlobalAvgPool -> Dense -> L2Normalize
   311→    static tflite::MicroMutableOpResolver<12> resolver;
   312→    resolver.AddConv2D();
   313→    resolver.AddMaxPool2D();
   314→    resolver.AddFullyConnected();
   315→    resolver.AddReshape();
   316→    resolver.AddMean();              // For GlobalAveragePooling2D
   317→    resolver.AddL2Normalization();   // For L2 normalize layer
   318→    resolver.AddQuantize();
   319→    resolver.AddDequantize();
   320→    resolver.AddRelu();              // Activation
   321→    resolver.AddPad();
   322→    resolver.AddSqueeze();
   323→    resolver.AddExpandDims();
   324→
   325→    // Create interpreter
   326→    static tflite::MicroInterpreter staticInterpreter(
   327→        model, resolver, _tensorArena, AUDIO_TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE);
   328→    _interpreter = &staticInterpreter;
   329→
   330→    if (_interpreter->AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
   331→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: AllocateTensors failed");
   332→        return false;
   333→    }
   334→
   335→    _inputTensor = _interpreter->input(0);
   336→    _outputTensor = _interpreter->output(0);
   337→
   338→    if (!_inputTensor || !_outputTensor) {
   339→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Failed to get tensors");
   340→        return false;
   341→    }
   342→
   343→    // Log tensor shapes
   344→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Input [%d, %d, %d, %d]\n",
   345→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[0],
   346→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[1],
   347→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[2],
   348→                  _inputTensor->dims->data[3]);
   349→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Output [%d, %d]\n",
   350→                  _outputTensor->dims->data[0],
   351→                  _outputTensor->dims->data[1]);
   352→
   353→    return true;
   354→}
   355→
   356→bool AudioEmbedder::_runInference(const float* melFeatures, float* embedding) {
   357→    // Input shape: [1, 64, 96, 1] = [batch, bins, frames, channel]
   358→    int inputSize = AUDIO_MEL_BINS * AUDIO_MEL_FRAMES;
   359→
   360→    // Fill input tensor
   361→    if (_inputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   362→        int8_t* inputData = _inputTensor->data.int8;
   363→        float scale = _inputTensor->params.scale;
   364→        int32_t zeroPoint = _inputTensor->params.zero_point;
   365→
   366→        for (int i = 0; i < inputSize; i++) {
   367→            int32_t quantized = (int32_t)(melFeatures[i] / scale + zeroPoint);
   368→            inputData[i] = constrain(quantized, -128, 127);
   369→        }
   370→    } else {
   371→        // Float input
   372→        float* inputData = _inputTensor->data.f;
   373→        memcpy(inputData, melFeatures, inputSize * sizeof(float));
   374→    }
   375→
   376→    // Run inference
   377→    if (_interpreter->Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
   378→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Invoke failed");
   379→        return false;
   380→    }
   381→
   382→    // Extract embedding (256-dim)
   383→    int outputDim = _outputTensor->dims->data[1];
   384→
   385→    if (_outputTensor->type == kTfLiteInt8) {
   386→        int8_t* outputData = _outputTensor->data.int8;
   387→        float scale = _outputTensor->params.scale;
   388→        int32_t zeroPoint = _outputTensor->params.zero_point;
   389→
   390→        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
   391→            embedding[i] = (outputData[i] - zeroPoint) * scale;
   392→        }
   393→    } else {
   394→        float* outputData = _outputTensor->data.f;
   395→        for (int i = 0; i < outputDim && i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i++) {
   396→            embedding[i] = outputData[i];
   397→        }
   398→    }
   399→
   400→    return true;
   401→}
   402→
   403→//==============================================================================
   404→// Public API
   405→//==============================================================================
   406→
   407→bool AudioEmbedder::embed(const int16_t* audio, size_t sampleCount, float* output) {
   408→    if (!_loaded) return false;
   409→
   410→    unsigned long startTime = millis();
   411→
   412→    // Step 1: Compute mel-spectrogram
   413→    if (!_computeMelSpectrogram(audio, sampleCount, _melFeatures)) {
   414→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Mel computation failed");
   415→        return false;
   416→    }
   417→
   418→    unsigned long melTime = millis();
   419→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Mel-spec took %lu ms\n", melTime - startTime);
   420→
   421→    // Step 2: Run CNN inference
   422→    if (!_runInference(_melFeatures, output)) {
   423→        Serial.println("AudioEmbed: Inference failed");
   424→        return false;
   425→    }
   426→
   427→    unsigned long inferTime = millis();
   428→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Inference took %lu ms\n", inferTime - melTime);
   429→    Serial.printf("AudioEmbed: Total time: %lu ms\n", inferTime - startTime);
   430→
   431→    return true;
   432→}

    23→//==============================================================================

   105→bool EmbeddingSearch::_loadIntents(const char* path) {
   106→    File f = SD.open(path);
   107→    if (!f) {
   108→        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Cannot open %s\n", path);
   109→        return false;
   110→    }
   111→
   112→    // Read entire file into memory
   113→    size_t fileSize = f.size();
   114→    _intentsData = (char*)ps_malloc(fileSize + 1);
   115→    if (!_intentsData) {
   116→        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Intents alloc failed");
   117→        f.close();
   118→        return false;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    f.read((uint8_t*)_intentsData, fileSize);
   122→    _intentsData[fileSize] = '\0';
   123→    f.close();
   124→
   125→    // Count lines and build offset table
   126→    int lineCount = 0;
   127→    for (size_t i = 0; i < fileSize; i++) {
   128→        if (_intentsData[i] == '\n') lineCount++;
   129→    }
   130→    // Add 1 if file doesn't end with newline
   131→    if (fileSize > 0 && _intentsData[fileSize - 1] != '\n') lineCount++;
   132→
   133→    // Verify line count matches embedding count
   134→    if (lineCount < _count) {
   135→        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Intent count mismatch: %d lines vs %d embeddings\n",
   136→                      lineCount, _count);
   137→        // Use minimum
   138→        _count = lineCount;
   139→    }
   140→
   141→    // Build offset table
   142→    _intentOffsets = (int*)ps_malloc(_count * sizeof(int));
   143→    if (!_intentOffsets) {
   144→        Serial.println("EmbedSearch: Offsets alloc failed");
   145→        free(_intentsData);
   146→        _intentsData = nullptr;
   147→        return false;
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    int line = 0;
   151→    _intentOffsets[0] = 0;
   152→
   153→    for (size_t i = 0; i < fileSize && line < _count; i++) {
   154→        if (_intentsData[i] == '\n') {
   155→            _intentsData[i] = '\0';  // Replace newline with null terminator
   156→            line++;
   157→            if (line < _count) {
   158→                _intentOffsets[line] = i + 1;
   159→            }
   160→        }
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Loaded %d intents\n", _count);
   164→    return true;
   165→}
   166→
   167→void EmbeddingSearch::_getIntent(int idx, char* buffer, size_t bufSize) {
   168→    if (idx < 0 || idx >= _count || !_intentsData || !_intentOffsets) {
   169→        buffer[0] = '\0';
   170→        return;
   171→    }
   172→
   173→    const char* intentStr = _intentsData + _intentOffsets[idx];
   174→    strncpy(buffer, intentStr, bufSize - 1);
   175→    buffer[bufSize - 1] = '\0';
   176→}
   177→
   178→float EmbeddingSearch::_cosineSimilarity(const float* a, const float* b) {
   179→    float dot = 0.0f;
   180→    float normA = 0.0f;
   181→    float normB = 0.0f;
   182→
   183→    // Unrolled loop for better performance
   184→    for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM; i += 4) {
   185→        dot += a[i] * b[i] + a[i+1] * b[i+1] + a[i+2] * b[i+2] + a[i+3] * b[i+3];
   186→        normA += a[i] * a[i] + a[i+1] * a[i+1] + a[i+2] * a[i+2] + a[i+3] * a[i+3];
   187→        normB += b[i] * b[i] + b[i+1] * b[i+1] + b[i+2] * b[i+2] + b[i+3] * b[i+3];
   188→    }
   189→
   190→    float denom = sqrtf(normA) * sqrtf(normB);
   191→    if (denom < 1e-8f) return 0.0f;
   192→
   193→    return dot / denom;
   194→}
   195→
   196→SearchResult EmbeddingSearch::search(const float* embedding) {
   197→    SearchResult result;
   198→    result.intentIdx = -1;
   199→    result.score = -1.0f;
   200→    result.intent[0] = '\0';
   201→
   202→    if (!_loaded || !embedding) {
   203→        return result;
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    unsigned long startTime = millis();
   207→
   208→    float bestScore = -1.0f;
   209→    int bestIdx = -1;
   210→
   211→    // Linear search through all embeddings
   212→    for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++) {
   213→        float score = _cosineSimilarity(embedding, &_embeddings[i * AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM]);
   214→
   215→        if (score > bestScore) {
   216→            bestScore = score;
   217→            bestIdx = i;
   218→        }
   219→    }
   220→
   221→    unsigned long searchTime = millis() - startTime;
   222→    Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: Searched %d embeddings in %lu ms\n", _count, searchTime);
   223→
   224→    if (bestIdx >= 0) {
   225→        result.intentIdx = bestIdx;
   226→        result.score = bestScore;
   227→        _getIntent(bestIdx, result.intent, sizeof(result.intent));
   228→    }
   229→
   230→    return result;
   231→}
   232→

     1→// llm_core.h - Int8 Quantized LLM Inference for ESP32-S3
     2→// Based on llama2.c/runq.c - Single-core, adaptive to any model size
     3→// Supports 1M-6M models with 512/768/1024 vocab sizes
     4→// Optimized with ESP-DSP PIE SIMD instructions
     5→
     6→#ifndef LLM_CORE_H
     7→#define LLM_CORE_H
     8→
     9→#include <Arduino.h>
    10→#include <SD.h>
    11→
    12→// ESP-DSP library (pre-built in Arduino ESP32 core)
    13→#include "dsps_dotprod.h"   // dsps_dotprod_f32_aes3() - Float SIMD dot product
    14→#include "dsps_mulc.h"      // dsps_mulc_f32_ae32() - Scalar multiply
    15→#include "dsps_add.h"       // dsps_add_f32_ae32() - Vector add
    16→#include "dsps_mul.h"       // dsps_mul_f32_ae32() - Element-wise multiply
    17→
    18→// Type alias for compatibility with tokenizer/sampler (originally SIMD, now plain float)
    19→typedef float v4sf;
    20→
    21→// Global group size for quantization (read from model file header)
    22→extern int GS;
    23→
    24→// Quantized tensor (int8 weights + per-group float scales)
    25→typedef struct {
    26→    int8_t* q;    // Quantized int8 values
    27→    float* s;     // Scale factors (one per group_size values)
    28→} QuantizedTensor;
    29→
    30→// Model config (read from 256-byte Q8_0 header, adapts to any model size)
    31→typedef struct {
    32→    int dim;        // Model dimension (128-224 for 1M-6M)
    33→    int hidden_dim; // FFN hidden size (512-896)
    34→    int n_layers;   // Number of transformer layers (4-8)
    35→    int n_heads;    // Number of attention heads (8)
    36→    int n_kv_heads; // Number of KV heads for GQA (4)
    37→    int vocab_size; // Vocabulary size (512, 768, or 1024)
    38→    int seq_len;    // Max sequence length (256)
    39→} Config;
    40→
    41→// Quantized transformer weights (from runq.c pattern)
    42→typedef struct {
    43→    // Token embeddings - DEQUANTIZED to fp32 at load time for fast lookup
    44→    QuantizedTensor *q_tokens;
    45→    float* token_embedding_table;  // Dequantized copy
    46→
    47→    // RMS norms - stored as fp32 in model file (NOT quantized)
    48→    float* rms_att_weight;   // Per-layer attention norm
    49→    float* rms_ffn_weight;   // Per-layer FFN norm
    50→    float* rms_final_weight; // Final norm before classifier
    51→
    52→    // Quantized attention weights (array of QuantizedTensor, one per layer)
    53→    QuantizedTensor *wq;  // Query projection
    54→    QuantizedTensor *wk;  // Key projection
    55→    QuantizedTensor *wv;  // Value projection
    56→    QuantizedTensor *wo;  // Output projection
    57→
    58→    // Quantized FFN weights (array of QuantizedTensor, one per layer)
